0004ade2a3d1d57f.source: The extension is connected, but MDM's own settings leave this download to the browser. Check, in MDM:
0004ade2a3d1d57f.text: 扩展程序已连接，但 MDM 的设置会让此下载由浏览器处理。请检查 MDM 中的以下设置：

001408812fbef8cb.source: RSS feeds: the feeds MDM follows and their items
001408812fbef8cb.text: RSS 源：MDM 订阅的源及其条目

00161c105e829376.source: Every message to MDM also says which browser it comes from (its name, as the browser tells it) and the extension's version.
00161c105e829376.text: 发送给 MDM 的每条消息还会说明消息来自哪个浏览器（浏览器提供的名称）以及扩展程序的版本。

0022aa34a898269c.source: <g1>A YouTube playlist in Add URL</g1> (<g2>#338</g2>) opens the video window with its videos, instead of saving the page as a file named "playlist".
0022aa34a898269c.text: <g1>在“添加 URL”中添加 YouTube 播放列表</g1>（<g2>#338</g2>）会打开带有其视频的视频窗口，而不是将页面保存为名为“playlist”的文件。

0025b509f2663050.source: Runs on most distributions: make it executable (<x1/>) and run it. It updates itself in place (<g2>Help → Check for updates</g2>).
0025b509f2663050.text: 可在大多数发行版上运行：使其可执行（<x1/>）并运行。它会原地更新（<g2>帮助 → 检查更新</g2>）。

003e18571307edf6.source: <g1>Under your speed limits</g1>: the <g2>Speed Limiter</g2>'s, the video's own (its progress window's <g3>Speed Limiter</g3> tab), and the limit for all downloads together. A change applies at once.
003e18571307edf6.text: <g1>在您的速度限制下</g1>：包括<g2>速度限制器</g2>的限制、视频本身的限制（其进度窗口的<g3>速度限制器</g3>选项卡），以及所有下载任务的总限制。任何更改都会立即生效。

0047e3c92be9288c.source: After a few months the list can hold hundreds of downloads. Here are four ways to get to the one you want.
0047e3c92be9288c.text: 几个月后，列表可能会包含数百个下载。这里有四种方法可以找到您想要的下载。

004fe4f40346b65b.source: MDM now goes well beyond single videos: whole playlists, subtitles, sound on its own, and picture galleries.
004fe4f40346b65b.text: MDM 现在远不止支持单个视频：它支持整个播放列表、字幕、单独的音频和图片库。

006bcd211ae86394.source: These pages explain each part of the program. The tutorials walk through the things people do most, one task each.
006bcd211ae86394.text: 这些页面介绍了程序的各个部分。教程会逐步讲解大家最常做的操作，每个教程介绍一项操作。

00a7253abb008136.source: Report a problem with a translation →

00c4e6015cb2a0d5.source: In <g1>Link grabber</g1>, the volumes of one archive form one package. Each package has its folder, the archives' password, <g2>Extract when done</g2> (ticked by itself when the package holds an archive) and <g3>Delete archives after extracting</g3>. The password is kept in memory only, never written to disk.
00c4e6015cb2a0d5.text: 在<g1>链接抓取器</g1>中，一个压缩包的所有分卷会组成一个包。每个包都有自己的文件夹、压缩包密码、<g2>完成后提取</g2>（当包包含压缩包时会自动勾选）和<g3>提取后删除存档</g3>。密码仅保存在内存中，绝不会写入磁盘。

00de390616043a08.source: <g1>The toolbar button</g1> says whether the browser reaches MDM, and <g2>How to fix it</g2> opens the help for the reason. When a setting leaves a download to the browser (its type isn't in <g3>File types</g3>, its site is excluded, it's under the minimum size), the button names the setting and the file, and MDM's log keeps a line for each.
00de390616043a08.text: <g1>工具栏按钮</g1>显示浏览器是否连接到 MDM，点击<g2>如何修复</g2>可查看原因的帮助。当某个设置将下载留给浏览器处理时（文件类型不在<g3>文件类型</g3>中、网站被排除、文件小于最小尺寸），按钮会显示该设置和文件名，MDM 的日志中也会记录每一项。

00deae29052686c9.source: The download list, text boxes and menus
00deae29052686c9.text: 下载列表、文本框和菜单

00dfff13e69e9ac7.text: 一个列表，管理所有下载

015f73be8184c2cb.source: Yes. MDM writes its progress as it goes, so after a lost connection, a crash or a restart it carries on where it stopped. Before resuming it checks that the file on the server hasn't changed. When a download address has expired, <g1>Refresh download address</g1> lets you give it a fresh one and keep the data. See <g2>Resume a broken download</g2>.
015f73be8184c2cb.text: 可以。MDM 会实时写入下载进度，因此在连接丢失、程序崩溃或重启后，它会从中断的地方继续。恢复下载前，它会检查服务器上的文件是否已更改。当下载地址过期时，您可以使用<g1>刷新下载地址</g1>来提供新的地址并保留已下载的数据。请参阅<g2>恢复中断的下载</g2>。

016a9690b4c55ee5.source: Both are kept in a <x1/> folder in MDM's data folder.
016a9690b4c55ee5.text: 两者都保存在 MDM 数据文件夹中的 <x1/> 文件夹里。

017e6920369637f6.source: <g1>One look for every kind of control</g1>, in both themes: text boxes, read-only fields, check boxes, buttons, drop-downs, tabs, lists and their headers, popups and progress bars are each drawn one way everywhere (dark mode drew some windows' controls in an older style, with bright borders). A number and its arrows are one box now, as Windows 11's are; text is centred in controls of any height; one blue for selection and focus.
017e6920369637f6.text: <g1>两种主题下的所有控件外观统一</g1>：文本框、只读字段、复选框、按钮、下拉菜单、选项卡、列表及其标题、弹出窗口和进度条在各处的绘制方式都一致（以前深色模式下，某些窗口中的控件使用旧样式，边框较亮）。数字和箭头现在位于同一个框中，就像 Windows 11 中一样；不同高度的控件中文本都居中显示；选中项和焦点统一使用蓝色。

017ea75600814341.source: Open <g1>View → Theme</g1> and click a theme: the whole window changes at once, nothing to restart. <g2>View → Dark Mode support</g2> and <g3>View → Always dark</g3> then choose its light or dark side, as for the classic look (<g4>Dark mode</g4>).
017ea75600814341.text: 打开<g1>视图 → 主题</g1>，然后点击一个主题：整个窗口会立即改变，无需重启。然后，<g2>视图 → 深色模式支持</g2>和<g3>视图 → 始终为深色</g3>会选择其浅色或深色模式，就像经典外观一样（<g4>深色模式</g4>）。

01bcaeaab78b066e.source: A page address that points at one video inside a playlist or a mix (for example <x1/>) downloads that one video, never the whole list.
01bcaeaab78b066e.text: 如果页面地址指向播放列表或混音中的某个视频（例如 <x1/>），只会下载该视频，不会下载整个列表。

01bff8c60e4100a3.source: <g1>Torrent → Files…</g1>: the list of a torrent's files for any torrent, running, stopped or finished, with a box to choose each (also a Files… button in File Properties).
01bff8c60e4100a3.text: <g1>种子 → 文件…</g1>：显示任何种子（运行中、已停止或已完成）的文件列表，并提供复选框供选择（“文件属性”中也有“文件…”按钮）。

01c4c1faa63db5e5.source: Add it to the main download queue without starting it.
01c4c1faa63db5e5.text: 将其添加到主下载队列，但不开始下载。

01d01057d15da7cc.source: A server far by its round trip (over 150 ms)
01d01057d15da7cc.text: 往返时间较长（超过 150 毫秒）的服务器

01e8f0b4acca66a4.source: <g1>Start Download</g1> (or <g2>Enter</g2>) — download now. The progress window opens.
01e8f0b4acca66a4.text: <g1>开始下载</g1>（或<g2>Enter</g2>） — 立即下载。进度窗口打开。

01e9f180dc2a2477.source: <g1>MDM offers the browser extension</g1>: until a browser's extension has reached MDM, each start shows <g2>Add Mister Download Manager to your browser</g2>, with a button for every browser installed, which opens its store page (<g3>Install it by hand</g3> stays there for a browser that can't use its store). The window says when the extension is connected; <g4>Don't ask again</g4> stops it.
01e9f180dc2a2477.text: <g1>MDM 提供浏览器扩展</g1>：在浏览器的扩展到达 MDM 之前，每次启动都会显示<g2>将 Mister Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>，并为每个已安装的浏览器提供一个按钮，点击后会打开其商店页面（对于无法使用商店的浏览器，<g3>手动安装</g3>会保留）。窗口会显示扩展何时连接；<g4>不再询问</g4>会停止此提示。

02134bd4a394a140.source: Torrents and magnet links, in the list you already use.
02134bd4a394a140.text: 种子和磁力链接，就在您已使用的列表中。

022606906a44694b.source: <g1>Download Mister Download Manager</g1> and install it; keep <g2>Set up browser integration</g2> ticked.
022606906a44694b.text: <g1>下载 Mister Download Manager</g1>并安装；勾选<g2>设置浏览器集成</g2>。

02371ffa84de243f.source: Yes. Put downloads in a queue and let the Scheduler start it at a set time, stop it at another, and even shut down or put the computer to sleep when the queue is done. See <g1>Download overnight</g1>.
02371ffa84de243f.text: 可以。将下载任务放入队列，让计划程序在设定时间开始，在另一时间停止，甚至在队列完成后关闭或休眠计算机。请参阅<g1>通宵下载</g1>。

0255cefc03d71cf4.source: <g1><g2>Keep some speed for everything else</g2></g1> — cap MDM so browsing and calls stay smooth.
0255cefc03d71cf4.text: <g1><g2>为其他任务留出带宽</g2></g1> — 限制 MDM 的下载速度，让网页浏览和通话保持流畅。

02676ddab1e18999.source: Click a download link in the browser: Download File Info opens in MDM.
02676ddab1e18999.text: 在浏览器中点击下载链接：MDM 中会打开“下载文件信息”窗口。

026a1b767daa1fa2.source: <g1>File name or part of the name</g1> — on by default.
026a1b767daa1fa2.text: <g1>文件名或名称的一部分</g1> — 默认开启。

029733b9b37c66ba.source: MDM is also in <g1>WinGet</g1>, Windows' package manager. In a terminal, the first line installs MDM and the second updates it to the latest version:
029733b9b37c66ba.text: MDM 也可在 Windows 的包管理器 <g1>WinGet</g1> 中获取。在终端中，第一行安装 MDM，第二行将其更新到最新版本：

02a38777a650e8a4.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>Video from a page</g3> <g4>Paste a page's address and choose a quality, up to 4K, from YouTube, Vimeo and thousands of other sites.</g4>
02a38777a650e8a4.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>下载网页视频</g3> <g4>粘贴网页地址，即可从 YouTube、Vimeo 和数千个其他网站选择画质，最高可达 4K。</g4>

02a3ebd04f6ae293.source: Each release lists the <g1>SHA-256</g1> checksum of every file in <x2/>. Check your download against it: see <g3>Download</g3>.
02a3ebd04f6ae293.text: 每个版本都列出了 <x2/> 中每个文件的 <g1>SHA-256</g1> 校验和。请对照它检查您的下载：请参阅<g3>下载</g3>。

02a4b2146e962eb9.source: <g1>Dark Mode support follows the desktop, on every desktop</g1> (<g2>#156</g2>): <g3>View → Dark Mode support</g3> did nothing on Linux: MDM asked the window system for the desktop's light or dark setting, and X11 never says. It now asks the desktop itself (the freedesktop portal, which KDE, GNOME, Cinnamon and most others answer) and follows it as it changes. Where the portal doesn't answer, as on XFCE and MATE, MDM stayed light under a dark theme: it now reads the theme the desktop gives its programs (a name such as Adwaita-dark, Mint-Y-Dark or Greybird-dark is dark), GNOME's own dark style setting when there is no portal, and GTK's settings with no desktop at all, and follows changes as they happen. The portal still comes first. A change now shows at once too: the window waited for its next theme check, up to 20 s on a busy machine, on every desktop.
02a4b2146e962eb9.text: <g1>深色模式支持在所有桌面上都遵循桌面设置</g1> (<g2>#156</g2>)：<g3>视图 → 深色模式支持</g3> 在 Linux 上不起作用：MDM 向窗口系统查询桌面的浅色或深色设置，而 X11 从不提供。现在它会向桌面本身查询（freedesktop 门户，KDE、GNOME、Cinnamon 和大多数其他桌面都会响应）并随其变化。在门户不响应的情况下，例如在 XFCE 和 MATE 上，MDM 在深色主题下仍保持浅色：现在它会读取桌面为其程序提供的主题（例如 Adwaita-dark、Mint-Y-Dark 或 Greybird-dark 等名称表示深色），在没有门户时读取 GNOME 自己的深色样式设置，以及在完全没有桌面时读取 GTK 的设置，并随变化而变化。门户仍然优先。现在变化也会立即显示：之前窗口会等待下一次主题检查，在繁忙的机器上可能长达 20 秒，在所有桌面上都是如此。

02ac46daf827b7ff.source: <g1>Your local network only</g1>: MDM listens on the computer's private addresses, one by one, never on every address at once.
02ac46daf827b7ff.text: <g1>仅限本地网络</g1>：MDM 逐一监听计算机的私有地址，绝不会同时监听所有地址。

02b95a4f44948228.source: <g1>Download only what you have the right to.</g1> You are responsible for what you download and share.
02b95a4f44948228.text: <g1>只下载您有权下载的内容。</g1>您对您下载和分享的内容负责。

02ca3f873396cdab.source: How to help Mister Download Manager: report bugs, fix translations, build it from source and send pull requests. The checks CI runs and the project's rules.
02ca3f873396cdab.text: 如何帮助 Mister Download Manager：报告错误、修复翻译、从源代码构建并发送拉取请求。CI 运行的检查和项目规则。

02e10cd2e08b346c.source: MDM starts its torrent engine the first time you add a torrent. If you never use torrents, it never listens for peers.
02e10cd2e08b346c.text: MDM 会在您首次添加种子时启动种子引擎。如果您从不使用种子，MDM 就不会监听来自其他节点的连接。

02e598ee413c0595.source: A checked box's or radio's accent
02e598ee413c0595.text: 选中复选框或单选框的强调色

02e9c054cc24b55b.source: If MDM closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a window opens with a report of what happened. You can read all of it, and send it to the developers on GitHub if you want to.
02e9c054cc24b55b.text: 如果 MDM 意外关闭或停止响应，会弹出一个窗口，其中包含事件报告。您可以阅读所有内容，如果愿意，可以将其发送给 GitHub 上的开发者。

02f824962fd84248.source: This cap is shared by every download, however many run at once. It works on its own; you don't need to turn the Speed Limiter on.
02f824962fd84248.text: 无论同时运行多少个下载，此限制都由所有下载共享。它独立工作；您无需开启速度限制器。

03069bf346ba733c.source: <g1>Help → About Mister Download Manager</g1> shows the version you have.
03069bf346ba733c.text: <g1>帮助 → 关于 Mister Download Manager</g1>显示你拥有的版本。

031da5c20d1881e4.text: 计划程序能做的所有事情 →

032a8300d1b20c3e.source: MDM on Ubuntu's GNOME desktop, with the desktop's own file icons.
032a8300d1b20c3e.text: MDM 在 Ubuntu 的 GNOME 桌面上运行，使用桌面自带的文件图标。

032f38898f839833.source: <g1>Move/Rename</g1> was greyed out with several downloads selected, for example a set just added to a queue. It now asks for a folder and moves them all there (<g2>#333</g2>).
032f38898f839833.text: 当选择多个下载任务时，例如一组刚添加到队列中的任务，<g1>移动/重命名</g1>会变灰。现在它会要求选择一个文件夹并将所有任务移动到那里（<g2>#333</g2>）。

03615f08519b4f49.source: <g1>Tasks → Link grabber...</g1> opens the same window empty: paste text with links in it (<g2>Ctrl+V</g2>). See <g3>Link grabber and archives</g3> for the packages, the archive password and extracting archives when they are downloaded.
03615f08519b4f49.text: <g1>任务 → 链接抓取器...</g1>会打开一个空白的同一窗口：粘贴包含链接的文本（<g2>Ctrl+V</g2>）。有关下载包、压缩包密码以及下载完成后解压压缩包的信息，请参阅<g3>链接抓取器和压缩包</g3>。

0364c0cf3df3d7e2.source: Select the download and click <g1>Resume</g1>. Many errors are a server or connection having a bad moment.
0364c0cf3df3d7e2.text: 选择下载任务并点击<g1>恢复</g1>。很多错误只是服务器或连接暂时出了问题。

03eaf59587da32f8.source: Answers about Mister Download Manager: is it free, is it safe, how it compares with IDM, browsers, videos, torrents, speed, Mac and Linux, and more.
03eaf59587da32f8.text: 关于 Mister Download Manager 的解答：它是否免费、是否安全、与 IDM 的比较、浏览器、视频、种子、速度、Mac 和 Linux 等。

03f6065d45b64f00.source: Windows: no more crash on a computer where Direct3D can't start, when a window opened during the switch to OpenGL (<g1>#337</g1>).
03f6065d45b64f00.text: Windows：在 Direct3D 无法启动的计算机上，当在切换到 OpenGL 期间打开窗口时，不再发生崩溃（<g1>#337</g1>）。

03f8c46be74abce4.source: <g1>Where a download's server is</g1> (<g2>#140</g2>): <g3>Download File Info</g3>, the progress window and <g4>Properties</g4> show the server's country, with its flag, and its round trip, such as <g5>about 24 ms (near)</g5>, in green, amber or red. The country comes from a table that ships with MDM (<g6>IP to Country Lite by DB-IP</g6>, CC BY 4.0, refreshed with each release), looked up on the computer: no address is sent anywhere. The time is measured from the download's own connections, with nothing extra sent. Through a proxy MDM says so instead of guessing, and a CDN's server (Cloudflare, CloudFront, Fastly, Akamai and others) is said to be the CDN's, not the site owner's. Properties keeps what the last run saw. MDM is about 770 KB larger (the table 674 KB, the flags 95 KB).
03f8c46be74abce4.text: <g1>下载服务器所在地</g1>（<g2>#140</g2>）：<g3>下载文件信息</g3>、进度窗口和<g4>属性</g4>显示服务器的国家/地区及其国旗，以及其往返时间，例如<g5>约 24 毫秒（附近）</g5>，以绿色、琥珀色或红色显示。国家/地区来自 MDM 附带的表格（<g6>DB-IP 的 IP to Country Lite</g6>，CC BY 4.0，每次发布都会刷新），在计算机上查找：不会将任何地址发送到任何地方。时间是从下载自己的连接中测量的，没有额外发送任何内容。通过代理，MDM 会说明而不是猜测，CDN 的服务器（Cloudflare、CloudFront、Fastly、Akamai 等）被认为是 CDN 的，而不是网站所有者的。属性保留上次运行看到的内容。MDM 大约增加了 770 KB（表格 674 KB，国旗 95 KB）。

03fe2d590fecb966.source: Enter new address to download with the copied address filled in
03fe2d590fecb966.text: “输入要下载的新地址”已填入复制的地址

042975319f3eadfb.source: <g1>Torrents behind a proxy open no UDP socket toward the network</g1>: UDP trackers were already left out there; now their client stays on this computer too.
042975319f3eadfb.text: <g1>代理后的种子不会向网络打开 UDP 套接字</g1>：UDP 追踪器已经排除在外；现在它们的客户端也保留在此电脑上。

043086b485508c73.source: If some of the torrent's files are already in the folder, MDM asks before using them. <g1>Yes</g1> keeps them for the torrent: MDM checks them, keeps what matches the torrent and downloads the rest, which is how you continue a download started elsewhere or share files you already have. <g2>No</g2> (the default) goes back, so you can choose another folder and nothing of yours is overwritten.
043086b485508c73.text: 如果 torrent 的某些文件已在文件夹中，MDM 会在使用前询问。选择<g1>是</g1>会将它们用于 torrent：MDM 会检查它们，保留与 torrent 匹配的部分并下载其余部分，这样您就可以继续在其他地方开始的下载或共享您已有的文件。选择<g2>否</g2>（默认）会返回，以便您可以选择另一个文件夹，并且您的任何内容都不会被覆盖。

04767f8b4224f77b.source: MDM refuses a torrent with file names your system can't write safely, says which name, and writes nothing.
04767f8b4224f77b.text: 如果种子包含系统无法安全写入的文件名，MDM 会拒绝该种子，指出有问题的文件名，并且不写入任何内容。

047d41a834df5979.source: Free and open source. The interface you already know, a faster engine underneath, torrents and video built in.
047d41a834df5979.text: 免费开源。采用您熟悉的界面，底层引擎更快，并内置种子下载和视频下载功能。

049652ed195253e0.source: MDM is free and always will be. If it saves you time, you can support its creator on GitHub Sponsors.
049652ed195253e0.text: MDM 是免费的，并将永远免费。如果它为您节省了时间，您可以在 GitHub Sponsors 上支持其创建者。

04bb12464d3a29f6.source: Tick <g1>Wake the computer to run this queue</g1>, under the start time, and a computer that is asleep at the start time is woken for it. It needs <g2>Start download at</g2>.
04bb12464d3a29f6.text: 勾选开始时间下方的<g1>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g1>，电脑将在开始时间被唤醒。此功能需要<g2>在以下时间开始下载</g2>。

04ea3f289327532e.source: Tick <g1>Send torrents and magnet links to the first account instead of to peers</g1> in <g2>Options → Accounts</g2>. A magnet link (Add URL, the browser, the clipboard, a drop) or a <x3/> file (Add torrent's <g4>Download Now</g4> or <g5>Later</g5>) then goes to the first account in the list:
04ea3f289327532e.text: 在<g2>选项 → 帐户</g2>中勾选<g1>将种子和磁力链接发送到第一个帐户，而不是发送给对等方</g1>。之后，磁力链接（通过添加 URL、浏览器、剪贴板或拖放添加）或<x3/>文件（通过“添加种子”中的<g4>立即下载</g4>或<g5>稍后</g5>操作）都会发送到列表中的第一个帐户：

04fca60787a71402.source: Don't make MDM reachable from the internet (a router's port forwarding): the remote control is made for your home network. To reach it while away, use a VPN to your home network instead (WireGuard, Tailscale): with Tailscale, choose its address in <g1>Listen on</g1>.
04fca60787a71402.text: 不要让 MDM 可以从互联网访问（路由器的端口转发）：远程控制是为您的家庭网络设计的。要在外出时访问它，请使用 VPN 连接到您的家庭网络（WireGuard、Tailscale）：使用 Tailscale 时，请在<g1>监听</g1>中选择其地址。

050988a5d66f5eb1.source: A big fixes release: YouTube and video downloads, crashes and freezes, downloads on slow disks, the Mac helper, plus a Safari extension, far more file types and a few new columns and options.
050988a5d66f5eb1.text: 此版本主要修复了错误：包括 YouTube 和视频下载、崩溃和卡顿、慢速磁盘上的下载、Mac 辅助程序，以及 Safari 扩展、更多文件类型和一些新列与选项。

052e65771dfdbc15.source: While the app is not notarized by Apple (the experimental builds are not), Safari lists the extension only with unsigned extensions allowed: <g1>Settings → Advanced</g1> → <g2>Show features for web developers</g2>, then <g3>Settings → Developer</g3> → <g4>Allow unsigned extensions</g4>. Safari forgets that setting each time it quits.
052e65771dfdbc15.text: 由于此应用程序未经 Apple 公证（实验版本未经公证），Safari 仅在允许未签名扩展程序时才列出此扩展程序：<g1>设置 → 高级</g1> → <g2>显示网页开发者功能</g2>，然后<g3>设置 → 开发者</g3> → <g4>允许未签名扩展程序</g4>。Safari 每次退出时都会忘记此设置。

053263e0b7c48cfa.text: 哪些内容会连接到您的计算机

0533acda9da6cbfb.source: <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> filled the form's System and Installed with only for a moment; they stay filled now.
0533acda9da6cbfb.text: 现在，<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>填写的表单中，“系统”和“已安装”信息不会再只显示片刻，而会一直保留。

053b48e80f60c390.source: <g1>Ignore file modification time changes when resuming a download</g1> — for servers that report a new date for the same file each time. Without it, such a server makes every resume start over.
053b48e80f60c390.text: <g1>恢复下载时忽略文件修改时间的变化</g1> — 适用于每次都为同一文件报告新日期的服务器。如果关闭此选项，此类服务器会导致每次恢复下载都从头开始。

0545f90df5da9852.source: Can I limit the download speed? — Mister Download Manager
0545f90df5da9852.text: 我可以限制下载速度吗？— Mister Download Manager

05496369e6596ec5.source: Yes. MDM writes its progress as it goes, so after a lost connection, a crash or a restart it carries on where it stopped. Before resuming it checks that the file on the server hasn't changed. When a download address has expired, Refresh download address lets you give it a fresh one and keep the data. See Resume a broken download.
05496369e6596ec5.text: 是。MDM 会实时记录下载进度，因此在连接中断、程序崩溃或重启后，它会从停止的地方继续下载。恢复下载前，它会检查服务器上的文件是否发生变化。当下载地址过期时，刷新下载地址 功能可让您提供新的地址并保留现有数据。请参阅恢复中断的下载。

05519de6cf4ebfd7.source: Downloads at full speed no longer stop and go on a slow disk: writing the resume state flushed the file to the disk so often that every connection waited for it, and were then replaced as slow (<g1>#361</g1>).
05519de6cf4ebfd7.text: 慢速磁盘上的全速下载不再停止和继续：写入恢复状态会频繁地将文件刷新到磁盘，导致每个连接都等待它，然后被替换为慢速连接（<g1>#361</g1>）。

0554081950609ac4.source: A debrid service downloads files from file hosts on its own servers and hands back a plain link, without the host's waits, speed caps and captchas. With your account in MDM, that link is downloaded like any file.
0554081950609ac4.text: 网盘服务会从文件主机下载文件到其自己的服务器，然后返回一个普通链接，没有主机等待、速度限制和验证码。在 MDM 中使用您的账户，该链接会像任何文件一样被下载。

056973ea0bc40de4.source: Use GitHub's private <g1><g2>Report a vulnerability</g2></g1> form. Only the maintainers can read it. Say what you found, how to reproduce it, and which version you used (<g3>Help → About</g3> shows it). Please don't open a public issue for security problems.
056973ea0bc40de4.text: 请使用 GitHub 的私密<g1><g2>报告漏洞</g2></g1>表单。只有维护者可以查看。请说明您发现的问题、复现方法以及使用的版本（可在<g3>帮助 → 关于</g3>中查看）。请勿公开提交安全问题。

0570989b9bf67a64.source: Sites change often, and a newer yt-dlp usually fixes it. MDM doesn't update yt-dlp on its own yet. To get the newest one: quit MDM (<g1>Tasks → Exit</g1>), delete the <x2/> folder in MDM's data folder (<x3/>, or the <x4/> folder of a portable copy), start MDM, open the video window and click <g5>Install yt-dlp</g5>.
0570989b9bf67a64.text: 网站经常变化，更新 yt-dlp 通常可以解决问题。MDM 目前不会自动更新 yt-dlp。要获取最新版本：退出 MDM（<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>），删除 MDM 数据文件夹中的 <x2/> 文件夹（<x3/>，或便携版副本中的 <x4/> 文件夹），启动 MDM，打开视频窗口并点击<g5>安装 yt-dlp</g5>。

057b1bcb7273a7bb.source: <g1><g2>The browser and MDM aren't connected</g2></g1> — what the extension's red <g3>!</g3> means, reason by reason, and how to fix each.
057b1bcb7273a7bb.text: <g1><g2>浏览器与 MDM 未连接</g2></g1> — 扩展程序中的红色 <g3>!</g3> 表示什么、各种原因以及相应的解决方法。

0588c7c82fed2d21.source: Which browsers does it work with?

05ae27da0376b80e.source: <g1>.deb</g1> for Debian and Ubuntu, <g2>.rpm</g2> for Fedora
05ae27da0376b80e.text: 适用于 Debian 和 Ubuntu 的 <g1>.deb</g1>，适用于 Fedora 的 <g2>.rpm</g2>

05bd7f3cbec0de04.source: When the browser used no proxy, and <g1>No proxy/socks</g1> is chosen, MDM uses Windows' proxy settings, as browsers do.
05bd7f3cbec0de04.text: 如果浏览器未使用代理，且选择了<g1>无代理/SOCKS</g1>，MDM 会像浏览器一样使用 Windows 的代理设置。

05e4107afbf16316.source: Open it with <g1>Scheduler</g1> on the toolbar or <g2>Downloads → Scheduler</g2>. Right-clicking a queue and choosing <g3>Schedule</g3> or <g4>Edit queue</g4> opens it on that queue.
05e4107afbf16316.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>计划程序</g1>或选择<g2>下载 → 计划程序</g2>即可打开窗口。右键点击某个队列，然后选择<g3>计划</g3>或<g4>编辑队列</g4>，即可打开该队列的设置。

05e98a5438868ee9.source: The other buttons copy the report, open its folder, or start MDM again.
05e98a5438868ee9.text: 其他按钮可以复制报告、打开报告所在的文件夹，或重新启动 MDM。

05f8c699ee2684d7.source: The website is in 21 languages too, also machine-translated. Its texts are in <x1/>, one row per sentence: fix a row's <x2/> (keep tags like <x3/> and <x4/> as they are, they are the links and icons). <x5/> shows what each language still lacks, and the same tool with <x6/> translates only that.
05f8c699ee2684d7.text: 本网站也提供 21 种语言版本，同样由机器翻译生成。网站文本位于<x1/>中，每行一句：修正每行的<x2/>（保留<x3/>和<x4/>等标签，它们代表链接和图标）。<x5/>会显示各语言还缺少哪些内容；使用同一工具并指定<x6/>时，只会翻译这些内容。

05f8c91edd2041dd.source: Under <g1>Add to queue</g1>, pick <g2>Main download queue</g2>. Leave <g3>Start the queue now</g3> unticked. Click <g4>OK</g4>.
05f8c91edd2041dd.text: 在<g1>添加到队列</g1>下，选择<g2>主下载队列</g2>。不要勾选<g3>立即启动队列</g3>。点击<g4>确定</g4>。

060740273a407a0d.source: Options, Save to: a category's folder
060740273a407a0d.text: 选项 → 保存到：一个类别的文件夹

061f476958c76686.text: 验证下载文件的校验和（MD5、SHA-256）— Mister Download Manager

063cb01120e3c2de.source: Looking for a free alternative to Internet Download Manager (IDM)? Mister Download Manager is free and open source, laid out like IDM, and imports your IDM list. Compare it with Free Download Manager, AB Download Manager, Motrix, Neat, JDownloader and more.
063cb01120e3c2de.text: 正在寻找 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 的免费替代品？Mister Download Manager 是一款免费、开源的下载管理器，界面布局与 IDM 相似，并可导入您的 IDM 列表。将其与 Free Download Manager、AB Download Manager、Motrix、Neat、JDownloader 等进行比较。

06492aa608ada06d.source: <g1>Paused and resumed</g1> like a file, also after quitting MDM: it carries on from the bytes already saved.
06492aa608ada06d.text: 像文件一样<g1>暂停和恢复</g1>，即使退出 MDM 后也能继续：它会从已保存的字节处继续。

068929e04a8d8a6b.text: 进度窗口显示下载情况：速度、剩余时间以及每个连接的状态。

0692cbfad04324c6.source: The progress window draws it as it happens: a bar of the whole file with each connection's start and progress, and a table with what every connection is doing right now.
0692cbfad04324c6.text: 进度窗口会实时显示下载情况：一个显示整个文件进度的条形图，其中包含每个连接的起始位置和进度，以及一个显示每个连接当前正在做什么的表格。

06963b667716f236.text: 通过 AI 助手（MCP 服务器）控制下载

06a005846d84ad31.text: 功能丰富：通过 yt-dlp 下载视频和 MP3，支持种子下载，提供网站抓取工具和来自 Hugging Face 的 AI 模型

06eeabbea1b11ae5.source: Uninstall MDM from Windows <g1>Settings → Apps</g1>. The uninstaller asks whether to delete your download list and settings too. Your downloaded files are never touched.
06eeabbea1b11ae5.text: 从 Windows <g1>设置 → 应用</g1>中卸载 MDM。卸载程序会询问是否也删除您的下载列表和设置。您的下载文件永远不会被触及。

06f1e7a5c9a5fcfc.text: 帮助 → 关于：您拥有的版本。

06f2b21b4750b749.text: 如何报告错误或提出功能请求？

070c8fa6ee24507e.source: Download <g1>setup.exe</g1> above and run it. Windows may ask whether to allow it: the installer isn't code-signed yet, so choose <g2>More info → Run anyway</g2>.
070c8fa6ee24507e.text: 下载上方的<g1>setup.exe</g1>并运行。Windows 可能会询问是否允许运行：安装程序尚未进行代码签名，因此请选择<g2>更多信息 → 仍然运行</g2>。

0717a2923d7e72cc.source: <g1>Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi</g1>: one click from the Chrome Web Store, and the browser keeps it up to date. Edge first asks to allow extensions from other stores.
0717a2923d7e72cc.text: <g1>Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi</g1>：从 Chrome 网上应用店一键安装，浏览器会自动保持更新。Edge 浏览器首次安装时会要求允许来自其他商店的扩展。

072428c8bd6ba91a.source: When the limit is reached, MDM stops downloading. New downloads show <g1>Waiting: the download limit is reached (Scheduler)</g1>. Everything resumes on its own when the period is over. <g2>Show warning before stopping downloads</g2> tells you when this happens and when downloads will go on.
072428c8bd6ba91a.text: 达到限制后，MDM 会停止下载。新下载会显示<g1>等待: 已达到下载限制（计划程序）</g1>。时间段结束后，所有下载都会自动恢复。启用<g2>停止下载前显示警告</g2>后，MDM 会在停止下载前以及下载即将恢复时通知您。

07367459e6405a5a.source: <g1>Screen readers</g1> (Narrator, NVDA): every window, dialogs and menus included, now tells them what each control is, its name and its state; the download list reads each download.
07367459e6405a5a.text: <g1>屏幕阅读器</g1>（讲述人、NVDA）：现在每个窗口、对话框和菜单都包含在内，告知它们每个控件是什么、其名称和状态；下载列表会读取每个下载。

0748049168576df3.text: “选项”的“下载”页面：开始下载对话框、“下载完成”和重复链接。

07640f7e75a3c8b1.text: ；选项的 <x1/> 是 <x2/> 占用的空间（它所源自的格式，如 <x3/>，如果这些格式不存在，则为最接近的格式），<x4/> 表示其 <x5/> 是一个估计值，<x6/> 是 <x7/>、<x8/>、<x9/>……，<x10/> 是 <x11/>（或 HDR 选项旁边的 <x12/>）；字幕的 <x13/> 是 <x14/> 占用的空间。

0799a3169d80c8d3.text: 我可以同时安装 IDM 吗？

The built-in categories (Compressed, Documents, Music, Programs, Video) can be renamed, given other file types and deleted like your own; a renamed one keeps its folder. General and Torrents change only their folder.
07b884f85a5adcba.text: <g1>新建</g1> — 创建您自己的类别。<g2>编辑...</g2> — 更改所选类别的名称、文件类型和文件夹。内置类别（压缩文件、文档、音乐、程序、视频）可以像您自己的类别一样重命名、更改文件类型和删除；重命名后的类别会保留其文件夹。常规和种子类别只能更改其文件夹。

0b6fab6c1ab7b8c8.source: In the same window, tick <g1>Limit all downloads together to</g1> and set the speed. This caps MDM as a whole, however many files are downloading, torrents included. When torrents and other downloads run at the same time, each side gets at least half of the speed, and more when the other side needs less: a torrent going slowly leaves the rest to the other downloads, and the other way round. It applies whenever it is ticked, whether the per-file limiter is on or off.

0bc5fc7eb49e15cd.source: <g1>Streams served as plain text, from addresses without .m3u8 or .mpd</g1> (<g2>#171</g2>): some players load their stream from such an address, and the extension didn't know it as one. The button over the video, the right-click menu and <g3>Media on this page</g3> then sent the page alone, which yt-dlp answered "Unsupported URL". Now, when one of them is used and no stream is known, the extension reads the start of what the player fetched (a few kilobytes, never on sight) and recognises an HLS playlist or a DASH manifest.
0bc5fc7eb49e15cd.text: <g1>以纯文本形式提供的流，来自不带 .m3u8 或 .mpd 的地址</g1>（<g2>#171</g2>）：有些播放器会从此类地址加载其流，而扩展程序未将其识别为流。视频上方的按钮、右键菜单和<g3>此页面上的媒体</g3>随后只发送页面，yt-dlp 回复“不支持的 URL”。现在，当使用其中之一且未识别到流时，扩展程序会读取播放器获取内容的开头（几千字节，从不显示），并识别 HLS 播放列表或 DASH 清单。

That service sees those names and your IP address, under its own privacy terms.

0c9bfa704b26c7a2.source: <g1>Proxy auto-config scripts (PAC) run in QuickJS</g1>, a much smaller JavaScript engine, with limits on memory and running time: a script that loops or grows forever now fails, as a broken script does (the download goes on with the default proxy settings), instead of holding it.

10fdbfc09f721602.text: <g1>服务器不再重复发送不带范围的文件</g1>（<g2>#136</g2>）：当额外连接的响应延迟（计算机繁忙）时，下载可能完成，然后在一个连接上重新开始，再次获取整个文件。MDM 现在会在所有字节都到位后停止其他连接，并且对于从未声明支持范围的服务器，MDM 会在其第一次完整响应时将其识别为支持范围的服务器（而对于那些声明支持但偶尔丢失范围的 CDN，MDM 仍会使用多个连接）。

11c54a9841b75a9b.source: <g1>Fairness.</g1> The apps alternate, IDM first on even runs and MDM first on odd ones, so drift on the machine hits both. One warm-up run each is discarded. Failed runs are counted, not dropped. Before every run the harness waits until the loopback is quiet: against a server that refuses extra connections IDM retries about 250 times a second, leaving thousands of closed sockets for half a minute; without the wait, whichever app ran next was timed on that backlog.
11c54a9841b75a9b.text: <g1>公平性。</g1> 应用程序交替运行，IDM 在偶数次运行中优先，MDM 在奇数次运行中优先，因此机器上的漂移会同时影响两者。每次运行一次热身运行，结果被丢弃。失败的运行会被计数，而不是丢弃。在每次运行之前，测试工具会等待直到回环链路安静：对于拒绝额外连接的服务器，IDM 每秒重试约 250 次，留下数千个关闭的套接字半分钟；如果没有等待，接下来运行的应用程序将在该积压上计时。

14fdd504d3380998.source: By default MDM downloads the pieces that the fewest peers have first, as BitTorrent programs usually do. That way a piece only one peer has is fetched before that peer leaves, and MDM can pass it on to others sooner. On MDM's test swarms it finished just as fast as downloading in order, and it was the only order that finished when a scarce piece's only holder left.
14fdd504d3380998.text: 默认情况下，MDM 会像其他 BitTorrent 程序一样，优先下载拥有者最少的分块。这样，只有一个对等方拥有的分块就能在该对等方离开前下载完成，MDM 也能更早将它传给其他对等方。在 MDM 的测试群中，这种方式的完成速度与按顺序下载一样快；当稀有分块的唯一持有者离开时，也只有这种方式能完成下载。

While MDM reads a long file, the strip under the list of downloads says <g2>Reading</g2> and the file's name; you can go on using MDM meanwhile. Import reads files of up to 64 MB, far more than any list of links holds: a larger file (a video, an archive, a backup picked by mistake) is refused with a message.
167087cbbeb790d1.text: 选择文件。<g1>链接抓取器</g1>会列出 MDM 在其中找到的所有网址，并按包分类。当 MDM 读取大文件时，下载列表下方的条带会显示<g2>正在读取</g2>和文件名；在此期间您可以继续使用 MDM。导入功能可读取最大 64 MB 的文件，这远超任何链接列表的大小：如果文件过大（例如视频、压缩包或误选的备份文件），MDM 会拒绝并显示消息。

167b6aef6b7c3e2d.source: On Linux and macOS, MDM sets browser integration up itself each time it starts: start MDM once. <g1>Test browser integration</g1> says what went wrong if it couldn't, such as <g2>The helper program the browsers start is missing</g2>: <g3>Set it up</g3> puts it back.
167b6aef6b7c3e2d.text: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，MDM 每次启动时都会自行设置浏览器集成：只需启动 MDM 一次。<g1>测试浏览器集成</g1> 会说明如果设置失败，例如出现 <g2>浏览器启动的帮助程序缺失</g2>，是哪里出了问题：点击 <g3>设置</g3> 即可修复。

167e0568310b7eb2.source: Download video from a page: the qualities on offer, from 2160p 60fps down, with their sizes.
167e0568310b7eb2.text: 从页面下载视频：显示可选画质及文件大小，从 2160p 60fps 到更低画质。

169f679e7202c9c5.source: The torrent engine is written in Rust, which rules out many memory bugs, and MDM checks every piece against the torrent's fingerprint, so a peer can't slip in altered data. MDM keeps the engine up to date with the fixes its authors publish.
169f679e7202c9c5.text: 种子引擎使用 Rust 编写，可避免许多内存错误。MDM 还会根据种子的指纹检查每个数据块，因此对等方无法混入被篡改的数据。MDM 会及时更新种子引擎，以应用其作者发布的修复。

16ae7edc2b9c219f.source: Find a download in a long list

16b5e82e122812f5.source: <g1>Download overnight</g1> walks through it step by step.
16b5e82e122812f5.text: <g1>夜间下载</g1>会逐步引导您完成。

16c14aa13a1bf0c5.source: <g1>Your own yt-dlp and ffmpeg</g1>: <g2>Helpers...</g2> takes a copy you already have.
16c14aa13a1bf0c5.text: <g1>您自己的 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg</g1>：<g2>帮助程序...</g2>可以导入您已有的副本。

16c4f234a1f663ce.source: A download manager can fill your whole connection. The Speed Limiter caps MDM so that browsing, video calls and games stay smooth, and can give it full speed again while you're away from the computer.
16c4f234a1f663ce.text: 下载管理器可能会占用您全部的网络连接。速度限制器可以限制 MDM 的速度，让您在浏览网页、视频通话和玩游戏时保持流畅。当您不在电脑旁时，它还可以让 MDM 恢复全速下载。

16cc6550e7f6316d.source: In the <g1>Categories</g1> pane: the selected category's menu (<g2>Properties</g2>, <g3>Add category</g3>, <g4>Delete</g4>)
16cc6550e7f6316d.text: 在<g1>类别</g1>窗格中：打开所选类别的菜单（<g2>属性</g2>、<g3>添加类别</g3>、<g4>删除</g4>）

16d498a3a477d64c.source: <g1>Dark mode has day mode's sizes and places</g1>: the menu bar, the toolbar, the panes, the list's lines and selection, buttons and the progress window's table measure the same in both modes. Only the colours change.
16d498a3a477d64c.text: <g1>深色模式的尺寸和位置已与浅色模式一致</g1>：两种模式下，菜单栏、工具栏、窗格、列表行和选中项、按钮以及进度窗口中的表格尺寸都相同。只有颜色不同。

16da6109033e7c1d.source: <g1>Copy a link, get the download window</g1>: copying a link to a file type on the <g2>File types</g2> list opens <g3>Download File Info</g3> with it, ready to start, also without the browser extension (<g4>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g4>, on by default).
16da6109033e7c1d.text: <g1>复制链接，打开下载窗口</g1>：复制文件类型列表<g2>文件类型</g2>上的链接会打开<g3>下载文件信息</g3>，并准备好开始下载，即使没有浏览器扩展程序也可以（<g4>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g4>，默认开启）。

172730c20b2fdcfc.text: 一个适配器用于所有连接

1745fe3e724c0846.source: <g1><g2>Link grabber and archives</g2></g1> — many links at once, in packages; zip, 7z and rar archives extracted when they are downloaded.
1745fe3e724c0846.text: <g1><g2>链接抓取器和压缩包</g2></g1> — 一次处理多个链接，以包的形式下载；下载完成后自动解压 zip、7z 和 rar 压缩包。

174c2671a756fca2.source: <g1>Scheduler and queues</g1><g2>Queues started and stopped by the clock, a few files at a time, the computer off at the end.</g2>
174c2671a756fca2.text: <g1>计划程序和队列</g1><g2>按时启动和停止队列，每次下载少量文件，完成后自动关闭电脑。</g2>

17834855ff83a05b.source: <g1>Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi</g1> can't ask for that permission at the switch, so the extension has it from the install (Chrome counts it under the access to every site the extension already asks for, so it adds no line to the install prompt and the update asks for nothing new). The switch asks nothing. MDM gets the browser's effective proxy, whoever set it (a VPN or proxy extension, a policy, the command line): a fixed server for the download's scheme (<x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>), unless the address is on its bypass list, or its proxy auto-config script (by its address or inline). With no proxy, or the system's, nothing is sent and MDM goes by its own Options. A QUIC proxy can't be shared.
17834855ff83a05b.text: <g1>Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi</g1>无法在切换时请求该权限，因此扩展在安装时就已获得（Chrome 将其计入扩展已请求的对每个站点的访问权限中，因此不会在安装提示中添加新行，更新时也不会请求新内容）。此切换不请求任何权限。MDM 会获取浏览器有效的代理，无论是由谁设置的（VPN 或代理扩展、策略、命令行）：对于下载方案（<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>），它是一个固定的服务器，除非地址在其绕过列表中，或者其代理自动配置脚本（通过其地址或内联）。如果没有代理，或者使用系统代理，则不会发送任何内容，MDM 将遵循其自己的选项。QUIC 代理无法共享。

178857076aff1609.source: Archives: extract when downloaded, and where the files go.
178857076aff1609.text: 存档：下载后提取，以及文件的存放位置。

178c8da6e827d8a3.source: Leave MDM running. Closing the main window is fine: MDM keeps going in the tray. Don't use <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1>.
178c8da6e827d8a3.text: 让 MDM 保持运行。关闭主窗口没关系：MDM 会在系统托盘中继续运行。不要使用<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>。

17a6b9e12e193121.source: <g1>New:</g1> the server mode is new in this version. Please <g2>tell us how it goes</g2>.
17a6b9e12e193121.text: <g1>新增：</g1>服务器模式是此版本的新功能。请<g2>告诉我们您的使用体验</g2>。

17c258da3c18b1a9.source: A <x1/> file fetched from a web address goes through the same checks as one opened from disk, and MDM reads at most 10 MB of it.
17c258da3c18b1a9.text: 从网址获取的 <x1/> 文件会经过与从磁盘打开的文件相同的检查，MDM 最多读取 10 MB 的内容。

17d79e8a62ab236e.source: <g1>Linux and Mac too.</g1> Builds with every release, if you use more than Windows. From version 0.5.0, Linux is no longer experimental: it is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon.
17d79e8a62ab236e.text: <g1>也支持 Linux 和 Mac。</g1> 如果您不只使用 Windows，每个版本都有相应的构建。从 0.5.0 版本开始，Linux 不再是实验性版本：它已在 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 上进行过测试。

181fa54da02e74a5.source: Mister Download Manager's crash and freeze reports: readable, free of your addresses and file names, and sent only by you, through your browser and GitHub.
181fa54da02e74a5.text: Mister Download Manager 的崩溃和冻结报告：可读，不含您的地址和文件名，并且仅由您通过浏览器和 GitHub 发送。

182407bd73119322.source: The <g1>browser extension</g1> talks only to Mister Download Manager on your own computer.
182407bd73119322.text: <g1>浏览器扩展程序</g1>只与您自己电脑上的 Mister Download Manager 通信。

1839e6e1134a946d.source: <g1>The video helpers are offered on the first start.</g1> A window explains what yt-dlp and ffmpeg do and downloads both on <g2>Yes, download them (recommended)</g2>; <g3>Not now</g3> leaves them for the video window. Upgrading? It asks once too, if one of them is missing.
1839e6e1134a946d.text: <g1>首次启动时会提供视频辅助工具。</g1>窗口会说明 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg 的用途，点击<g2>是，下载它们（推荐）</g2>即可下载这两个工具；点击<g3>暂不</g3>则可在视频窗口中再下载。升级时，如果缺少其中一个工具，也会询问一次。

185d7d9ae44f9d62.text: 86 种，包括从右到左的语言

185df2d914fc7b3a.source: Very likely: MDM speaks 86 languages, every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen on the first start or any time in View → Language. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur are laid out right to left. See all the languages and how to help improve yours.
185df2d914fc7b3a.text: 很有可能：MDM 支持 86 种语言，涵盖 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，您可以在首次启动时选择，或随时通过“视图”→“语言”进行更改。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语是从右到左排版的。查看所有语言以及如何帮助改进您的语言。

188937d35875a6f2.source: Pick one. Without ffmpeg, only the qualities that come with their sound are listed, and no MP3, Opus or FLAC (ffmpeg makes them).
188937d35875a6f2.text: 选择一项。如果没有 ffmpeg，列表只会显示包含音频的画质选项，不会提供 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC（这些格式由 ffmpeg 生成）。

1892ea346c743f7d.source: The <x1/> label on the Linux files (macOS keeps it).
1892ea346c743f7d.text: Linux 文件上的 <x1/> 标签（macOS 仍保留）。

1895aedc8d74299a.source: Corner radius of a check box

18b71bddc92d0eb7.source: <g1>A Linux test machine, scripted</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): <x3/> sets up an Ubuntu 24.04 desktop in VirtualBox from a Windows host (<x4/>: hardware, headless start, linked clones; <x5/>: packages, Rust, Node, the browsers, UI automation, an unlocked keyring), builds any branch or pull request there with a quick test profile (<x6/>), and checks pull requests on it: windows shot and compared pixel by pixel (<x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>), HLS and DASH hand-overs from the Snap Firefox and Google Chrome (<x10/>, <x11/>), the extension's proxy switch (<x12/>), hand-overs and the Scheduler while minimized, torrents without a network, and MDM's start-up time (<x13/>). Every change is now checked on Linux as on Windows. The machine also has copies on KDE Plasma, Cinnamon and XFCE (<x14/>), which get a build copied over instead of making one (<x15/>); a window harness shoots many windows from one running MDM in any language, mode and theme, with real clicks and keys inside the machine (<x16/>, <x17/>); and a store package is checked before it ships (<x18/>, <x19/>).
18b71bddc92d0eb7.text: <g1>脚本化的 Linux 测试机</g1>（<g2>#164</g2> 的一部分）：<x3/> 在 VirtualBox 中从 Windows 主机设置 Ubuntu 24.04 桌面（<x4/>：硬件、无头启动、链接克隆；<x5/>：软件包、Rust、Node、浏览器、UI 自动化、已解锁的密钥环），使用快速测试配置文件（<x6/>）构建任何分支或拉取请求，并检查其上的拉取请求：窗口截图并逐像素比较（<x7/>、<x8/>、<x9/>），Snap Firefox 和 Google Chrome 的 HLS 和 DASH 切换（<x10/>、<x11/>），扩展程序的代理切换（<x12/>），最小化时的切换和计划程序，无网络时的种子下载，以及 MDM 的启动时间（<x13/>）。现在，每次更改都会像在 Windows 上一样在 Linux 上进行检查。该机器还在 KDE Plasma、Cinnamon 和 XFCE 上有副本（<x14/>），这些副本会复制构建而不是重新生成（<x15/>）；一个窗口工具可以在机器内部通过真实的点击和按键，以任何语言、模式和主题从一个运行中的 MDM 拍摄多个窗口（<x16/>、<x17/>）；并且在发布之前会检查商店软件包（<x18/>、<x19/>）。

18bca0e419aafc22.source: <g1>Browser integration</g1> for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi (Firefox in testing): downloads hand over to MDM with their cookies and referrer, right-click <g2>Download with Mister Download Manager</g2>, and a <g3>Download video</g3> button over videos on any page, which can be dragged along the video's edge, hidden on a video or a site, or turned off in Options.
18bca0e419aafc22.text: 适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 的<g1>浏览器集成</g1>（Firefox 正在测试中）：下载会将其 Cookie 和引用页移交给 MDM，右键单击<g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载</g2>，以及在任何页面视频上方显示<g3>下载视频</g3>按钮，该按钮可以沿视频边缘拖动、在视频或网站上隐藏，或在选项中关闭。

18c24d96f8691583.source: Give a video's page address to <g1>Add URL</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>) and MDM sees that it is a video page: <g3>Download video from a page</g3> opens and looks it up. YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit and well over a thousand other sites work. With the <g4>browser extension</g4>, the button over a video opens the same window.
18c24d96f8691583.text: 将视频页面地址粘贴到<g1>添加 URL</g1>（<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>），MDM 会识别出这是一个视频页面：<g3>从页面下载视频</g3>窗口会打开并查找视频。YouTube、Vimeo、Dailymotion、Twitch、TikTok、Instagram、Reddit 以及一千多个其他网站都支持。通过<g4>浏览器扩展</g4>，视频上方的按钮也能打开相同的窗口。

18cc6766da5be7db.source: Mister Download Manager runs on Windows 10 and 11, installed or portable, with Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm, .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) builds.
18cc6766da5be7db.text: Mister Download Manager 运行于 Windows 10 和 11，可安装或便携使用，并提供 Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm, .tar.gz) 和 macOS (.dmg) 构建。

19156d7406477513.source: <g1>Server</g1> — where the server is: its country's flag and name, and how long a round trip to it takes. See <g2>Where the server is</g2>. It stays blank when the browser handed the download over with its name and size, since MDM didn't need to ask the server.
19156d7406477513.text: <g1>服务器</g1> — 服务器的位置：其国家/地区旗帜和名称，以及往返所需时间。请参阅<g2>服务器位置</g2>。当浏览器将下载文件及其名称和大小移交给MDM时，此项会留空，因为MDM无需询问服务器。

191ccd3146ac5b2d.source: A theme can be one file (<x1/>) or a folder of its own (<x2/>) when it brings icons.
191ccd3146ac5b2d.text: 主题可以是一个文件（<x1/>），或者当它包含图标时，可以是一个独立的文件夹（<x2/>）。

19377f473665c846.source: <g1>The help shows what it describes</g1> (<g2>#228</g2>): every guide and the main help pages now have pictures of the windows they explain, cropped to what matters, numbered where a step points at one control, and step strips for the usual flows (a download from the browser, a first download, a video, a torrent, a queue overnight). On the website they follow its light or dark theme, keep their place while they load, and open larger with a click; their descriptions and captions are translated with the page. The pictures are made by a script from one list (<x3/>), so they can all be taken again in one go.
19377f473665c846.text: <g1>帮助文档所见即所得</g1>（<g2>#228</g2>）：所有指南和主要帮助页面现在都配有其所解释窗口的图片，图片经过裁剪以突出重点，步骤指向某个控件时会进行编号，并为常见流程（从浏览器下载、首次下载、视频、种子、夜间队列）提供步骤条。在网站上，它们会根据网站的明暗主题显示，加载时保持原位，点击后可放大；图片描述和标题会随页面一起翻译。这些图片由脚本根据一个列表（<x3/>）生成，因此可以一次性全部重新拍摄。

1962902ce083389d.source: If they match, it is the file we published. Every release is built on GitHub from the <g1>public source code</g1>, so anyone can read what went into it.
1962902ce083389d.text: 如果匹配，则说明是官方发布的文件。每个版本都是在 GitHub 上从<g1>公开源代码</g1>构建的，因此任何人都可以查看其内容。

19686779e1123d73.source: To open the page by the server's name (<x1/>), give MDM that name: <x2/> (several: separated by commas). Other names are refused, so that no web page can reach MDM through a name of its own.
19686779e1123d73.text: 要通过服务器名称（<x1/>）打开页面，请为 MDM 提供该名称：<x2/>（多个名称用逗号分隔）。其他名称将被拒绝，这样任何网页都无法通过其自己的名称访问 MDM。

198e0f8020d53f36.source: <g1>Trackers</g1> — the torrent's trackers. With none, peers come from the DHT and other peers.
198e0f8020d53f36.text: <g1>跟踪器</g1> — 种子的跟踪器。如果没有跟踪器，对等方将来自 DHT 和其他对等方。

19a3fe3b4ef2bca1.source: All Downloads, Unfinished, Finished and Queues, each by category.
19a3fe3b4ef2bca1.text: 所有下载、未完成、已完成和队列；每个分支都按类别显示。

19a5a4d2defa62ce.source: Short answers to what people ask most, each with a link to the full guide.
19a5a4d2defa62ce.text: 以下是人们最常问的问题的简短回答，每个问题都附有完整指南的链接。

19af82a4564bc92c.source: Downloads no longer fail with "part file still in use" on a busy computer.
19af82a4564bc92c.text: 在繁忙的电脑上，下载不再因“部分文件仍在占用”而失败。

19d15279ff89ebf1.source: <g1>YouTube's look-up failing with "Requested format is not available"</g1> (<g2>#352</g2>): signed-in cookies make yt-dlp use only YouTube's players that need a JavaScript runtime, and without one no video is left. The page is now looked up again without the cookies, and lists its qualities.
19d15279ff89ebf1.text: <g1>YouTube 查找失败并显示“请求的格式不可用”</g1>（<g2>#352</g2>）：登录的 Cookie 会使 yt-dlp 仅使用需要 JavaScript 运行时的 YouTube 播放器，如果没有运行时，则没有视频可用。现在会再次查找页面，但不带 Cookie，并列出其质量。

19ef176da302a2b4.source: When the browser can't hand a download to MDM, it keeps the download itself, so nothing is lost. The extension's toolbar button then shows a red !. Click it…
19ef176da302a2b4.text: 浏览器无法将下载交给 MDM 时，会自行处理下载，因此不会丢失任何内容。此时，扩展程序的工具栏按钮会显示红色感叹号。点击它…

1a1c4d85605e18ae.text: 按 <g1>Alt+Enter</g1> 始终会打开<g2>属性</g2>。

1a2ae740a4acb937.text: 批量下载：许多带编号的文件

1a3adf48a31bc69c.source: Every text the UI shows goes through <x1/> (craft-i18n catalogs, <x2/>). <x3/> rebuilds <x4/> from the source, with a note for translators on each text (what it is, where it shows, its placeholders). <x5/> fills what the other catalogs lack (rows marked <x6/>), following each language's style guide (<x7/>) and the glossary; a row a person reviewed is never replaced, and CI (<x8/>) fails a change that drops one. The website has its own catalogs (<x9/>, <x10/>).
1a3adf48a31bc69c.text: UI 显示的每个文本都通过 <x1/>（craft-i18n 目录，<x2/>）。<x3/> 从源代码重建 <x4/>，并为每个文本附上翻译人员的注释（它是什么，在哪里显示，其占位符）。<x5/> 填充其他目录中缺少的内容（标记为 <x6/> 的行），遵循每种语言的样式指南（<x7/>）和词汇表；人工审核过的行永远不会被替换，CI（<x8/>）会使删除行的更改失败。网站有自己的目录（<x9/>，<x10/>）。

1a3b9d0d6a07985d.source: the page's address as you open it, shown with the pairing code
1a3b9d0d6a07985d.text: 您打开页面时显示的地址，与配对码一起显示

1a4513aa7b897fc8.source: <g1>Confirm before deleting downloads</g1> — ask before taking downloads off the list. On by default; <g2>Don't show this dialog again</g2> in that question turns it off, and ticking it here turns it back on.
1a4513aa7b897fc8.text: <g1>删除下载前确认</g1> — 在从列表中删除下载前进行询问。默认开启；该问题中的<g2>不再显示此对话框</g2>会将其关闭，而在此处勾选则会重新开启。

1a9a6da034f61a17.source: <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks → Network adapter</g1> holds MDM's connections to one adapter, usually a VPN's (<g2>Options</g2>). The torrent engine binds every socket to it: peers (TCP, and through a SOCKS proxy), HTTP and UDP trackers, the DHT and the listening port. On Linux and macOS it binds the adapter itself. On Windows it binds the adapter's address (its IPv4 one when it has one), and Windows sends a packet only through the adapter that has its source address. UPnP and local peer discovery are turned off then, because they talk to the local network rather than through the adapter.
1a9a6da034f61a17.text: <g1>选项 → 代理/Socks → 网络适配器</g1>可将 MDM 的连接绑定到一个适配器，通常是 VPN 适配器（<g2>选项</g2>）。种子引擎会将每个套接字绑定到该适配器：包括对等方连接（TCP，以及通过 SOCKS 代理的连接）、HTTP 和 UDP 跟踪器、DHT，以及监听端口。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它会绑定适配器本身。在 Windows 上，它会绑定适配器的地址（如果有 IPv4 地址，则绑定该地址）；Windows 只会通过拥有该源地址的适配器发送数据包。此时会关闭 UPnP 和本地对等方发现，因为它们通过本地网络通信，而不是通过该适配器通信。

1aafdbaf510c3af8.source: <g1>It's free, for good.</g1> No trial that runs out, no licence key, no ads. The GNU GPL guarantees it stays free.
1aafdbaf510c3af8.text: <g1>永久免费。</g1> 没有试用期，没有许可证密钥，没有广告。GNU GPL 保证它始终免费。

1abcbaa5fe5d513a.source: To find peers without trackers, MDM joins the DHT through four public routers (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/> and <x4/>); any one that answers is enough. It keeps the DHT nodes it found for the next start, so later starts don't depend on those routers.
1abcbaa5fe5d513a.text: MDM 通过四个公共路由器（<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/> 和 <x4/>）加入 DHT，以查找没有跟踪器的对等点；只要其中一个响应即可。它会保存找到的 DHT 节点，供下次启动时使用，因此后续启动不依赖于这些路由器。

1adaa7c4de6bc9e1.source: Paste the new link into Address, then resume.
1adaa7c4de6bc9e1.text: 将新链接粘贴到“地址”中，然后恢复下载。

1afe0a44e06cfa4b.source: To check MDM's side, open <g1>Options → General</g1> in MDM and click <g2>Test browser integration...</g2>. It checks that browser integration is on, that this is the installed copy, that the browsers can find MDM, and which browsers' extension has connected; <g3>How to fix it</g3> opens the section for the first that fails.
1afe0a44e06cfa4b.text: 要检查 MDM 端的情况，请在 MDM 中打开<g1>选项 → 常规</g1>，然后点击<g2>测试浏览器集成...</g2>。它会检查浏览器集成是否已启用、当前是否为已安装的副本、浏览器能否找到 MDM，以及哪些浏览器的扩展程序已连接；点击<g3>如何修复</g3>可打开第一个未通过检查的项目对应的部分。

1b0b5fa5425d1c30.source: A window larger than the screen at a big interface size scrolls.
1b0b5fa5425d1c30.text: 当界面尺寸较大时，如果窗口超出屏幕，则会出现滚动条。

1b0dc8717e516ad4.source: MDM doesn't do this alone, and doesn't pretend to. <g1>yt-dlp</g1> reads the page and downloads the video. <g2>ffmpeg</g2> joins the picture and the sound when a site keeps them apart, which most sites do for their higher qualities. MDM offers both on its first start and downloads them from their official releases, checked against what their publishers sign before it uses them. On Linux and macOS MDM uses the system's ffmpeg.
1b0dc8717e516ad4.text: MDM 并非独立完成此功能，也从未声称如此。<g1>yt-dlp</g1>负责读取页面并下载视频。<g2>ffmpeg</g2>负责将视频和音频合并，因为大多数网站为了提供更高画质，会将它们分开。MDM 在首次启动时会提供这两个程序，并从其官方发布渠道下载，在使用前会检查发布者签名。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，MDM 使用系统自带的 ffmpeg。

1b0e944da20951df.source: Faster than IDM. Timed to the millisecond.
1b0e944da20951df.text: 比 IDM 更快，精确测时至毫秒。

1b2880e6f949c293.source: <g1>Open the following file when done</g1> — for example a sound, a script or a program. <g2>...</g2> picks the file.
1b2880e6f949c293.text: <g1>完成后打开以下文件</g1> — 例如声音、脚本或程序。<g2>...</g2>用于选择文件。

1b3efe7b98d2c2da.source: Jump to the item that starts with it, in a list or a drop-down
1b3efe7b98d2c2da.text: 在列表或下拉列表中，跳转到以该字母开头的项目

1b3f954132679636.source: <g1>Download File Info's errors are worded in the interface language</g1>, as the list's are.
1b3f954132679636.text: <g1>“下载文件信息”的错误信息以界面语言显示</g1>，与列表中的错误信息一致。

1b435f0f6139d174.source: You may use, copy, change and share Mister Download Manager under the <g1>GNU GPL, version 3</g1>.
1b435f0f6139d174.text: 您可以根据<g1>GNU GPL 第 3 版</g1>使用、复制、修改和分享 Mister Download Manager。

1b5c1b21bdd749ea.source: When none of this helps, the browser keeps the download, so nothing is lost. The extension's toolbar button says why it couldn't reach MDM; see <g1>The browser and MDM aren't connected</g1>.
1b5c1b21bdd749ea.text: 如果以上方法都不起作用，浏览器会保留下载任务，不会丢失任何内容。扩展程序的工具栏按钮会说明无法连接到 MDM 的原因；另请参阅<g1>浏览器和 MDM 未连接</g1>。

1b638519d92c59b7.source: More about queues in <g1>Queues and the Scheduler</g1>.
1b638519d92c59b7.text: 有关队列的更多信息，请参1阅<g1>队列和计划程序</g1>。

1b8ba08ddbbd4d39.source: Show a dialog and ask what to do.
1b8ba08ddbbd4d39.text: 显示对话框并询问如何操作。

1b95b890c71da1b4.source: How it works: a second copy of MDM, the <g1>monitor</g1>, starts beside it with <x2/>. The crash code lives in <x3/> and <x4/>.
1b95b890c71da1b4.text: 工作原理：MDM 的另一个副本（即<g1>监视器</g1>）会通过<x2/>在 MDM 旁边启动。崩溃处理代码位于<x3/>和<x4/>中。

1b9bbdc7f554f0b8.source: In Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur the whole window is mirrored: the menus, toolbar and categories run from right to left, as Windows does for these languages. File names, addresses and folder paths keep their own direction inside translated sentences, so they stay readable.
1b9bbdc7f554f0b8.text: 使用阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语时，整个窗口会镜像显示：菜单、工具栏和分类会从右向左排列，就像 Windows 对这些语言的处理方式一样。文件名、地址和文件夹路径在翻译后的句子中仍保持原有的书写方向，以确保可读性。

1bad738cb3cea90f.source: Select or unselect the download with the dotted outline
1bad738cb3cea90f.text: 选择或取消选择带虚线轮廓的下载

1badff5f5fc8b6a9.source: Download MDM only from <g1>the website</g1> or <g2>GitHub Releases</g2>.
1badff5f5fc8b6a9.text: 仅从<g1>官网</g1>或 <g2>GitHub Releases</g2> 下载 MDM。

1bc816518d6f87cb.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: the folder its torrents go to; empty, the Torrents category's folder. <g2>Add them without starting them</g2> adds them as <g3>Download Later</g3> would.

1bcf62be8def689c.text: “下载文件信息”中圈出的“稍后下载”

1be93bd020009908.source: <g1>The keyboard focus got lost</g1> when a button greyed itself or Escape closed a drop-down: Tab started over at the top of the window. It now moves on, or comes back, as in Windows.
1be93bd020009908.text: <g1>键盘焦点会丢失</g1>：按钮变灰或按 Escape 关闭下拉菜单时，按 Tab 会从窗口顶部重新开始。现在，焦点会像在 Windows 中一样继续移动或返回。

1c0101659f1e2203.source: <g1>Feeds</g1>: the feeds it watches; none ticked, all of them.
1c0101659f1e2203.text: <g1>源</g1>：规则适用的源；如果没有勾选任何源，则适用于所有源。

1c41a815ee54b7d7.source: MDM has <g1>no analytics, no automatic crash reporting, no telemetry and no advertising</g1> (a crash report goes only where you send it yourself). It never sends us your download list, the addresses you download, or anything else.
1c41a815ee54b7d7.text: MDM <g1>没有分析、没有自动崩溃报告、没有遥测、没有广告</g1>（崩溃报告只发送到您自己发送的地方）。它绝不会向我们发送您的下载列表、您下载的地址或任何其他信息。

1c4670fc540cb86b.source: <g1>Refresh</g1> fetches the selected feed now. <g2>Remove</g2> stops watching it. A feed that can't be read is shown in red, and its line at the bottom says why.
1c4670fc540cb86b.text: <g1>刷新</g1>会立即获取选定的源。<g2>删除</g2>会停止监视该源。无法读取的源会显示为红色，底部一行会说明原因。

1c4a1576b5d90b00.source: Logos and names belong to their owners and are shown only to identify each product; Mister Download Manager has no connection to them.
1c4a1576b5d90b00.text: 徽标和名称归其所有者所有，仅用于识别各产品；Mister Download Manager 与它们无任何关联。

1c4eee6300f12df4.source: Every file name now has its file-type icon, the one your system uses.
1c4eee6300f12df4.text: 现在每个文件名都带有其文件类型图标，即您的系统所使用的图标。

1c6bf762506d348a.text: MDM 附带一个 <g1>MCP</g1> 服务器 <x2/>，因此支持 MCP 的 AI 助手（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 等）可以与您正在运行的 MDM 中的下载协同工作。您可以用自己的话提问：

1c7c99ef90478d88.text: Windows 10/11；macOS 和 Linux 版本可供试用

1c90a99a45e311c8.text: 如果服务无法获取种子（没有对等方、文件过大或请求被拒绝），列表会说明原因。

1c983d2d9b657a29.source: MDM downloads videos from their web pages with yt-dlp, the open-source tool whose community keeps it working as sites change. You pick the quality; the video joins your other downloads.
1c983d2d9b657a29.text: MDM 使用开源工具 yt-dlp 从网页下载视频。yt-dlp 社区会持续更新，以适应网站变化。您可以选择画质，视频将加入您的下载列表。

1ca5420546545830.source: <g1>Force processes to terminate</g1> closes programs that would otherwise hold Windows up.
1ca5420546545830.text: <g1>强制终止进程</g1>会关闭那些可能导致 Windows 无法正常关闭的程序。

1cafb86bd2c2b2f4.source: <g1>Download File Info</g1> shows the file's name, its size and where it will be saved. The folder depends on the file's type: a ZIP goes to <x2/>, a video to <x3/>, and so on. Change the folder or the category if you like.
1cafb86bd2c2b2f4.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>显示文件名、大小以及保存位置。文件夹取决于文件类型：ZIP 文件到<x2/>，视频文件到<x3/>，依此类推。您可以更改文件夹或类别。

1cf59e936ec9e349.source: Whether <g1>7-Zip</g1> was found: 7z and RAR archives need it.
1cf59e936ec9e349.text: 是否找到 <g1>7-Zip</g1>：7z 和 RAR 存档需要使用它。

1cfe5aa7a4ff4b14.source: <g1>The engine tests no longer fail on a busy computer</g1> (<g2>#123</g2>, <g3>#136</g3>, <g4>#201</g4>):

1d098969ea9cf781.source: : the user that owns those folders (MDM runs as no particular user).
1d098969ea9cf781.text: ：拥有这些文件夹的用户（MDM 不以特定用户身份运行）。

1d26bf9aebfa246c.source: The main window in Arabic, laid out right to left.
1d26bf9aebfa246c.text: 阿拉伯语主窗口，采用从右到左的布局。

1d28151c4fc4f2b7.source: The download's log (hover over it in the list) says what happened: <g1>Extracted 12 files to …</g1>, or why not, for example <g2>Couldn't extract movie.7z.001: volume 3 of it is missing</g2>. An encrypted archive without its password opens the <g3>Archive password</g3> window. Type the password and click <g4>Extract</g4>, or <g5>Cancel</g5> to leave the archive as it is.
1d28151c4fc4f2b7.text: 下载日志（将鼠标悬停在列表中的下载上即可查看）会说明提取结果：<g1>已提取 12 个文件到…</g1>；如果提取失败，也会说明原因，例如 <g2>无法提取 movie.7z.001：缺少第 3 卷</g2>。如果加密存档没有密码，会打开“<g3>存档密码</g3>”窗口。输入密码并点击“<g4>提取</g4>”，或点击“<g5>取消</g5>”以保留存档。

1d4ee2f96c724f0f.source: A torrent: what it sends to peers, while it runs.
1d4ee2f96c724f0f.text: 一个种子：运行时发送给对等点的数据。

1d5d3ee024011a5e.source: When a torrent's files are already in the folder, MDM asks before writing into them.
1d5d3ee024011a5e.text: 当 torrent 文件已存在于文件夹中时，MDM 会在写入前进行询问。

1d698c89212c8b9b.text: 每次运行期间各应用占用的 CPU 时间中位数和内存峰值。MDM 使用 GPU 绘制窗口，因此比 IDM 的经典 Windows 控件占用更多内存。

1d6ccabe01271561.source: The progress window: speed, time left and each connection's share of the file
1d6ccabe01271561.text: 进度窗口：速度、剩余时间以及每个连接的文件份额

1d7e46d70dc708ef.source: <g1>Download video</g1> shows a plain file's size, from its server, instead of "size unknown" (<g2>#320</g2>).
1d7e46d70dc708ef.text: <g1>下载视频</g1>会显示普通文件从服务器获取的大小，而不是“大小未知”（<g2>#320</g2>）。

1da156143837aec9.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 Torrent</g1>来选择一个 <x2/> 文件。或者点击旁边的箭头，选择<g3>打开 torrent 文件...</g3>或<g4>添加磁力链接...</g4>（也在<g5>任务</g5>下）。

1db710a3a79cb703.source: <g1>Show download complete dialog</g1> — show <g2>Download complete</g2> when a file finishes.
1db710a3a79cb703.text: <g1>显示下载完成对话框</g1> — 文件完成时显示<g2>下载完成</g2>。

1dc7d4ba0d377867.text: 遵循浏览器的 VPN 扩展

1dd3fad91652b5ff.source: Pick what the setup should do: - <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> - <g2>Open .torrent files and magnet links with Mister Download Manager</g2> - <g3>Start Mister Download Manager when Windows starts</g3> - <g4>Create a desktop shortcut</g4> (off unless you tick it)
1dd3fad91652b5ff.text: 选择安装程序应执行的操作：- <g1>设置浏览器集成 (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> - <g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 打开 .torrent 文件和磁力链接</g2> - <g3>Windows 启动时启动 Mister Download Manager</g3> - <g4>创建桌面快捷方式</g4>（默认关闭，除非您勾选）

1e4861cc4f32a384.source: <g1>Every text the user sees goes through <x2/></g1> (<x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>); after adding one, run <x7/>. Data inside a sentence (a file name, an address, a size) goes in through <x8/> or <x9/>, so it reads right in right-to-left languages.
1e4861cc4f32a384.text: <g1>用户看到的所有文本都必须通过<x2/></g1>（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/>）；添加文本后，运行<x7/>。句子中的数据（文件名、地址、大小）应通过<x8/>或<x9/>传入，以便在从右到左的语言中正确显示。

1e7024dcce490c17.text: 下载列表 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

1e85323c7843fa8c.text: 填写<g1>每 [H] 小时下载不超过 [N] MB</g1>。默认设置为每 5 小时 200 MB。

1edcb9d37be4f279.text: 选项 → 常规 → 使用高级浏览器集成

1fa3125805e7daac.source: In a Wayland session (GNOME, KDE Plasma and others), MDM's windows run through XWayland when it is there: Wayland doesn't let a program place its own windows, so MDM's menus and drop-down lists would open in the middle of the screen. To run on Wayland itself anyway, start it with <x1/>. If the system lacks a library X11 windows need (such as libxkbcommon-x11, which the .deb and .rpm bring but the AppImage and the tar.gz can't), MDM opens on Wayland instead; with no window system it can use, it names what's missing and the command that installs it.
1fa3125805e7daac.text: 在 Wayland 会话（GNOME、KDE Plasma 及其他）中，如果存在 XWayland，MDM 的窗口会通过 XWayland 运行：Wayland 不允许程序自行放置窗口，因此 MDM 的菜单和下拉列表会打开在屏幕中央。若要在 Wayland 本身运行，请使用<x1/>启动。如果系统缺少 X11 窗口所需的库（例如 libxkbcommon-x11，.deb 和 .rpm 包会提供，但 AppImage 和 tar.gz 包无法提供），MDM 会转而在 Wayland 上打开；如果没有可用的窗口系统，它会列出缺失的组件和安装命令。

1fd04f332635d14c.source: Look at <g1>Resume capability</g1> in the progress window. <g2>No</g2> means the server can't send a file in parts. MDM then uses one connection, and a download that stops has to start over. For such servers, avoid stopping the download, and avoid a very low speed limit, which can make the server drop the connection.
1fd04f332635d14c.text: 查看进度窗口中的<g1>恢复功能</g1>。<g2>否</g2>表示服务器无法分段发送文件。MDM 此时会使用一个连接，并且停止的下载必须重新开始。对于此类服务器，请避免停止下载，并避免设置过低的限速，这可能导致服务器断开连接。

21aa032bde745310.source: A download's first request (<x1/>) follows redirects and the pages that lead on to a file by themselves (a waiting page's refresh). Sites whose links aren't the file's address have a module in <x2/> (Google Drive: <x3/>): it turns the link into the file's address, reads the site's own pages (a confirmation form, an error page) and names its refusals (<x4/>), with pure functions tested without a network. The lab server plays such a site on its real host names for the end-to-end tests (<x5/>).
21aa032bde745310.text: 下载的第一个请求 (<x1/>) 会跟踪重定向以及那些自行导向文件的页面（例如等待页面的刷新）。如果网站的链接不是文件地址，<x2/> 中会有一个模块（例如 Google Drive: <x3/>）：它将链接转换为文件地址，读取网站自己的页面（例如确认表单、错误页面），并指出其拒绝原因 (<x4/>)，所有这些都通过无需网络即可测试的纯函数实现。实验室服务器会在其真实主机名上模拟此类网站，以进行端到端测试 (<x5/>)。

21bc1db419022796.source: <g1>Statcounter</g1> counts visits so we know which pages people read and where they come from. Its script records the page you open, the page that linked to it, your browser, system and screen size, and your approximate location from your IP address, and sets a cookie to tell new visitors from returning ones. We see these as statistics in Statcounter's dashboard; we don't use them to identify you, and we don't sell or share them. See <g2>Statcounter's privacy policy</g2>. Blocking cookies or scripts for statcounter.com in your browser, or a content blocker, keeps you out of the count; the site works the same.
21bc1db419022796.text: <g1>Statcounter</g1> 统计访问量，以便我们了解人们阅读了哪些页面以及他们来自何处。其脚本会记录您打开的页面、链接到该页面的页面、您的浏览器、系统和屏幕尺寸，以及根据您的 IP 地址推断的大致位置，并设置一个 Cookie 来区分新访客和回访者。我们在 Statcounter 的控制面板中将这些信息视为统计数据；我们不会使用它们来识别您的身份，也不会出售或分享它们。请参阅 <g2>Statcounter 的隐私政策</g2>。在您的浏览器中阻止 statcounter.com 的 Cookie 或脚本，或使用内容拦截器，可以使您不被计入统计；网站功能保持不变。

21bd8c498a87e902.source: <g1>from YouTube Music and YouTube's mobile site</g1>: the button over a video on music.youtube.com or m.youtube.com passed the page's cookies for that host only, while yt-dlp asks www.youtube.com, so the sign-in didn't reach it. The extension now sends each cookie with the domain the browser keeps it for, and MDM gives yt-dlp each one for that domain: youtube.com's sign-in reaches every YouTube host, and a host's own cookie stays with that host. With an older extension, a YouTube page's cookies (or a site's mobile page's, m. and mobile.) go to the whole site.
21bd8c498a87e902.text: <g1>来自 YouTube Music 和 YouTube 移动网站</g1>：music.youtube.com 或 m.youtube.com 上视频上方的按钮仅传递该主机的页面 Cookie，而 yt-dlp 请求的是 www.youtube.com，因此登录信息未到达。现在，扩展程序会为浏览器保存的每个域发送相应的 Cookie，MDM 会将每个 Cookie 提供给 yt-dlp 用于该域：youtube.com 的登录信息会到达所有 YouTube 主机，而主机的自有 Cookie 会保留在该主机上。对于较旧的扩展程序，YouTube 页面的 Cookie（或网站移动页面的 Cookie，m. 和 mobile.）会发送到整个网站。

235c06966eea3298.source: In Torrent settings you can turn off <g1>Accept incoming connections</g1> and <g2>Map the port on the router (UPnP)</g2>, or the DHT. Downloads still work, sometimes more slowly. 2656643a5769e161.source: <g1>Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Premiumize</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>): <g3>Options → Accounts</g3> keeps your debrid service accounts. Real-Debrid signs in by code in the browser, or with your API token; AllDebrid by a PIN in the browser or with an API key, and MDM waits while it prepares a slow link; Premiumize with its API key. A link from a file host your service supports is unlocked through your account, then downloaded with all of MDM's connections, pause and resume, from Add URL, the browser's link menu and batch downloads. When the direct link expires, MDM asks the service for a new one. The direct link is never shown or copied, and the sign-in is kept like your other passwords (the system's keychain, below). Each service is asked well under its request limit. See <g4>Debrid service accounts</g4>. Experimental: built from the services' public API documentation, not yet confirmed with a real paid account.
2656643a5769e161.text: <g1>Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 和 Premiumize</g1>（<g2>#44</g2>）：<g3>选项 → 账户</g3> 用于保存您的网盘服务账户。Real-Debrid 通过浏览器中的代码或您的 API 令牌登录；AllDebrid 通过浏览器中的 PIN 码或 API 密钥登录，MDM 会等待它准备慢速链接；Premiumize 使用其 API 密钥。您的服务支持的文件托管链接会通过您的账户解锁，然后通过“添加 URL”、浏览器链接菜单和批量下载，使用 MDM 的所有连接、暂停和恢复功能进行下载。当直链过期时，MDM 会向服务请求新的链接。直链永远不会显示或复制，并且登录信息会像您的其他密码一样保存（系统密钥链，见下文）。每个服务的请求频率都远低于其请求限制。请参阅<g4>网盘服务帐户</g4>。实验性功能：根据服务的公共 API 文档构建，尚未通过真实的付费账户确认。

27a63d4123ea19ed.source: Carry MDM on a USB stick
27a63d4123ea19ed.text: 在 U 盘上携带 MDM

27be9a365a65b5ef.source: Add links and manage your downloads and queues from your phone, on your own network: <g1>Options → Remote</g1>.
27be9a365a65b5ef.text: 在您自己的网络中，从手机添加链接并管理下载和队列：<g1>选项 → 远程</g1>。

27cc3e16602bb3b6.source: <g1>Source</g1>, <g2>Q</g2> and <g3>Status</g3> offer a few values to tick, such as only <g4>Error</g4> under <g5>Status</g5>, or only <g6>Not in a queue</g6> under <g7>Q</g7>.
27cc3e16602bb3b6.text: <g1>源</g1>、<g2>队列</g2>和<g3>状态</g3>可供选择一些值，例如只显示<g5>状态</g5>为<g4>错误</g4>的项目，或只显示<g7>队列</g7>为<g6>不在队列中</g6>的项目。

281e2c871ace1c1d.source: Not affiliated with Tonec Inc.; Internet Download Manager and IDM are trademarks of their owner, named here only to compare.
281e2c871ace1c1d.text: 与 Tonec Inc. 无关联；Internet Download Manager 和 IDM 是其所有者的商标，此处仅用于比较。

28229ae295418c57.source: Each language has its own catalog in the repository: <x1/>, for example <x2/> for German or <x3/> for Portuguese (Brazil). The codes are listed in <x4/>. Each catalog is a text file with one row per text, in three columns separated by tabs:
28229ae295418c57.text: 存储库中每种语言都有自己的目录：<x1/>，例如德语目录<x2/>或巴西葡萄牙语目录<x3/>。代码列在<x4/>中。每个目录都是一个文本文件，每行对应一条文本，分为由制表符分隔的三列：

2825ed52113e5428.source: Up to 128 connections per file, re-split as they go
2825ed52113e5428.text: 每个文件最多 128 个连接，下载时可重新分配

2826420ef85a1bcf.source: Open <g1>View → Language...</g1>. The same window as on the first start opens: every language by its flag, its own name and its English name. Type in <g2>Search</g2> to narrow the list, then double-click a language or select it and click <g3>OK</g3>. The window switches at once; there is nothing to restart.
2826420ef85a1bcf.text: 打开<g1>视图 → 语言...</g1>。打开的窗口与首次启动时相同，其中每种语言都显示国旗、该语言的名称和英文名称。在<g2>搜索</g2>中输入内容以缩小列表范围，然后双击一种语言，或选择该语言并点击<g3>确定</g3>。界面会立即切换，无需重新启动。

282f9b6ea43027ed.source: Saved beside the video, they get its name and the language: <x1/>. Players such as VLC and MPV pick them up on their own. With ffmpeg they're always SRT; without it, the site's own format (often WebVTT, <x2/>).
282f9b6ea43027ed.text: 字幕文件会保存在视频旁边，文件名与视频相同，并带有语言信息：<x1/>。VLC 和 MPV 等播放器会自动识别字幕。使用 ffmpeg 时，字幕始终为 SRT 格式；不使用 ffmpeg 时，则采用网站提供的格式（通常是 WebVTT，<x2/>）。

28303c1fbe9c6009.source: Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, from their stores

28363ce0cfaf4e8e.source: The browser extension, from the browsers' own stores: the Chrome Web Store's is for Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi too. It also comes with the app and as <g1>its own download</g1>, to add by hand. Every file is built from the public source by GitHub Actions and listed with its SHA-256 checksum.
28363ce0cfaf4e8e.text: 浏览器扩展可从各浏览器自带的商店获取：Chrome 网上应用店中的版本也适用于 Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi。扩展也随应用一同提供，还可<g1>单独下载</g1>并手动添加。每个文件都由 GitHub Actions 根据公开的源代码构建，并附有 SHA-256 校验和。

285bca50f6f03a0a.source: Start Download: the progress window shows it coming in.
285bca50f6f03a0a.text: 开始下载：进度窗口显示文件正在下载。

286a2be607456e48.source: Set <g1>Maximum download speed</g1> in KBytes/sec. The new limit applies at once.
286a2be607456e48.text: 以千字节/秒为单位设置<g1>最大下载速度</g1>。新限制会立即生效。

28a0353a83207f33.source: <g1>Open folder no longer freezes the window</g1> (<g2>#222</g2>): Download complete's <g3>Open folder</g3> asks the desktop's file manager (over D-Bus) to show the file, and MDM waited for its answer on the window's own thread. A file manager slow to start, or one that never answered (seen on Pop!_OS), froze the window until the freeze report caught it. MDM now asks in the background and, when the file manager hasn't answered within 5 seconds, opens the folder instead. Every other program MDM starts from a window goes the same way, on every system: Test browser integration's <g4>Set it up</g4>, moving an extracted archive to the Trash (on a Mac the Finder may ask first), putting an update in place (<g5>Installing the update...</g5>, with Cancel greyed while it runs), opening pages and folders, reading the icon theme on Linux and, on a Mac, the accent colour (every 2 seconds with the Native theme) and the system's version for a bug report.
28a0353a83207f33.text: <g1>“打开文件夹”不再冻结窗口</g1> (<g2>#222</g2>)：“下载完成”的<g3>打开文件夹</g3>会请求桌面文件管理器（通过 D-Bus）显示文件，而 MDM 会在窗口自己的线程上等待其响应。启动缓慢或从未响应的文件管理器（在 Pop!_OS 上出现过）会冻结窗口，直到冻结报告捕获到它。MDM 现在会在后台请求，如果文件管理器在 5 秒内没有响应，则会转而打开文件夹。MDM 从窗口启动的所有其他程序在所有系统上都以相同的方式运行：“测试浏览器集成”的<g4>设置</g4>，将提取的存档移动到垃圾箱（在 Mac 上 Finder 可能会先询问），安装更新（<g5>正在安装更新...</g5>，运行时“取消”按钮会变灰），打开页面和文件夹，在 Linux 上读取图标主题，以及在 Mac 上读取强调色（使用原生主题时每 2 秒一次）和系统版本以用于错误报告。

28a8a7183e41f557.source: <g1>Zen, Helium and other browsers built on Firefox or Chromium</g1> (<g2>#41</g2>): the extension reaches MDM in them, also when one is the only browser on Linux or macOS (Zen reads Firefox's folder, which MDM now creates; Helium its own). <g3>Add Mister Download Manager to your browser</g3> lists them, Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp and Waterfox by their own names (Options too), and sends Firefox's family to the right page. On Windows MDM lists the browsers Windows itself lists, so Helium is no longer taken for Chrome. Flatpak browsers can't start MDM's helper, which the help page now says.
28a8a7183e41f557.text: <g1>Zen、Helium 和其他基于 Firefox 或 Chromium 构建的浏览器</g1>（<g2>#41</g2>）：扩展可以在这些浏览器中连接到 MDM，即使其中一个浏览器是 Linux 或 macOS 上唯一的浏览器（Zen 读取 Firefox 的文件夹，MDM 现在会创建；Helium 读取其自己的文件夹）。<g3>将 Mister Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g3>会列出它们，Zen、LibreWolf、Floorp 和 Waterfox 会显示其自己的名称（“选项”中也是），并将 Firefox 系列浏览器发送到正确的页面。在 Windows 上，MDM 会列出 Windows 自身列出的浏览器，因此 Helium 不再被视为 Chrome。Flatpak 浏览器无法启动 MDM 的助手，帮助页面现在会说明这一点。

28aaa598d16d2456.source: <g1>Downloads on a schedule</g1> Queues that start at 2 a.m., stop by 7 and turn the computer off when they're done.
28aaa598d16d2456.text: <g1>定时下载</g1> 设置队列在凌晨 2 点开始、早上 7 点前停止，并在下载完成后关闭电脑。

28b58f9af9a6fed9.source: In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera or Vivaldi
28b58f9af9a6fed9.text: 在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 或 Vivaldi 中

292621fe40d7beca.source: Every video starts ticked. Untick the ones you don't want, or use <g1>Select all</g1> and <g2>Select none</g2>. Private and deleted videos are greyed out and can't be ticked.
292621fe40d7beca.text: 每个视频默认都已勾选。取消勾选不需要的视频，或使用<g1>全选</g1>和<g2>不选</g2>。私人和已删除的视频会显示为灰色，无法勾选。

296bb6abbc747f28.source: If it gives up and shows <g1>Error</g1>:
296bb6abbc747f28.text: 如果重试失败并显示<g1>错误</g1>：

29746f1ff804cccd.source: <g1>AppImage tools support:</g1> the AppImage can update through them, downloading only what changed.
29746f1ff804cccd.text: <g1>支持 AppImage 工具：</g1> AppImage 可以通过它们进行更新，只下载更改的部分。

2a014824bb4f981c.source: Disabled text, the one grey of every greyed control and label
2a014824bb4f981c.text: 禁用文本，所有灰色控件和标签的灰色

2a1c06f26ea84eee.source: <g1>pywal itself:</g1> once <x2/> has run, <g3>View → Theme</g3> lists <g4>pywal</g4>, read straight from where pywal writes its colours: <x5/> (on Windows <x6/>, where winwal and pywal write it; <x7/> or <x8/> when you set them). Pick it and MDM follows your wallpaper: each time <x9/> writes new colours, MDM takes them within two seconds. It looks only at the file's date and size, every two seconds, and only while pywal is the theme. A copy added with <g10>Add a theme file…</g10> keeps the colours it had.
2a1c06f26ea84eee.text: <g1>pywal 本身：</g1> 一旦 <x2/> 运行，<g3>视图 → 主题</g3> 会列出 <g4>pywal</g4>，直接从 pywal 写入颜色的位置读取：<x5/>（在 Windows 上是 <x6/>，winwal 和 pywal 写入此处；如果您设置了 <x7/> 或 <x8/>，则为这些位置）。选择它，MDM 就会跟随您的壁纸：每次 <x9/> 写入新颜色时，MDM 都会在两秒内获取。它每两秒只查看文件日期和大小，并且仅在 pywal 是主题时。通过 <g10>添加主题文件…</g10> 添加的副本会保留其原有的颜色。

2a367bb5be1ef2a5.source: <g1>Build it from source</g1><g2>cargo build, on Windows, macOS or Linux</g2>
2a367bb5be1ef2a5.text: <g1>从源代码构建</g1><g2>在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上运行 cargo build</g2>

2a42c1b85c83a742.source: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, is the main platform. Builds for Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) come with every release too; today's are marked experimental. From version 0.5.0, Linux isn't experimental any more: it is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, in Wayland sessions too, and its packages in clean Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora systems. Still to come there: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet, and screen readers (Orca) don't read MDM's windows yet. macOS stays experimental. See <g1>Windows, Mac and Linux</g1> and <g2>Download</g2>.
2a42c1b85c83a742.text: Windows 10 和 11（64 位）是主要平台。每个版本也提供 Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm 和 .tar.gz) 和 macOS (.dmg) 构建版本；目前这些版本标记为实验性。从 0.5.0 版本开始，Linux 不再是实验性的：它已在 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon（包括 Wayland 会话）以及干净的 Ubuntu、Debian 和 Fedora 系统中的软件包上进行过检查。仍有待完成的工作：Flatpak Firefox 尚未检查，屏幕阅读器 (Orca) 尚未读取 MDM 的窗口。macOS 仍处于实验阶段。请参阅<g1>Windows、Mac 和 Linux</g1>以及<g2>下载</g2>。

2a45fadaa534ed11.source: <g1>The volumes of one archive</g1> (<x2/>, <x3/>…, or <x4/>, <x5/>…) form one package named after the archive, as long as they come from the same site.
2a45fadaa534ed11.text: <g1>同一存档的分卷</g1>（<x2/>、<x3/>…，或<x4/>、<x5/>…）来自同一站点时，会组成一个以存档命名的分组。

2a6ff2c6c070bf78.source: MDM comes with an MCP server, misterdownloadmanager-mcp, so an AI assistant that supports MCP (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and others) can…
2a6ff2c6c070bf78.text: MDM 附带一个 MCP 服务器 misterdownloadmanager-mcp，因此支持 MCP 的 AI 助手（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 及其他）可以…

2a737f9f3c493f67.source: Machine translations in all 85 languages were checked again against the English and corrected.
2a737f9f3c493f67.text: 所有 85 种语言的机器翻译都已根据英文原文重新检查并更正。

2a7a3565df41c178.source: <g1>A page for every feature, and a Themes page</g1> (<g2>#260</g2>): each feature has a page of its own, with the real window, where to find it in the app, since which version, and what it can't do yet; the home page lists them all, by group. The Themes page shows every built-in theme in its light and dark side, and how to make your own theme file, try it without building MDM, and share it, with a prompt to give an AI assistant. What isn't in a release yet says so.
2a7a3565df41c178.text: <g1>每个功能都有一个页面，以及一个主题页面</g1>（<g2>#260</g2>）：每个功能都有自己的页面，包含真实的窗口截图、在应用中的位置、从哪个版本开始提供，以及尚未实现的功能；主页按组列出所有功能。主题页面展示了每个内置主题的亮色和暗色模式，以及如何制作自己的主题文件、无需构建 MDM 即可试用，并分享主题，同时提示可以向 AI 助手提问。尚未发布的功能会特别说明。

2a86bffcb4952c03.source: <g1>Logging in.</g1> Write the login in the address (<x2/>), tick <g3>Use authorization</g3>, or save it in <g4>Options → Sites Logins</g4>. Without one, MDM logs in as <x5/>. The path is relative to the folder the login starts in; to start from the server's root, write <x6/> after the server (<x7/>).
2a86bffcb4952c03.text: <g1>登录。</g1>可将登录信息写入地址（<x2/>）、勾选<g3>使用授权</g3>，或将其保存到<g4>选项 → 站点登录</g4>。如果没有登录信息，MDM 会以 <x5/> 身份登录。路径相对于登录后所在的文件夹；要从服务器根目录开始，请在服务器地址后写入<x6/>（<x7/>）。

2ab8acec08b25c9a.source: <g1>A server on your computer or your local network</g1> shows as such, with no flag.
2ab8acec08b25c9a.text: <g1>您计算机或本地网络上的服务器</g1>会显示为本地服务器，不带旗帜。

2add106c9e30c8d5.source: <g1>One browser only:</g1> <g2>Options → General → Capture downloads from the following browsers</g2>. Untick the ones MDM should leave alone.
2add106c9e30c8d5.text: <g1>仅使用某个浏览器：</g1><g2>选项 → 常规 → 从以下浏览器捕获下载</g2>。取消勾选要由 MDM 忽略的浏览器。

2ae83cc65522b8e0.source: <g1>Lists read as blank items</g1> (<g2>#95</g2>): the rows of Download video's qualities, Add torrent's files, the language picker, Options (browsers, sounds, the file-type and site lists), the Scheduler and Import now have their names (a format and its size, a file's name and size), their check boxes theirs, ticked or not, and their selected row; Download video's list is called Quality, Add torrent's Files and the sounds' Sounds. Choosing a row from a screen reader (UI Automation's Select) now shows the new choice at once: it used to wait for the next mouse move.
2ae83cc65522b8e0.text: <g1>列表项不再显示为空白</g1> (<g2>#95</g2>)：“下载视频”的质量列表、“添加种子”的文件列表、语言选择器、“选项”（浏览器、声音、文件类型和站点列表）、“计划程序”和“导入”的行现在都有其名称（格式和大小、文件名和大小）、其复选框（选中或未选中）以及其选定的行；“下载视频”的列表名为“质量”，“添加种子”的列表名为“文件”，声音列表名为“声音”。现在，从屏幕阅读器中选择一行（UI Automation 的 Select）会立即显示新选择：以前它会等待下一次鼠标移动。

2b022cf4d9a97412.source: An encrypted archive without its password opens the <g1>Archive password</g1> window. Hover over the download in the list to read what happened: how many files were extracted and where, or why not.
2b022cf4d9a97412.text: 没有密码的加密压缩包会打开<g1>压缩包密码</g1>窗口。将鼠标悬停在列表中的下载任务上，可以查看发生了什么：提取了多少文件、提取到哪里，或者为什么没有提取。

2b1b4f2777615ee9.source: <g1>Alt</g1> and <g2>F10</g2> open the menu bar while a button or the list has the keyboard focus, not only when nothing does (<g3>#328</g3>).
2b1b4f2777615ee9.text: 当按钮或列表具有键盘焦点时，<g1>Alt</g1> 和 <g2>F10</g2> 可以打开菜单栏，而不仅仅是在没有焦点时（<g3>#328</g3>）。

2b1f05dd303b4a14.source: <g1>Resume capability</g1> — <g2>Yes</g2> if the server lets MDM continue the download later, <g3>No</g3> if it doesn't.
2b1f05dd303b4a14.text: <g1>恢复功能</g1> — 如果服务器允许 MDM 稍后继续下载，则为<g2>是</g2>；如果不允许，则为<g3>否</g3>。

2b32b47b6f8a0433.source: <g1>Remember this path for "…" category</g1> — tick it to make the folder you typed the category's folder from now on.
2b32b47b6f8a0433.text: <g1>记住“…”类别的此路径</g1> — 勾选此项可将您输入的文件夹设为该类别从今往后的文件夹。

2b3813b1923fc5e3.source: The list covers every display language of Windows 11, including both Chinese scripts, Spanish for Spain and Mexico, French for France and Canada, Portuguese for Portugal and Brazil, and Serbian in Cyrillic and Latin. The <g1>languages page</g1> lists them all.
2b3813b1923fc5e3.text: 此列表涵盖 Windows 11 的所有显示语言，包括两种中文脚本、西班牙语（西班牙和墨西哥）、法语（法国和加拿大）、葡萄牙语（葡萄牙和巴西），以及西里尔字母和拉丁字母的塞尔维亚语。<g1>语言页面</g1>列出了所有这些语言。

2b3d6323fe302b82.source: <g1>Menus fit their texts</g1>: they were wider than needed, so short commands looked lost in them.
2b3d6323fe302b82.text: <g1>菜单宽度与文本相匹配</g1>：之前菜单太宽，简短的命令显得很空。

2b4574fba16c1a56.source: IDM vs Mister Download Manager, timed to the millisecond
2b4574fba16c1a56.text: IDM 与 Mister Download Manager，精确到毫秒的计时

2b51dbb563e184f7.source: MDM no longer contacts torrent trackers on this computer or the local network.
2b51dbb563e184f7.text: MDM 不再联系此计算机或本地网络上的 torrent 跟踪器。

2b59fa980f99642c.source: <g1>Queues</g1> — each queue; select one to see only its downloads.
2b59fa980f99642c.text: <g1>队列</g1> — 显示各个队列；选择一个队列即可只查看其中的下载。

2b7236574073322f.source: By default MDM starts downloading while this window is open, so no time is lost while you decide. <g1>Cancel</g1> drops what it fetched. You can turn this off in <g2>Options → Downloads → Start downloading immediately while displaying "Download File Info" dialog</g2>.
2b7236574073322f.text: 默认情况下，MDM 会在此窗口打开时开始下载，因此您在决定时不会浪费时间。<g1>取消</g1>会丢弃已获取的内容。您可以在<g2>选项 → 下载 → 显示“下载文件信息”对话框时立即开始下载</g2>中关闭此功能。

2b7807a59c407729.source: Right-click any text box for <g1>Undo</g1>, <g2>Cut</g2>, <g3>Copy</g3>, <g4>Paste</g4>, <g5>Delete</g5> and <g6>Select all</g6>. A read-only value (an address, a path, a version) copies with <g7>Ctrl+C</g7> or its right-click menu.
2b7807a59c407729.text: 右键点击任何文本框可进行<g1>撤消</g1>、<g2>剪切</g2>、<g3>复制</g3>、<g4>粘贴</g4>、<g5>删除</g5>和<g6>全选</g6>。只读值（地址、路径、版本）可通过<g7>Ctrl+C</g7>或右键菜单复制。

2b85e42ae79f0732.source: <g1>Off on this site</g1> (grey): after <g2>Never on</g2> the site, or when Options keep it off there. <g3>Turn on</g3> shows it on the site again.
2b85e42ae79f0732.text: <g1>此站点已关闭</g1>（灰色）：在网站上选择<g2>从不在此站点显示</g2>后，或者当“选项”中将其关闭时。<g3>开启</g3>会再次在该站点上显示它。

While one is chosen, MDM gives them a proxy of its own on this computer, with a password only they get, and opens their connections through the adapter as it opens its own. 2f308e07588a7fa0.source: <g1>Speed limits now work as they do for other downloads</g1> (<g2>#39</g2>): a limit set in a torrent's progress window changed every torrent's limit, a remembered limit was ignored, the Speed Limiter's "for one file" was shared by all torrents together, and "Limit all downloads together" left torrents out. Each torrent now has a limit of its own, a remembered one applies again when it resumes, and torrents and other downloads share the global cap evenly: each side gets at least half of it, and the rest when the other side needs less. A limit under 16 KB/s, which made a torrent drop its peers and stall, gives it 16 KB/s. A torrent started again while its files were still being checked no longer stays paused, and of two torrents started at the same moment, the second no longer fails with "the torrent is no longer there".
2f308e07588a7fa0.text: <g1>限速功能现在与其他下载一致</g1> (<g2>#39</g2>)：之前在洪流进度窗口设置的限速会改变所有洪流的限速，记住的限速会被忽略，“针对单个文件”的限速器设置会被所有洪流共享，“限制所有下载”功能不包括洪流。现在每个洪流都有自己的限速，记住的限速在恢复时会再次生效，洪流和其他下载会平均共享全局限速：每方至少获得一半，另一方需求较少时则获得剩余部分。低于 16 KB/s 的限速曾导致洪流断开对等方并停滞，现在会将其设置为 16 KB/s。洪流文件仍在检查时重新启动的洪流不再保持暂停状态，同时启动的两个洪流中，第二个不再因“洪流已不存在”而失败。
