2fc8613b95008d65.source: With no tray icon to come back from, closing or minimizing the main window now leaves it in the taskbar, with downloads still going, instead of hiding it with no way back. <g1>Options → General → Keep running when closing the window</g1> (on by default) makes closing quit MDM when unticked (<g2>#457</g2>).
2fc8613b95008d65.text: 现在，关闭或最小化主窗口时，它会留在任务栏中，下载仍在进行，而不是隐藏起来无法返回，因为不再有托盘图标可供恢复。<g1>选项 → 常规 → 关闭窗口时保持运行</g1>（默认开启）在取消勾选时会使关闭操作退出 MDM（<g2>#457</g2>）。

2fcb7506d45a47ba.source: Options on its Accounts page: debrid service accounts
2fcb7506d45a47ba.text: “选项”的“帐户”页面：网盘服务帐户。

2fd7c78a2f4da033.source: "What is MDM downloading right now, and how long is left?"
2fd7c78a2f4da033.text: “MDM 现在正在下载什么，还剩多长时间？”

2fe0c976fe735d9b.source: <g1>Translators: a reviewed translation is never replaced by machine translation.</g1> A row whose <x2/> line a person deleted is kept by <x3/> in every case (<x4/> included; a check it fails is printed for the person to decide), and CI fails a pull request that drops such a row or marks it <x5/> again (<x6/>). The first reviewed catalog is Italian (<g7>#150</g7>).
2fe0c976fe735d9b.text: <g1>翻译人员须知：人工审阅过的翻译绝不会被机器翻译取代。</g1> 凡是人工删除 <x2/> 行的条目，<x3/> 都会保留（包括 <x4/>；如果检查失败，会打印出来供人工决定），并且 CI 会拒绝删除此类条目或再次将其标记为 <x5/>（<x6/>）的拉取请求。第一个经过审阅的目录是意大利语（<g7>#150</g7>）。

2fe5fdd952f3a4cd.source: A file name that would land outside the torrent's folder (<x1/>) stops the download, and nothing is written.
2fe5fdd952f3a4cd.text: 如果文件名会导致文件保存到种子文件夹（<x1/>）之外，下载就会停止，且不会写入任何内容。

300fe42c6f7d0e75.source: Help: what to do when an antivirus or VirusTotal flags MDM, and how to check your copy is the real one.
300fe42c6f7d0e75.text: 帮助：当杀毒软件或 VirusTotal 标记 MDM 时该怎么做，以及如何检查您的副本是否为正版。

301fb01942b6c3a7.source: <g1>macOS Intel</g1><g2>.dmg · Macs with an Intel processor · experimental</g2>
301fb01942b6c3a7.text: <g1>macOS Intel</g1><g2>.dmg · 适用于配备 Intel 处理器的 Mac · 实验性</g2>

30dcac77c1bb8824.source: Options on its Proxy / Socks page: No proxy/socks, Use system settings, Use automatic configuration script and Manual proxy/socks configuration
30dcac77c1bb8824.text: 其“代理/SOCKS”页面上的选项：无代理/SOCKS、使用系统设置、使用自动配置脚本和手动代理/SOCKS 配置

30dd4f90dec7102f.source: <g1>Password</g1>: the archives' password, if they have one. It is kept in memory only, never written to disk.
30dd4f90dec7102f.text: <g1>密码</g1>：存档的密码（如果有）。密码只保存在内存中，不会写入磁盘。

30e98a27009330fd.source: Add a download from the couch.

3116d425d2ba3eb0.source: Download manager in 86 languages, right to left included — Mister Download Manager
3116d425d2ba3eb0.text: 86 种语言的下载管理器，包括从右到左的界面 — Mister Download Manager

3119a32ef52a6c93.source: A window's headline (Tahoma Bold): the browser extension's, the helpers'
3119a32ef52a6c93.text: 窗口标题（Tahoma Bold）：浏览器扩展、辅助工具的标题

312843bf3d93b787.source: <g1>Don't show this dialog again</g1> — MDM stops asking and does what you answered this time. To be asked again, tick <g2>Options → General → Confirm before deleting downloads</g2>.
312843bf3d93b787.text: <g1>不再显示此对话框</g1> — MDM 不再询问，并按照本次选择执行。要恢复询问，请勾选<g2>选项 → 常规 → 删除下载前确认</g2>。

314870831b11d2bd.source: MDM starts its torrent engine the first time a torrent needs it. With <g1>Stop the torrent engine when no torrent is running</g1> on (the default), it stops again a minute after no torrent is running or sharing. While it runs, other peers can connect to MDM, and MDM asks your router to forward its port (UPnP). Windows may ask whether to allow MDM through the firewall: allow it on private networks only.
314870831b11d2bd.text: 种子首次需要种子引擎时，MDM 会启动它。默认情况下，<g1>没有种子运行时停止种子引擎</g1>处于开启状态；没有种子运行或共享 1 分钟后，种子引擎就会停止。种子引擎运行时，其他对等方可以连接到 MDM，MDM 也会要求路由器转发其端口 (UPnP)。Windows 可能会询问是否允许 MDM 通过防火墙：仅允许其在专用网络上通过。

315ec1116b53cad4.source: Updating the graphics driver from the card maker's site (Intel, AMD or NVIDIA) fixes many of these problems.
315ec1116b53cad4.text: 从显卡厂商（Intel、AMD 或 NVIDIA）的网站更新显卡驱动程序，可以解决许多此类问题。

316cb20416b76934.source: Archive extraction (#37): zip, tar, gz and xz in process; 7z and RAR through an installed 7-Zip, run as its own program
316cb20416b76934.text: 档案解压 (#37)：zip、tar、gz 和 xz 正在处理中；7z 和 RAR 通过已安装的 7-Zip 程序运行

3175f66bedeb42a3.source: <g1>Every connection, live</g1> Each connection drawn as it fills, with the speed and the time left. Crash-safe resume picks up where it stopped.
3175f66bedeb42a3.text: <g1>实时显示每个连接</g1> 实时显示每个连接的进度、速度和剩余时间。崩溃后可从中断处继续下载。

318864bcd3bac76e.source: A split archive is extracted once its last volume is in. Extraction is careful: a name that would lead outside the folder is left out, an archive that would fill the disk stops first, and an existing file is never overwritten. The archive itself goes to the Recycle Bin only when you ask.
318864bcd3bac76e.text: 分卷压缩包在最后一个分卷到达后开始提取。提取过程非常谨慎：会导致文件超出文件夹的名称会被忽略，可能填满磁盘的压缩包会提前停止，并且绝不会覆盖现有文件。压缩包本身只有在您要求时才会移至回收站。

318c6489ae0115d3.source: The server's country that <g1>Download File Info</g1> and the progress window show comes from a table inside MDM: no address is sent anywhere to look it up.
318c6489ae0115d3.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>和进度窗口显示的服务器国家/地区来自MDM内部的一个表格：不会向任何地方发送地址来查找它。

3192871cb34fc18f.source: <g1>VPN and proxy support:</g1> send downloads through the browser's proxy or VPN extension (off until you turn it on).
3192871cb34fc18f.text: <g1>VPN 和代理支持：</g1> 通过浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载（默认关闭，需手动开启）。

31c727cb512fbff6.source: <g1>Download all links</g1> and <g2>Download selected links</g2> send a page's links to <g3>Link grabber</g3>.
31c727cb512fbff6.text: <g1>下载所有链接</g1>和<g2>下载选定链接</g2>会将页面的链接发送到<g3>链接抓取器</g3>。

31cd6fb308737763.source: <g1>With WinGet</g1>, Windows' package manager: in a terminal, the first line installs MDM and the second updates it.
31cd6fb308737763.text: <g1>使用 WinGet</g1>，Windows 的包管理器：在终端中，第一行安装 MDM，第二行更新 MDM。

32019125aa8198c0.source: <g1>View → Always dark</g1> (<g2>#60</g2>): MDM stays dark whatever the system says, for a desktop that reports no light or dark preference (MDM also reads it on Linux now, see Fixed).
32019125aa8198c0.text: <g1>视图 → 始终为深色</g1>（<g2>#60</g2>）：无论系统设置如何，MDM 始终保持深色模式，适用于未报告浅色或深色偏好的桌面（MDM 现在也能在 Linux 上读取此设置，详见“已修复”）。

321b96d0efb29bed.source: Rules only look at articles that are new since the feed was last fetched, and a feed's first fetch only lists what is there. So adding a feed or a rule never downloads a whole backlog. <g1>Matches ... articles now</g1> shows which of the articles the feeds hold now the rule matches, to check it; download those by hand. A torrent the list already has isn't added again, and neither is one whose files are already in the folder: MDM never writes into files it didn't make without asking. The bottom line of the tab says what the rules did last, and a torrent a rule added says so in its event log.
321b96d0efb29bed.text: 规则只检查自上次获取源以来新增的文章；首次获取源时只会列出当前已有的内容。因此，添加源或规则都不会下载之前积累的所有内容。<g1>现在匹配...篇文章</g1>会显示规则与源中当前文章的匹配情况，供您检查；匹配的文章需要手动下载。列表中已有的种子不会再次添加；如果种子文件已在文件夹中，也不会再次添加：未经询问，MDM 不会写入它未创建的文件。选项卡底部会说明规则上次执行的操作；规则添加的种子也会在其事件日志中注明。

3234f4b6e3d07939.source: On an internet plan with a data cap, the amount matters more than the speed. The Scheduler's <g1>Download limits</g1> stops MDM after a set number of megabytes every few hours, and lets it carry on when the period is over: see <g2>Scheduler and queues</g2>.
3234f4b6e3d07939.text: 对于有数据流量限制的互联网套餐，数据量比速度更重要。计划程序的<g1>下载限制</g1>功能可以在每隔几小时下载一定数量的兆字节后停止 MDM，并在周期结束后继续下载：请参阅<g2>计划程序和队列</g2>。

324849db5f12fed0.source: Stroke width of a drop-down's chevron
324849db5f12fed0.text: 下拉菜单箭头的描边宽度

3252d1ce7fc8c7ea.source: <g1>Allow more than 32 connections</g1> in <g2>Options → Connection</g2> raises the limit to 128 per download, for server exceptions too. The command line's <x3/> takes 1 to 128.
3252d1ce7fc8c7ea.text: 在<g2>选项 → 连接</g2>中<g1>允许超过 32 个连接</g1>会将每个下载的限制提高到 128 个，服务器例外也适用。命令行中的<x3/>接受 1 到 128。

326233a6912ae49d.source: A user's systemd timer can't wake the computer, and <x1/> needs root, so without this setting MDM can't wake the computer. MDM never asks for an administrator's password.
326233a6912ae49d.text: 用户的 systemd 计时器无法唤醒电脑，并且<x1/>需要 root 权限，因此没有此设置，MDM 无法唤醒电脑。MDM 从不要求管理员密码。

327c76a006445d54.source: Yes. MDM comes with an MCP server, <x1/>: add it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or another assistant that supports MCP, and you can ask it in your own words to list, add, pause, resume or remove downloads. It works with the MDM on your computer only, and needs the automation API on. See <g2>AI assistants</g2>.
327c76a006445d54.text: 可以。MDM 自带 MCP 服务器，<x1/>：将其添加到 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 或其他支持 MCP 的助手中，即可用自己的话要求它列出、添加、暂停、恢复或删除下载。它只能连接您电脑上的 MDM，并且需要启用自动化 API。请参阅<g2>AI 助手</g2>。

32949b8ebe5959f1.source: Minimize sends windows to the tray as well
32949b8ebe5959f1.text: 最小化也会将窗口发送到托盘

32a011206d3398ba.source: No. Mister Download Manager is an independent project written from scratch in Rust. It has no connection to Tonec Inc. and contains none of IDM's code, artwork or text. Internet Download Manager and IDM are trademarks of their owner, named here only to compare. <g1>More</g1>
32a011206d3398ba.text: 不是。Mister Download Manager 是一个用 Rust 从头开始编写的独立项目。它与 Tonec Inc. 没有任何关系，不包含 IDM 的任何代码、美术作品或文本。Internet Download Manager 和 IDM 是其所有者的商标，此处仅用于比较。<g1>更多</g1>

32bbe5a36745a480.source: A magnet link has to get the torrent's file list from other peers first. That can take a minute or two, and longer for torrents with few peers. If nobody answers in about three minutes, MDM gives up; try again later, or use the <x1/> file if the site offers one.
32bbe5a36745a480.text: 磁力链接必须首先从其他对等点获取种子的文件列表。这可能需要一两分钟，对于对等点较少的种子则需要更长时间。如果大约三分钟内没有响应，MDM 会放弃；请稍后再试，或者如果网站提供<x1/>文件，请使用该文件。

32bc6896e72ffa39.source: On the same PC and the same test server, MDM fetched a 1 GiB file in 1.0 s against IDM 6.42's 5.5 s, and a 256 KiB file in 0.03 s against 3.1 s: the medians of alternating runs. The <g1>benchmark page</g1> has every run, the method and the raw data.
32bc6896e72ffa39.text: 在同一台电脑和同一测试服务器上，MDM 下载 1 GiB 文件耗时 1.0 秒，而 IDM 6.42 耗时 5.5 秒；下载 256 KiB 文件耗时 0.03 秒，而 IDM 耗时 3.1 秒：这些都是交替运行的中位数。<g1>基准测试页面</g1>包含每次运行、测试方法和原始数据。

32e3899aac6c6245.source: not to use it to break copy protection (DRM): MDM doesn't do this and isn't meant to;
32e3899aac6c6245.text: 不使用它来破解复制保护（DRM）：MDM 不具备此功能，也无意为之；

331445d79428b7e9.source: The report names what happened and where in MDM's code, so the problem can be found and fixed. It works on Windows, Linux and macOS.
331445d79428b7e9.text: 报告会指出发生了什么以及在 MDM 代码的哪个位置，以便可以找到并修复问题。它适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。

335ddbe14ee4164c.source: Closing the window with its close box keeps the download running.
335ddbe14ee4164c.text: 通过关闭按钮关闭窗口会使下载继续运行。

336d90cdead9909e.source: Delete the selected downloads and their files (asks first)
336d90cdead9909e.text: 删除所选下载及其文件（先询问）

3372acb1d146d213.source: <g1>Download File Info</g1> says which account a link goes through, such as <g2>Download through Real-Debrid (your account)</g2>. Untick it to download that one link directly. The command line's <x3/> uses your accounts too, and <x4/> skips them.
3372acb1d146d213.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>会显示链接通过哪个账户下载，例如<g2>通过 Real-Debrid 下载（您的账户）</g2>。取消勾选即可直接下载该链接。命令行中的<x3/>也会使用您的账户，而<x4/>则会跳过它们。

3374475144d2ca82.source: Before you unplug the stick, quit MDM with <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1> so it saves everything. Closing the window only hides it in the tray.
3374475144d2ca82.text: 在拔下 U 盘之前，请使用<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>关闭 MDM，以便它保存所有内容。关闭窗口只会将其隐藏在托盘中。

338575eefc8880a1.source: Type part of the file's name.

33a7d786853dbe7d.source: <g1>Remote control</g1><g2>Paste a link on your phone and the computer downloads it. Watch and pause from anywhere at home.</g2>
33a7d786853dbe7d.text: <g1>远程控制</g1><g2>在手机上粘贴链接，电脑即可下载。在家中任何地方查看和暂停下载。</g2>

33cb6035f72e6370.source: Choose the subtitles; tick Put them into the video to keep them inside the file.
33cb6035f72e6370.text: 选择字幕；勾选“将它们放入视频”，即可将字幕保存到视频文件中。

33cd34762a5593c2.source: It takes the video you clicked: its own file when it plays one, or the stream the player loaded (HLS or DASH), else the page. When the button can't tell which one you mean, the toolbar button's <g1>Media on this page</g1> lists them all. Embedded players work too, and your sign-in for the site, the page that embeds the player and your browser's User-Agent go with it, so videos for members, or that play only on the site that embeds them, can be downloaded. Sound players get the button too.
33cd34762a5593c2.text: 它会获取您点击的视频：如果视频播放的是文件，则获取其文件本身；否则获取播放器加载的流（HLS 或 DASH），再否则获取页面。当按钮无法判断您指的是哪个时，工具栏按钮的<g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>会列出所有选项。嵌入式播放器也适用，并且您的网站登录信息、嵌入播放器的页面以及您的浏览器 User-Agent 都会随之发送，因此会员视频或仅在嵌入它们的网站上播放的视频也可以下载。音频播放器也会显示此按钮。

33e74c2131bce5b0.text: 种子下载公平共享限速

33e932958a661bfe.source: <g1>Category</g1> — choose a category to see and change its settings below.
33e932958a661bfe.text: <g1>类别</g1> — 选择一个类别以查看和更改其下方的设置。

33f4f8585891fea7.source: Yes: export your list from IDM, then choose Tasks → Import → From IDM export file in MDM. <g1>More</g1>
33f4f8585891fea7.text: 可以：先从 IDM 导出列表，然后在 MDM 中选择“任务”→“导入”→“从 IDM 导出文件”。<g1>更多</g1>

340464f741db2a7b.source: Import your download list from IDM
340464f741db2a7b.text: 从 IDM 导入下载列表

34100b5c1de1a9b1.source: MDM is made by Ahmed Nefzaoui, an independent developer, and is open to contributions from anyone on <g1>GitHub</g1>. Bug reports, translations and code are all welcome.
34100b5c1de1a9b1.text: MDM 由独立开发者 Ahmed Nefzaoui 制作，并欢迎<g1>GitHub</g1>上的任何人贡献。欢迎提交错误报告、翻译和代码。

343a94d738e764aa.source: Each connection writes directly into the file's place on disk, in a part file next to the final one. There is no temporary folder and no joining step at the end: when the last part arrives, MDM checks the size and renames the file.
343a94d738e764aa.text: 每个连接直接写入磁盘上文件所在的位置，写入最终文件旁边的部分文件。没有临时文件夹，也没有最后的合并步骤：当最后一个部分到达时，MDM 会检查大小并重命名文件。

345c7e16b78ebacc.source: In a Wayland session the windows go through XWayland (below). Not there yet on Linux: screen readers (Orca) don't read MDM's windows; browsers installed as a Flatpak can't reach MDM (Firefox from Flathub may, through the desktop as the Snap does, but that isn't checked yet); and <g1>View → Draw with → Vulkan</g1> is a choice, OpenGL stays the default.
345c7e16b78ebacc.text: 在 Wayland 会话中，窗口通过 XWayland 运行（如下）。Linux 上尚未实现的功能：屏幕阅读器（Orca）无法读取 MDM 的窗口；作为 Flatpak 安装的浏览器无法连接 MDM（来自 Flathub 的 Firefox 可能会通过桌面连接，就像 Snap 那样，但这尚未验证）；<g1>视图 → 绘制方式 → Vulkan</g1>是一个选项，OpenGL 仍是默认设置。

3466dc2ae5de4cde.source: <g1>The installer</g1> (<x2/>), the one to pick unless you have a reason not to. It installs for you alone without administrator rights, or for everyone, and can set up browser integration and open <x3/> files and magnet links with MDM.
3466dc2ae5de4cde.text: <g1>安装程序</g1> (<x2/>)，除非您有特殊原因，否则请选择此项。它无需管理员权限即可为您个人或所有用户安装，并可设置浏览器集成，以及使用 MDM 打开 <x3/> 文件和磁力链接。

347561bddd3264b9.source: With <g1>First and last pieces first</g1> (on by default), each file's last pieces come early too. Most video files keep their index at the end, and a player reads it before anything plays.
347561bddd3264b9.text: 启用<g1>先下载首尾分块</g1>（默认开启）后，每个文件末尾的分块也会提前下载。大多数视频文件将索引保存在末尾，而播放器会先读取索引，再开始播放。

3477bbfd4c6c4344.source: A caption button under the pointer (a tint over the bar)
3477bbfd4c6c4344.text: 指针下的标题按钮（标题栏上的着色）

347b30cc38c9585e.text: 不是。MDM 是一个完全独立的程序，使用 Rust 从头编写，与 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 的制造商 Tonec Inc. 没有任何关系。它包含…

349e5952fd29a21e.source: Can my AI assistant use MDM?

3512eeafea5246da.source: <g1>Catching problems.</g1> When MDM crashes (a Windows exception, a signal on Linux, a Mach exception on macOS), panics, or freezes, it asks the monitor for a dump. A freeze is a frame of the window running more than 8 s, seen by a watchdog thread that ignores time spent asleep. It times both parts of a frame: what MDM handles (the commands that come in, the clock of downloads, queues and the Scheduler), which runs minimized too, and the drawing; never the wait between frames. The watchdog also measures how much processor time the window thread got meanwhile, and the report says what that means: it ran all along (a loop), it waited in a lock or on I/O (a deadlock), or it hardly ran in ordinary code, which is a computer too busy to run MDM or slow to load it from disk, most likely not MDM's bug (those share one signature, <x2/>). When the window thread is already back in the event loop by the time the dump is written, the freeze was over before the snapshot, so its stack can't explain it; those reports say so and share the signature <x3/>. macOS doesn't measure it yet. The monitor then writes a <g4>minidump</g4> of every thread from outside, through <x5/> and <x6/>. A crashed process never writes its own dump, which is how Firefox, Crashpad and Sentry do it too.
3512eeafea5246da.text: <g1>捕获问题。</g1> 当 MDM 崩溃（Windows 异常、Linux 信号、macOS Mach 异常）、程序异常终止或冻结时，它会向监视器请求一个转储。冻结是指窗口运行超过 8 秒的帧，由一个忽略休眠时间的看门狗线程检测。它会测量帧的两个部分：MDM 处理的部分（接收到的命令、下载时钟、队列和计划程序），这部分在最小化时也会运行，以及绘图部分；但不测量帧之间的等待时间。看门狗还会测量在此期间窗口线程获得了多少处理器时间，报告会说明这意味着什么：它一直在运行（一个循环），它在锁或 I/O 上等待（死锁），或者它几乎没有在普通代码中运行，这表示计算机太忙而无法运行 MDM 或从磁盘加载 MDM 太慢，这很可能不是 MDM 的错误（这些情况共享一个签名，<x2/>）。如果转储写入时窗口线程已经回到事件循环中，则冻结在快照之前已经结束，因此其堆栈无法解释冻结；这些报告会说明这一点并共享签名 <x3/>。macOS 尚未测量此项。然后，监视器通过 <x5/> 和 <x6/> 从外部写入每个线程的<g4>小型转储</g4>。崩溃的进程从不写入自己的转储，Firefox、Crashpad 和 Sentry 也是如此。

383dd475be5b733b.source: <g1>Waterfox (and Firefox set to ask what to do with each file): the download stayed in the browser</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>). Firefox's family hands an extension the download only after its <g3>What should … do with this file?</g3> dialog, by which time it has already downloaded the file behind the dialog. MDM now takes the download as the server's answer arrives, before the dialog: for a file MDM takes, the dialog never shows and the browser downloads nothing. Other files open the dialog as before.

38a26b82fbe90cf3.source: The Mac gets two smaller downloads, one for Apple Silicon and one for Intel, instead of one universal <x1/> of 80 MB. From 0.2.4 or older, update the Mac once by hand: <g2>Download</g2> in <g3>Check for updates</g3> opens the release, where you pick your Mac's file. The AppImage can update through AppImageLauncher, Gear Lever and AppImageUpdate, which fetch only the parts that changed. Linux can draw with Vulkan and macOS with Metal, from <g4>View → Draw with</g4>, while OpenGL stays the default there. In a Wayland session, MDM runs through XWayland so its menus open where you click.
38a26b82fbe90cf3.text: Mac 获得两个更小的下载包，一个用于 Apple Silicon，一个用于 Intel，而不是一个 80 MB 的通用 <x1/> 包。从 0.2.4 或更早版本更新 Mac 时，请手动更新一次：<g2>下载</g2>在<g3>检查更新</g3>中会打开发布页面，您可以在其中选择适合您 Mac 的文件。AppImage 可以通过 AppImageLauncher、Gear Lever 和 AppImageUpdate 进行更新，它们只获取更改的部分。Linux 可以使用 Vulkan 绘制，macOS 可以使用 Metal 绘制，通过<g4>视图 → 绘制方式</g4>选择，而 OpenGL 仍是默认设置。在 Wayland 会话中，MDM 通过 XWayland 运行，因此其菜单会在您点击的位置打开。

38aa0b67fa9ddfff.source: Before it continues, MDM checks that the file on the server is still the same one, so a changed file never gets stitched onto an old half. When a server can't send a file in parts, the progress window says <g1>Resume capability: No</g1> before you rely on it.
38aa0b67fa9ddfff.text: 在继续下载之前，MDM 会检查服务器上的文件是否仍然是同一个文件，因此更改过的文件绝不会与旧的半成品拼接在一起。当服务器无法分段发送文件时，进度窗口会在您依赖它之前显示<g1>恢复功能：否</g1>。

38c2835e2c5124e2.source: <g1>Files</g1> — each file, its size and how much of it is done. Files you unticked show <g2>Skipped</g2>. Tick or untick a file's box to change what is downloaded, even while the torrent runs. At least one file stays ticked. If you untick everything still missing, the torrent finishes. If a finished torrent that isn't running gets a file back, it waits as stopped until you resume it, so nothing downloads unseen.
38c2835e2c5124e2.text: <g1>文件</g1> — 每个文件、其大小以及完成的进度。未勾选的文件显示<g2>已跳过</g2>。勾选或取消勾选文件的框以更改下载内容，即使种子正在运行。至少有一个文件保持勾选状态。如果您取消勾选所有仍缺失的文件，则种子完成。如果一个已完成但未运行的种子重新获得一个文件，它会保持停止状态，直到您恢复它，这样就不会在不知情的情况下下载任何内容。

38d4b8570c497ca6.source: MDM's Proxy / Socks settings are for web and FTP downloads. Torrents can use a SOCKS5 one too: set a <x1/> proxy in <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks</g2> and turn on <g3>Use the proxy</g3> in Torrent settings. The proxy covers connections to peers and web trackers only, so with it MDM turns off the DHT, local peer discovery, incoming connections and UDP trackers; it opens no UDP socket toward the network at all. If the proxy is gone from Proxy / Socks while that switch is on, torrents don't start rather than go around it.
38d4b8570c497ca6.text: MDM 的代理/Socks 设置适用于网页和 FTP 下载。种子也可以使用 SOCKS5 代理：在<g2>选项 → 代理/Socks</g2>中设置<x1/>代理，并在种子设置中开启<g3>使用代理</g3>。代理只用于连接对等方和网页跟踪器，因此启用后，MDM 会关闭 DHT、本地对等方发现、传入连接和 UDP 跟踪器；MDM 完全不会向网络打开 UDP 套接字。如果开启该选项时，代理/Socks 中没有配置代理，种子就不会启动，而不会绕过代理连接。

391a6b0e422e6b00.text: 通过您的 VPN，否则不下载。

3928b858acc4258f.source: <g1>Update now asks the package manager which package MDM is</g1>: a copy in /usr/bin was taken for the .deb on a Debian-like system and for the .rpm anywhere else, so a copy installed with another package manager (pacman on Arch) would have fetched and opened an .rpm. MDM now asks dpkg, rpm and pacman which one owns its program; the .deb and .rpm update as before, and a copy of another package manager is left to the system's updates: Check for updates shows the new version's notes and says to update it there.
3928b858acc4258f.text: <g1>“立即更新”现在会询问包管理器 MDM 是哪个包</g1>：在类似 Debian 的系统上，/usr/bin 中的副本被视为 .deb 包，在其他任何地方则被视为 .rpm 包，因此使用其他包管理器（Arch 上的 pacman）安装的副本会获取并打开 .rpm 包。MDM 现在会询问 dpkg、rpm 和 pacman 哪个拥有其程序；.deb 和 .rpm 会像以前一样更新，而其他包管理器的副本则留给系统的更新：“检查更新”会显示新版本的说明，并提示在那里更新。

3973c8ad482da3cc.source: When MDM takes a download, the browser's own copy is cancelled and removed from the browser's download list. In Firefox and the browsers built on it (Waterfox, Zen, LibreWolf), MDM takes it as soon as the server answers, before the browser asks <g1>What should … do with this file?</g1>: for a file MDM takes, that question never shows (Waterfox asks it for every new type of file). Files MDM doesn't take get the question as before. <g2>Download File Info</g2> opens in MDM (unless you turned it off in <g3>Options → Downloads</g3>). Cancelling there doesn't hand the download back to the browser.
3973c8ad482da3cc.text: MDM 接管下载后，浏览器自身的下载会被取消，并从浏览器的下载列表中移除。在 Firefox 及其衍生浏览器（Waterfox、Zen、LibreWolf）中，MDM 会在服务器响应后立即接管下载，甚至在浏览器询问“<g1>此文件应该如何处理？</g1>”之前：对于 MDM 接管的文件，这个问题永远不会出现（Waterfox 会对每种新类型的文件询问）。MDM 未接管的文件仍会像以前一样出现此问题。<g2>下载文件信息</g2>会在 MDM 中打开（除非您在<g3>选项 → 下载</g3>中将其关闭）。在此处取消下载不会将下载任务交还给浏览器。

3974fae232e4c76f.source: MDM is a separate program, written from scratch, but its windows are laid out the way IDM users expect: the toolbar, the categories, the download list, the progress window with every connection, queues and the Scheduler. It is free, with no trial and no sign-up.

3ab6ae7f023cdf09.source: A video yt-dlp downloads by itself (<g1>How a video comes down</g1>) takes a limit only as it starts: when you turn the limiter on or off, change its settings or the video's own limit, MDM stops it and starts it again with the new limit, and it goes on from where it was (the log says "Stopped: the speed limit changed; starting again with it"). Under the limit for all downloads, such videos share it evenly: when another starts, the ones running with more than their share start again with it; when one ends, the others keep theirs. A gallery's pictures that MDM brings in follow a change at once; what gallery-dl still fetches itself starts again with the new limit, skipping the files already saved. Other changes (torrents taking more or less of the limit for all downloads, <g2>Only while I'm using the computer</g2>) apply to the next one that starts.
3ab6ae7f023cdf09.text: yt-dlp 独立下载的视频（<g1>视频下载方式</g1>）仅在开始时应用速度限制：当您开启或关闭限速器、更改其设置或视频自身的限制时，MDM 会停止该视频并以新限制重新开始，它会从中断处继续（日志显示“已停止：速度限制已更改；正在以新限制重新开始”）。在所有下载的限制下，此类视频会平均分配速度：当另一个视频开始时，那些超出其份额的视频会以新限制重新开始；当一个视频结束时，其他视频会保持其速度。MDM 导入的图库图片会立即遵循更改；gallery-dl 仍在获取的图片会以新限制重新开始，跳过已保存的文件。其他更改（种子下载占用所有下载限制的增减，<g2>仅在我使用计算机时</g2>）将应用于下一个开始的下载。

3b4702fd37014cc6.source: <g1>Torrent peers and trackers.</g1> When you download a torrent, MDM connects to the trackers listed in the torrent, to the BitTorrent DHT network and to other peers, who see your IP address and which pieces you have. To accept connections it may ask your router to open a port (UPnP). This is how BitTorrent works; it ends when the torrent stops.
3b4702fd37014cc6.text: <g1>种子对等点和追踪器。</g1>当您下载种子时，MDM 会连接到种子中列出的追踪器、BitTorrent DHT 网络和其他对等点，这些对等点会看到您的 IP 地址和您拥有的片段。为了接受连接，它可能会要求您的路由器打开一个端口（UPnP）。这就是 BitTorrent 的工作方式；当种子停止时，它就结束了。

3b599b113ccf494f.source: <g1>Compressed</g1>, <g2>Documents</g2>, <g3>Music</g3>, <g4>Programs</g4> and <g5>Video</g5> can be renamed, given other file types or deleted, like your own. A renamed category keeps its folder. Deleting one asks what happens to its downloads: move them to <g6>General</g6>, or take them off the list. Their files stay either way.
3b599b113ccf494f.text: <g1>压缩文件</g1>、<g2>文档</g2>、<g3>音乐</g3>、<g4>程序</g4>和<g5>视频</g5>等内置类别可以像您创建的类别一样进行重命名、更改文件类型或删除。重命名后的类别会保留其文件夹。删除类别时会询问如何处理其下载：将其移动到<g6>常规</g6>，或从列表中移除。无论哪种方式，文件都会保留。

3ba6d167c2122fa5.source: Start a finished gallery again with <g1>Resume</g1> and MDM fetches only the pictures that aren't in its folder yet. The ones you already have are skipped, so following an artist or an album costs nothing but the new pictures.

3bb3ef42e42b2a4e.source: On Windows, MDM binds the adapter's own address, and Windows then sends those packets only through that adapter. Linux binds the device itself (Linux 5.7 or newer), and macOS binds the interface. An address of a kind the adapter doesn't have, such as IPv6 on a VPN that has only IPv4, is refused, not sent around it.
3bb3ef42e42b2a4e.text: 在 Windows 上，MDM 绑定网卡自身的地址，然后 Windows 只通过该网卡发送这些数据包。Linux 绑定设备本身（Linux 5.7 或更高版本），macOS 绑定接口。网卡不具备的地址类型，例如只有 IPv4 的 VPN 上的 IPv6，将被拒绝，而不是绕过它发送。

3e87c1c47e7b6f4c.source: It works as a kill switch. When the adapter disconnects, running torrents stop with "… is not connected; it goes on when it is back", and they start again through the adapter when it is. Until MDM notices (within a second), the engine's sockets are still bound to an address that is gone, so nothing can leave another way. A torrent added while the adapter isn't connected doesn't start, and says why. Tracker names are still looked up by the system's DNS.
3e87c1c47e7b6f4c.text: 这相当于一个网络断开保护开关。适配器断开连接时，正在运行的种子会停止，并显示“……未连接；重新连接后将继续”。适配器重新连接后，种子会通过该适配器重新启动。在 MDM 检测到断开之前（最多 1 秒），种子引擎的套接字仍绑定到已失效的地址，因此无法通过其他途径发送数据。适配器未连接时添加的种子不会启动，并会说明原因。跟踪器名称仍由系统的 DNS 查询。

3f66be3de33c7d79.source: Some sites, YouTube among them, send each viewer to a nearby video server, sometimes one inside the internet provider's own network. If that server can't be reached from your connection, a browser quietly switches to another one, but yt-dlp on its own would give up. Before each video download MDM checks the servers in the video's links and, if one doesn't answer, switches to the next one the site lists. The download's log says when this happens.
3f66be3de33c7d79.text: 一些网站（包括 YouTube）会将每位观看者连接到附近的视频服务器，有时是互联网服务提供商自己网络中的服务器。如果您的网络无法连接到该服务器，浏览器会自动切换到另一个服务器，但单独使用 yt-dlp 则会放弃。每次下载视频前，MDM 都会检查视频链接中的服务器；如果某个服务器没有响应，就会切换到网站列出的下一个服务器。下载日志会记录这种情况。

406a798e6be784f9.source: The system's DNS asks the names in its own way, and Windows may ask over every adapter. To keep the names inside the adapter too, choose a DNS under <g1>Connection</g1> → <g2>DNS</g2>: MDM then asks it through the adapter.
406a798e6be784f9.text: 系统的 DNS 会以自己的方式查询域名，而 Windows 可能会通过所有适配器进行查询。若要让域名查询也通过该适配器进行，请在<g1>连接</g1> → <g2>DNS</g2>下选择一个 DNS：MDM 随后会通过该适配器向其查询。

4087eca64b1e9c7f.text: 更多内容请参阅<g1>连接和速度</g1>。

409d31554c535043.source: With <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> on in <g2>Options → General</g2> (it is on by default), Minimize hides the main window, and a progress window, in the notification area instead of leaving them on the taskbar. Closing the main window does the same: MDM keeps running until you choose <g3>Tasks → Exit</g3> or <g4>Exit</g4> in the tray menu.
409d31554c535043.text: 在<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中启用<g1>最小化到通知区域</g1>（默认开启）后，“最小化”会将主窗口和进度窗口隐藏到通知区域，而不是留在任务栏上。关闭主窗口也会执行相同的操作：MDM 将继续运行，直到您在托盘菜单中选择<g3>任务 → 退出</g3>或<g4>退出</g4>。

40a26ac3ae7dcbbc.source: If the link has expired (common for links from sites you sign in to, or links with a time limit in them), get a new one: right-click → <g1>Refresh download address</g1>. See <g2>Resume a broken download</g2>.
40a26ac3ae7dcbbc.text: 如果链接已过期（登录后才能访问的网站链接或带有时限的链接常会过期），请获取新链接：右键点击 → <g1>刷新下载地址</g1>。另请参阅<g2>恢复中断的下载</g2>。

40ae9f6f34dade5c.text: 选择<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 设置...</g1>。

40b300c66a605f82.source: In the Scheduler's time and date boxes, <g1>Up</g1> / <g2>Down</g2> and the number keys change the selected part, and <g3>Left</g3> / <g4>Right</g4> move between parts. In the calendar, the arrows move a day or a week, <g5>Page Up</g5> / <g6>Page Down</g6> a month, and <g7>Enter</g7> picks the day.
40b300c66a605f82.text: 在计划程序的日期和时间框中，<g1>向上</g1> / <g2>向下</g2>键和数字键可更改选定部分，<g3>向左</g3> / <g4>向右</g4>键可在各部分之间移动。在日历中，箭头键可移动一天或一周，<g5>Page Up</g5> / <g6>Page Down</g6>键可移动一个月，<g7>Enter</g7>键可选择日期。

40b46adc61bd2f95.source: Tick Also delete the file from disk only if you want the file gone too.
40b46adc61bd2f95.text: 仅当您也想删除文件时，才勾选同时从磁盘中删除文件。

40c721d28a572fcf.source: The bar at the top shows the total speed and the free space where your downloads go.
40c721d28a572fcf.text: 顶部栏显示总速度和下载目标位置的可用空间。

40c8dcda0be79537.source: Download a file — Mister Download Manager help
40c8dcda0be79537.text: 下载文件 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

40d45b50d2257bd9.source: The command line runs in the app's own program, so the download engine ships once. Every command, <x1/>, Ctrl+C and exit code work as before.
40d45b50d2257bd9.text: 命令行在应用程序自己的程序中运行，因此下载引擎只需打包一次。所有命令、<x1/>、Ctrl+C 和退出代码都与以前一样。

40dfdd7492287dec.source: <g1>A cut file name's full text shows at the pointer</g1>, not under the list.
40dfdd7492287dec.text: <g1>将指针悬停在被截断的文件名上时，会显示完整名称</g1>，而不是在列表下方显示。

41333ec069d15e15.source: A magnet link takes a long time
41333ec069d15e15.text: 磁力链接需要很长时间

413ea94686ccd93b.source: When an address is already in the list, MDM asks what to do, or follows the answer you chose in <g1>Options → Downloads → If a duplicate download link is added</g1>.
413ea94686ccd93b.text: 当地址已在列表中时，MDM 会询问如何处理，或者遵循您在<g1>选项 → 下载 → 如果添加了重复的下载链接</g1>中选择的答案。

4160d55635d3e362.source: Freeze reports that tell the kind of freeze
4160d55635d3e362.text: 显示冻结类型的冻结报告

416638a8e1ca52f8.source: Mister Download Manager's main window in night mode: web and torrent downloads in one list.
416638a8e1ca52f8.text: Mister Download Manager 夜间模式主窗口：网页和种子下载在一个列表中。

416b2928058d450b.source: Torrents and galleries have no single server of MDM's own (peers, or the many a gallery's pictures come from), so their windows don't show one. A video in one file shows the server it comes from.
416b2928058d450b.text: 种子和图库没有 MDM 自己的单一服务器（它们来自对等点或图库中的多张图片），因此它们的窗口不显示服务器。单个视频文件会显示其来源服务器。

416dd4c491e33d28.source: A torrent the list already has isn't added again, and MDM never writes into files it didn't make without asking. The window is made for feeds of torrents: an article opens in <g1>Add torrent</g1>, and a rule adds torrents.
416dd4c491e33d28.text: 列表中已有的种子不会再次添加，MDM 绝不会在未经询问的情况下写入它未创建的文件。该窗口专为种子订阅源设计：文章在<g1>添加种子</g1>中打开，规则添加种子。

4171c591cc5de164.source: A menu's and a popup's frame
4171c591cc5de164.text: 菜单和弹出窗口的边框

418a57e1f6e0ae58.source: Yes: ftp://, and FTP over TLS both ways (ftpes:// and ftps://), with several connections at once, resume, and logins from the address or from Sites Logins.…
418a57e1f6e0ae58.text: 是：ftp://，以及双向的 FTP over TLS（ftpes:// 和 ftps://），支持同时进行多个连接、续传，并可从地址或“站点登录”中获取登录信息。

41afc8da9523f7b7.source: <g1>Where it comes from:</g1> MDM downloads gallery-dl from its releases on Codeberg. It accepts it only when the release's checksum list is signed by gallery-dl's author's key, pinned in MDM, and the program matches that list. It keeps the previous version and never goes back to an older one. On Windows and on Linux (x86-64) MDM installs it; on macOS, install it with Homebrew (<x2/>) or pip.
41afc8da9523f7b7.text: <g1>来源：</g1> MDM 从 Codeberg 上的发布下载 gallery-dl。只有当发布版本的校验和列表由 MDM 中固定的 gallery-dl 作者密钥签名，并且程序与该列表匹配时，MDM 才接受它。它会保留上一个版本，并且绝不会回滚到旧版本。在 Windows 和 Linux (x86-64) 上，MDM 会安装它；在 macOS 上，请使用 Homebrew (<x2/>) 或 pip 安装。

41b21e6f6cf70f57.source: <g1>Drag on blank space</g1> to draw a box around downloads.

41d58fdb5c4f98df.source: A row with a <x1/> line above it was translated by machine. When you have checked it (and corrected it if needed), delete that <x2/> line. From then on the row is yours: machine translation never replaces it, and a check on every pull request makes sure no change drops it or marks it machine again.
41d58fdb5c4f98df.text: 上方有 <x1/> 线的行是由机器翻译的。当您检查并（如果需要）更正后，请删除该 <x2/> 线。从那时起，该行就属于您了：机器翻译绝不会替换它，并且每次拉取请求都会进行检查，以确保不会有任何更改将其删除或再次标记为机器翻译。

4208f79380d548a0.source: <g1>ffmpeg</g1> (about 80 MB) joins a video and its sound when a site keeps them apart, which most sites do for the higher qualities, and turns the sound into an MP3, Opus or FLAC file. Click <g2>Install ffmpeg</g2> when MDM offers it. MDM checks it against the checksums its release publishes.
4208f79380d548a0.text: <g1>ffmpeg</g1>（约 80 MB）会在网站将视频和音频分开时将它们合并。大多数网站都会为较高画质这样处理。ffmpeg 还可以将音频转换为 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC 文件。MDM 提示时，点击<g2>安装 ffmpeg</g2>。MDM 会根据其发布版本提供的校验和进行验证。

420fd4269607a080.source: Pick a quality, then Download Now.
420fd4269607a080.text: 选择画质，然后点击“立即下载”。

42719c02fcae1f7c.source: The copy of the extension from the Chrome Web Store showed no <g1>Download video</g1> button on YouTube before version 0.5.1. From 0.5.1 it shows it. Your browser updates extensions by itself; to get it sooner, open its extensions page and update them there.
42719c02fcae1f7c.text: Chrome 网上应用店中的扩展程序副本在 0.5.1 版本之前，YouTube 页面上不显示<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮。从 0.5.1 版本开始，该按钮会显示。您的浏览器会自行更新扩展程序；要更快获取更新，请打开浏览器的扩展程序页面并在那里更新。

427cc05e98da7048.source: <g1>Extract when done</g1>: ticked by itself when the package holds an archive.
427cc05e98da7048.text: <g1>完成后提取</g1>：分组中包含存档时，此项会自动勾选。

429af5aabcba70df.source: 50 MiB, server allows 2 connections, 2 MB/s each
429af5aabcba70df.text: 50 MiB，服务器允许 2 个连接，每个 2 MB/秒

42d22490266e1c29.source: The pictures go into a folder of their own, named after the gallery. Want only a few? Type a number in <g1>Files at most</g1> to take the first ones the site lists, on most sites the newest.
42d22490266e1c29.text: 图片将保存到以图库命名的独立文件夹中。如果只想下载部分图片，可在<g1>最多文件数</g1>中输入数字，以下载网站列出的前几张图片（在大多数网站上为最新图片）。

42d39125634c1b6d.source: <g1>Options → Connection → DNS</g1> picks who turns names into addresses for downloads, FTP, MDM's own downloads and the update check: the system's (the default), Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, NextDNS with your configuration ID, or your own. It is asked over HTTPS (the default) or TLS, so nobody on the way sees or changes the names you look up, or plainly over TCP. <g2>Test</g2> shows how long it takes to answer.
42d39125634c1b6d.text: <g1>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g1> 用于选择谁将下载、FTP、MDM 自身的下载和更新检查的名称解析为地址：系统默认、Cloudflare、Google、Quad9、AdGuard、带有您的配置 ID 的 NextDNS，或您自己的 DNS。解析请求通过 HTTPS（默认）或 TLS 发送，因此途中的任何人都无法看到或更改您查询的名称，也可以直接通过 TCP 发送。<g2>测试</g2> 显示响应所需的时间。

42f13ba00e15c0ff.source: <g1>No proxy/socks</g1> connects directly; it is the default. <g2>Use system settings</g2> takes the proxy set in Windows. <g3>Manual proxy/socks configuration</g3> takes the proxy's address and <g4>Port</g4>, a <g5>UserName</g5> and <g6>Password</g6> if it needs them, and the protocols it is for. Write a SOCKS proxy as <x7/>. <g8>Get System</g8> fills the fields in from Windows' settings, to adjust from there.
42f13ba00e15c0ff.text: <g1>无代理/SOCKS</g1> 表示直接连接，这是默认设置。<g2>使用系统设置</g2> 采用 Windows 中设置的代理。<g3>手动代理/SOCKS 配置</g3> 允许您输入代理地址和<g4>端口</g4>，如果需要，还可以输入<g5>用户名</g5>和<g6>密码</g6>，以及适用的协议。SOCKS 代理的格式为 <x7/>。<g8>从系统获取</g8> 会从 Windows 设置中填充这些字段，以便您在此基础上进行调整。

42fcdc57b1d01537.source: A code works once, for ten minutes, and not after five wrong tries: click <g1>New code</g1> for another. To keep the page one tap away, add it to the phone's home screen (the browser's menu: <g2>Add to Home screen</g2>).
42fcdc57b1d01537.text: 一个代码只能使用一次，有效期十分钟，并且在五次错误尝试后失效：点击<g1>新代码</g1>获取另一个。要让页面触手可及，请将其添加到手机主屏幕（浏览器菜单：<g2>添加到主屏幕</g2>）。

42fd1c3a7225fa22.source: Each feature has a page of its own, with the real window, where to find it, and what it can't do yet.
42fd1c3a7225fa22.text: 每个功能都有专属页面，其中包含实际窗口截图、查找位置，以及尚未实现的功能。

42fd429771459bdb.source: A playlist: every video ticked, one quality for all.
42fd429771459bdb.text: 播放列表：所有视频均已勾选，画质统一。

4322a9c35e172e53.source: Its title and glyphs while the window isn't the active one, and a greyed button's
4322a9c35e172e53.text: 窗口非活动时，其标题和字形，以及置灰按钮的标题和字形

432cbb1ffee89925.source: <g1>Your downloads are yours to answer for.</g1> Respect copyright and the terms of the sites you download from. With torrents, remember that a torrent client also shares what it downloads.
432cbb1ffee89925.text: <g1>您的下载由您负责。</g1> 请尊重版权和您下载网站的条款。对于种子文件，请记住种子客户端也会分享它下载的内容。

4331daa8e422b4a6.source: a <x1/> beside any icons, saying who drew them and under which licence. Icons must be your own or under a licence that lets MDM share them (GPL-3.0), never copied from another program.
4331daa8e422b4a6.text: 在任何图标旁添加一个 <x1/>，说明图标的作者及其许可协议。图标必须是您自己创作的，或在允许 MDM 分发的许可协议（GPL-3.0）下发布，绝不能从其他程序复制。

433e0637cae84575.source: Links that work only once no longer fail with "403 Forbidden".
433e0637cae84575.text: 仅限一次的链接不再因“403 Forbidden”而失败。

436bac2c4f3d3f4c.source: <g1>Downloads → Start queue</g1> and <g2>Downloads → Stop queue</g2> list them too.
436bac2c4f3d3f4c.text: <g1>下载 → 启动队列</g1>和<g2>下载 → 停止队列</g2>也会列出所有队列。

437098c2f3d487d8.source: The file host's link, MDM's download
437098c2f3d487d8.text: 文件主机链接，MDM 下载

438a47f34fb3d4b7.source: Browser integration — Mister Download Manager help
438a47f34fb3d4b7.text: 浏览器集成 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

439e42205d062684.source: Video pages through yt-dlp and ffmpeg, image galleries through gallery-dl (run as separate programs); while a network adapter is chosen, their connections go through a proxy of MDM's on 127.0.0.1 that binds them to it (<x1/>)
439e42205d062684.text: 视频页面通过 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，图片画廊通过 gallery-dl（作为独立程序运行）；当选择网络适配器时，它们的连接通过 MDM 在 127.0.0.1 上的代理，将它们绑定到该适配器 (<x1/>)

43ad4ee2e95fdb1f.source: A page's own short sounds (a click, a voice-search chime) are no longer listed in <g1>Media on this page</g1>.
43ad4ee2e95fdb1f.text: 页面本身的短音（点击声、语音搜索提示音）不再列在<g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>中。

43b468d3bb0d57bb.source: Sites Logins: a user name and password per site.
43b468d3bb0d57bb.text: 站点登录：每个站点的用户名和密码。

43bb74214b2e4ee2.source: The first release: a free download manager for Windows, laid out the way Internet Download Manager users expect, with experimental builds for macOS and Linux.
43bb74214b2e4ee2.text: 首次发布：一款适用于 Windows 的免费下载管理器，布局与 Internet Download Manager 用户所期望的一致，并提供 macOS 和 Linux 的实验性版本。

43cb42591f1e4934.source: <g1>No proxy/socks</g1> — connect directly. This is the default.
43cb42591f1e4934.text: <g1>无代理/SOCKS</g1> — 直接连接。这是默认设置。

43dc4b87cceb0568.source: Links that come while the window is open join the ones already there. A link that is already in the window isn't added twice. A link that is already in your download list goes under <g1>Already in the list</g1>, unticked.
43dc4b87cceb0568.text: 窗口打开期间收到的链接会加入已有链接。窗口中已有的链接不会重复添加。已在下载列表中的链接会显示在<g1>已在列表中</g1>下方，且不会被勾选。

43ff6b9c3376c383.source: Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi

44199156f7cc5b17.source: MDM must be running at that time. Closing the window is fine (it stays in the tray); <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1> is not.
44199156f7cc5b17.text: MDM 必须在计划启动时运行。关闭窗口没有问题（MDM 会留在系统托盘中）；但不能选择<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>。

441af57745084076.text: 打开<g1>速度限制器</g1>选项卡。

4447a34a8cbe1ae6.source: <g1>The Categories pane and the menus</g1> (<g2>#113</g2>): the pane reads as a tree (each category named with its count, open or shut, selected), the menu bar and every right-click menu as menus whose items can be run, and <g3>Shift+F10</g3> or the <g4>Menu</g4> key opens the selected category's menu. A menu opened from the keyboard no longer stays invisible until the mouse moves.
4447a34a8cbe1ae6.text: <g1>“类别”窗格和菜单</g1> (<g2>#113</g2>)：该窗格现在被读取为树状结构（每个类别都有名称、计数、展开或折叠状态、选中状态），菜单栏和每个右键菜单都被读取为可执行项目的菜单，<g3>Shift+F10</g3>或<g4>菜单</g4>键可以打开所选类别的菜单。通过键盘打开的菜单不再在鼠标移动之前保持不可见。

445e6378c12f1e16.source: <g1>Image gallery support:</g1> download whole galleries (Flickr, Imgur, DeviantArt and more) with gallery-dl.
445e6378c12f1e16.text: <g1>图像画廊支持：</g1> 使用 gallery-dl 下载整个画廊（Flickr、Imgur、DeviantArt 等）。

44970b9b25afe28d.source: These are the checks CI runs; each works on a clean clone:
44970b9b25afe28d.text: 以下是 CI 执行的检查；每项检查都在干净的克隆版本上运行：

44aa99ba0ee91e15.source: It's a desktop app: open this page on your computer to download it.
44aa99ba0ee91e15.text: 这是一个桌面应用：请在您的电脑上打开此页面进行下载。

44be10554ef4d67f.source: Preliminary results from {date}. A full re-run is under way; these numbers will be replaced when it finishes.
44be10554ef4d67f.text: {date} 的初步结果。正在进行全面重新运行；完成后这些数字将被替换。

44c2ef53e14c6f1a.source: A save folder shown as <x1/> could be taken literally, asking to create it in the wrong place or failing with "Read-only file system" on macOS.
44c2ef53e14c6f1a.text: 保存文件夹显示为<x1/>时，可能会被字面理解，导致在错误位置创建文件夹或在 macOS 上因“只读文件系统”而失败。

44c881667b5a140f.source: The pane on the left has four branches. <g1>All Downloads</g1> holds everything, <g2>Unfinished</g2> what isn't complete yet and <g3>Finished</g3> what is, each by category. <g4>Queues</g4> lists each queue. The top branches show how many downloads they hold, and right-click → <g5>Browse</g5> opens a category's folder.
44c881667b5a140f.text: 左侧窗格有四个分支。<g1>所有下载</g1>包含所有文件，<g2>未完成</g2>显示尚未完成的文件，<g3>已完成</g3>显示已完成的文件，每个都按类别分类。<g4>队列</g4>列出每个下载队列。顶部显示的分支会显示其包含的下载数量，右键点击 → <g5>浏览</g5>可打开类别的文件夹。

4633f7d30e0b2908.source: <g1>Windows: MDM draws with Direct3D 12</g1> (<g2>#89</g2>). Its windows open faster (about a quarter of a second sooner on our test PC), and Direct3D may avoid the stalls some graphics drivers' OpenGL has (<g3>#82</g3>). <g4>View → Draw with</g4> goes back to OpenGL, as before, from the next start; a choice of OpenGL is kept. The window always opens: when Direct3D can't start, its first frame doesn't come within 10 seconds, or a start with it ends before its first frame, MDM draws with OpenGL until Direct3D is chosen again (the menu says so, and why); without a usable OpenGL either, it draws with Microsoft's software renderer (Remote Desktop, virtual machines without a graphics driver). When the graphics card is reset while MDM runs (a driver update), MDM starts again by itself. Freeze and crash reports say what was drawing. Linux and macOS keep OpenGL by default.
4633f7d30e0b2908.text: <g1>Windows：MDM 使用 Direct3D 12 绘制</g1>（<g2>#89</g2>）。其窗口打开速度更快（在我们的测试 PC 上大约快四分之一秒），Direct3D 可能会避免某些显卡驱动的 OpenGL 出现的卡顿（<g3>#82</g3>）。<g4>视图 → 绘制方式</g4>可选择回到 OpenGL，与之前一样，从下次启动生效；OpenGL 的选择会被保留。窗口始终会打开：当 Direct3D 无法启动、其第一帧在 10 秒内未出现，或使用它启动但在第一帧出现前结束时，MDM 会使用 OpenGL 绘制，直到再次选择 Direct3D（菜单会说明原因）；如果 OpenGL 也无法使用，它会使用 Microsoft 的软件渲染器绘制（远程桌面、没有显卡驱动的虚拟机）。当 MDM 运行时显卡重置（驱动更新）时，MDM 会自行重新启动。冻结和崩溃报告会说明正在使用的绘制方式。Linux 和 macOS 默认保持 OpenGL。

465aa7792ebfb03e.source: On Linux and macOS, MDM finds yt-dlp, ffmpeg and gallery-dl on your <x1/> and in the usual package-manager folders, including Homebrew's. A program you selected yourself takes priority, followed by MDM's own installed copy. The system copy is used when neither is present, and your package manager keeps it up to date: MDM never downloads over it on its own. If your distribution's yt-dlp is old, <g2>Use MDM's own copy</g2> in Helpers downloads MDM's, which keeps itself current and is used from then on.
465aa7792ebfb03e.text: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，MDM 会在您的 <x1/> 以及包括 Homebrew 在内的常用包管理器文件夹中查找 yt-dlp、ffmpeg 和 gallery-dl。您自己选择的程序优先，其次是 MDM 自己安装的副本。当两者都不存在时，将使用系统副本，并且您的包管理器会使其保持最新：MDM 绝不会自行覆盖它。如果您的发行版中的 yt-dlp 过旧，请在“帮助程序”中勾选<g2>使用 MDM 自带的副本</g2>，MDM 将下载并使用自己的副本，该副本会自行保持最新。

47c3075afae12dd9.source: MDM contains no adware, spyware, bundled offers or tracking. Its whole source code is public, so anyone can check what it does, and every release is built from that code by GitHub's servers, where the build can be inspected. The helper programs it can fetch for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. Download MDM only from this site or the project's GitHub releases.
47c3075afae12dd9.text: MDM 不含广告软件、间谍软件、捆绑软件或跟踪功能。它的全部源代码都是公开的，任何人都可以检查其功能；每个版本都由 GitHub 的服务器根据这份代码构建，构建过程也可以检查。它为下载视频而获取的辅助程序在运行前都会经过验证：yt-dlp 会与其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会与其发布的校验和进行核对。请仅从本网站或项目的 GitHub 发布页面下载 MDM。

On Windows it needs <g4>Allow wake timers</g4> in the power plan: when that is off the Scheduler says so, with a link to the setting. On Linux an administrator has to allow it once (the guide shows how); on macOS only an administrator can schedule a wake, so the option says why it's greyed. MDM never asks for an administrator's password. The Scheduler is 40 pixels taller for it.

499bdc1bfed9df4b.source: <g1>A download too big for the drive is refused on a busy computer too</g1> (<g2>#224</g2>): before a download starts, MDM checks the drive has room for it. It gave up checking after 5 seconds (a network drive that no longer answers can hang), counted from when it asked; on a very busy computer the check could wait longer than that just to start, and a download too big for its drive started anyway. The 5 seconds now count from when the check runs, and it asks only the folder's own drive instead of listing every drive, which takes well under a millisecond. A shared network folder (<x3/>) is checked too, which it wasn't before, and a folder that doesn't exist yet is checked on the drive it will be made on.
499bdc1bfed9df4b.text: <g1>对于驱动器空间不足的下载，在繁忙的电脑上也会被拒绝</g1>（<g2>#224</g2>）：在下载开始之前，MDM 会检查驱动器是否有足够的空间。它在 5 秒后放弃检查（无响应的网络驱动器可能会挂起），从它请求时开始计时；在非常繁忙的电脑上，检查可能需要等待更长时间才能开始，而对于驱动器来说太大的下载仍然会开始。现在，这 5 秒从检查运行时开始计时，并且它只询问文件夹自己的驱动器，而不是列出所有驱动器，这花费的时间远少于一毫秒。共享网络文件夹（<x3/>）也会被检查，而以前不会，并且尚未存在的文件夹会在它将要创建的驱动器上进行检查。

499ed264441447e6.source: <g1>Linux: torrents work on a system without CA certificates too</g1> (part of <g2>#264</g2>): the torrent engine built its own connection for the trackers, which can't be made without them, so no torrent or magnet link started there. It now uses MDM's: peers, the DHT and <x3/> trackers work, and an <x4/> tracker fails saying there are no certificates to check it with.
499ed264441447e6.text: <g1>Linux：在没有 CA 证书的系统上，种子下载也能工作</g1>（<g2>#264</g2> 的一部分）：种子引擎为跟踪器构建了自己的连接，没有证书就无法建立，因此无法启动任何种子或磁力链接。现在它使用 MDM 的连接：对等点、DHT 和 <x3/> 跟踪器可以工作，而 <x4/> 跟踪器会因没有证书可供检查而失败。

Anything else can be added to the list.

4ab3b6f6e5964401.source: <g1>Control MDM from your phone</g1> (<g2>#141</g2>): <g3>Options → Remote</g3>, off by default. A phone or another computer on the local network, paired with a code (or a QR code) MDM shows, opens a page MDM serves over HTTPS: it adds links, magnet links and <x4/> files, shows the list with its progress, pauses, starts and removes downloads, and starts and stops the queues, in the phone's language. Only paired devices are answered, each removable in Options, and only on the computer's private network addresses. <g5>Guide</g5>.

4bc9bd6c4901c383.source: MDM contains no adware, spyware, bundled offers or tracking. Its whole source code is public, so anyone can check what it does, and every release is built from that code by GitHub's servers, where the build can be inspected. The helper programs it can fetch for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. Download MDM only from <g1>this site</g1> or the project's GitHub releases.
4bc9bd6c4901c383.text: MDM 不包含广告软件、间谍软件、捆绑优惠或跟踪。它的全部源代码都是公开的，因此任何人都可以检查它的功能，并且每个版本都是由 GitHub 的服务器从该代码构建的，构建过程可以被检查。它为视频获取的辅助程序在运行前会进行验证：yt-dlp 会对照其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会对照其发布的校验和进行验证。请仅从<g1>本网站</g1>或项目的 GitHub 发布页面下载 MDM。

4bd284ee80f6799e.source: <g1>Experimental:</g1> built from each service's public API documentation, not yet confirmed with a real paid account. AllDebrid's answers were also checked against its real API with the public demo key from its documentation, which answers with sample data, not a real file. If something doesn't work with your account, please <g2>open an issue</g2> (never paste your token or key in it).
4bd284ee80f6799e.text: <g1>实验性：</g1>根据各项服务的公开 API 文档构建，尚未使用真实的付费帐户进行验证。我们还使用文档中的公开演示密钥，通过 AllDebrid 的真实 API 检查了返回结果。该密钥返回的是示例数据，不是真实文件。如果帐户无法正常使用，请<g2>提交问题</g2>（切勿在问题中粘贴令牌或密钥）。

4c0b75cb39374b7b.source: Download a file with up to 8 connections (<x1/>, 1 to 128), showing progress. <x2/> pauses it; <x3/> continues. <x4/> checks the finished file: hex MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 or CRC32, optionally named (<x5/>). <x6/> picks the DNS: <x7/> (the default); a service and how to ask it, <x8/>, <x9/>, <x10/>, <x11/>, <x12/>; DNS servers' addresses, <x13/>; or a DNS-over-HTTPS address. It never falls back to the system's DNS. <x14/> sends every connection through one network adapter, by its name (<x15/>, <x16/>) or one of its addresses; when it isn't connected, nothing is sent and the download fails. A link from a file host that one of your debrid accounts (<g17>Options → Accounts</g17>) supports goes through that account, as in the app, and <x18/> says <x19/>; <x20/> downloads the address itself (<g21>Debrid service accounts</g21>).
4c0b75cb39374b7b.text: 下载文件，最多使用 8 个连接（<x1/>，范围为 1 到 128），并显示进度。<x2/> 暂停下载；<x3/> 继续下载。<x4/> 检查已下载完成的文件：以十六进制格式显示 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 或 CRC32 校验和，也可以指定名称（<x5/>）。<x6/> 选择 DNS：<x7/>（默认）；选择服务及其查询方式，<x8/>、<x9/>、<x10/>、<x11/>、<x12/>；指定 DNS 服务器地址，<x13/>；或指定 DNS-over-HTTPS 地址。它不会回退到系统 DNS。<x14/> 通过一个网络适配器发送所有连接，可指定适配器名称（<x15/>、<x16/>）或其地址之一；如果适配器未连接，则不会发送任何内容，下载也会失败。文件托管网站的链接如果受网盘服务帐户（<g17>选项 → 帐户</g17>）支持，就会像在应用程序中一样通过该帐户处理；<x18/> 表示 <x19/>；<x20/> 则直接下载该网址（<g21>网盘服务帐户</g21>）。

4ceca71bcfd7f0a8.text: 双击列表中的种子以打开其进度窗口。除了常规状态外，种子的窗口有五个选项卡：

4d0868248400f576.source: <g1>No video this can download on that page</g1> means yt-dlp found nothing on the page. Check that the address is the video's own page.
4d0868248400f576.text: <g1>此页面上没有可下载的视频</g1>表示 yt-dlp 未在该页面找到视频。请确认地址是视频本身的页面。

4d13242235854bbc.source: The main window's toolbar and categories in the High contrast theme
4d13242235854bbc.text: 主窗口的工具栏和类别采用高对比度主题

4d14bced2740498b.source: Start in the notification area, the window hidden: what <g1>Launch Mister Download Manager on startup</g1> starts MDM with when you sign in. Where no notification area shows MDM's icon (some Linux desktops), MDM starts minimized. A running MDM stays as it is.
4d14bced2740498b.text: 在通知区域启动，窗口隐藏：这是您登录时，<g1>启动时运行 Mister Download Manager</g1> 启动 MDM 的方式。在没有通知区域显示 MDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面），MDM 会最小化启动。正在运行的 MDM 保持不变。

4d35cd399872baf1.source: Open the selected download (a double-click follows right-click → <g1>On Double click</g1>)
4d35cd399872baf1.text: 打开所选下载（双击操作遵循右键单击 → <g1>双击时</g1> 的设置）

4d398edd535e24d9.source: The <g1>Speed Limiter</g1> tab of a torrent's window has, besides its download limit, <g2>Limit uploading</g2> to a speed of your choice. That limit is kept with the torrent: it applies again whenever the torrent runs or shares. A torrent can't be held under 16 KBytes/sec either way.
4d398edd535e24d9.text: torrent 窗口的<g1>速度限制器</g1>选项卡除了下载限制外，还有<g2>限制上传</g2>到您选择的速度。该限制会随 torrent 保存：每当 torrent 运行或分享时，该限制都会再次生效。无论如何，torrent 的上传速度不能低于 16 千字节/秒。

4d3d75cb167e532b.source: <g1>Hide to the notification area</g1> (<g2>#63</g2>): a download's progress window has a button that hides it in the tray while the download goes on: on Windows in its title bar, left of Minimize (the progress window draws its own Windows 11 title bar now, keeping the system's snapping, shaking, menu and shadow), and in its Alt+Space menu; on Linux and macOS at the end of its tab row. The tray menu's new <g3>Downloads in progress</g3> lists the running downloads to bring one's window back (double-clicking it in the list does too). With <g4>Options → General → Minimize to the notification area</g4> (on by default), Minimize hides the main window and progress windows there as well. Only where a tray shows MDM's icon.
4d3d75cb167e532b.text: <g1>隐藏到通知区域</g1>（<g2>#63</g2>）：下载进度窗口有一个按钮，可以在下载进行时将其隐藏到系统托盘：在 Windows 上位于标题栏中“最小化”按钮的左侧（进度窗口现在绘制自己的 Windows 11 标题栏，保留系统的吸附、摇动、菜单和阴影），以及其 Alt+Space 菜单中；在 Linux 和 macOS 上位于其选项卡行的末尾。系统托盘菜单中新增的<g3>正在进行的下载</g3>会列出正在运行的下载，以恢复其窗口（双击列表中的项目也可以）。启用<g4>选项 → 常规 → 最小化到通知区域</g4>（默认开启）后，“最小化”也会将主窗口和进度窗口隐藏到系统托盘。仅在显示 MDM 图标的系统托盘中可用。

4d5e2be36abbc65b.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>86 languages, right to left too</g3> <g4>It speaks your computer's language. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu lay out right to left.</g4>
4d5e2be36abbc65b.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>支持 86 种语言和从右到左的排版</g3> <g4>界面语言与电脑的语言一致。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语和乌尔都语均采用从右到左的排版。</g4>

4d65ae4e627d7620.source: Quit MDM with <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1> before you unplug the stick, so it saves the list.
4d65ae4e627d7620.text: 拔下 U 盘前，请通过<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>退出 MDM，以保存下载列表。

4d7daf5f5a647783.source: Double-click the download to open its progress window.
4d7daf5f5a647783.text: 双击下载任务，打开其进度窗口。

4d876c329eaf2379.source: The <g1>Mister Download Manager</g1> extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox:
4d876c329eaf2379.text: 适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Firefox 的 <g1>Mister Download Manager</g1> 扩展：

4d895f12e00559ae.source: Can it download from Netflix or other paid streaming services?
4d895f12e00559ae.text: 它能从 Netflix 或其他付费流媒体服务下载吗？

4dad09a9ad62a54a.source: Many sites hand out links that only work for a while, or only while you are signed in. Resuming then fails, because the old address no longer answers.
4dad09a9ad62a54a.text: 许多网站提供的链接只在一段时间内有效，或者只在您登录时有效。此时恢复会失败，因为旧地址不再响应。

4dbf5f3368111d27.source: Free and open source. Install it, click a link, and watch every connection at work.
4dbf5f3368111d27.text: 免费开源。安装后点击链接，即可查看每个连接如何工作。

4dd744e98a23c84f.source: MDM can download and run third-party tools at your request: <g1>yt-dlp</g1> for video pages and <g2>ffmpeg</g2> for merging video and sound. They come from their developers' official releases, are checked before they run, and are governed by their own licences (yt-dlp: Unlicense; ffmpeg: LGPL or GPL, depending on the build). The libraries built into MDM and their licences are listed on the <g3>License</g3> page. Websites and services you download from are governed by their own terms.
4dd744e98a23c84f.text: MDM 可以根据您的请求下载并运行第三方工具：用于视频页面的 <g1>yt-dlp</g1> 和用于合并视频和音频的 <g2>ffmpeg</g2>。它们来自其开发者的官方发布版本，在运行前经过检查，并受其各自许可的约束（yt-dlp：Unlicense；ffmpeg：LGPL 或 GPL，取决于构建版本）。MDM 内置的库及其许可列在<g3>许可</g3>页面上。您下载的网站和服务受其各自条款的约束。

4de971bbe1263ef0.source: Tutorial: carry MDM on a USB stick →
4de971bbe1263ef0.text: 教程：在 U 盘上携带 MDM →

4ded0822f265967f.source: Paste the new link into <g1>Address</g1> in <g2>File Properties</g2> and click <g3>OK</g3>.
4ded0822f265967f.text: 将新链接粘贴到<g2>文件属性</g2>中的<g1>地址</g1>，然后点击<g3>确定</g3>。

4df48331225c7085.source: MDM can start with your computer and wait in the notification area, its window closed and its downloads running. A download's progress window can go there too, with one click.
4df48331225c7085.text: MDM 可以随电脑启动，并在通知区域等待，窗口关闭，下载仍在进行。下载进度窗口也可以一键隐藏到通知区域。

4e0dc326dff9f5b7.source: Many sites publish a checksum next to the download. Right-click the download, choose <g1>Verify checksum...</g1> and paste it. MDM reads MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and CRC32. A finished file is checked at once; an unfinished one is checked when its download ends. MDM then says <g2>The file matches</g2> or <g3>The file does NOT match</g3>.
4e0dc326dff9f5b7.text: 许多网站会在下载链接旁提供校验和。右键单击下载，选择<g1>验证校验和...</g1>，然后粘贴校验和。MDM 支持 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 和 CRC32。已完成的文件会立即进行校验；未完成的文件会在下载结束后进行校验。随后，MDM 会显示<g2>文件匹配</g2>或<g3>文件不匹配</g3>。

4e0e8dcb4e45ef32.source: Download videos from YouTube and other sites — Mister Download Manager
4e0e8dcb4e45ef32.text: 从 YouTube 和其他网站下载视频 — Mister Download Manager

4e2c245c44f6b6ff.source: The files go next to the archive, into a folder named after it when it holds several things (or always, or never: you choose in Options). A file that is already there is kept, and the new one is numbered: <x1/>.
4e2c245c44f6b6ff.text: 文件会解压到压缩包旁边，如果压缩包包含多个文件，则会解压到一个以压缩包命名的文件夹中（您可以在选项中选择总是、从不或仅在多文件时创建文件夹）。如果目标位置已有同名文件，则会保留原有文件，新文件会进行编号：<x1/>。

4e3e7d596fa947ef.source: Check <g1>Save to</g1> (the Video category's folder by default) and <g2>File name</g2>, which comes from the video's title.
4e3e7d596fa947ef.text: 检查<g1>保存到</g1>（默认为视频类别的文件夹）和<g2>文件名</g2>。文件名取自视频标题。

4e46cacda919db98.source: An add-on loaded with <g1>Load Temporary Add-on</g1> (from <x2/>) is removed when Firefox closes. Remove it and install the add-on from <g3>its page on addons.mozilla.org</g3> instead: Firefox keeps that one, and updates it.
4e46cacda919db98.text: 通过<x2/>中的<g1>加载临时附加组件</g1>加载的附加组件会在 Firefox 关闭时被移除。请移除它，然后从<g3>addons.mozilla.org 上的页面</g3>安装附加组件：Firefox 会保留并更新该组件。

4e4d590e10d29607.text: 欢迎使用脚本。支持 IDM 命令行参数。

4e56d054c4ea1845.source: <g1>A minimized MDM keeps working</g1>: with the main window minimized (not to the notification area), queues didn't start their next file, the Scheduler's starts and stops didn't fire, download limits, the network adapter's kill switch, the clipboard monitor, the update check, the taskbar's progress and saving the list all waited until the window was restored. They run in every window state now, and their windows (Download complete, a limit's notice) open at once.
4e56d054c4ea1845.text: <g1>最小化后的 MDM 仍可正常工作</g1>：当主窗口最小化（未最小化到通知区域）时，队列不会启动下一个文件，“计划程序”的启动和停止不会触发，下载限制、网络适配器的断路开关、剪贴板监视器、更新检查、任务栏进度和保存列表都会等待，直到窗口恢复。它们现在在所有窗口状态下运行，并且它们的窗口（下载完成、限制通知）会立即打开。

4f07dda13d242d23.source: Options on its Connection page: connections per download, per-server exceptions, Download limits and the DNS list
4f07dda13d242d23.text: 其“连接”页面上的选项：每个下载的连接数、每个服务器的例外、下载限制和 DNS 列表

4f342424b8dab68f.source: Every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen by flag on the first start or any time in View → Language. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur are laid out right to left.
4f342424b8dab68f.text: 支持 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，首次启动时可通过旗帜选择，或随时在视图 → 语言中更改。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语采用从右到左的布局。

4f58f9e363899fcd.source: You decide what MDM takes. <g1>Options → File types</g1> lists the file types it catches (ZIP, RAR, EXE, ISO, MP4, PDF and many more) and the sites it leaves alone, and <g2>Options → General</g2> has the browsers it takes downloads from. Everything else stays with the browser.
4f58f9e363899fcd.text: 您可以决定 MDM 接管哪些下载。<g1>选项 → 文件类型</g1>列出了它会捕获的文件类型（ZIP、RAR、EXE、ISO、MP4、PDF 等等）以及它会忽略的网站，而<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>则列出了它会从哪些浏览器接管下载。其他所有下载都将保留在浏览器中。

4f5ab4808403e058.source: Turn the running app's automation API on or off.
4f5ab4808403e058.text: 开启或关闭运行中的应用的自动化 API。

4f7a15d66fcc61dc.source: Is MDM available in my language? — Mister Download Manager
4f7a15d66fcc61dc.text: MDM 有我的语言版本吗？— Mister Download Manager

4faa7018e737c223.source: <g1>Categories</g1> (left). Choose what the list shows: <g2>All Downloads</g2>, <g3>Unfinished</g3>, <g4>Finished</g4> and <g5>Queues</g5>, each with its categories. Drag the gap between the pane and the list to make it wider.
4faa7018e737c223.text: <g1>类别</g1>（左侧）。选择列表显示的内容：<g2>所有下载</g2>、<g3>未完成</g3>、<g4>已完成</g4>和<g5>队列</g5>，每个项目下还有相应的类别。拖动窗格与列表之间的分隔线可加宽窗格。

4fb7cfbf3e8ef4a2.source: Run in the notification area: start hidden, hide progress windows
4fb7cfbf3e8ef4a2.text: 在通知区域运行：隐藏启动，隐藏进度窗口

4fbf90cc572fcc58.source: The window that offers the browser extension on Linux: Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox, each with Add the extension
4fbf90cc572fcc58.text: 在 Linux 上提供浏览器扩展的窗口：Google Chrome 和 Mozilla Firefox，每个都有“添加扩展”按钮

4fdcd2fa8811b894.source: MDM itself still sends nothing anywhere: the server talks only to the MDM on this computer, over the token-protected local channel. But what the assistant reads, it passes to its own AI service: when it lists your downloads, their file names, addresses and folders go to that service, under that service's privacy terms. Turn the automation API off, or remove the server from the assistant, when you don't want that.
4fdcd2fa8811b894.text: MDM 本身仍不会向任何地方发送数据：服务器仅通过受令牌保护的本地通道与此计算机上的 MDM 通信。但助手读取的数据会传递给其自身的 AI 服务：列出下载内容时，下载的文件名、地址和文件夹会发送给该服务，并受该服务隐私条款的约束。如果不希望这样，请关闭自动化 API，或从助手中移除服务器。

4fefa1c9a9258b09.source: Download manager for Windows, with macOS and Linux builds
4fefa1c9a9258b09.text: 适用于 Windows 的下载管理器，也支持 macOS 和 Linux 构建

4ffb28494afc5681.source: With the list selected, type the first letters of a name to jump straight to it.
4ffb28494afc5681.text: 选中列表后，输入名称的首字母即可直接跳转到该项。

5002ef0265a457da.source: The built-in themes are <g1>Classic</g1> (MDM's own look, the default), <g2>Native</g2> (your system's accent colour and contrast), <g3>High contrast</g3>, and the style themes <g4>Metro</g4>, <g5>Adwaita</g5>, <g6>Breeze</g6>, <g7>Luna</g7>, <g8>Aero</g8>, <g9>Aqua</g9> and <g10>Emerald</g10>, each with its own control shapes and icons, and on Windows its own title bar. <g11>Getting started</g11> describes each one; the website's <g12>Themes page</g12> shows them all, light and dark.
5002ef0265a457da.text: MDM 内置主题包括：<g1>经典</g1>（MDM 默认外观）、<g2>原生</g2>（使用系统强调色和对比度）、<g3>高对比度</g3>，以及样式主题 <g4>现代</g4>、<g5>Adwaita</g5>、<g6>Breeze</g6>、<g7>Luna</g7>、<g8>Aero</g8>、<g9>Aqua</g9> 和 <g10>翡翠</g10>。每个主题都有独特的控件形状、图标，在 Windows 上还有专属标题栏。<g11>入门指南</g11> 详细介绍了每个主题；网站的<g12>主题页面</g12> 展示了所有主题的亮色和暗色模式。

502153a741b65e5f.source: <g1>Mister Download Manager (MDM)</g1> is a free, open-source download manager for Windows 10 and 11, with builds for Linux and macOS. It looks and works like Internet Download Manager (IDM), but it is free (GPL-3.0), downloaded a 1 GiB file 5.4 times faster than IDM 6.42 in our published benchmark, and also downloads torrents, magnet links and videos from web pages. A browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox hands downloads to it.
502153a741b65e5f.text: <g1>Mister Download Manager (MDM)</g1> 是一款免费、开源的下载管理器，适用于 Windows 10 和 11，并提供 Linux 和 macOS 版本。它的外观和功能与 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 相似，但它是免费的 (GPL-3.0)。在我们发布的基准测试中，它下载 1 GiB 文件比 IDM 6.42 快 5.4 倍，并且还支持下载种子、磁力链接和网页视频。适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Firefox 的浏览器扩展程序可将下载任务交给它处理。

50344e9c00abc1e4.source: <g1>Add to queue</g1> adds the ticked links to the <g2>Main download queue</g2>, as the import always did, and <g3>Start</g3> starts the queue as well. An <x4/> file still brings each download's referrer and cookies. See <g5>Link grabber and archives</g5>.
50344e9c00abc1e4.text: <g1>添加到队列</g1>会将已勾选的链接添加到<g2>主下载队列</g2>，就像以前的导入功能一样，而<g3>开始</g3>也会同时启动队列。<x4/> 文件仍然会带上每个下载任务的来源和 Cookie。请参阅<g5>链接抓取器和压缩包</g5>。

505a599d74a09b57.source: The gallery gets one row in your download list. Its size grows as the pictures arrive, and its log says how many were saved.
505a599d74a09b57.text: 该图库将在您的下载列表中占据一行。其大小会随着图片的到来而增长，日志会显示已保存的图片数量。

505ed46ec34b3953.source: <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks → Network adapter</g1> holds every connection MDM opens to one network adapter, usually your VPN's: downloads, FTP, torrents, video pages and galleries, MDM's own downloads and the update check. It works as a kill switch: when the adapter disconnects, or the VPN is switched off, nothing goes out through your normal connection. Running downloads stop with <g2>… is not connected</g2>, and start again by themselves when the adapter is back. The line under the list shows the adapter's address, or that it isn't connected. Details in <g3>Options → Proxy / Socks</g3> and, for torrents, in <g4>Torrents and your security</g4>.
505ed46ec34b3953.text: <g1>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 网络适配器</g1>将 MDM 打开的所有连接（下载、FTP、种子、视频页面和图库、MDM 自身的下载以及更新检查）都绑定到一个网络适配器，通常是您的 VPN 适配器。它充当终止开关：当适配器断开连接或 VPN 关闭时，任何数据都不会通过您的常规连接传出。正在进行的下载会因<g2>…未连接</g2>而停止，并在适配器恢复后自行重新开始。列表下方的行显示适配器的地址，或显示其未连接。详情请参阅<g3>选项 → 代理/SOCKS</g3>，以及种子相关的<g4>种子与您的安全</g4>。

5069ed5778c3addc.source: <g1>Extract archives when their download completes</g1> (off by default) — every archive downloaded, as soon as it (or a split archive's last volume) is in. A Link grabber package has its own <g2>Extract when done</g2>.
5069ed5778c3addc.text: <g1>下载完成后提取存档</g1>（默认关闭）— 每个存档下载完成后立即提取；分卷存档则在最后一个卷下载完成后提取。链接抓取器的每个包都可以单独设置<g2>完成后提取</g2>。

5095a187528ef523.source: Closed to the notification area, MDM gives its memory back to Windows: <g1>Memory</g1> drops to under 10 MB within seconds and stays low while it waits. Downloads, queues and the scheduler go on as before. The list of every language (<g2>View → Language</g2>) loads fonts for every script while it's open; MDM lets them go when it closes.
5095a187528ef523.text: 关闭到通知区域后，MDM 会将占用的内存还给 Windows：几秒钟内，<g1>内存</g1>会降至 10 MB 以下，并在等待期间保持较低水平。下载、队列和计划任务照常运行。打开每种语言的列表（<g2>视图 → 语言</g2>）时，会加载所有文字系统所需的字体；关闭列表后，MDM 会释放这些字体。

50a8864f971c1689.source: Right-click → <g1>Add category</g1> makes one for what you collect, say <g2>Books</g2> for <x3/>: a name, the file types separated by spaces (<x4/> allowed) and a folder. Change it later with <g5>Properties</g5>, or remove it with <g6>Delete</g6>. The files stay where they are.
50a8864f971c1689.text: 右键点击 → <g1>添加类别</g1>可为您收集的文件创建类别，例如为<x3/>创建<g2>图书</g2>类别：输入名称、用空格分隔的文件类型（允许<x4/>）以及一个文件夹。之后可以使用<g5>属性</g5>更改，或使用<g6>删除</g6>移除。文件会保留在原位置。

50b8783da591113a.text: 选择<g1>任务 → 导入 → 从文本文件</g1>。

5506de938e48a710.text: <g1>内置类别可供您更改</g1>（<g2>#93</g2>）：压缩文件、文档、音乐、程序和视频可以重命名、赋予其他文件类型和删除，就像您自己的类别一样（右键点击 → 属性或删除）。重命名的类别会保留其文件夹。删除类别时会询问其下载任务的处理方式：将其移动到常规，或将其从列表中删除；无论哪种方式，其文件都会保留。<g3>选项 → 保存到 → 恢复内置类别</g3>会将其恢复为原始状态。常规和种子仍然只更改其文件夹。

55106b089fb71eba.source: <g1>Ubuntu's Firefox reaches MDM</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): the Snap Firefox never makes the folder MDM looked for, so browser integration wasn't set up for it and its extension couldn't find MDM. It is now, and the Snap goes through the desktop, which asks once (<g3>Allow</g3>); the help says how to be asked again after <g4>Don't allow</g4>. Chromium as a Snap ran MDM's helper inside its sandbox, away from MDM (it started a second, sandboxed MDM): MDM no longer offers it, and the help says why.
55106b089fb71eba.text: <g1>Ubuntu 的 Firefox 连接到 MDM</g1>（<g2>#164</g2> 的一部分）：Snap 版 Firefox 从不创建 MDM 查找的文件夹，因此浏览器集成未为其设置，其扩展程序也无法找到 MDM。现在已解决此问题，Snap 版通过桌面进行，会请求一次 (<g3>允许</g3>)；帮助文档说明了在选择 <g4>不允许</g4> 后如何再次请求。Snap 版 Chromium 在其沙盒内运行 MDM 的辅助程序，与 MDM 隔离（它启动了第二个沙盒化的 MDM）：MDM 不再提供此选项，帮助文档说明了原因。

55215ba8e5158748.text: Mister Download Manager 的队列和计划程序：夜间开始下载，早上停止下载，控制流量，关闭计算机。

Its button reads the page only to find video and sound players and place itself. Clicking it passes the page's address, the video's address, the page's title, the site's cookies, the page that embeds the player and your browser's User-Agent to MDM.
558bb1c07f16684f.text: 它会在该标签页的内存中记录页面播放器加载的视频流（HLS 和 DASH 播放列表）地址，以便<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮可以传递该流。其按钮只读取页面以查找视频和音频播放器并放置自身。点击它会将页面地址、视频地址、页面标题、网站 cookie、嵌入播放器的页面和您的浏览器 User-Agent 传递给 MDM。

The arrow keys move through it, <g12>Enter</g12> picks, <g13>Esc</g13> closes it.

5634c00f6562f001.source: MDM can open a file, such as a sound or a script, exit, or turn the computer off with <g1>Shut down</g1>, <g2>Sleep</g2> or <g3>Hibernate</g3>. A 30-second countdown comes first, so if you are still at the computer, <g4>Cancel</g4> stops it.
5634c00f6562f001.text: MDM 可以打开一个文件（例如声音或脚本），退出，或通过<g1>关机</g1>、<g2>睡眠</g2>或<g3>休眠</g3>关闭计算机。在此之前会有 30 秒倒计时，如果您仍在计算机旁，可以点击<g4>取消</g4>来停止。

56417f54e14c905b.source: Have the links already, in a text file? <g1>Tasks → Import → From text file</g1> reads every web address in it, and you untick the ones you don't want. <g2>From IDM export file</g2> reads an <x3/> list, with each download's referrer and cookies, so a list exported from IDM comes over with what its downloads need. You can also drop a <x4/> or <x5/> list on the download list.
56417f54e14c905b.text: 已经有文本文件中的链接了？<g1>任务 → 导入 → 从文本文件</g1>会读取其中的每个网址，您可以取消勾选不想要的链接。<g2>从 IDM 导出文件</g2>会读取一个<x3/>列表，其中包含每个下载的引用页和 Cookie，因此从 IDM 导出的列表会随其下载所需的信息一同导入。您也可以将<x4/>或<x5/>列表拖放到下载列表中。

567f61dda0920579.text: 灰色未选中复选框的边框

5690cb4f1434f4bc.source: Open Windows <g1>Settings → Apps</g1>, find Mister Download Manager and choose Uninstall. The uninstaller asks whether to delete your download list and settings as well. Files you downloaded are never touched. For the portable copy, delete its folder. On Linux, remove the package with your package manager, or delete the AppImage; <g2>Uninstall on Linux</g2> says what stays in your home folder and how to remove it.
5690cb4f1434f4bc.text: 打开 Windows <g1>设置 → 应用</g1>，找到 Mister Download Manager 并选择“卸载”。卸载程序会询问是否同时删除您的下载列表和设置。您下载的文件永远不会被触碰。对于便携版，请删除其文件夹。在 Linux 上，使用您的包管理器删除软件包，或删除 AppImage；<g2>Linux 上的卸载</g2>说明了您的主文件夹中会保留哪些内容以及如何删除它们。

5696bc1cc94d2b78.source: MDM's setup registers the helper where Helium looks for it, on Windows, Linux and macOS. On Linux and macOS MDM also offers the extension to Helium, through Helium's own services, so with them allowed it arrives by itself at Helium's next start (on macOS Helium asks first: <g1>New extension added</g1> in its menu, where you turn it on). The Linux packages (.deb, .rpm) leave that to the window below, writing nothing in your home folder. On Windows Helium can't be offered the extension this way: MDM's <g2>Add Mister Download Manager to your browser</g2> window opens the store's page in Helium when Helium was installed with its setup; Helium from its zip isn't found there, so open the store's page in it yourself. Helium presents itself as Google Chrome, on purpose, so in <g3>Options → General → Capture downloads from the following browsers</g3> it is <g4>Google Chrome</g4>.
5696bc1cc94d2b78.text: MDM 的安装程序会在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上将助手注册到 Helium 查找的位置。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，MDM 还会通过 Helium 自身服务向 Helium 提供扩展程序，因此在允许这些服务的情况下，扩展程序会在 Helium 下次启动时自动出现（在 macOS 上，Helium 会先询问：在其菜单中显示<g1>已添加新扩展程序</g1>，您可以在那里将其开启）。Linux 软件包（.deb、.rpm）将此操作留给下面的窗口，不会在您的主文件夹中写入任何内容。在 Windows 上，无法通过这种方式向 Helium 提供扩展程序：如果 Helium 是通过其安装程序安装的，MDM 的<g2>将 Mister Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口会在 Helium 中打开商店页面；如果 Helium 是从 zip 文件安装的，则无法找到，因此请您自行在其中打开商店页面。Helium 会故意将自己伪装成 Google Chrome，因此在<g3>选项 → 常规 → 从以下浏览器捕获下载</g3>中，它显示为<g4>Google Chrome</g4>。

56a440bc7aa24cf3.source: Your language, from the first window.
56a440bc7aa24cf3.text: 从第一个窗口开始，就是您的语言。

56c9545f29a88358.source: <g1>The clipboard.</g1> <g2>Tasks → Add batch download from clipboard</g2> (<g3>Ctrl+B</g3>, also in the tray icon's menu) reads the copied text when you choose it and lists every download link in it: <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/> and magnet links, in a list, a forum post, Markdown or HTML, each once.
56c9545f29a88358.text: <g1>剪贴板。</g1> 选择<g2>任务 → 从剪贴板批量添加下载</g2>（<g3>Ctrl+B</g3>，也可在托盘图标菜单中找到），MDM 会读取复制的文本，并列出其中所有的下载链接：<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/> 和磁力链接，无论它们是在列表、论坛帖子、Markdown 还是 HTML 中，每个链接只添加一次。

56c991946fe8d471.text: 要继续已停止的下载，请选择该下载，然后点击工具栏上的<g1>恢复</g1>（或选择<g2>文件 → 立即下载</g2>）。

56cc0ee76be4673e.source: You can add your own queues in the Scheduler, or with <g1>Create new queue</g1> in a download's right-click menu.
56cc0ee76be4673e.text: 您可以在“计划程序”中添加自己的队列，或者通过下载右键菜单中的<g1>创建新队列</g1>来添加。

56e24f6222e629f5.source: is the theme yours starts from: <x1/> (the default), <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>, or another theme file in the same folder.

56efd2641fb36334.source: With the MDM extension, clicking a download link in your browser hands the download to MDM. MDM gets the address together with the page it came from (the referrer), your cookies for the site and the browser's User-Agent, so downloads that need you to be signed in still work. It also gets the address the browser's own download had reached: when a site refuses MDM the link itself (a one-time link the browser has already used, or a site that lets only browsers ask for its links), MDM goes on from there once, without your cookies if it is another site. When a site's bot check (Cloudflare's, for one) or its refusal of programs (FileHippo's <g1>412 Precondition Failed</g1>) turns MDM's own connection away, MDM asks once more connecting the way your browser does (the same handshake, settings and order of headers), with your browser's User-Agent and its cookies for that site only, and downloads on that one connection; your proxy, network adapter and speed limits apply as usual. It solves no challenge: a site that still wants one answered refuses again, and MDM says <g2>this site lets only browsers through</g2>; Alt+click the link to leave the download to the browser.
56efd2641fb36334.text: 安装 MDM 扩展后，在浏览器中点击下载链接即可将下载任务交给 MDM。MDM 会获取下载地址、来源页面（referrer）、您在该网站的 cookie 和浏览器的 User-Agent，因此需要登录才能下载的任务也能正常工作。它还会获取浏览器自身下载已达到的地址：当网站拒绝 MDM 直接获取链接时（浏览器已使用过的一次性链接，或只允许浏览器请求其链接的网站），MDM 会在此基础上继续一次，如果目标是另一个网站则不带您的 cookie。当网站的机器人检查（例如 Cloudflare）或其拒绝程序（FileHippo 的 <g1>412 Precondition Failed</g1>）拒绝 MDM 自己的连接时，MDM 会再次尝试以浏览器的方式连接（相同的握手、设置和请求头顺序），并仅使用您浏览器的 User-Agent 和该网站的 cookie，在此连接上进行下载；您的代理、网络适配器和速度限制照常适用。它无法解决挑战：如果网站仍要求回答挑战，它会再次拒绝，MDM 会提示<g2>此网站只允许浏览器通过</g2>；此时请 Alt+点击链接，将下载任务留给浏览器处理。

56f407c985b086ad.source: Adds a download, as the command line's <x1/> do (<x2/> is <x3/>); <x4/>. <x5/> (a key from the list's <x6/>) puts it in that category's folder instead of the one its type picks; <x7/> (a queue's name) is the queue it waits in with <x8/>. Also with the API off, like the command line.
56f407c985b086ad.text: 添加下载，如同命令行中的 <x1/>（<x2/> 是 <x3/>）；<x4/>。<x5/>（列表中的 <x6/> 键）将其放入该类别的文件夹，而不是其类型选择的文件夹；<x7/>（队列名称）是它与 <x8/> 一起等待的队列。在 API 关闭时也可用，如同命令行。

5704b78ea54419dd.source: Click <g1>Add URL</g1> and paste the gallery's address, for example <x2/>.
5704b78ea54419dd.text: 点击<g1>添加 URL</g1> 并粘贴图库地址，例如 <x2/>。

57271fd14fc7d6ce.source: The main window on Windows 11: the toolbar, the categories on the left and the download list on the right
57271fd14fc7d6ce.text: Windows 11 上的主窗口：工具栏、左侧的类别和右侧的下载列表

5730437f2b40d7c8.source: You can also <g1>open the form yourself</g1>; it asks for the same details.
5730437f2b40d7c8.text: 你也可以<g1>自行打开表单</g1>；它会要求相同的详细信息。

573a41047704eff4.source: On the web page, start the download again, or copy the new download link (right-click → <g1>Copy link</g1>). If the browser hands the new download to MDM, cancel it there: you only need the address.
573a41047704eff4.text: 在网页上，再次开始下载，或复制新的下载链接（右键点击 → <g1>复制链接</g1>）。如果浏览器将新下载交给 MDM，请在那里取消它：您只需要地址。

57669c2585ba41dc.source: <g1>Windows: Download File Info and the progress window open in front of the browser</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>): a download handed over by the browser could open its window behind the browser, and stay there. Windows lets a program in the background take the foreground only with the browser's say-so, which the user's next click or key ends, and a window refused it opens under the program in front. Every dialog and progress window of MDM that opens without the foreground now goes above the other programs' windows, without taking the keyboard from the one being typed in: a click on it does, as with Download complete.
57669c2585ba41dc.text: <g1>Windows：“下载文件信息”和进度窗口在浏览器前面打开</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）：浏览器移交的下载任务可能会在浏览器后面打开其窗口，并停留在那里。Windows 允许后台程序在浏览器同意的情况下才能切换到前台，这会在用户下次点击或按键时结束，并且被拒绝的窗口会在前面的程序下方打开。现在，MDM 中所有在没有前台的情况下打开的对话框和进度窗口都会显示在其他程序的窗口上方，而不会从正在输入的程序中抢夺键盘焦点：点击它会抢夺焦点，就像“下载完成”一样。

5771868f7e936b50.source: runs MDM with its list, categories, queues, Scheduler, speed limits and torrents, but no window. Its folders and port come from flags or the environment. It stops cleanly, saving its list, when the system stops it. It runs on any Linux machine with MDM installed, and on Windows and macOS the same way.
5771868f7e936b50.text: 运行 MDM 时，它会保留下载列表、分类、队列、计划程序、速度限制和种子功能，但不会显示窗口。其文件夹和端口由标志或环境变量决定。当系统停止它时，它会干净地停止并保存其列表。它可以在任何安装了 MDM 的 Linux 机器上运行，在 Windows 和 macOS 上也以同样的方式运行。

5772c548e0c2bc17.source: MDM saves how far each part has got as it goes. A download picks up where it stopped after you pause it, after the connection drops, or after Windows or MDM itself crashes. A connection that fails is retried on its own, and the table shows <g1>Retrying</g1> with the reason.
5772c548e0c2bc17.text: MDM 会在下载过程中保存每个部分的进度。在您暂停下载、连接中断或 Windows 或 MDM 本身崩溃后，下载会从中断处继续。失败的连接会自行重试，表格会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>及原因。

5788eb33d3ff84e8.source: When the connection drops, MDM retries on its own. In the progress window, the connection table shows <g1>Retrying</g1> and the reason. Usually the download goes on by itself once the connection is back.
5788eb33d3ff84e8.text: 当连接中断时，MDM 会自行重试。在进度窗口中，连接表会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>和原因。通常，一旦连接恢复，下载就会自行继续。

5792cd265ddea512.source: If Mister Download Manager closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a crash report window opens. It shows what happened, lets you read the whole report, and…

579fa88e074acc8d.source: The first time, the phone's browser warns about the certificate. That is expected: MDM made it on your computer, and no public authority knows it. <g1>Options → Remote</g1> shows its fingerprint to compare. Add the page to the phone's home screen to keep it one tap away.
579fa88e074acc8d.text: 首次使用时，手机浏览器会警告证书问题。这是预期的：MDM 在您的电脑上生成了它，并且没有公共机构知道它。<g1>选项 → 远程</g1>显示其指纹以供比较。将页面添加到手机主屏幕，以便一键访问。

57e8a79811198d54.source: <g1>The gallery-dl of your Linux distribution:</g1> the one your distribution ships works too, from 1.20 (Ubuntu 22.04) on. Found on its own, it gets only the options every one of those versions knows; chosen in <g2>Helpers...</g2>, the ones its version knows. One older than that (Debian 11's 1.17) is refused when you choose it, saying which version MDM needs; found on its own, its galleries fail, and <g3>Use MDM's own copy</g3> is the way out.
57e8a79811198d54.text: <g1>您的 Linux 发行版中的 gallery-dl：</g1> 您的发行版附带的版本也可以使用，从 1.20 (Ubuntu 22.04) 开始。如果自行找到，它只会获取这些版本都支持的选项；如果在<g2>帮助程序...</g2>中选择，则获取其版本支持的选项。如果版本过旧（Debian 11 的 1.17），当您选择它时会被拒绝，并提示 MDM 需要哪个版本；如果自行找到，其图库下载会失败，此时<g3>使用 MDM 自带的副本</g3>是解决方案。

57f7a41f3d7829f5.source: A video or a gallery takes a limit of its own the same way. For a torrent, the limit is that torrent's alone; the others keep theirs. A torrent can't be held under 16 KBytes/sec: a lower limit gives it 16.
57f7a41f3d7829f5.text: 视频或图片库同样有自己的限制。对于种子文件，限制仅适用于该种子文件；其他文件保持其各自的限制。种子文件的速度不能低于 16 千字节/秒：如果设置了更低的限制，它将自动调整为 16 千字节/秒。

5807d89f8c08086c.text: <g1>然后将存档移至回收站</g1>（默认关闭；在 macOS 和 Linux 上移至废纸篓）— 仅在成功提取后移动。这也是新建包的<g2>提取后删除存档</g2>选项的默认设置。

58aa346f63353299.source: MDM runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11, and on 64-bit Linux: see <g1>On Linux</g1>. Builds for macOS are new and still experimental: see <g2>On a Mac</g2>.

58c630fdea148533.source: <g1>Link grabber</g1> gathers many links at once, sorts them into packages, and lets you tick the ones to download. MDM can then extract the archives it downloaded (zip, 7z, rar and more), by itself or when you ask.
58c630fdea148533.text: <g1>链接抓取器</g1>可一次收集多个链接，将它们整理成分组，并让您勾选要下载的链接。MDM 随后可以自动提取下载的存档（zip、7z、rar 等），也可以等您选择后再提取。

58cb91129ec3a7fd.source: Free for everyone, forever. No sign-up, no ads, nothing bundled.
58cb91129ec3a7fd.text: 永久免费。无需注册，没有广告，也不捆绑其他软件。
