58ce836617870834.text: 添加带编号文件名的重复项

58d632aa7f93ec0d.source: <g1>MDM comes back as you left it</g1>: the window's place and size, the Categories pane, its open branches and the node shown.
58d632aa7f93ec0d.text: <g1>MDM 会恢复到上次关闭时的状态</g1>：包括窗口的位置和大小、“类别”窗格、展开的分支以及当前显示的节点。

59130ab4ecc47c65.source: <g1>Hide to the notification area</g1> (a short dash with an arrow down to the corner; on Windows in the title bar, left of Minimize) puts the window in the notification area; <g2>Downloads in progress</g2> in the tray icon's menu brings it back. See <g3>The tray icon</g3>.
59130ab4ecc47c65.text: <g1>隐藏到通知区域</g1>（在 Windows 标题栏中，最小化按钮左侧，一个带向下箭头的短横线图标）会将窗口最小化到通知区域；通过托盘图标菜单中的<g2>正在进行的下载</g2>可将其恢复。请参阅<g3>托盘图标</g3>。

591498dd46bd5859.source: <g1>A copy from elsewhere?</g1> Remove it and add the extension as MDM's <g2>Add Mister Download Manager to your browser</g2> window shows (see <g3>Browser integration</g3>).
591498dd46bd5859.text: <g1>副本来自其他地方？</g1>删除该副本，然后按照 MDM 的<g2>将 Mister Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口中的说明添加扩展程序（请参阅<g3>浏览器集成</g3>）。

5922c26d865c882f.source: The wake follows the schedule: change the start time or the days, untick the option or delete the queue, and the wake moves or goes away. MDM sets it again each time it starts. Nothing stays behind in the system when MDM quits or is uninstalled.
5922c26d865c882f.text: 唤醒功能遵循计划：更改开始时间或日期，取消勾选选项或删除队列，唤醒功能会随之移动或消失。MDM 每次启动时都会重新设置。MDM 退出或卸载后，系统中不会留下任何东西。

592ec35cbf46dec2.source: <g1>Link grabber, and archives extracted when they are downloaded</g1> (<g2>#37</g2>). The window that took the browser's "Download all links", Tasks → Import and dropped lists grew into Link grabber (also Tasks → Link grabber..., where pasted links go). Links come in packages: a split archive's volumes together, the other links of a page together, the rest in "Various files". Each link is looked up for its name, size and whether the server has it (Offline links come unticked), and each package has its folder, an archive password, "Extract when done" and "Delete archives after extracting". <g3>Start</g3> or <g4>Add to queue</g4> (IDM's import, unchanged: an <x5/> file still brings each download's referrer and cookies). MDM extracts ZIP (AES and Deflate64 too), TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.XZ, GZ and XZ itself; 7z and RAR need 7-Zip (split <x6/> and <x7/> too), and a window says so when it isn't installed. It extracts when a package says so, for any download with <g8>Options → Archives → Extract archives when their download completes</g8> (off by default), or with right-click → <g9>Extract</g9>. A split archive is extracted once its last volume is in. Extracted files are marked as downloaded from the internet, as the archive is; names that would leave the folder, links, and archives that would fill the disk are refused; an existing file is never overwritten. The archive goes to the Recycle Bin (the Trash) only when you ask. Options has a new <g10>Archives</g10> page.
592ec35cbf46dec2.text: <g1>链接抓取器，以及下载后提取的存档</g1>（<g2>#37</g2>）。接收浏览器“下载所有链接”、任务 → 导入和拖放列表的窗口已发展为链接抓取器（也可通过任务 → 链接抓取器…，粘贴的链接会进入此处）。链接以包的形式出现：拆分的存档卷在一起，页面上的其他链接在一起，其余的在“各种文件”中。每个链接都会查找其名称、大小以及服务器是否拥有它（离线链接未勾选），每个包都有其文件夹、存档密码、“完成后提取”和“提取后删除存档”。<g3>开始</g3>或<g4>添加到队列</g4>（IDM 的导入，未更改：<x5/> 文件仍然会带来每个下载的引用者和 cookie）。MDM 自己提取 ZIP（也包括 AES 和 Deflate64）、TAR、TAR.GZ、TAR.XZ、GZ 和 XZ；7z 和 RAR 需要 7-Zip（也包括拆分的 <x6/> 和 <x7/>），如果未安装，会弹出一个窗口说明。当包说明时，它会提取，对于任何下载，如果<g8>选项 → 压缩包 → 下载完成后提取存档</g8>（默认关闭）或右键点击 → <g9>提取</g9>。拆分的存档会在其最后一个卷进入后提取。提取的文件被标记为从互联网下载，就像存档一样；会离开文件夹的名称、链接以及会填满磁盘的存档会被拒绝；现有文件绝不会被覆盖。存档只有在您要求时才会进入回收站（垃圾箱）。选项中新增了<g10>压缩包</g10>页面。

592f898c79b39c3a.source: A download falls into a category by its file type: <g1>General</g1>, <g2>Compressed</g2>, <g3>Documents</g3>, <g4>Music</g4>, <g5>Programs</g5> or <g6>Video</g6>, and torrents into <g7>Torrents</g7>. Each category has its own folder inside your Downloads folder, so a ZIP file lands in <x8/> and a film in <x9/> without you choosing.
592f898c79b39c3a.text: 下载文件会根据其文件类型归入相应类别：<g1>常规</g1>、<g2>压缩文件</g2>、<g3>文档</g3>、<g4>音乐</g4>、<g5>程序</g5> 或 <g6>视频</g6>，种子文件则归入<g7>种子</g7>。每个类别在您的“下载”文件夹中都有自己的子文件夹，因此 ZIP 文件会自动存入<x8/>，电影文件会自动存入<x9/>，无需您手动选择。

5934223575270924.text: 在<g1>下载文件信息</g1>中：<g2>开始下载</g2>

5936f5324103bf1c.text: 大小以字节为单位（<x1/> 表示未知），速度以字节每秒为单位。失败会打印 <x2/> 并以代码 1 退出。例如：

59920ff7101c276f.source: Fix the translation in the row's third column and delete its <x1/> line.
59920ff7101c276f.text: 修正该行第 3 列的翻译，并删除该行的<x1/>行。

59bedd7437781de2.source: Point at the video in your browser and click the <g1>Download video</g1> button that appears over it, or paste the page's address into <g2>Tasks → Download video from a page</g2>. MDM lists every quality the site offers, with sizes; pick one and it downloads like any file. It uses yt-dlp, which supports thousands of sites. Download only videos you have the right to. See <g3>Download a video from a page</g3>.
59bedd7437781de2.text: 将鼠标指向浏览器中的视频，然后点击视频上方出现的<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮，或者将页面地址粘贴到<g2>任务 → 从页面下载视频</g2>。MDM 会列出网站提供的所有画质及对应大小；选择所需画质，即可像下载普通文件一样下载。MDM 使用 yt-dlp，支持数千个网站。仅下载您有权下载的视频。请参阅<g3>从页面下载视频</g3>。

59d5983b5e65fbf4.source: reads who opened pull requests and issues, and who commented, from GitHub's public API (the maintainer, Claude and bots left out) for every place that thanks them: the website's home page, <x1/> and each release on the News page (<x2/>, on every build), each release's notes (<x3/>, the people active since the release before) and the README (<x4/> at each release's preparation: its round photos are committed in <x5/>, since GitHub can't round a picture in a README).
59d5983b5e65fbf4.text: 从 GitHub 的公共 API 读取谁发起了拉取请求和问题，以及谁发表了评论（维护者、Claude 和机器人除外），用于感谢他们的所有地方：网站主页、<x1/> 和新闻页面上的每个版本（<x2/>，在每个构建中），每个版本的发布说明（<x3/>，自上一个版本以来活跃的人员）以及 README（<x4/> 在每个版本准备时：其圆形照片提交在 <x5/> 中，因为 GitHub 无法在 README 中将图片设为圆形）。

5a4b18e23bcce78d.source: <g1>When an address stops working</g1>: a video's addresses are signed and expire after a few hours (YouTube's after six). MDM asks yt-dlp for a fresh one for the same quality and carries on from where it stopped.
5a4b18e23bcce78d.text: <g1>当地址失效时</g1>：视频地址经过签名，并在几小时后过期（YouTube 的地址在六小时后过期）。MDM 会向 yt-dlp 请求相同质量的新地址，并从停止的地方继续。

5a55baadee6565e2.source: <g1>Drag and drop on the main window</g1>: drop a link to add it, several links or a list (.txt, .ef2) to choose them in Import, a .torrent file to add it.
5a55baadee6565e2.text: <g1>支持在主窗口中拖放</g1>：拖放链接即可添加；拖放多个链接或列表文件（.txt、.ef2）可在“导入”中选择；拖放 .torrent 文件即可添加。

5a7146ca6411e2e2.source: Right-click a category → Properties: its name, file types and folder.
5a7146ca6411e2e2.text: 右键点击类别 → 属性：查看类别名称、文件类型和文件夹。

5a8f5b9cbaf78453.source: Passwords (Sites Logins, the proxy's, debrid accounts) stay in <x1/> too, instead of in Windows Credential Manager. They are sealed for your Windows account: on another computer, or another account, type them again (and sign in to a debrid account again).
5a8f5b9cbaf78453.text: 密码（站点登录、代理、网盘账户）也保存在<x1/>中，而不是 Windows 凭据管理器中。它们已为您的 Windows 账户加密：在另一台电脑或另一个账户上，请重新输入（并重新登录网盘账户）。

5ab4860fe21cf34f.source: <g1></g1>Up to 32, or 128 if you allow it; re-split as they go
5ab4860fe21cf34f.text: <g1></g1>最多 32 个；如果允许，最多可达 128 个；下载过程中会重新分配

5ab4c6539d7626fb.source: A caption button at rest, where the style shows one (a tint over the bar; transparent: none)
5ab4c6539d7626fb.text: 静止时的标题按钮，样式显示时（标题栏上的着色；透明：无）

5ac4058ece1d82f9.source: Under 10 MB of memory in the notification area on Windows, from about 50 MB.
5ac4058ece1d82f9.text: 在 Windows 上，通知区域的内存占用从约 50 MB 降至 10 MB 以下。

5adb99b470c63eee.source: A magnet link shows as <g1>Magnet link</g1> and isn't looked up: once you click <g2>Start</g2> or <g3>Add to queue</g3>, MDM finds the torrent's files and adds it with all of them, in the package's folder (or the <g4>Torrents</g4> folder when the package has none).
5adb99b470c63eee.text: 磁力链接显示为<g1>磁力链接</g1>，不会被查找：一旦您点击<g2>开始</g2>或<g3>添加到队列</g3>，MDM 会找到种子的文件并将其全部添加，保存在包的文件夹中（如果包没有文件夹，则保存在<g4>种子</g4>文件夹中）。

5add75b015a05297.source: Before continuing, MDM checks that the file on the server is still the same. If it changed, the download stops with <g1>the file changed on the server</g1>. Use <g2>Redownload</g2> to start again from the beginning.
5add75b015a05297.text: 继续下载前，MDM 会检查服务器上的文件是否仍然相同。如果文件已更改，下载会停止，并显示<g1>服务器上的文件已更改</g1>。使用<g2>重新下载</g2>即可从头开始下载。

5b0d0ca5b308331e.source: Tick <g1>Only while I'm using the computer</g1> to apply it only while you use the mouse or keyboard. After a minute without input, MDM goes back to full speed.
5b0d0ca5b308331e.text: 勾选<g1>仅在我使用计算机时</g1>，使其仅在您使用鼠标或键盘时生效。在一分钟没有输入后，MDM 会恢复全速。

5b0fe00dada2cdda.source: Files from torrents are marked as downloaded from the internet, so SmartScreen and Gatekeeper check programs before they first run.
5b0fe00dada2cdda.text: 来自 torrent 的文件被标记为从互联网下载，以便 SmartScreen 和 Gatekeeper 在程序首次运行前进行检查。

5b15875b4623f610.source: Each package is a row you can open and close (click its arrow, double-click it, or press <g1>Right</g1> and <g2>Left</g2>). Ticking a package ticks all its links; its box is half-filled when only some are ticked.
5b15875b4623f610.text: 每个分组占一行，可展开或收起（单击箭头、双击，或按<g1>Right</g1>和<g2>Left</g2>）。勾选分组会勾选其中的所有链接；只勾选部分链接时，分组复选框会显示为半选状态。

5b17add1c6bcc243.source: With <x1/> (before or after the command), every command prints JSON instead of text, one object per line, for scripts and AI agents to read:
5b17add1c6bcc243.text: 使用 <x1/>（在命令之前或之后），每个命令都会打印 JSON 而不是文本，每行一个对象，供脚本和 AI 代理读取：

5b2f50b75525fecb.text: Mister Download Manager 是一款通用工具。本页面简要说明了它的用途。

5b3dd3a6597bd4e1.text: 大多数翻译由机器完成，正等待母语使用者校对。<g1>帮助我们完善您的语言</g1>。

5d52bf2d7d02a534.source: <g1>Freeze reports say what kind of freeze it was</g1> (<g2>#57</g2>): MDM measures how much processor time the window got while it didn't answer. The report then says whether it ran all along (a loop), waited (a deadlock, or the disk or the network), or hardly ran at all, which means a computer too busy to run MDM or slow to load it from disk, most likely not a bug in MDM. Those last ones share one signature, so they find one issue instead of many.
5d52bf2d7d02a534.text: <g1>冻结报告说明了冻结的类型</g1>（<g2>#57</g2>）：MDM 会测量窗口在无响应时获得了多少处理器时间。报告会说明它是始终运行（循环）、等待（死锁，或磁盘或网络），还是几乎没有运行，这意味着电脑太忙无法运行 MDM 或从磁盘加载速度慢，很可能不是 MDM 的错误。最后一种情况共享一个签名，因此它们会找到一个问题而不是多个问题。

6099cbdd95729fa1.text: 在 MDM 中，选择<g1>任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 导出文件</g1>并选择文件。您的下载任务将随其地址、引用页和 Cookie 一并导入。

609ec75faaea91d6.source: Seven download scenarios against a local fault-injecting test server, each run at least seven times per app in alternating order; end-to-end and server-side transfer times, connections, requests, CPU and memory.
609ec75faaea91d6.text: 七种下载场景，针对本地故障注入测试服务器，每个应用交替运行至少七次；端到端和服务器端传输时间、连接、请求、CPU 和内存。

60b2c5b6854643d6.source: Very likely: MDM speaks 86 languages, every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen on the first start or any time in <g1>View → Language</g1>. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur are laid out right to left. See <g2>all the languages</g2> and how to help improve yours.
60b2c5b6854643d6.text: 很有可能：MDM 支持 86 种语言，涵盖 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，可在首次启动时或随时在<g1>视图 → 语言</g1>中选择。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语采用从右到左的布局。请参阅<g2>所有语言</g2>以及如何帮助改进您的语言。

60b93e8420c52c24.source: After a crash or a restart

60bfea57686a0f37.source: <g1>Video and sound files</g1> the page played (MP4, WebM, MP3 and the like), with their size and, for a video, its picture size.
60bfea57686a0f37.text: <g1>页面播放的视频和音频文件</g1>（MP4、WebM、MP3 等），显示文件大小；如果是视频，还会显示画面尺寸。

60db104b0c4ca856.source: MDM asks each service well under its request limit: Real-Debrid at most 120 times a minute (it allows 250), AllDebrid 300 (it allows 600), Premiumize 60 (it publishes no limit), TorBox 120 (it allows 300 a minute, and 60 new web downloads an hour). When a service says it's asked too often, MDM waits.
60db104b0c4ca856.text: MDM 对每个服务的请求次数远低于其限制：Real-Debrid 每分钟最多 120 次 (它允许 250 次)，AllDebrid 300 次 (它允许 600 次)，Premiumize 60 次 (它未公布限制)，TorBox 120 次 (它允许每分钟 300 次，每小时 60 次新网页下载)。当服务提示请求过于频繁时，MDM 会等待。

60e4ea08eb29abeb.source: <g1>Stop</g1> on a download in a running queue stays stopped, instead of the queue starting it again a moment later; <g2>Stop All</g2> too (<g3>#341</g3>).
60e4ea08eb29abeb.text: 队列中正在运行的下载任务，点击<g1>停止</g1>后会保持停止状态，而不是稍后又被队列重新启动；<g2>停止所有</g2>也一样（<g3>#341</g3>）。

60f3c58ee8c2af81.source: <g1>Options where you expect them</g1> Every setting where an IDM user looks first: connections, proxies, folders, sounds.
60f3c58ee8c2af81.text: <g1>选项都在熟悉的位置</g1> 各项设置都在 IDM 用户首先会查找的位置：连接、代理、文件夹和声音。

6111bd2651de0090.source: <g1>The download engine</g1>: up to 32 connections per file, re-splitting the slowest part until the last byte, and crash-safe resume after a restart or a dropped connection. HTTP, HTTPS, <g2>FTP and FTPS</g2> (<x3/>, <x4/> explicit TLS, <x5/> implicit TLS), proxies, SOCKS and <g6>proxy auto-config (PAC)</g6> scripts.
6111bd2651de0090.text: <g1>下载引擎</g1>：每个文件最多 32 个连接，重新分割最慢的部分直到最后一个字节，并在重启或连接中断后安全恢复。支持 HTTP、HTTPS、<g2>FTP 和 FTPS</g2>（<x3/>、<x4/> 显式 TLS、<x5/> 隐式 TLS）、代理、SOCKS 和<g6>代理自动配置 (PAC)</g6> 脚本。

6123bcde0dc986bd.source: Install MDM with the setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> ticked. This registers the helper. (The portable copy can't do this; see <g2>Portable mode</g2>.) On Linux and macOS MDM registers it itself, each time it starts, for the browsers installed then.
6123bcde0dc986bd.text: 使用安装程序安装 MDM，并勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Firefox）</g1>。这会注册辅助程序。（便携版无法执行此操作；请参阅<g2>便携模式</g2>。）在 Linux 和 macOS 上，MDM 每次启动时都会为当时安装的浏览器自行注册。

6126a3542358d39b.source: Tick <g1>Don't show this dialog again</g1> to stop seeing it. It can be turned back on in <g2>Options → Downloads → Show download complete dialog</g2>.
6126a3542358d39b.text: 勾选<g1>不再显示此对话框</g1>以停止显示它。可以在<g2>选项 → 下载 → 显示下载完成对话框</g2>中重新开启。

61298c24065d8bad.source: A filtered column's funnel turns blue. Right-click a column title and choose <g1>Clear all filters</g1> to see everything again.
61298c24065d8bad.text: 已筛选列的漏斗图标会变为蓝色。右键点击列标题，然后选择<g1>清除所有筛选器</g1>，即可再次查看所有内容。

612c083423df5e68.source: Hover over the download's <g1>Status</g1> in the list to see them.
612c083423df5e68.text: 将鼠标悬停在列表中的下载<g1>状态</g1>上即可查看这些信息。

615e187e2caacd27.source: <g1>Otherwise:</g1> MDM shows the list of languages, each with its flag and its own name. Pick yours.
615e187e2caacd27.text: <g1>其他情况：</g1>MDM 会显示语言列表，每种语言都标有国旗和该语言的名称。选择您的语言。

617b3af69a12514a.source: works the same way, and follows <x1/> too.

6188db7e3b890126.source: The automation API is off by default. When you turn it on, it listens only on <x1/> (your own computer) and answers only programs that present the secret token from MDM's data folder.
6188db7e3b890126.text: 自动化 API 默认关闭。当您打开它时，它只监听<x1/>（您自己的电脑），并且只响应呈现 MDM 数据文件夹中秘密令牌的程序。

61b5ac8cec973d16.source: Found a bug? Help → Report a problem in the app opens an issue with your version, system and language filled in. Read it, then post it.
61b5ac8cec973d16.text: 发现 Bug？在应用中选择“帮助”→“报告问题”，即可创建一个已填写版本、系统和语言的问题。阅读后即可发布。

61d179601f69a50c.source: No more black band across menus and windows on Windows 11 Insider builds.
61d179601f69a50c.text: Windows 11 Insider 版本中，菜单和窗口不再出现黑色条带。

61d6c2c5f915ca8e.source: <g1>Added to MDM</g1> (green), with the quality: <g2>Show</g2> brings MDM's window up with that download selected.
61d6c2c5f915ca8e.text: <g1>已添加到 MDM</g1>（绿色），并显示画质：<g2>显示</g2>会弹出 MDM 窗口并选中该下载任务。

61dfb9258d4ae7c3.source: The first time, Windows may ask whether to let MDM communicate on networks: allow it on private networks, or the phone can't reach MDM.
61dfb9258d4ae7c3.text: 首次使用时，Windows 可能会询问是否允许 MDM 在网络上通信：请允许其在专用网络上通信，否则手机无法连接 MDM。

61e77c7c55f48e1e.source: 4. Decide what happens at the end (optional)
61e77c7c55f48e1e.text: 4. 决定结束时发生什么（可选）

6216638d7aa4db3f.source: Check <g1>Save to</g1> (the General category's folder by default). The pictures go into a folder of their own there, named after the gallery.
6216638d7aa4db3f.text: 确认<g1>保存到</g1>（默认为“常规”类别的文件夹）。图片会保存到该文件夹下一个以图库命名的独立文件夹中。

621c5a4f8acb706b.source: In dialogs, <g1>Tab</g1> moves between controls, the arrows go through radio groups and tab strips, <g2>Ctrl+Tab</g2> changes tabs, and typing a name jumps to it in any list or drop-down. <g3>Add URL</g3>'s address and <g4>Save As</g4> keep a history you can walk with <g5>Up</g5> and <g6>Down</g6>, and the Scheduler's calendar works from the keyboard. On a Mac, <g7>⌘</g7> takes the place of <g8>Ctrl</g8>.
621c5a4f8acb706b.text: 在对话框中，<g1>Tab</g1> 在控件之间移动，方向键遍历单选组和选项卡条，<g2>Ctrl+Tab</g2> 切换选项卡，输入名称可在任何列表或下拉菜单中跳转到该项。<g3>添加 URL</g3> 的地址和<g4>另存为</g4>保留了历史记录，您可以使用<g5>向上</g5>和<g6>向下</g6>键浏览，计划程序的日历也可以通过键盘操作。在 Mac 上，<g7>⌘</g7> 键代替 <g8>Ctrl</g8> 键。

62296921bc8016ff.source: <g1>Always turn on Speed Limiter on Mister Download Manager startup</g1> turns it on each time MDM starts.
62296921bc8016ff.text: <g1>每次 Mister Download Manager 启动时都开启速度限制器</g1>可在每次 MDM 启动时开启速度限制器。

623892e6f268d7fd.source: Add the MDM extension to your browser (<g1>how</g1>) and turn IDM's off, so only one of them takes your downloads.
623892e6f268d7fd.text: 将 MDM 扩展程序添加到您的浏览器（<g1>如何操作</g1>），并关闭 IDM 的扩展程序，这样只有一个程序会接管您的下载。

624b98af1c3e9963.source: The first / last item of an open menu
624b98af1c3e9963.text: 转到已打开菜单中的第一个/最后一个项目

6252af3e97f3ba17.source: A category's properties: its name, file types and folder
6252af3e97f3ba17.text: 类别属性：其名称、文件类型和文件夹

626026d1984c82a1.source: The layout is familiar on purpose: the toolbar, the categories, the download list, the progress window with every connection, queues and the scheduler. The differences: MDM is free and open source, downloads BitTorrent and magnet links in the same list, finished faster in <g1>our benchmark</g1>, speaks 86 languages and has builds for Linux and macOS. IDM is the more mature product, refined over many years. See the full <g2>comparison</g2>.
626026d1984c82a1.text: 界面布局刻意保持熟悉：工具栏、分类、下载列表、显示每个连接的进度窗口、队列和调度程序。不同之处在于：MDM 是免费开源的，可在同一列表中下载 BitTorrent 和磁力链接，在<g1>我们的基准测试</g1>中完成速度更快，支持 86 种语言，并提供 Linux 和 macOS 版本。IDM 是更成熟的产品，经过多年完善。查看完整的<g2>比较</g2>。

62e049f954021405.source: Control it from your phone or your browser
62e049f954021405.text: 通过手机或浏览器控制它

62e5693f6f57e039.source: Add the duplicate and overwrite the existing file
62e5693f6f57e039.text: 添加重复项并覆盖现有文件

62ebed48ebb1093d.source: Is <g1>Options → General → Use advanced browser integration</g1> on, and your browser ticked under <g2>Capture downloads from the following browsers</g2>?
62ebed48ebb1093d.text: 是否已启用<g1>选项 → 常规 → 使用高级浏览器集成</g1>，并在<g2>从以下浏览器捕获下载</g2>下勾选了您的浏览器？

634ba66c06a04968.source: Your download list, settings, logins you save in <g1>Sites Logins</g1>, the history of each download and the files you download are stored only on your computer: in <x2/> on Windows (or the <x3/> folder of the portable copy), and in the usual application-data folder on macOS and Linux. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Uninstalling offers to delete them. From version 0.5.0, the passwords of Sites Logins, the proxy and debrid accounts go into the system's keychain instead (Windows Credential Manager, the keyring on Linux, the macOS keychain), still on your computer, when one is there and unlocked.
634ba66c06a04968.text: 您的下载列表、设置、您在<g1>站点登录</g1>中保存的登录信息、每个下载的历史记录以及您下载的文件仅存储在您的计算机上：Windows 上的 <x2/>（或便携版中的 <x3/> 文件夹），以及 macOS 和 Linux 上常用的应用程序数据文件夹中。没有任何内容会被上传到任何地方。卸载时会提示删除这些内容。从 0.5.0 版本开始，如果系统存在并已解锁，站点登录、代理和网盘账户的密码将存储在系统密钥链中（Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环、macOS 密钥链），仍然在您的计算机上。

635f40f1db7e086a.source: Pause running downloads, or start (resume) stopped, queued or failed ones, in the running app.
635f40f1db7e086a.text: 暂停正在运行的下载，或在运行中的应用里开始（恢复）已停止、已排队或失败的下载。

63864f0ddcaa9a14.source: to download only files you have the right to download, and to respect copyright and the terms of the sites you download from;
63864f0ddcaa9a14.text: 仅下载您有权下载的文件，并尊重版权和您下载网站的条款；

639b04fd92deea56.source: <g1>Cancel</g1> closes the window and adds nothing.
639b04fd92deea56.text: <g1>取消</g1>关闭窗口，不添加任何内容。

639e97e78af63aae.source: <g1>Google Docs, Sheets and Slides</g1> come as Word (<x2/>), Excel (<x3/>) and PowerPoint (<x4/>) files, and Drawings as <x5/>. These files are made when they are asked for, so their size is unknown until they arrive and they can't be resumed: a cut-off download starts again.
639e97e78af63aae.text: <g1>Google Docs、Sheets 和 Slides</g1>会以 Word（<x2/>）、Excel（<x3/>）和 PowerPoint（<x4/>）文件的形式下载，Drawings 则会以 <x5/> 格式下载。这些文件会在请求时生成，因此下载完成前无法知道文件大小，也无法恢复下载：下载中断后会从头开始。

63a9ff90215698fd.source: MDM's torrents don't use <g1>encryption</g1> (sometimes called "protocol encryption"). That kind of encryption only hides the traffic from simple filters. It never hides who you are, so MDM doesn't claim to offer it. Some peers that require it won't connect.
63a9ff90215698fd.text: MDM 的种子不使用<g1>加密</g1>（有时称为“协议加密”）。这种加密只能让简单的过滤器无法识别流量，但不会隐藏您的身份，因此 MDM 不会声称提供这种加密。部分要求使用这种加密的对等方将无法连接。

63b82090a9141698.source: A queue is a list of downloads that run in order, a few at a time. Click <g1>Download Later</g1> in <g2>Download File Info</g2>, or right-click downloads in the list and choose <g3>Add to queue</g3>. The <g4>Q</g4> column marks them, and <g5>Queues</g5> in the categories pane shows each queue on its own.
63b82090a9141698.text: 队列是按顺序运行的下载列表，每次运行少量任务。在<g2>下载文件信息</g2>中点击<g1>稍后下载</g1>，或右键点击列表中的下载任务并选择<g3>添加到队列</g3>。<g4>Q</g4>列会标记它们，类别窗格中的<g5>队列</g5>会单独显示每个队列。

63cf6dd5807201af.source: <g1>Any (the system chooses)</g1> is the default. Choose an adapter instead, and MDM sends its connections through that one only. When it disconnects, or the VPN is switched off, nothing goes out another way. Running downloads stop with "… is not connected" and start again by themselves when the adapter is back. The line under the list shows the adapter's address, or that it isn't connected.
63cf6dd5807201af.text: <g1>任何（系统选择）</g1>是默认设置。选择一个网卡后，MDM 只会通过该网卡发送连接。当网卡断开连接或 VPN 关闭时，不会有任何数据通过其他方式传输。正在进行的下载会显示“……未连接”并停止，当网卡恢复后会自动重新开始。列表下方的行显示网卡的地址，或显示其未连接。

63d0ba3e76606052.source: No. MDM is an independent program written from scratch in Rust, with no connection to Tonec Inc., the makers of Internet Download Manager (IDM). It contains none of IDM's code or artwork. Its windows are laid out the way IDM users expect, so you can switch without learning anything new — and because MDM is free, there is nothing to crack. Please don't download "cracked" download managers: they are a common way to spread malware.
63d0ba3e76606052.text: 不是。MDM 是一个完全独立的程序，使用 Rust 从头编写，与 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 的开发商 Tonec Inc. 没有任何关系。它不包含 IDM 的任何代码或美术作品。它的窗口布局符合 IDM 用户的习惯，因此您可以无需学习新知识即可切换使用——而且由于 MDM 是免费的，所以无需破解。请不要下载“破解版”下载管理器：它们是传播恶意软件的常见方式。

63dc8a0242c6302b.source: <g1>New queue</g1> asks for a name and adds a queue. <g2>Delete</g2> removes one of your own queues; the two built-in queues can't be deleted. A deleted queue's downloads stay in the list.
63dc8a0242c6302b.text: <g1>新建队列</g1>会提示您输入名称，然后添加队列。<g2>删除</g2>会移除您创建的队列；两个内置队列无法删除。删除队列后，其中的下载任务仍会保留在列表中。

63e081b54c563868.text: <g1>状态</g1> — <g2>正在连接...</g2>、<g3>正在接收数据...</g3>、<g4>已暂停</g4>、<g5>完成</g5>或错误信息。

63f14dc462397998.source: Get MDM <g1>only from this site or the project's GitHub releases</g1>. Copies elsewhere may be altered.
63f14dc462397998.text: 请<g1>仅从本网站或项目的 GitHub 发布页面</g1>获取 MDM。其他地方的副本可能已被篡改。

640ceca3e229adc2.source: Make every window larger, up to 200 %: <g1>View → Interface size</g1>, or Ctrl + and Ctrl −.
640ceca3e229adc2.text: 将所有窗口放大至 200%：<g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>，或按 Ctrl + 和 Ctrl −。

64127a76a775643b.source: <g1>Options on completion</g1> — shows where the file will be saved. Untick <g2>Show download complete dialog</g2> to skip the <g3>Download complete</g3> box for this file only.
64127a76a775643b.text: <g1>完成时选项</g1> — 显示文件将保存的位置。取消勾选<g2>显示下载完成对话框</g2>可跳过此文件的<g3>下载完成</g3>框。

64135e3cb31c778b.source: <g1>Faster where it counts.</g1> In our benchmark against IDM 6.42 on the same computer and server, MDM downloaded 1 GiB in 1.0 s against 5.5 s, and a small file in 0.03 s against 3.1 s. <g2>See every run.</g2>
64135e3cb31c778b.text: <g1>在关键之处更快。</g1> 在我们对 IDM 6.42 进行的基准测试中，在同一台计算机和服务器上，MDM 下载 1 GiB 用时 1.0 秒，而 IDM 用时 5.5 秒；下载一个小文件 MDM 用时 0.03 秒，而 IDM 用时 3.1 秒。<g2>查看每次运行。</g2>

6418ff5742ef4770.source: The free download managers people reach for instead of IDM, checked on their own websites and code in November 2026. Each is good at something. We make the first one, so judge the rest by their own links.
6418ff5742ef4770.text: 人们用来替代 IDM 的免费下载管理器，于 2026 年 11 月在其各自官网和代码库上进行核查。每款都有其优点。我们开发了第一款，因此请通过它们自己的链接来判断其余的。

64254df81bae2d98.text: <g1>安装帮助</g1><g2>从 IDM 导入</g2><g3>基准测试</g3>

64266fd2f0a2ef69.source: MDM files each download by its type, music with music and programs with programs, each category with a folder of its own. The pane on the left shows them all, finished or not.
64266fd2f0a2ef69.text: MDM 会根据文件类型自动归类下载，音乐文件归入音乐类别，程序文件归入程序类别，每个类别都有自己的文件夹。左侧窗格会显示所有下载，无论是否完成。

6430a2d06dcbebf0.source: <g1>The stack:</g1> the place in MDM's code where it crashed or froze, and what every other part of it was doing.
6430a2d06dcbebf0.text: <g1>调用堆栈：</g1>MDM 代码中发生崩溃或冻结的位置，以及其他各部分当时正在执行的操作。

64411e8900502fb0.source: Windows 8's flat look: square corners, flat buttons and one-colour icons.
64411e8900502fb0.text: Windows 8 的扁平外观：方形边角、扁平按钮和单色图标。

64537e877bb3abb4.source: A selection's fill: rows, a chosen day, selected text
64537e877bb3abb4.text: 选区填充：行、选定日期、选定文本

6455ea30143a8721.source: Right-click a page in the browser for <g1>Download all links with Mister Download Manager</g1>, or select part of it for <g2>Download selected links with Mister Download Manager</g2>. The page's referrer and cookies go with each link. You can also import a text file or an <x3/> export with <g4>Tasks → Import</g4>, drop a list on the download list, or open <g5>Tasks → Link grabber...</g5> and paste any text with <g6>Ctrl+V</g6>: every web address in it is added. Copied a list of links, or a forum post with links in it? <g7>Tasks → Add batch download from clipboard</g7> (Ctrl+B) opens Link grabber with every http, ftp and magnet link in the text, each once, ticked.
6455ea30143a8721.text: 在浏览器中右键点击页面，选择<g1>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载所有链接</g1>；或者选择页面的一部分，选择<g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载选定链接</g2>。页面的引用页和 Cookie 会随每个链接一起发送。您也可以通过<g4>任务 → 导入</g4>导入文本文件或 <x3/> 导出文件，将列表拖放到下载列表中，或者打开<g5>任务 → 链接抓取器...</g5>并按<g6>Ctrl+V</g6>粘贴任何文本：其中包含的每个网址都会被添加。复制了链接列表或包含链接的论坛帖子？<g7>任务 → 从剪贴板批量添加下载</g7> (Ctrl+B) 会打开链接抓取器，其中包含文本中每个 HTTP、FTP 和磁力链接，每个链接只出现一次，并已勾选。

64654f809c621efe.source: <g1>Download limits</g1> — download no more than a set amount every few hours. The same setting is in the Scheduler; see <g2>Queues and the Scheduler</g2>.
64654f809c621efe.text: <g1>下载限制</g1> — 每隔几小时，限制下载量不超过设定值。计划程序中也有相同设置；请参阅<g2>队列和计划程序</g2>。

647a6ba9cf8c0dae.source: the <x1/> file, and its folder of icons if it has one;
647a6ba9cf8c0dae.text: 该 <x1/> 文件，以及其图标文件夹（如果有）；

648b3c118f4bb30b.source: <g1>The project on GitHub</g1><g2>Code, issues and every release</g2>
648b3c118f4bb30b.text: <g1>GitHub 上的项目</g1><g2>代码、问题和所有发布版本</g2>

64e9d0f93e60556f.source: The browser and MDM aren't connected
64e9d0f93e60556f.text: 浏览器和 MDM 未连接

64f61d6ae94023a6.source: Menus and the main window's text (Segoe UI)
64f61d6ae94023a6.text: 菜单和主窗口文本 (Segoe UI)

6501a7e45e25931c.source: <g1>Torrents</g1> go through it on Windows too (<g2>#143</g2>): every torrent connection goes out from the adapter's address, with the same kill switch as downloads: peers, trackers, the DHT and the listening port. When the adapter disconnects, torrents stop, nothing goes out another way, and they start again when it is back.
6501a7e45e25931c.text: <g1>种子</g1>在 Windows 上也通过它进行（<g2>#143</g2>）：每个种子连接都从适配器的地址发出，与下载具有相同的断网开关：对等点、跟踪器、DHT 和监听端口。当适配器断开连接时，种子停止，不会有其他方式发出，并在适配器恢复时重新开始。

650f31994e698c98.source: Free for Windows, with macOS and Linux to try. Installer, portable zip and the browser extension.
650f31994e698c98.text: Windows 版免费，macOS 和 Linux 版可试用。包含安装程序、便携式压缩包和浏览器扩展。

651cf6fa2ef369ab.source: Many sites publish a checksum next to a download. Paste it into MDM and it tells you in plain words whether the file you got is the one they meant.
651cf6fa2ef369ab.text: 许多网站会在下载链接旁发布校验和。将其粘贴到 MDM 中，MDM 会用简洁的语言告诉您下载的文件是否与发布者提供的文件一致。

6521afeb5532ac33.source: <g1>A freeze while MDM handles a command is reported again</g1> (<g2>#202</g2>): since the clock and what comes in from outside (a second launch, the browser, the automation API) run in every window state, a freeze there opened no crash report window and wrote no freeze report, minimized or not. The watchdog now times that part of each frame too.
6521afeb5532ac33.text: <g1>MDM 处理命令时冻结的问题再次报告</g1>（<g2>#202</g2>）：由于时钟和外部输入（第二次启动、浏览器、自动化 API）在所有窗口状态下运行，因此在此处冻结时不会打开崩溃报告窗口，也不会写入冻结报告，无论是否最小化。现在，看门狗也会对每个帧的这一部分进行计时。

6529f89a5f8b2eee.source: Tasks → Add new download, with a gallery's address
6529f89a5f8b2eee.text: 任务 → 添加新下载，输入图库地址

65405b254c9c07bd.source: The portable copy runs straight from a USB stick and keeps its list and settings there. With a few settings, it saves your downloads to the stick too.
65405b254c9c07bd.text: 便携版可直接从 U 盘运行，并将下载列表和设置保存在 U 盘上。调整几项设置后，下载文件也会保存到 U 盘上。

6542349c43e32bc7.source: The main window: the Categories pane on the left with All Downloads, Unfinished, Finished and Queues, and the download list on the right
6542349c43e32bc7.text: 主窗口：左侧是类别窗格，包含所有下载、未完成、已完成和队列；右侧是下载列表

6543d7e635d11ea1.source: The download list, settings, helpers for video and galleries (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, gallery-dl), torrent data, your <g1>theme files</g1> (<x2/>) and the logs are kept in <x3/>, not in your Windows profile.
6543d7e635d11ea1.text: 下载列表、设置、视频和图库辅助工具（yt-dlp、ffmpeg、gallery-dl）、种子数据、您的<g1>主题文件</g1>（<x2/>）和日志都保存在<x3/>中，而不是您的 Windows 配置文件中。

6565dec7ab42cb96.source: MDM refuses a torrent with file names your system can't write safely, says which name, and writes nothing. What others can see, the network switches in <g1>Torrent settings</g1>, blocklists and proxies: <g2>Torrents and your security</g2>.
6565dec7ab42cb96.text: MDM 会拒绝文件名无法安全写入您系统的种子，并会说明是哪个文件名，且不写入任何内容。其他人可以看到的内容、<g1>种子设置</g1> 中的网络开关、黑名单和代理：<g2>种子与您的安全</g2>。

65b71efc22b4ce41.text: Linux，其他包管理器（pacman 等）的包

65cb5200a6c6b9ad.source: The video download button moves to a free corner instead of covering a control of the page, such as a thumbnail's watch-later button (<g1>#421</g1>). Dragging it still puts it where you want it.
65cb5200a6c6b9ad.text: 视频下载按钮会移动到空闲角落，而不是覆盖页面上的控件，例如缩略图的稍后观看按钮（<g1>#421</g1>）。拖动它仍然可以将其放置在您想要的位置。

65da44cc551abd0f.source: <g1>Download complete</g1> shows the file's size, its address and where it was saved. Choose <g2>Open</g2>, <g3>Open with...</g3>, <g4>Open folder</g4> or <g5>Close</g5>. On Windows you can also drag the small box at the bottom right into Explorer, an email or a chat to drop the file there. The window shows above your other programs until you click it, without taking the keyboard from the one you're typing in.
65da44cc551abd0f.text: <g1>下载完成</g1>窗口显示文件大小、地址和保存位置。您可以选择<g2>打开</g2>、<g3>打开方式...</g3>、<g4>打开文件夹</g4>或<g5>关闭</g5>。在 Windows 上，您还可以将右下角的小框拖到资源管理器、电子邮件或聊天中以放置文件。此窗口会显示在其他程序上方，直到您点击它，但不会抢占您正在输入的程序的键盘焦点。

662e8cdda4078826.source: 32 MiB, one connection in three crawls at 128 KB/s
662e8cdda4078826.text: 32 MiB，三次抓取中一次连接，速度 128 KB/秒

666232cd46d2646c.source: Without the API, the assistant can still add downloads, as MDM's <g1>command line</g1> can.
666232cd46d2646c.text: 即使没有 API，助手仍然可以添加下载，就像 MDM 的<g1>命令行</g1>一样。

6685cbbaa02eceef.source: The progress window shows it coming in.
6685cbbaa02eceef.text: 进度窗口显示下载正在进行。

66987ab567339aa6.text: 免费的 IDM 替代品

66a39a85a0d50d8a.source: <g1>Windows-only calls live in <x2/></g1>, their Linux and macOS counterparts in <x3/>; the rest of the workspace is safe, portable Rust (<x4/>). On Windows, <x5/> checks that it still builds for Linux and macOS.
66a39a85a0d50d8a.text: <g1>仅限 Windows 的调用放在<x2/></g1>中，Linux 和 macOS 对应的调用放在<x3/>中；工作区的其余部分使用安全、可移植的 Rust（<x4/>）。在 Windows 上，<x5/>会检查是否仍能为 Linux 和 macOS 构建。

66b76acd18192191.source: <g1>Properties</g1> — change its name, its file types and its folder. General and Torrents only change their folder. A renamed category keeps its folder; a built-in one keeps its name in your language until you rename it.
66b76acd18192191.text: <g1>属性</g1> — 更改类别名称、文件类型和文件夹。常规和种子类别只能更改文件夹。重命名后的类别会保留原文件夹；内置类别会保留当前语言的名称，直到重命名。

66bed96fa5191ffc.source: The main window in the Emerald theme

66c4836883cab606.source: <g1>Made possible by these amazing humans</g1>: the home page's first view thanks everyone who sent a pull request, opened an issue or joined a conversation on GitHub, with their round photos; the new <g2>Contributors</g2> page shows what each one did; each release, on the News page and in its notes on GitHub, ends with the people who helped since the one before; and the README thanks everyone too.
66c4836883cab606.text: <g1>感谢这些杰出贡献者</g1>：主页的第一个视图感谢所有在 GitHub 上提交拉取请求、提出问题或参与讨论的人，并展示他们的圆形头像；新的<g2>贡献者</g2>页面展示了每个人的贡献；每个版本在新闻页面和 GitHub 上的发布说明中，都会列出自上次发布以来提供帮助的人员；README 也感谢了所有人。

66c64617aa9effd4.source: 1 the category, 2 where the file goes, 3 start now, 4 or put it in a queue.
66c64617aa9effd4.text: 1是类别，2是文件保存位置，3是立即开始，4是加入队列。

66e61fa9b0888d8e.source: <g1>Must not contain</g1>: words that make the rule skip an article.
66e61fa9b0888d8e.text: <g1>不得包含</g1>：使规则跳过文章的词语。

66f0d356afa03754.text: 两个辅助程序，使用前需检查

66f7530c7179f562.source: <g1>The Download video button over the video</g1> passes that page's cookies, from the window and profile you're in (a private window, a Firefox container), for the look-up and the download. Nothing to set up. Each cookie goes with the domain the browser keeps it for, so a sign-in on YouTube Music (music.youtube.com) or YouTube's mobile site reaches www.youtube.com too.
66f7530c7179f562.text: <g1>视频上方的下载视频按钮</g1>会传递您当前窗口和配置文件（私人窗口、Firefox 容器）中的页面 Cookie，用于查找和下载。无需设置。每个 Cookie 都与其浏览器保存的域一起使用，因此在 YouTube Music (music.youtube.com) 或 YouTube 移动网站上的登录也会到达 www.youtube.com。

670bb10cde757ad1.source: MDM never writes the token to its event log, crash reports, the automation API or the command line's output.
670bb10cde757ad1.text: MDM 绝不会将令牌写入其事件日志、崩溃报告、自动化 API 或命令行输出。

67102ad4c4b47883.text: <g1>Mister Download Manager 对比 IDM 6.42</g1><g2>2026 年 10 月核查 · 来源见下</g2>

671b07a3edfa2c00.source: MDM first shows a 30-second countdown. <g1>Cancel</g1> stops it; <g2>Turn off now</g2> goes ahead at once.
671b07a3edfa2c00.text: MDM 首先会显示 30 秒倒计时。<g1>取消</g1>会停止倒计时；<g2>立即关闭</g2>会立即执行。

671f8cb62812acdc.source: Add a download from your phone, or from another computer at home, and watch it run on the computer where MDM is: paste a link or a magnet link, send a <x1/> file, see the list with its progress, and pause, start or remove downloads. Your phone opens a small page that MDM itself serves; nothing is installed on the phone, and no outside service is involved.
671f8cb62812acdc.text: 从手机或家中另一台电脑添加下载，并在运行 MDM 的电脑上查看其运行情况：粘贴链接或磁力链接，发送 <x1/> 文件，查看包含进度、暂停、开始或删除下载的列表。您的手机会打开 MDM 自身提供的小页面；手机上无需安装任何东西，也不涉及任何外部服务。

672ffa07db0bd6d7.source: Reinstall MDM to restore its files.
672ffa07db0bd6d7.text: 重新安装 MDM 以恢复其文件。

676c0b5817404515.source: To route <g1>everything</g1> through another network, use a VPN for the whole computer.
676c0b5817404515.text: 要将<g1>所有</g1>流量通过另一个网络路由，请为整台计算机使用VPN。

67b09013b9c7d05d.source: Yes downloads both helpers in the background, once.
67b09013b9c7d05d.text: 点击“是”会在后台下载这两个辅助工具，只需下载一次。

67b7e3e016904e39.source: Install MDM with the setup and keep Set up browser integration ticked. In Firefox, then open the add-on's page on addons.mozilla.org and click Add to…
67b7e3e016904e39.text: 使用安装程序安装 MDM，并保持勾选“设置浏览器集成”。然后在 Firefox 中打开 addons.mozilla.org 上的附加组件页面，点击“添加到…”。

67d7688dc5224a95.source: Run MDM on a server — Mister Download Manager help
67d7688dc5224a95.text: 在服务器上运行 MDM — Mister Download Manager 帮助

67de05d9a72c0618.source: The setup asks for its language first, with Windows' own already selected, and MDM starts in the one you pick. A zip copy shows the list on its first start instead: each language with its flag, its own name and its English name. The setup speaks the same languages, and the browser extension speaks your browser's.
67de05d9a72c0618.text: 安装程序会首先询问语言，并已预选 Windows 自身的语言，MDM 将以您选择的语言启动。如果是 zip 压缩包版本，首次启动时会显示语言列表：每种语言都带有其国旗、本地名称和英文名称。安装程序也支持这些语言，浏览器扩展则使用您浏览器的语言。

67e3386aef4aa20f.source: <g1>The network is yours to choose</g1>: incoming connections, UPnP, a fixed port, the DHT, local peers, a SOCKS5 proxy, an IP blocklist, and one network adapter (a VPN's) with a kill switch.
67e3386aef4aa20f.text: <g1>网络由您选择</g1>：传入连接、UPnP、固定端口、DHT、本地对等点、SOCKS5 代理、IP 黑名单，以及带终止开关的一个网络适配器（VPN 的）。

67f71066401d978a.source: <g1>No breaking of copy protection.</g1> MDM doesn't remove or get around DRM, and isn't meant to. Protected content stays protected.
67f71066401d978a.text: <g1>不破解版权保护。</g1> MDM 不会移除或绕过 DRM，也无意如此。受保护的内容仍然受保护。

680e0718914ac5b0.source: <g1>Test</g1> asks it for github.com and shows how long it took.
680e0718914ac5b0.text: <g1>测试</g1>会查询 github.com 并显示耗时。

681d0b7c714c93a1.source: Passwords (Sites Logins, the proxy, debrid accounts) are in the system's keychain, not in <x1/>; see <g2>Options → Sites Logins</g2>.
681d0b7c714c93a1.text: 密码（站点登录、代理、网盘账户）存储在系统的钥匙串中，而不是在<x1/>中；请参阅<g2>选项 → 站点登录</g2>。

681f0aa1f312eba6.source: Right-click: Download with Mister Download Manager
681f0aa1f312eba6.text: 右键点击：使用 Mister Download Manager 下载

6821496b26156b7b.source: IDM facts from internetdownloadmanager.com, checked October 2026; timings from <g1>our published benchmark</g1> with raw data. Spot a mistake? <g2>Tell us</g2>.
6821496b26156b7b.text: IDM 数据来自 internetdownloadmanager.com，于 2026 年十月核实；时间数据来自<g1>我们发布的基准测试</g1>及原始数据。发现错误？<g2>告诉我们</g2>。

68501e4a16b6ce4f.source: The browser's native messaging host: takes captured downloads from the extension and hands them to the app
68501e4a16b6ce4f.text: 浏览器的原生消息主机：从扩展程序获取捕获的下载并将其交给应用

687eb3437405d3f6.source: A picture's own address (one ending in <x1/> or <x2/>) downloads as a file, as before.
687eb3437405d3f6.text: 图片本身的地址（以 <x1/> 或 <x2/> 结尾）仍会像以前一样作为文件下载。

6881e899825efad9.source: <g1><g2>Command line and automation</g2></g1>: IDM's switches (<x3/>), <x4/> (files, videos, torrents) and a local, token-protected automation API that lists, pauses, starts, removes and deletes downloads.
6881e899825efad9.text: <g1><g2>命令行和自动化</g2></g1>：IDM 的开关（<x3/>）、<x4/>（文件、视频、种子）以及一个本地的、受令牌保护的自动化 API，用于列出、暂停、启动、移除和删除下载。

688b2703f9059b6f.source: Is Mister Download Manager really free?
688b2703f9059b6f.text: Mister Download Manager 真的免费吗？

68a4ceb65babc872.source: MDM extracts safely. A name that would lead outside the folder is left out, and so is a link to somewhere else on the disk. An archive that would write far more than its size, or more than the disk has room for, stops before it fills it. When something goes wrong, nothing but the archive is left behind.
68a4ceb65babc872.text: MDM 会安全地提取文件。可能导致文件被写入文件夹之外的路径会被忽略，指向磁盘其他位置的链接也会被忽略。如果存档会写入远超自身大小的数据，或超出磁盘可用空间，提取会在磁盘写满前停止。如果提取出错，除了存档外不会留下任何文件。

68b88047fcca2939.text: 将下载加入队列以便稍后下载 →

6941e88ad1cb9eb7.source: When a download comes from a form you submitted, it passes <g1>the form's data</g1> too, so MDM can submit it again. It notes the data of forms you submit (in memory, used for two minutes at most, never stored) only for that.
6941e88ad1cb9eb7.text: 当下载来自您提交的表单时，它也会传递<g1>表单数据</g1>，以便 MDM 可以再次提交。它只为此目的记录您提交的表单数据（在内存中，最多使用两分钟，从不存储）。

69662d745c57ca02.source: MDM downloads the pictures of a gallery (a Wikimedia Commons category, a Flickr album, a DeviantArt gallery, an Imgur album and many more) with the help of <g1>gallery-dl</g1>, a free program that reads several hundred sites. Like yt-dlp for videos, it's an optional helper: MDM installs it the first time you need it, or uses your own copy.
69662d745c57ca02.text: MDM 借助 <g1>gallery-dl</g1>（一个可读取数百个网站的免费程序）下载图库中的图片（如维基共享资源分类、Flickr 相册、DeviantArt 图库、Imgur 相册等）。它和 yt-dlp 视频下载工具一样，是一个可选的辅助程序：MDM 会在您首次需要时安装它，或使用您已有的副本。

6976d3a5455f9216.source: Typing the start of a name while the list has the focus jumps to the first download whose name starts with it.
6976d3a5455f9216.text: 列表获得焦点时，输入名称的开头即可跳转到名称以这些字符开头的第一个下载。

69993806a2016916.source: MDM keeps Internet Download Manager's compact sizes. On a large or high-resolution screen, choose <g1>View → Interface size</g1> (110 %, 115 %, 120 %, 125 %, 150 %, 175 % or 200 %), or press <g2>Ctrl +</g2> and <g3>Ctrl −</g3> in any MDM window, as in a browser; <g4>Ctrl 0</g4> goes back to 100 %. Every window follows at once, and MDM starts at that size next time. It comes on top of Windows' own display scale (<g5>Settings → System → Display → Scale</g5>).
69993806a2016916.text: MDM 保持了 Internet Download Manager 的紧凑尺寸。在大屏幕或高分辨率屏幕上，选择<g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>（110%、115%、120%、125%、150%、175% 或 200%），或者在任何 MDM 窗口中按下 <g2>Ctrl +</g2> 和 <g3>Ctrl -</g3>，就像在浏览器中一样；<g4>Ctrl 0</g4> 可恢复到 100%。所有窗口会立即随之调整，MDM 下次启动时也会使用该尺寸。这会叠加在 Windows 自身的显示缩放（<g5>设置 → 系统 → 显示 → 缩放</g5>）之上。

6cf66bb7f58412f7.source: <g1>Downloads from a browser behind a VPN or proxy extension go through it too</g1> (<g2>#42</g2>): the browser extension passes the proxy the browser uses for a download (an extension's, or its settings' manual proxy or auto-config script) with it. MDM downloads through the same proxy while <g3>Options → Proxy / Socks → Use proxy/socks from a browser's request</g3> is on, which is the default. A proxy that needs the VPN extension's own login can't be shared: the download says so rather than going without it. It is an opt-in, off as installed: <g4>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g4> in the extension's popup. In Firefox the switch asks for the browser's <g5>proxy</g5> permission (to read the browser's proxy, never to change it). Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi can't make that permission optional, so their extension has it from the install; Chrome counts it under the access to every site the extension already has, so the update asks for nothing new. There the extension reads the browser's proxy settings: the server for the download's scheme (honouring their bypass list), or their auto-config script. Addresses on this computer (localhost, 127.0.0.1) go straight to it, as the browser sends them.
6cf66bb7f58412f7.text: <g1>通过 VPN 或代理扩展的浏览器下载也会通过它</g1>（<g2>#42</g2>）：浏览器扩展会将浏览器用于下载的代理（扩展的，或其设置中的手动代理或自动配置脚本）一并传递。当<g3>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 使用浏览器请求中的代理/SOCKS</g3>开启时（默认设置），MDM 会通过相同的代理下载。需要 VPN 扩展自身登录的代理无法共享：下载会提示此情况，而不是在没有代理的情况下进行。这是一个选择性加入功能，默认安装时关闭：在扩展的弹出窗口中选择<g4>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g4>。在 Firefox 中，此开关会请求浏览器的<g5>代理</g5>权限（读取浏览器的代理，绝不更改）。Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 无法使该权限成为可选，因此其扩展在安装时就拥有此权限；Chrome 将其计入扩展已拥有的对每个站点的访问权限中，因此更新不会请求任何新内容。在此，扩展会读取浏览器的代理设置：下载方案的服务器（遵守其绕过列表），或其自动配置脚本。此计算机上的地址（localhost、127.0.0.1）会直接发送，就像浏览器发送它们一样。

6e6cb68a69541c09.text: 添加 URL 会将以下内容发送到图库窗口：维基共享资源分类、Flickr 摄影师和相册、DeviantArt 和 ArtStation 图库、Imgur 相册、Pixiv 艺术家和作品、Pinterest 画板和图钉、Danbooru 和 Gelbooru 搜索、Tumblr 博客和 Bluesky 个人资料。以 <x1/> 或 <x2/> 结尾的图片地址仍将作为单个文件下载。

6e7548052a98a59e.source: <g1>The video window opens instead:</g1> the address is a video's page. See <g2>Download a video from a page</g2>.
6e7548052a98a59e.text: <g1>反而打开了视频窗口：</g1>该地址是视频页面。请参阅<g2>从页面下载视频</g2>。

6e76463077ae88ff.source: Browser link import: tighter handling of site data.
6e76463077ae88ff.text: 浏览器链接导入：更严格地处理网站数据。

6ea13851d3ed0904.source: An unchecked box's or radio's border
6ea13851d3ed0904.text: 未选中复选框或单选框的边框

6ea21a2d16bf4777.source: <g1>Tasks → Torrent settings...</g1> — sharing and file associations. See <g2>Torrents</g2>.
6ea21a2d16bf4777.text: <g1>任务 → 种子设置…</g1> — 共享和文件关联。请参阅<g2>种子</g2>。

6ea6f59940533f5d.source: Extract ZIP, 7z and RAR archives automatically
6ea6f59940533f5d.text: 自动提取 ZIP、7z 和 RAR 压缩包

6ec7e367cdfb8475.source: When Firefox started MDM for a download, closing its helper could close MDM too.
6ec7e367cdfb8475.text: 当 Firefox 启动 MDM 进行下载时，关闭其辅助程序也可能关闭 MDM。

6ed1f7b8dcba3260.source: A torrent comes from other people's computers, not from one website. That changes what you can trust and what others can see. This page says plainly what MDM does and what it doesn't. The switches it mentions are in <g1>Tasks → Torrent settings...</g1>.
6ed1f7b8dcba3260.text: 种子来自其他人的计算机，而不是某个网站。这会影响您可以信任什么，以及其他人能看到什么。本页会明确说明 MDM 能做什么、不能做什么。文中提到的开关位于<g1>任务 → 种子设置...</g1>。

6eef75044c57910f.source: Stop now also stops yt-dlp, which used to keep downloading in the background.
6eef75044c57910f.text: “停止”现在也会停止 yt-dlp，后者以前会在后台继续下载。

6f15d2fb946db9c5.source: <g1>Mister Download Manager closed unexpectedly</g1>: MDM crashed, or hit an internal error and closed.
6f15d2fb946db9c5.text: <g1>Mister Download Manager 意外关闭</g1>：MDM 崩溃，或遇到内部错误并关闭。

6f22280b42545622.source: <g1>Torrent commands</g1> (<g2>#39</g2>): a torrent's right-click menu has <g3>Torrent → Recheck files</g3>, <g4>Reannounce</g4>, <g5>Add trackers...</g5> and <g6>Copy magnet link</g6>. Its Files tab can tick and untick files while it runs. A <x7/> file's web address, in Add URL or from the browser, opens Add torrent with what the file holds. TORRENT is in Options → File types' defaults, so the browser hands <x8/> files over; a list saved before keeps what it had.
6f22280b42545622.text: <g1>种子命令</g1>（<g2>#39</g2>）：种子的右键菜单现在包含 <g3>种子 → 重新检查文件</g3>、<g4>重新发布</g4>、<g5>添加跟踪器...</g5> 和 <g6>复制磁力链接</g6>。其“文件”选项卡可以在运行时勾选和取消勾选文件。在“添加 URL”或从浏览器中输入的 <x7/> 文件网址，会打开“添加种子”窗口并显示文件内容。TORRENT 已添加到“选项 → 文件类型”的默认设置中，因此浏览器会将 <x8/> 文件传递给 MDM；之前保存的列表会保留其原有内容。

6f324acffbd74d42.source: Look at <g1>Resume capability</g1> in the progress window. <g2>No</g2> means the server can't send a file in parts, so MDM can't continue it later.
6f324acffbd74d42.text: 查看进度窗口中的<g1>恢复功能</g1>。如果显示<g2>否</g2>，表示服务器无法分段发送文件，因此 MDM 无法稍后继续下载。

6f4442a3a172826f.source: <g1>Drop-down lists for screen readers</g1>: a screen reader or UI Automation can now set a drop-down list's choice by its text, and open or close the list.
6f4442a3a172826f.text: <g1>屏幕阅读器的下拉列表</g1>：屏幕阅读器或 UI Automation 现在可以通过文本设置下拉列表的选择，并打开或关闭列表。

6f5eb359b4bae5f0.source: A torrent's progress window: its tabs touched the buttons above them, and Resume capability's Yes / No stood apart from the other values. A long list of file types in Options ran out under its box.
6f5eb359b4bae5f0.text: 种子进度窗口中的选项卡会紧贴上方按钮，“恢复功能”的“是”/“否”也与其他值分开显示。选项中的文件类型列表过长，会超出其边框。

6f628c9a49c046f2.text: 下载 Apple Silicon 版本

6f6b05ed4b05346c.source: <g1>A window closed with its title bar's × no longer turns black first</g1> (<g2>#207</g2>): every dialog and the progress window turned black for a moment when closed with the × or Alt+F4, rather than with Esc or one of its buttons: one to several seconds on Linux, a few hundredths of a second on Windows. The window now keeps its contents until it goes.
6f6b05ed4b05346c.text: <g1>用标题栏的“×”关闭的窗口不再先变黑</g1>（<g2>#207</g2>）：所有对话框和进度窗口在用“×”或 Alt+F4 关闭时会短暂变黑，而不是用 Esc 或其按钮关闭时：在 Linux 上持续一到几秒，在 Windows 上持续几百分之一秒。现在，窗口在关闭前会保持其内容。

6fd265830dad2b39.source: Untick the folders or files you don't want. <g1>Select all</g1> and <g2>Select none</g2> help with big torrents. <g3>Selected</g3> shows how many files and how much data you picked.
6fd265830dad2b39.text: 取消勾选您不想要的文件夹或文件。<g1>全选</g1>和<g2>不选</g2>有助于处理大型种子。<g3>已选</g3>显示您选择了多少文件和多少数据。

6fd74c9a6e95ff7a.source: The service downloads the torrent on its own servers. The list shows how far it is, such as <g1>45% at Real-Debrid</g1>. A torrent the service already has is ready at once.
6fd74c9a6e95ff7a.text: 服务会在自己的服务器上下载种子。列表会显示下载进度，例如<g1>Real-Debrid 上的进度为 45%</g1>。如果服务已有该种子，就能立即开始下载。

6fe2dcd2583ba8b7.source: MDM closed with an internal error when a window opened while the main window was minimized or hidden in the notification area, for example Download File Info for a download from the browser, or Add torrent for a magnet link opened in the browser (<g1>#22</g1>, <g2>#145</g2>). The cause was in egui, the toolkit MDM is drawn with (<g3>emilk/egui#8470</g3>), and is fixed in MDM's copy of it.
6fe2dcd2583ba8b7.text: 当主窗口最小化或隐藏在通知区域时，如果打开了一个窗口（例如浏览器下载的“下载文件信息”，或浏览器中打开磁力链接的“添加种子”），MDM 会因内部错误而关闭 (<g1>#22</g1>, <g2>#145</g2>)。原因是 MDM 绘制所用的 egui 工具包 (<g3>emilk/egui#8470</g3>)，此问题已在 MDM 的副本中修复。

6ff6bb70b136e59c.source: A download refused by a site's bot check (Cloudflare's challenge) says so and how to get the file, instead of "the server answered 403 Forbidden" (<g1>#376</g1>).
6ff6bb70b136e59c.text: 当下载被网站的机器人检查（Cloudflare 的挑战）拒绝时，会显示拒绝原因和获取文件的方法，而不是“服务器响应 403 Forbidden”（<g1>#376</g1>）。

6ffa7e77fe9e6b56.source: The <g1>Q</g1> column shows which downloads are in a queue. Under <g2>Queues</g2> in the categories pane, select a queue to see only its downloads.
6ffa7e77fe9e6b56.text: <g1>Q</g1>列会显示哪些下载任务已加入队列。在类别窗格的<g2>队列</g2>下选择一个队列，即可只查看该队列中的下载任务。

70074a48a853a98b.source: Is it safe? Does it contain adware or spyware? — Mister Download Manager
70074a48a853a98b.text: 安全吗？是否包含广告软件或间谍软件？— Mister Download Manager

700b58886e17c427.source: <g1><g2>Options</g2></g1> — every page of the Options window.

700bb1f331ccb359.source: Very likely: MDM speaks 86 languages, every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen on the first start or any time in View → Language. Arabic, Hebrew…
700bb1f331ccb359.text: 很有可能：MDM 支持 86 种语言，涵盖 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，您可以在首次启动时选择，或随时通过“视图”→“语言”进行更改。阿拉伯语、希伯来语……

70304346a925831b.source: MDM opens <g1>Download File Info</g1> instead of the browser downloading the file. Click <g2>Start Download</g2>.
70304346a925831b.text: MDM 会打开<g1>下载文件信息</g1>，而不是让浏览器下载文件。点击<g2>开始下载</g2>。

70381b0593915f1e.source: <g1>Torrents: file names are checked more strictly</g1> (<g2>#40</g2>): a torrent with names the system can't write safely is refused, saying which name, and so are torrents kept from an earlier run.
70381b0593915f1e.text: <g1>洪流：文件名检查更严格</g1> (<g2>#40</g2>)：包含系统无法安全写入文件名的洪流会被拒绝，并说明具体是哪个文件名，从早期运行中保留的洪流也是如此。

70950300e88df4b7.source: An API for the running app
70950300e88df4b7.text: 运行中应用程序的 API

70976b80435321d8.source: Hide a download's progress window to the notification area while it keeps going.
70976b80435321d8.text: 将下载进度窗口隐藏到通知区域，同时下载继续进行。

709db3121ce7df32.text: 保留在您电脑上的内容

70aaa86487419e0d.source: Link grabber: untick what you don't want, then Add to queue.
70aaa86487419e0d.text: 链接抓取器：取消勾选不需要的地址，然后点击“添加到队列”。

70ae16056b2c6783.source: Replaces the AppImage, or the programs in their folder.
70ae16056b2c6783.text: 替换 AppImage，或其文件夹中的程序。

70bdef1d80986cfc.source: A server at a medium round trip (60 to 150 ms)
70bdef1d80986cfc.text: 往返时间中等（60 到 150 毫秒）的服务器

70c4b3c5ac70fcc0.source: In the same window, set <g1>Maximum download speed for one file</g1>. It starts at 10 KBytes/sec, which is very slow, so set it first.
70c4b3c5ac70fcc0.text: 在同一窗口中，设置<g1>单个文件的最大下载速度</g1>。它最初设置为 10 千字节/秒，速度非常慢，所以请先设置它。

70c4df1b8695ae14.source: MDM can be driven without its window in three ways:
70c4df1b8695ae14.text: MDM 可通过以下 3 种方式在不显示窗口的情况下运行：

70e82e92e0ad33fa.source: MDM reads MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and CRC32 checksums. Paste the code as the site shows it: there is no list to pick the kind from, as MDM tells them apart by their length.
70e82e92e0ad33fa.text: MDM 可读取 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 和 CRC32 校验和。请按网站显示的方式粘贴代码：无需从列表中选择类型，MDM 会根据其长度进行区分。

711d5121d3f92e71.source: Use <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> in the app: it opens the bug report form with your version, system, how MDM was installed and its language filled in. The form asks for the same when you open it yourself. Security problems: see <g2>SECURITY.md</g2>.
711d5121d3f92e71.text: 在应用中使用<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>：这会打开错误报告表单，并自动填入您的版本、系统、MDM 的安装方式和界面语言。手动打开表单时，也会要求提供这些信息。安全问题：请参阅<g2>SECURITY.md</g2>。

71287ba3a8c111ae.source: <g1>Resuming after a waiting page</g1>: when a download's address had to be asked again (an expired link), MDM now goes through the same waiting pages and redirects as the first time, instead of giving up on them.
71287ba3a8c111ae.text: <g1>等待页面后恢复</g1>：当下载地址需要再次请求（链接过期）时，MDM 现在会像第一次一样通过相同的等待页面和重定向，而不是放弃它们。

713fb9ae833ec7e5.source: MDM got much lighter, and Linux is now supported like Windows.
713fb9ae833ec7e5.text: MDM 变得更轻巧，Linux 现在像 Windows 一样受到支持。

714ba48c1b2d5091.source: MDM runs on 64-bit Linux with a desktop session. It is tested on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora, with GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, on X11 and in Wayland sessions. Pick one of these files (up to version 0.2.4, their names end in <x1/>, as in <x2/>):
714ba48c1b2d5091.text: MDM 可以在 64 位 Linux 桌面会话中运行。它已在 Ubuntu 24.04、Debian 12 和 Fedora 上，使用 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 桌面环境，以及 X11 和 Wayland 会话中进行过测试。请选择以下文件之一（最高版本 0.2.4，文件名以 <x1/> 结尾，例如 <x2/>）：

716774ebd9fc2524.source: Already have a Base16 or pywal scheme?
716774ebd9fc2524.text: 已有 Base16 或 pywal 配色方案？

717ab971db931b42.source: <g1>MDM asks to create a folder:</g1> the folder doesn't exist yet. Click <g2>Yes</g2>.
717ab971db931b42.text: <g1>MDM 要求创建文件夹：</g1>该文件夹尚不存在。点击<g2>是</g2>。

7185d7f30357903e.source: Download whole image galleries from Flickr, DeviantArt, Imgur, Wikimedia Commons and more with Mister Download Manager and gallery-dl.
7185d7f30357903e.text: 使用 Mister Download Manager 和 gallery-dl 从 Flickr、DeviantArt、Imgur、维基共享资源等网站下载整个图片库。

71cdb318bbd7d713.source: <g1>Google Drive support:</g1> links now download the actual file instead of Drive's web page.
71cdb318bbd7d713.text: <g1>Google Drive 支持：</g1> 链接现在下载的是实际文件，而不是 Drive 的网页。

71d14444f997862f.source: are a handful of colours (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>) that MDM spreads over every control. <x10/> and <x11/> give each side its own.
71d14444f997862f.text: 是 MDM 分布到每个控件上的一些颜色（<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/>、<x7/>、<x8/>、<x9/>）。<x10/> 和 <x11/> 为每一侧提供自己的颜色。

71e90b70c32a4238.source: <g1>Download list</g1> (right). One row per download. See <g2>The download list</g2>.
71e90b70c32a4238.text: <g1>下载列表</g1>（右侧）。每行一个下载。请参阅<g2>下载列表</g2>。

7245ff310e79465b.source: The command line's <x1/> and <x2/> use the same accounts, and say <x3/>; <x4/> downloads the address itself (<g5>command line</g5>).
7245ff310e79465b.text: 命令行中的 <x1/> 和 <x2/> 使用相同的账户，并显示 <x3/>；<x4/> 下载地址本身（<g5>命令行</g5>）。

7255d87a5a4d1b5d.source: The whole source is public, and every release is built from it on GitHub's servers. No adware, no spyware, no bundled offers. The helpers it downloads for video are verified before they run. <g1>More</g1>
7255d87a5a4d1b5d.text: 所有源代码都已公开，每个版本都在 GitHub 的服务器上根据源代码构建。没有广告软件、间谍软件或捆绑软件。运行前会验证为视频下载而获取的辅助程序。<g1>更多</g1>

72600252a067c7ec.source: The Scheduler can wake the computer to run a queue.
72600252a067c7ec.text: 计划程序可以在队列运行时唤醒计算机。

72769bded1d786a9.source: Paste a Google Drive link as it is, the one <g1>Share → Copy link</g1> gives:
72769bded1d786a9.text: 直接粘贴 Google Drive 链接，即<g1>分享 → 复制链接</g1>生成的链接：

72af22f48add6a8d.source: Internet Download Manager and IDM are trademarks of their owner. We name them only to describe and compare, as allowed by law. MDM is <g1>not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Tonec Inc.</g1> and contains none of Internet Download Manager's code, artwork or text.
72af22f48add6a8d.text: Internet Download Manager 和 IDM 是其所有者的商标。我们仅在法律允许的范围内使用它们进行描述和比较。MDM <g1>不隶属于 Tonec Inc.，也未获得其认可或与之关联</g1>，并且不包含 Internet Download Manager 的任何代码、美术作品或文本。

72b07c25fd5b5171.source: Logos belong to their owners, shown only to identify each product. PyIDM, which search results still list, is no longer developed: the copy they point to was last updated in March 2020.
72b07c25fd5b5171.text: 徽标归其所有者所有，仅用于识别各产品。搜索结果中仍列出的 PyIDM 已不再开发：其指向的副本最后更新于2020年3月。

72b6a754c65db16f.source: <g1>GitHub, to check for updates.</g1> Each time it starts, and once a day while it stays open, MDM asks GitHub's public API for the latest release of MDM (<x2/>). The request carries MDM's version in its User-Agent and nothing else. Turn the check off in <g3>Help → Check for updates</g3> (<g4>Check for updates at every start</g4>). If you choose <g5>Update now</g5>, MDM downloads the new version's file and its signed checksum list from the same GitHub release. GitHub's own privacy statement applies to these requests.
72b6a754c65db16f.text: <g1>GitHub，用于检查更新。</g1>每次启动时，以及在MDM保持打开状态下每天一次，MDM会向GitHub的公共API请求MDM的最新版本（<x2/>）。此请求在其User-Agent中携带MDM的版本信息，不包含其他任何内容。您可以在<g3>帮助 → 检查更新</g3>中关闭此检查（<g4>每次启动时检查更新</g4>）。如果您选择<g5>立即更新</g5>，MDM会从同一个GitHub发布中下载新版本的文件及其签名的校验和列表。GitHub自己的隐私声明适用于这些请求。

72bf213c33c77f67.source: Or open its progress window (double-click an unfinished download). The connection table shows what each connection is doing, and <g1>Retrying</g1> with the reason when one fails.
72bf213c33c77f67.text: 也可以打开下载进度窗口（双击未完成的下载）。连接表会显示每个连接正在执行的操作；连接失败时，还会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>及失败原因。

72c2f96db7aa7caa.text: 1. 将 MDM 放到 U 盘上

72ff8f6b37364fc1.source: is where files land: each category has its folder inside (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/>…). Mount a network share there to download straight onto it.
72ff8f6b37364fc1.text: 是文件存放的位置：每个分类都有其自己的子文件夹（<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>…）。在此处挂载网络共享，即可直接下载到共享中。

730094bedec47eb9.text: 所有元素恢复正常大小（100%）

73460447cd841230.source: 1 GiB over a fast local link
73460447cd841230.text: 通过快速本地链接下载 1 GiB

734a722e25f3a1f1.source: Use your Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize account in Mister Download Manager: file-host links unlocked, then downloaded with every connection.
734a722e25f3a1f1.text: 在 Mister Download Manager 中使用您的 Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 或 Premiumize 账户：解锁文件主机链接，然后通过所有连接下载。

734da40a1b2e7f72.source: Everything MDM doesn't take stays with the browser.
734da40a1b2e7f72.text: MDM 不捕获的内容仍由浏览器处理。

735b6ed69d617454.source: Save a video from YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok and many other sites, in the quality you choose.
735b6ed69d617454.text: 从 YouTube、Vimeo、TikTok 和许多其他网站保存视频，可选择您想要的画质。

7376905f9a1bfe65.source: 9 built-in looks in <g1>View → Theme</g1>: Classic, Native, High contrast, Metro, Adwaita, Breeze, Luna, Aero, Aqua.
7376905f9a1bfe65.text: <g1>视图 → 主题</g1> 中有 9 种内置外观：经典、原生、高对比度、现代、Adwaita、Breeze、Luna、Aero、Aqua。

75f7cfcbf2ebf842.source: A <x1/> file's web address works too: paste it into <g2>Add URL</g2> or <g3>Torrent</g3>, or let the browser hand the download over. MDM fetches the file, with the browser's cookies when the browser sent it, and <g4>Add torrent</g4> shows what it holds. The browser hands <x5/> downloads over because <x6/> is in <g7>Options → File types</g7>. It's there by default; a list you had before this version keeps what it had, so add <x8/> to it yourself. <g9>Download with Mister Download Manager</g9> on a link always hands it over. A command line with <x10/> (silent) saves the <x11/> file itself, like any file. MDM fetches at most 10 MB: anything bigger isn't a <x12/> file.
75f7cfcbf2ebf842.text: 一个 <x1/> 文件的网址也适用：将其粘贴到<g2>添加 URL</g2>或<g3>种子</g3>中，或者让浏览器将下载任务交给 MDM。MDM 会获取该文件，如果浏览器发送了它，则会带上浏览器的 cookie，<g4>添加种子</g4>会显示其中包含的内容。浏览器会将 <x5/> 下载任务交给 MDM，因为 <x6/> 位于<g7>选项 → 文件类型</g7>中。它默认就在那里；如果您在此版本之前有一个列表，它会保留原有的内容，因此请自行添加 <x8/>。<g9>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载</g9>链接总是会将其交给 MDM。带有 <x10/>（静默）的命令行会像任何文件一样保存 <x11/> 文件本身。MDM 最多获取 10 MB：任何更大的文件都不是 <x12/> 文件。

On the home page, a search or a channel it got that whole page instead, and offered about 50 videos. The button now sends the video playing in the player it's on, and a Short as the Short it is.
760cc3b840fe565d.text: <g1>YouTube 上的下载视频按钮选择了错误的视频</g1>（<g2>#311</g2>，感谢 <g3>@mayankmohan1992</g3>）：YouTube 会在不加载新页面的情况下从一个视频切换到下一个视频，而浏览器会一直命名它最初加载的页面，因此 MDM 获取的是之前观看的视频。在主页、搜索或频道页面上，它会获取整个页面，并提供大约 50 个视频。现在，该按钮会发送正在播放器中播放的视频，并将短视频作为其本身。

773674dc66042658.source: Its permissions, and why: <g1>downloads</g1> to see and hand over downloads; <g2>cookies</g2> so signed-in downloads work in MDM; <g3>nativeMessaging</g3> to talk to MDM; <g4>contextMenus</g4> for the right-click items; <g5>storage</g5> for its settings; <g6>webRequest</g6> to see forms submitted and video streams loaded (it changes nothing); <g7>declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess</g7> (Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers) to have the files the browser would open (a PDF) downloaded instead, for the types MDM takes; in Firefox, <g8>webRequestBlocking</g8> does that; <g9>scripting</g9> to read a page's links when you ask, and to add the video button to pages already open when the extension is installed; <g10>proxy</g10> to read which proxy the browser uses, so downloads taken from a browser behind a VPN or proxy extension go through it too, only while you have that switched on in the popup (it never changes the browser's proxy; in Firefox it is optional, asked for when you switch it on; Chrome and the other Chromium browsers can't make it optional, and count it under the access to all sites); access to all sites because downloads and videos can come from any site.
773674dc66042658.text: 其权限及原因：<g1>下载</g1>用于查看和移交下载；<g2>Cookie</g2>用于使已登录的下载在 MDM 中工作；<g3>原生消息</g3>用于与 MDM 通信；<g4>上下文菜单</g4>用于右键菜单项；<g5>存储</g5>用于其设置；<g6>网络请求</g6>用于查看提交的表单和加载的视频流（它不改变任何内容）；<g7>声明式网络请求与主机访问</g7>（Chrome、Edge 和其他 Chromium 浏览器）用于将浏览器会打开的文件（PDF）改为下载，适用于 MDM 支持的类型；在 Firefox 中，<g8>网络请求阻止</g8>实现此功能；<g9>脚本</g9>用于在您请求时读取页面链接，并在安装扩展后将视频按钮添加到已打开的页面；<g10>代理</g10>用于读取浏览器使用的代理，以便从 VPN 或代理扩展后面的浏览器获取的下载也通过它进行，仅当您在弹出窗口中开启此功能时（它从不改变浏览器的代理；在 Firefox 中是可选的，在您开启时会询问；Chrome 和其他 Chromium 浏览器无法使其可选，并将其计入对所有站点的访问权限）；访问所有站点是因为下载和视频可以来自任何站点。

77bd0523361e1992.text: 接下来，MDM 会提供 2 个免费的视频辅助工具：<g1>yt-dlp</g1>用于查找网页上的视频，<g2>ffmpeg</g2>用于合并视频画面和声音。点击<g3>是，下载它们（推荐）</g3>，这两个工具就会在后台下载，约 100 MB，只需下载一次。点击<g4>暂不</g4>可稍后再下载：首次需要时，视频窗口会提供下载选项。更多信息请参阅<g5>视频</g5>。

7830997efe7b81a7.source: MDM also takes the file types the browser would show or play itself (a PDF, an MP3), when they're listed in <g1>Options → File types</g1> and <g2>Also take files the browser would open</g2> is ticked in <g3>Options → General → Keys...</g3>. This needs a Chromium browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi) version 128 or later, or Firefox. Sites in MDM's excluded sites keep opening them in the browser. Hold <g4>Alt</g4> while clicking a link to leave it to the browser: Firefox then opens it, while Chromium browsers download it themselves (Alt+click is their own "download link").
7830997efe7b81a7.text: 如果文件类型已列在<g1>选项 → 文件类型</g1>中，并且已在<g2>选项 → 常规 → 按键...</g2>中勾选<g3>也接管浏览器会打开的文件</g3>，MDM 也会接管浏览器通常会显示或播放的文件（如 PDF、MP3）。此功能需要 Chromium 浏览器（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi）128 或更高版本，或 Firefox。MDM 排除的网站仍会在浏览器中打开这些文件。点击链接时按住<g4>Alt</g4>可让浏览器处理：Firefox 会打开文件，而 Chromium 浏览器会自行下载（Alt+点击是它们自带的“下载链接”功能）。

787aa2d926139bb5.source: <g1>Crash reports.</g1> If MDM closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a report window opens. It shows what happened and where in MDM's code, lets you read the whole report, and <g2>Send on GitHub</g2> opens a crash report form in your browser, filled in. Nothing is sent by itself. When the same problem was already reported, it takes you to that issue instead. A frozen MDM can be ended and restarted from there. Reports leave out your download addresses and file names. See <g3>Crash reports</g3>.
787aa2d926139bb5.text: <g1>崩溃报告。</g1>如果 MDM 意外关闭或停止响应，会打开报告窗口，显示问题经过以及问题在 MDM 代码中的位置。您可以查看完整报告，也可以点击<g2>在 GitHub 上发送</g2>，在浏览器中打开已填写内容的崩溃报告表单。报告不会自动发送。如果相同问题已有人报告，窗口会带您前往对应的问题页面。您也可以从这里结束并重新启动已冻结的 MDM。报告中不包含您的下载地址和文件名。请参阅<g3>崩溃报告</g3>。

789ceb2a0c6594a0.source: Height of a row in the download list

78c318b1f146d438.source: <g1>Derived palettes.</g1> <x2/> makes a whole palette from a few seeds (background, surface, text, accent…), mixing every other role in OKLab and keeping WCAG contrast (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for edges); High contrast strengthens every edge on top. <x3/> seeds the Native theme from the system's accent and contrast (Windows' settings, the freedesktop portal on Linux, macOS's accent).
78c318b1f146d438.text: <g1>派生调色板。</g1> <x2/> 从几个种子（背景、表面、文本、强调色…）生成完整的调色板，在 OKLab 中混合所有其他角色并保持 WCAG 对比度（文本 4.5:1，边缘 3:1）；高对比度会加强所有边缘。 <x3/> 根据系统的强调色和对比度（Windows 设置、Linux 上的 freedesktop 门户、macOS 的强调色）为“原生”主题提供种子。

78d1901f870994d6.source: Every window, from the keyboard. Read aloud.
78d1901f870994d6.text: 所有窗口，均可通过键盘操作。可朗读。

79298af691e8bdd2.source: You need your own paid account with one of these services: MDM doesn't sell or include one. Sharing an account or its links breaks the services' terms and can get the account suspended.
79298af691e8bdd2.text: 您需要拥有这些服务之一的付费账户：MDM 不出售或包含任何账户。共享账户或其链接会违反服务条款，并可能导致账户被暂停。

7957b18548166390.source: Questions and answers — Mister Download Manager
7957b18548166390.text: 常见问题 — Mister Download Manager

798a534b6b549e15.source: <g1>Things that fail say why</g1>: opening a file that was moved, a file that can't be deleted or moved, the list that can't be saved, a computer that won't shut down, a check closed early.
798a534b6b549e15.text: <g1>操作失败时会说明原因</g1>：打开已移动的文件、删除或移动文件失败、保存列表失败、计算机无法关机，以及检查提前关闭。

799b0b15db05f399.source: If the server needs a login, tick <g1>Use authorization</g1>.
799b0b15db05f399.text: 如果服务器需要登录，请勾选<g1>使用授权</g1>。

79a0cbc1cf868d3a.source: A theme in a folder of its own (<x1/>) can bring its icons in <x2/> and <x3/> (and, for PNG pictures, <x4/> and <x5/>, used on a screen scaled to 150 % and more), each named for what it shows (<x6/>, <x7/>…). SVG and PNG files keep their colours; <x8/> and <x9/> ones, as GNOME and KDE name them, take the theme's text colour. An icon the set lacks is drawn as the classic look draws it. The full list of names is in <g10>themeicons.rs</g10> (<x11/>).
79a0cbc1cf868d3a.text: 位于独立文件夹中的主题（<x1/>）可以在<x2/>和<x3/>中（对于 PNG 图片，还有<x4/>和<x5/>，用于 150% 及以上缩放的屏幕）引入其图标，每个图标都以其显示的内容命名（<x6/>、<x7/>…）。SVG 和 PNG 文件保留其颜色；<x8/>和<x9/>文件，如 GNOME 和 KDE 所命名，采用主题的文本颜色。缺少图标的集合将以经典外观绘制。名称的完整列表在<g10>themeicons.rs</g10>（<x11/>）中。

79a674edc4b6045b.source: <g1>Resume a broken download</g1> covers expired links too.
79a674edc4b6045b.text: <g1>恢复中断的下载</g1>也适用于过期链接。

79e3140fba001947.source: <g1>Google Drive links</g1> (<g2>#34</g2>): paste a Drive file's link (<x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>) and MDM downloads the file itself, as it was uploaded, over several connections and resumable, with its real name and size in Download File Info. Large files get past Drive's "can't scan this file for viruses" page as <g6>Download anyway</g6> does. Google Docs, Sheets and Slides come as Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. A private file downloads with the sign-in the extension passes from the browser. When Drive won't give a file (too many downloads lately, sign-in needed, no access), MDM says so in your language instead of saving Drive's page. The video button over a Drive video downloads the original file. Folders aren't downloaded yet: MDM says the link is a folder. See <g7>Google Drive links</g7>.
79e3140fba001947.text: <g1>Google Drive 链接</g1>（<g2>#34</g2>）：粘贴 Drive 文件的链接（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>），MDM 会下载文件本身，就像上传时一样，通过多个连接并可恢复，在“下载文件信息”中显示其真实名称和大小。大文件可以绕过 Drive 的“无法扫描此文件是否存在病毒”页面，就像<g6>仍然下载</g6>一样。Google 文档、表格和幻灯片以 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文件的形式出现。私人文件会通过扩展程序从浏览器传递的登录信息进行下载。当 Drive 不提供文件时（最近下载过多、需要登录、无访问权限），MDM 会用您的语言说明，而不是保存 Drive 的页面。Drive 视频上方的视频按钮会下载原始文件。文件夹尚未下载：MDM 会说明该链接是文件夹。请参阅<g7>Google Drive 链接</g7>。

7a013b94d0d00807.source: <g1><x2/></g1> — strengthens every edge and text colour on top of the rest.
7a013b94d0d00807.text: <g1><x2/></g1> — 在其他颜色之上，加强每个边缘和文本颜色。

7a10ae909a8694f8.source: For your own DNS: the servers' IP addresses, the name their certificate shows (TLS), or the <x1/> address (HTTPS, with its IP addresses if you know them). NextDNS takes your configuration ID.
7a10ae909a8694f8.text: 自定义 DNS：输入服务器的 IP 地址、证书中显示的名称（TLS），或 <x1/> 地址（HTTPS；如果知道其 IP 地址，也可以填写）。NextDNS 则需要填写配置 ID。

7a31f6dd87f98452.source: <g1>The window no longer freezes when the system's sleep or keychain service is slow</g1> (follows <g2>#222</g2>): a queue set to <g3>Wake the computer to run this queue</g3> asks the system to keep the computer awake while it runs. On Linux that is logind, which can be slow to answer just after the computer wakes, exactly when such a queue starts, and MDM waited for it on the window's own thread (asking again every 5 seconds while it refused). It is now asked in the background, on every system; the queue's downloads, retries and log lines are the same. A keyring that doesn't answer at start (a stopped GNOME Keyring) is now waited for once, at most 5 seconds, instead of once per saved password, and saving the list no longer asks it at all. On Linux the check for a tray to hide windows in, and in Download File Info the check that <g4>Save As</g4> isn't a folder (slow on a network share that doesn't answer), no longer run on the window's thread on every frame.
7a31f6dd87f98452.text: <g1>当系统睡眠或密钥链服务缓慢时，窗口不再冻结</g1>（继<g2>#222</g2>之后）：设置为<g3>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g3>的队列会请求系统在运行时保持电脑唤醒。在 Linux 上，这是 logind，它在电脑唤醒后（正是此类队列启动时）响应可能会很慢，而 MDM 会在窗口自己的线程上等待它（如果它拒绝，则每 5 秒再次询问）。现在它会在后台请求，在所有系统上都是如此；队列的下载、重试和日志行保持不变。对于启动时没有响应的密钥环（已停止的 GNOME Keyring），现在只会等待一次，最多 5 秒，而不是每个保存的密码等待一次，并且保存列表时根本不再询问它。在 Linux 上，检查是否有托盘可以隐藏窗口，以及在“下载文件信息”中检查<g4>另存为</g4>是否不是文件夹（在没有响应的网络共享上会很慢），不再在窗口的线程上每帧运行。

7a431c024b9ed18e.source: Choose <g1>Subtitles</g1> if you want them (see below).
7a431c024b9ed18e.text: 需要字幕时，选择<g1>字幕</g1>（见下文）。

7a5b7ab31d5f22cb.source: Click <g1>Add Torrent</g1> on the toolbar to open a <x2/> file, or use the arrow next to it for <g3>Add magnet link...</g3>. A magnet link pasted into <g4>Add URL</g4> works too. Torrents land in the same list as your other downloads, marked <g5>Torrent</g5> in the <g6>Source</g6> column, and go into queues and the Scheduler like them.
7a5b7ab31d5f22cb.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 Torrent</g1>以打开 <x2/> 文件，或使用旁边的箭头选择<g3>添加磁力链接…</g3>。粘贴到<g4>添加 URL</g4>中的磁力链接也同样有效。种子会出现在您其他下载任务的同一列表中，在<g6>来源</g6>列中标记为<g5>种子</g5>，并像其他任务一样进入队列和计划程序。

7a6583f7f0b33adf.source: The browser and MDM aren't connected — Mister Download Manager help
7a6583f7f0b33adf.text: 浏览器与 MDM 未连接 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

7a6ff9503edd25ad.source: Is the site in <g1>Don't start downloading automatically from the following sites</g1>?
7a6ff9503edd25ad.text: 该网站是否在<g1>不要从以下网站自动开始下载</g1>中？

7a77ad085222bc5b.source: <g1><x2/></g1> <g3><g4>Make your own theme</g4><g5>A text file of colours and sizes, tried in seconds. Three steps.</g5></g3>
7a77ad085222bc5b.text: <g1><x2/></g1> <g3><g4>创建您自己的主题</g4><g5>一个包含颜色和尺寸的文本文件，几秒钟即可试用。只需三步。</g5></g3>

7a8b05b164a2ebec.source: Can it download overnight or on a schedule? — Mister Download Manager
7a8b05b164a2ebec.text: 可以通宵下载或定时下载吗？— Mister Download Manager

7a8f7ce21924c5b5.source: Move from Internet Download Manager to Mister Download Manager: import an IDM export file (.ef2) or a text list of links, with referrers and cookies.
7a8f7ce21924c5b5.text: 从 Internet Download Manager 切换到 Mister Download Manager：导入 IDM 导出文件 (.ef2) 或包含来源和 Cookie 的文本链接列表。

7aad71c792353898.source: <g1>Open folder</g1> works on a torrent that is still downloading (<g2>#354</g2>).
7aad71c792353898.text: 对于仍在下载的种子，<g1>打开文件夹</g1>功能现在可以正常使用（<g2>#354</g2>）。

7ab13cf63ca91547.source: Every release lists the SHA-256 checksum of each file in <g1>SHA256SUMS.txt</g1>. On Windows, compare it with <x2/>; on macOS and Linux with <x3/>. All files are built from the public source by GitHub Actions; the build logs are on <g4>GitHub</g4>.
7ab13cf63ca91547.text: 每个发布版本都在<g1>SHA256SUMS.txt</g1>中列出了每个文件的 SHA-256 校验和。在 Windows 上，请与<x2/>进行比较；在 macOS 和 Linux 上，请与<x3/>进行比较。所有文件均由 GitHub Actions 从公共源代码构建；构建日志可在<g4>GitHub</g4>上查看。

7abae1f3c6a9aed0.source: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi

7acc73393492b437.source: Tick <g1>Limit all downloads together to</g1> and type a speed in KBytes/sec. A good start is about two thirds of your connection's speed. (1 MByte/sec is about 1000 KBytes/sec.)
7acc73393492b437.text: 勾选<g1>将所有下载总计限制为</g1>，并输入速度（单位为千字节/秒）。一个好的开始是您连接速度的大约三分之二。（1 兆字节/秒大约是 1000 千字节/秒。）

7ad7c17f54ce45b0.source: Add torrent with a torrent's files as a folder tree, the folder they go to, and Download Now
7ad7c17f54ce45b0.text: 添加种子窗口，显示种子中的文件树、保存位置文件夹和“立即下载”按钮

7ae273da4ef67ce4.source: Give the video's page address to <g1>Add URL</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>). MDM recognises video pages and opens the video window, already looking the page up.
7ae273da4ef67ce4.text: 将视频页面地址输入<g1>添加 URL</g1>（<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>）。MDM 会识别视频页面并打开视频窗口，同时开始查找该页面。

7afa9ff250e9d374.source: There are several ways to give MDM something to download. Most of them end in the same window, Download File Info, where you choose where the file goes.
7afa9ff250e9d374.text: 有几种方法可以给 MDM 添加下载任务。大多数方法都会打开同一个窗口，即“下载文件信息”，您可以在其中选择文件的保存位置。

7b0fa7fbdf8802b0.source: Out of the way. Still downloading.

7b0fd2a3655650fc.text: 您的登录信息保持私密

7b2d988fbba5a132.source: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, is the main platform. Builds for Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) come with every release too; today's are marked experimental. From version 0.5.0, Linux isn't experimental any more: it is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, in Wayland sessions too, and its packages in clean Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora systems. Still to come there: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet, and screen readers (Orca) don't read MDM's windows yet. macOS stays experimental. See Windows, Mac and Linux and Download.
7b2d988fbba5a132.text: Windows 10 和 11（64 位）是主要平台。每个版本也提供 Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm 和 .tar.gz) 和 macOS (.dmg) 版本；目前这些版本标记为实验性。从 0.5.0 版本开始，Linux 不再是实验性：它已在 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon（包括 Wayland 会话）以及纯净的 Ubuntu、Debian 和 Fedora 系统上进行过检查。仍有待完成：Flatpak Firefox 尚未检查，屏幕阅读器 (Orca) 尚无法读取 MDM 的窗口。macOS 仍保持实验性。请参阅 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 以及下载。

7b3a4b79acf13381.source: Options on its Proxy / Socks page, with Network adapter near the bottom set to Any (the system chooses)
7b3a4b79acf13381.text: 在其“代理/SOCKS”页面上的选项，其中“网卡”设置为“任何（系统选择）”

7b655c3076cd7d8b.source: <g1>Tasks → Import → From text file</g1> and <g2>From IDM export file</g2>. An <x3/> file brings each download's referrer and cookies.
7b655c3076cd7d8b.text: <g1>任务 → 导入 → 从文本文件</g1>和<g2>从 IDM 导出文件</g2>。<x3/>文件会包含每个下载的引用页和 Cookie。

7b75149d61c4c0ff.source: A download that is running isn't deleted. Stop it first.
7b75149d61c4c0ff.text: 正在下载的任务不会被删除。请先停止下载。

7b96ddc4c567caf5.source: Browsers installed as a Flatpak or a Snap run in a sandbox, which decides whether they can reach MDM.
7b96ddc4c567caf5.text: 以 Flatpak 或 Snap 形式安装的浏览器在沙盒中运行，能否访问 MDM 取决于沙盒设置。

7bbfd6a588b5c2c4.text: 工具提示文本换行位置

7bc0ec3db2a805ed.source: <g1>View → Interface size</g1> (<g2>#262</g2>): every window larger, 100 % to 200 %, on top of the system's display scale; <g3>Ctrl +</g3>, <g4>Ctrl −</g4> and <g5>Ctrl 0</g5> in any MDM window, as in a browser. Every open window follows at once (dialogs, menus, the drop target) and MDM starts at that size, the crash report window too. A window larger than the screen opens as large as the screen allows and scrolls the rest, its title bar on the screen.
7bc0ec3db2a805ed.text: <g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>（<g2>#262</g2>）：所有窗口放大，从 100% 到 200%，在系统显示缩放之上；在任何 MDM 窗口中，像浏览器一样使用 <g3>Ctrl +</g3>、<g4>Ctrl −</g4> 和 <g5>Ctrl 0</g5>。所有打开的窗口（对话框、菜单、拖放目标）会立即跟随调整，MDM 也会以该大小启动，崩溃报告窗口也一样。窗口大于屏幕时，会以屏幕允许的最大尺寸打开，其余部分可滚动，标题栏保持在屏幕上。

7bda8095d8381906.source: Other programs can ask the running app for its downloads, as JSON, and pause, start, remove or delete them. They connect to a port on this computer only, with a secret token that changes at every start and that only your own programs can read. The API is off until you turn it on with <x1/>, and <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/> and <x6/> use it from the command line.
7bda8095d8381906.text: 其他程序可以向正在运行的应用程序请求其下载任务（以 JSON 格式），并暂停、开始、移除或删除它们。它们仅连接到此计算机上的一个端口，使用每次启动时都会更改的秘密令牌，并且只有您自己的程序才能读取。API 默认关闭，直到您使用 <x1/> 开启它，并且 <x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/> 和 <x6/> 从命令行使用它。

7bde548eabfafc71.source: Eight per download by default, and up to 32 if you choose in Options → Connection, or 128 after ticking Allow more than 32 connections there. MDM uses fewer when a server allows fewer, and only one when a server can't send parts of a file at all.
7bde548eabfafc71.text: 默认情况下，每个下载使用八个连接。如果您在选项 → 连接中选择，最多可达32个；勾选允许超过32个连接后，可达128个。当服务器允许的连接数较少时，MDM会使用较少的连接；当服务器完全无法发送文件分段时，MDM只使用一个连接。

7beb76c0e99ab62c.source: <g1>Videos that need you signed in</g1>: <g2>Options → Sites Logins → Cookies for video sites</g2> lets yt-dlp read a browser's cookies, for pasted links. Chrome, Edge and Brave lock theirs on Windows, and the window says so; Firefox works, and so does the button over the video.
7beb76c0e99ab62c.text: <g1>需要登录才能观看的视频</g1>：<g2>选项 → 站点登录 → 视频网站的 Cookie</g2>允许 yt-dlp 读取浏览器的 Cookie，用于粘贴的链接。Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 在 Windows 上会锁定其 Cookie，窗口会提示；Firefox 可以正常工作，视频上方的按钮也可以。

7c13b99aeb6bd7c5.source: A playlist is listed whole, as its videos come in: the line above the list says how far it is ("Listing the videos: 1,200 of 6,000"). <g1>Stop listing</g1> keeps the ones listed so far, and <g2>List the rest</g2> carries on from there. If the site stops answering part-way (YouTube may, when it's asked too often), the window says after how many videos and why, and <g3>List the rest</g3> tries again from there.
7c13b99aeb6bd7c5.text: 播放列表会逐步列出其中的视频：列表上方会显示进度（“正在列出视频：6,000 个中的 1,200 个”）。<g1>停止列出</g1>会保留已列出的视频，<g2>列出其余部分</g2>会从那里继续。如果网站中途停止响应（YouTube 在请求过于频繁时可能会这样），窗口会显示已列出多少个视频以及原因，然后<g3>列出其余部分</g3>会从那里继续尝试。

7c262f198bfdda86.source: Point at a video on a web page and a small tab appears at its top corner: MDM's logo and a green <g1>Download video</g1> part, an arrow for its list and <g2>✕</g2> to hide it on this video. It follows Windows' light or dark mode. As it appears, MDM looks the video up (when MDM is running), and the button then names the best quality it found (<g3>1080p</g3>, <g4>4K</g4>). Click it and that quality downloads at once, with only its progress window; MDM's main window stays where it is (with <g5>Do not start downloading, only add files to the queue</g5> on in Options, it goes in the queue instead). Clicking while MDM is still looking works too: it takes the best quality as soon as it is known. A video that plays a plain file (not a stream) needs no look-up: the button shows its picture size and downloads the file itself. When nothing could be looked up (MDM wasn't running, yt-dlp isn't installed, the page is a playlist, or you send downloads to another MDM), a click opens the <g6>Download video from a page</g6> window, which says why and offers what to do.
7c262f198bfdda86.text: 当您将鼠标指向网页上的视频时，其顶部角落会出现一个小标签：MDM 的标志和绿色的<g1>下载视频</g1>部分，一个用于显示列表的箭头，以及一个<g2>✕</g2>用于在此视频上隐藏它。它会跟随 Windows 的浅色或深色模式。当它出现时，MDM 会查找视频（当 MDM 运行时），然后按钮会显示其找到的最佳画质（<g3>1080p</g3>、<g4>4K</g4>）。点击它，该画质会立即下载，只显示其进度窗口；MDM 的主窗口保持不变（如果“选项”中开启了<g5>不开始下载，只将文件添加到队列</g5>，则会进入队列）。在 MDM 仍在查找时点击也有效：一旦画质确定，它就会下载最佳画质。播放纯文件（非流媒体）的视频无需查找：按钮会显示其画面尺寸并下载文件本身。当无法查找时（MDM 未运行，未安装 yt-dlp，页面是播放列表，或者您将下载发送到另一个 MDM），点击会打开<g6>从页面下载视频</g6>窗口，其中说明了原因并提供了解决方案。

7ca97bd5e93217a8.source: Its progress window: each file and how much of it is here.
7ca97bd5e93217a8.text: 其进度窗口：显示每个文件及其已下载的百分比。

7ccdcbbf8262ca0f.source: Yes: every release has an AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz for Linux and a .dmg for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Today's are marked experimental; from version 0.5.0, Linux isn't, after checks on four desktops, and macOS stays experimental. <g1>More</g1>
7ccdcbbf8262ca0f.text: 是：每个版本都提供适用于 Linux 的 AppImage、.deb、.rpm 和 .tar.gz 包，以及适用于 Apple Silicon 和 Intel Mac 的 .dmg 包。目前这些版本标记为实验性；从 0.5.0 版本开始，Linux 版本在经过四个桌面环境的测试后将不再是实验性，而 macOS 版本仍将保持实验性。<g1>更多</g1>
