7cefc273f40903c0.text: 触发高亮显示的（默认）按钮；如果焦点位于按钮上，则按下该按钮

7cf5528b3b3918ab.source: With <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks → <g2>Network adapter</g2></g1> set, video downloads go through that adapter too, with the same kill switch as other downloads. MDM's own downloader opens its connections through the adapter as for any file; for yt-dlp's look-ups (and what it downloads itself, with the ffmpeg it starts) MDM hands it a proxy of its own on this computer, and opens every connection through the adapter, looking the names up with the DNS you chose in <g3>Options → Connection</g3> (without an adapter, yt-dlp uses the system's DNS). When the adapter disconnects, the video download stops, and it starts again when the adapter is back. Formats sent over RTMP, RTSP, MMS or FTP can't go through it and are refused.
7cf5528b3b3918ab.text: 设置<g1>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → <g2>网络适配器</g2></g1>后，视频下载也会通过该适配器进行，并具有与其他下载相同的终止开关。MDM 自己的下载器会像任何文件一样通过适配器打开其连接；对于 yt-dlp 的查找（以及它自己下载的内容，以及它启动的 ffmpeg），MDM 会在此计算机上为其提供自己的代理，并通过适配器打开每个连接，使用您在<g3>选项 → 连接</g3>中选择的 DNS 查找名称（如果没有适配器，yt-dlp 会使用系统的 DNS）。当适配器断开连接时，视频下载会停止，并在适配器恢复时重新开始。通过 RTMP、RTSP、MMS 或 FTP 发送的格式无法通过它，将被拒绝。

7cf59d4d39884c03.source: <g1>That you use MDM.</g1> Peers see the name "MisterDownloadManager" and its major version, not the exact build.
7cf59d4d39884c03.text: <g1>您正在使用 MDM。</g1>对等方会看到“MisterDownloadManager”这个名称及其主版本号，但看不到具体的构建版本。

7d3af2ef0e680bca.text: 通过多个连接下载文件时的进度窗口

7d71c5be1f245ab6.source: <g1>Commit size</g1> is memory MDM has reserved, whether in use or not.
7d71c5be1f245ab6.text: <g1>提交大小</g1>是 MDM 已保留的内存，无论是否在使用。

7d85e3a7a0f5dbf9.source: Starts with the computer, without getting in front

7d9a75bcfa07d198.source: It asks sites for one picture a second at most, and names itself as MDM, because some servers, Wikimedia's among them, refuse tools that ask faster or without a name. It uses no configuration file of yours.
7d9a75bcfa07d198.text: 它最多每秒向网站请求一张图片，并自称为 MDM，因为某些服务器（包括维基媒体的服务器）会拒绝请求过快或未命名的工具。它不使用您的任何配置文件。

7d9ceeedcf5266a6.source: MDM checks its own downloads too
7d9ceeedcf5266a6.text: MDM 也会检查自己的下载

7db9ed501785d447.source: <g1>Quality</g1> applies to every video: <g2>Best quality</g2>, <g3>Up to</g3> a height (each video at that height, or the nearest below it), <g4>Audio only, original</g4>, <g5>Audio only MP3</g5>, <g6>Audio only OPUS</g6> or <g7>Audio only FLAC</g7>. Without ffmpeg, only the qualities that come with their sound are offered, and no MP3, Opus or FLAC.
7db9ed501785d447.text: <g1>画质</g1>适用于所有视频：<g2>最佳质量</g2>、<g3>最高</g3>高度（每个视频下载该高度或最接近的较低高度）、<g4>仅音频，原始</g4>、<g5>仅音频 MP3</g5>、<g6>仅音频 OPUS</g6>或<g7>仅音频 FLAC</g7>。没有 ffmpeg 时，只提供带有音频的视频画质选项，不提供 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC。

7de0ee28024da88e.source: <g1>Tasks → Torrent settings → Open magnet links and .torrent files with Mister Download Manager</g1> does write to the registry, for your Windows account only. Leave it off to keep the portable copy registry-free.
7de0ee28024da88e.text: <g1>任务 → 种子设置 → 使用 Mister Download Manager 打开磁力链接和 .torrent 文件</g1>会写入注册表，但只影响当前 Windows 帐户。关闭此选项即可让便携版不使用注册表。

7df323245c8cc9b5.text: 视频下载 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

7e003eeb98d38711.text: 它是真的免费，还是试用版？

7e0f0fb8c60306bf.source: <g1>Default max. conn. number</g1> — how many connections each download may use, from 1 to 32 (8 by default). Type the number or use the arrows.
7e0f0fb8c60306bf.text: <g1>默认最大连接数</g1> — 每个下载可使用的连接数为 1 到 32（默认为 8）。输入数字或使用箭头调整。

7e34624a653bd43b.source: A file name sent by a site in plain UTF-8 now reaches MDM readable from Firefox and browsers built on it, such as Floorp, Waterfox and Zen: an Arabic name was saved as unreadable symbols (<g1>#447</g1>). A name written with percent signs in the same header is decoded as well. The add-on carries the fix
7e34624a653bd43b.text: 网站以纯 UTF-8 编码发送的文件名现在可以从 Firefox 及基于其构建的浏览器（如 Floorp、Waterfox 和 Zen）中清晰地显示在 MDM 中：以前阿拉伯语名称会保存为无法读取的符号（<g1>#447</g1>）。同一标头中带有百分号的文件名也会被解码。此修复已包含在附加组件中。

7e586eb111b09b23.source: Control Mister Download Manager from your phone on your home network: add links and torrents, pause and start downloads, run queues. Paired devices only.
7e586eb111b09b23.text: 在您的家庭网络上通过手机控制 Mister Download Manager：添加链接和种子，暂停和开始下载，运行队列。仅限已配对设备。

7e65341170033bf2.source: The user guide and tutorials, this file, the benchmark data; the website makes the guide its help pages, which Help opens
7e65341170033bf2.text: 用户指南和教程，此文件，基准数据；网站将此指南作为其帮助页面，点击“帮助”即可打开

7e729f39edba105a.source: <g1>MDM follows every kind of redirect a browser does</g1> (<g2>#28</g2>): any HTTP redirect (301, 302, 303, 307, 308), up to 20 in a row instead of 10, and the pages download sites put in between ("your download starts in a moment"), which lead on with a <x3/> header or a <x4/>: their wait is kept (up to 10 seconds), and the cookies they set go along while the download runs (not into a resume later). A page that leads on only through its own script still stops there.
7e729f39edba105a.text: <g1>MDM 遵循浏览器处理的各种重定向</g1>（<g2>#28</g2>）：任何 HTTP 重定向（301、302、303、307、308），最多连续 20 次而不是 10 次，以及下载网站在中间插入的页面（“您的下载即将开始”），这些页面通过 <x3/> 标头或 <x4/> 继续：它们的等待时间会保留（最多 10 秒），并且它们设置的 cookie 会在下载运行时一起发送（不会在稍后恢复时发送）。仅通过自身脚本继续的页面仍然会停止在那里。

7e7bffb22a4c1aa5.source: <g1>Adwaita</g1>: GNOME's look: round corners, flat grey buttons, a rounded focus ring, GNOME's check boxes, a header bar with the title in bold and round buttons (on Windows, where MDM draws it), and GNOME's Adwaita icons, in colour for files and categories, one colour in the toolbar.
7e7bffb22a4c1aa5.text: <g1>Adwaita</g1>：GNOME 的外观：圆角、扁平的灰色按钮、圆形的焦点环、GNOME 的复选框、带有粗体标题和圆形按钮的标题栏（在 Windows 上，由 MDM 绘制），以及 GNOME 的 Adwaita 图标，文件和类别为彩色，工具栏为单色。

7e92ca3591a44f50.source: Helium installs it from the same page, as long as Helium may download extensions: see <g1>Helium</g1>.
7e92ca3591a44f50.text: 只要 Helium 允许下载扩展，它就会从同一页面安装：请参阅<g1>Helium</g1>。

7e997f3f6fbc646c.text: 扩展程序无法读取此网站

7e9b5f493f60eac4.source: By default MDM asks what to do when you add an address it already has. You can choose a fixed answer in <g1>Options → Downloads → If a duplicate download link is added</g1>:
7e9b5f493f60eac4.text: 默认情况下，当您添加一个已有的地址时，MDM 会询问如何处理。您可以在<g1>选项 → 下载 → 如果添加了重复的下载链接</g1>中选择一个固定答案：

7eb542d3a6bc3fb8.source: The file's size, when the server told it.
7eb542d3a6bc3fb8.text: 服务器提供文件大小时显示该大小。

7ee169488133ab57.source: Link grabber gathers many links at once, sorts them into packages, and lets you tick the ones to download. MDM can then extract the archives it downloaded…
7ee169488133ab57.text: 链接抓取器可一次收集多个链接，将它们整理到不同的包中，并让您勾选要下载的链接。之后，MDM 还可以提取下载的存档…

7f06477bf6037af8.source: A window in MDM may be waiting for you (a question, <g1>Add torrent</g1>); answer it and ask again.
7f06477bf6037af8.text: MDM 中可能有窗口正等待您操作（例如问题提示或<g1>添加种子</g1>）；请先处理，然后重试。

7f0667de08ce7313.source: Firefox (from addons.mozilla.org), Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi (from the Chrome Web Store), through the MDM browser extension, and browsers built on them: Zen and LibreWolf, Helium. The extension hands downloads to MDM with their cookies and referrer, so files behind a sign-in still work, and it adds Download with Mister Download Manager to the right-click menu and a Download video button over videos. See Browser integration.
7f0667de08ce7313.text: Firefox（来自 addons.mozilla.org）、Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi（来自 Chrome 网上应用店）可通过 MDM 浏览器扩展程序使用；Zen、LibreWolf 和 Helium 等基于这些浏览器构建的浏览器也支持。该扩展程序会将下载任务连同 Cookie 和来源页信息交给 MDM，因此需要登录才能访问的文件也可以下载。它还会在右键菜单中添加使用 Mister Download Manager 下载，并在视频上方添加下载视频按钮。请参阅浏览器集成。

7f2b3156563a771b.source: Stopped, or after a restart, the download continues where it was: the service isn't sent the torrent again, and files already downloaded aren't downloaded again.
7f2b3156563a771b.text: 停止下载或重启后，下载会从中断处继续。MDM 不会再次将种子发送给服务，也不会重新下载已下载的文件。

7f2bfe6b9f5735b0.source: Hidden in the notification area, MDM hands the memory it isn't using back to the system. Task Manager's <g1>Memory</g1> for MDM drops from about 50 MB to under 10 MB there, and MDM gives memory back again every 10 minutes while it stays hidden. On Linux it does the same with its free memory.
7f2bfe6b9f5735b0.text: 隐藏在通知区域时，MDM 会将其未使用的内存交还给系统。任务管理器的 MDM <g1>内存</g1>会从大约 50 MB 下降到 10 MB 以下，并且 MDM 在保持隐藏状态时每 10 分钟会再次释放内存。在 Linux 上，它也会以同样的方式处理其空闲内存。

7f4f7a0d17c64cfa.source: Tick <g1>Let phones and computers on the local network control MDM</g1>.
7f4f7a0d17c64cfa.text: 勾选<g1>允许本地网络上的手机和电脑控制 MDM</g1>。

7f50cb9ccd546bfc.text: 在 GitHub 上赞助创作者

7f571de697da32a1.source: Tick <g1>Launch Mister Download Manager on startup</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> and MDM starts when you sign in, hidden, its icon in the notification area. Its downloads, queues, the <g3>Scheduler</g3> and downloads from the browser all run from there. Click the icon, or start MDM again, and the window opens as usual.
7f571de697da32a1.text: 在<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中勾选<g1>启动时运行 Mister Download Manager</g1>，MDM 就会在您登录时隐藏启动，其图标显示在通知区域。所有下载、队列、<g3>计划程序</g3>以及来自浏览器的下载都将从那里运行。点击图标或再次启动 MDM，窗口将照常打开。

7f5c3e858ef54b57.source: To run MDM on a home server instead, see <g1>Server mode</g1>.
7f5c3e858ef54b57.text: 要在家庭服务器上运行 MDM，请参阅<g1>服务器模式</g1>。

7f61eb0e95782c1a.source: Your debrid account, with every connection MDM has.
7f61eb0e95782c1a.text: 您的网盘账户，MDM 的所有连接都可用。

7f6e9b487e59c00f.source: The list shows the queue's downloads in the order they will run. The arrow buttons under it move the selected download down or up; the cross takes it out of the queue.
7f6e9b487e59c00f.text: 此列表按下载运行的顺序显示队列中的下载。列表下方的箭头按钮可将选定的下载向上或向下移动；叉号按钮可将其从队列中移除。

7f766e56cac844dc.source: The accent: focus lines, open and default controls, filters, links' focus
7f766e56cac844dc.text: 强调色：焦点线、打开和默认控件、过滤器、链接焦点

7f770ae470480a05.source: To skip that question and always use the <g1>Main download queue</g1>, turn off <g2>Options → Downloads → Show queue selection panel on pressing "Download Later" button</g2>.
7f770ae470480a05.text: 要跳过此问题并始终使用<g1>主下载队列</g1>，请关闭<g2>选项 → 下载 → 按“稍后下载”按钮时显示队列选择面板</g2>。

7f79702d18f48f44.source: <g1>Limits</g1>: stop sharing at a share ratio or after some minutes, and cap what torrents send, all together or one by one.
7f79702d18f48f44.text: <g1>限制</g1>：达到共享率或经过一定时间后停止共享，并限制种子发送的总量，可以全部一起限制，也可以逐个限制。

7f7bfe78bf5b687c.source: The window no longer freezes while watching the clipboard when the program holding it hangs, or while a cancelled download's files are removed from a slow disk (<g1>#418</g1>, <g2>#423</g2>).
7f7bfe78bf5b687c.text: 当持有剪贴板的程序挂起时，窗口不再在监视剪贴板时卡顿；当取消的下载文件从慢速磁盘中移除时，窗口也不再卡顿（<g1>#418</g1>、<g2>#423</g2>）。

7f9e86d9863d7f96.source: A report holds the error, where it happened, MDM's recent log, and your system: MDM's version, how it was installed, your operating system, the processor, the language and theme, and how many downloads and queues you have, as counts only.
7f9e86d9863d7f96.text: 报告包含错误、发生位置、MDM 的最新日志以及您的系统信息：MDM 版本、安装方式、操作系统、处理器、语言和主题，以及您拥有的下载和队列数量（仅计数）。

7fa6f9417a745711.source: <g1>Buttons fit their text in every language, in every window</g1> (<g2>#192</g2>): many windows gave their buttons a width made for English, so a longer translation was cut with "..." (German <g3>Später herunterla...</g3> in Download File Info, <g4>Hilfsprogramme...</g4> in Download a gallery, Russian <g5>Открыть с помощью...</g5> in Download complete, French <g6>Nouvelle file d’attente</g6> in the Scheduler). Each button is now as wide as its translated text, and the buttons beside it move along with the same gaps, the row keeping its end; a box or caption beside a widened button ends before it. Where a window has no room left, the buttons wider than their text give some back first. English is unchanged, and in Arabic and the other right-to-left languages the buttons widen the mirrored way.
7fa6f9417a745711.text: <g1>在所有语言和所有窗口中，按钮都能适应其文本长度</g1> (<g2>#192</g2>)：许多窗口的按钮宽度是为英文设计的，因此较长的翻译会被“...”截断（例如“下载文件信息”中的德语 <g3>Später herunterla...</g3>，“下载图库”中的 <g4>Hilfsprogramme...</g4>，“下载完成”中的俄语 <g5>Открыть с помощью...</g5>，“计划程序”中的法语 <g6>Nouvelle file d’attente</g6>）。现在每个按钮的宽度都与其翻译文本的长度一致，旁边的按钮也会随之移动，保持相同的间距，行尾保持不变；加宽按钮旁边的框或标题会在按钮之前结束。如果窗口没有剩余空间，则宽度超出文本的按钮会先缩小。英文界面保持不变，在阿拉伯语和其他从右到左的语言中，按钮会以镜像方式加宽。

7fc6f4be3515bc1a.source: <g1>Help → Check for updates...</g1> — <g2>Check for updates at every start</g2> is in that window.
7fc6f4be3515bc1a.text: <g1>帮助 → 检查更新…</g1> — <g2>每次启动时检查更新</g2>在该窗口中。

7fce2d2d4f446d51.source: For downloads already in the list:
7fce2d2d4f446d51.text: 对于已在列表中的下载：

7fea6520d723f668.source: <g1>Add torrent: the labels fit in every language</g1>: in German, <g2>Speichern unter</g2> ran under its field.
7fea6520d723f668.text: <g1>添加种子：标签在所有语言中都能适应</g1>：在德语中，<g2>另存为</g2>会超出其字段。

7ffd827fb0a1bcea.source: <g1>Sequential download support:</g1> download a torrent in order, so you can watch it while it downloads.
7ffd827fb0a1bcea.text: <g1>顺序下载支持：</g1> 按顺序下载种子文件，以便您可以在下载时观看。

8000c69387905255.source: If someone already reported the same problem, the window says so and <g1>Open the reported issue</g1> takes you there, with your report on the clipboard to add as a comment.
8000c69387905255.text: 如果有人已经报告了相同的问题，窗口会显示此信息，并且<g1>打开已报告的问题</g1>会带您前往该问题，您的报告已复制到剪贴板，可作为评论添加。

8004bfee90ddaa59.source: Starts (or with <x1/>, stops) the queue of that name (a name from the list's <x2/>). Answers <x3/>, or <x4/>. Only while the API is on.
8004bfee90ddaa59.text: 启动（或使用 <x1/> 停止）该名称的队列（列表中的 <x2/> 名称）。回答 <x3/> 或 <x4/>。仅在 API 开启时可用。

8010227c219a4c6e.source: Files downloaded from the web are marked as downloaded from the internet, as the browser marks its own: Windows' Mark of the Web (SmartScreen, Office's Protected View), macOS' quarantine.
8010227c219a4c6e.text: 从网络下载的文件会被标记为从互联网下载，就像浏览器标记自己的文件一样：Windows 的网络标记（SmartScreen、Office 的受保护视图）、macOS 的隔离区。

801512d2726be7fc.source: With a VPN or proxy program, allow connections to <x1/> (your own computer): the browser's helper reaches MDM through one.
801512d2726be7fc.text: 使用 VPN 或代理程序时，请允许连接到 <x1/>（您自己的计算机）：浏览器的辅助程序通过它连接到 MDM。

802bfd4bcc1b177c.source: <g1>Your proxy</g1>, if you set one in <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks</g2>, and your network's proxy auto-config script, if you point MDM at one.
802bfd4bcc1b177c.text: <g1>您的代理</g1>，如果您在<g2>选项 → 代理/Socks</g2>中设置了代理，以及您网络的代理自动配置脚本，如果您将 MDM 指向其中一个。

803aca98647fa373.source: <g1>Block the addresses in this list</g1> takes the address of a public IP blocklist, in the P2P (PeerGuardian) or eMule <x2/> format, plain or gzipped. MDM downloads it with its own downloader (your Proxy / Socks settings apply), checks it, and fetches it again every 7 days. Peers in it are refused. A list MDM can't read is left out, and the last good one stays. The engine reads the list when it starts.
803aca98647fa373.text: <g1>阻止此列表中的地址</g1>使用公共 IP 地址屏蔽列表的网址，支持 P2P (PeerGuardian) 或 eMule <x2/> 格式，也支持纯文本或 gzip 压缩格式。MDM 会使用自己的下载器获取列表（适用您的代理/Socks 设置），检查列表，并每 7 天重新获取一次。列表中的对等方会被拒绝连接。MDM 无法读取的列表会被忽略，并继续使用上次成功读取的列表。种子引擎会在启动时读取列表。

8043051a722a1eb8.source: The 80 MB universal Mac download: there's now one for Apple Silicon and one for Intel. Coming from 0.2.4, update once by hand: <g1>Download</g1> in Check for updates opens the release.
8043051a722a1eb8.text: 80 MB 的通用 Mac 下载包：现在分为 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 两种。从 0.2.4 更新的用户，请手动更新一次：在“检查更新”中点击<g1>下载</g1>即可打开发布页面。

804cb7dcc4ab8f45.source: <g1><x2/></g1> for <x3/>: every command prints JSON for scripts and AI agents, downloads as one <x4/> line per half second and then <x5/> or <x6/> (<g7>the formats</g7>).
804cb7dcc4ab8f45.text: <g1><x2/></g1> 用于 <x3/>：每个命令都会为脚本和 AI 代理打印 JSON，每半秒下载一行 <x4/>，然后是 <x5/> 或 <x6/>（<g7>格式</g7>）。

804d86a6a9ef1d57.text: 连接和速度 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

808baf7055af563c.text: 添加下载 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

8095066d80c0e857.text: “属性”中，往返时间较短（低于 60 毫秒）的下载服务器

80a8b3ec512d72f0.source: <g1>Archives extracted</g1><g2>ZIP, TAR and more extracted as they arrive, 7z and RAR with 7-Zip, split archives once complete.</g2>
80a8b3ec512d72f0.text: <g1>自动解压压缩包</g1><g2>ZIP、TAR 等格式的压缩包在下载完成后自动解压；7z 和 RAR 格式通过 7-Zip 解压；分卷压缩包在全部下载完成后解压。</g2>

80c074e4020e15bb.text: Windows，仅限您（安装程序的默认设置）

80d1105b9bfc4a7e.source: Some servers allow only a few connections. MDM notices this and stops asking that server for more. What it has learned shows in <g1>Options → Connection</g1> under <g2>Exceptions</g2>, marked <g3>(auto)</g3>.
80d1105b9bfc4a7e.text: 有些服务器只允许少量连接。MDM 会检测到这一点，并停止向该服务器请求更多连接。MDM 记录的信息会显示在<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>下的<g2>例外</g2>中，并标记为<g3>(auto)</g3>。

80d1a415cf94ac33.source: a live stream still being recorded;

80e9996878579eac.source: <g1>Tests no longer make Windows Firewall ask about them.</g1> The torrent tests and test tools listen on 127.0.0.1 only (a new setting of the torrent engine, its listen address), so each new build of a test no longer opens sockets on every address.
80e9996878579eac.text: <g1>测试不再让 Windows 防火墙询问相关问题。</g1> 种子测试和测试工具仅监听 127.0.0.1（种子引擎的新设置，其监听地址），因此每个新的测试构建不再在每个地址上打开套接字。

80ecaf76d9fa7658.source: If <g1>Resume capability</g1> is <g2>No</g2>, the server can't send a file in parts. MDM then downloads it over one connection, and a download that stops has to start over.
80ecaf76d9fa7658.text: 如果<g1>恢复功能</g1>为<g2>否</g2>，服务器就无法分段发送文件。MDM 会通过一个连接下载文件；如果下载停止，就必须从头开始。

80f30807306005d1.source: Control your downloads from an AI assistant (MCP server) — Mister Download Manager
80f30807306005d1.text: 通过 AI 助手（MCP 服务器）控制下载 — Mister Download Manager

81030a84bae36e5b.text: <g1>为项目点赞</g1><g2>这有助于其他人找到它。</g2>

810aeb3bcab43ab3.text: 洪流任务上传给对等方的数据量与从对等方下载的数据量之比。

81750d1f6af5701b.source: Tick <g1>Extract archives when their download completes</g1> in <g2>Options → Archives</g2> (it is off by default), and every archive is extracted as soon as it is in. Or right-click a finished archive and choose <g3>Extract</g3>. A split archive, such as <x4/> and the parts after it, is extracted once, when its last volume arrives.
81750d1f6af5701b.text: 在<g2>选项 → 压缩包</g2>中勾选<g1>下载完成后提取存档</g1>（默认关闭），所有压缩包下载完成后都会立即解压。或者右键点击已完成的压缩包，选择<g3>提取</g3>。分卷压缩包，例如<x4/>及其后续部分，将在最后一个分卷到达后一次性解压。

818a189cf94962b0.source: Does MDM collect my data? — Mister Download Manager
818a189cf94962b0.text: MDM 会收集我的数据吗？— Mister Download Manager

818f85cc4313eea3.text: 强调按钮被按下时的文本

8194da6d2ed769e2.source: The extension's button shows whether the browser reaches MDM. A red <g1>!</g1> means it doesn't; click the button to see why, and <g2>How to fix it</g2> opens the matching section of <g3>The browser and MDM aren't connected</g3>. The button also:
8194da6d2ed769e2.text: 扩展程序的按钮会显示浏览器是否能连接到 MDM。红色的 <g1>!</g1> 表示无法连接；点击按钮可查看原因，“<g2>如何修复</g2>”会打开“<g3>浏览器和 MDM 未连接</g3>”中对应的部分。按钮还可以：

81b50fe3972d72af.source: <g1>Offline (404)</g1>: it doesn't. The link is unticked.
81b50fe3972d72af.text: <g1>离线（404）</g1>：服务器上没有该文件。该链接不会被勾选。

81ce8b1ef8bffcb0.source: MDM's interface comes in 86 languages: every display language Windows 11 offers, from Afrikaans to Vietnamese, including both Chinese scripts, Spanish for…
81ce8b1ef8bffcb0.text: MDM 界面支持 86 种语言：Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，从南非荷兰语到越南语，包括两种中文字体、西班牙语等…

81e129770ec4dcbd.source: a stream sent over RTMP, RTSP, MMS or FTP;
81e129770ec4dcbd.text: 通过 RTMP、RTSP、MMS 或 FTP 发送的流；

821e4ece0c595969.source: <g1>Keep some speed for everything else</g1> walks through the settings step by step.
821e4ece0c595969.text: <g1>为其他活动保留一些速度</g1>将逐步引导您完成设置。

82214b19e565baff.source: Pick it in <g1>View → Theme</g1>, and look at both sides: <g2>View → Always dark</g2> on and off. Check that text is readable and the focus mark visible in both.
82214b19e565baff.text: 在<g1>视图 → 主题</g1>中选择它，并查看两侧：<g2>视图 → 始终为深色</g2>的开启和关闭状态。检查文本是否可读，以及焦点标记在两种模式下是否可见。

82268b57f7ea4db3.source: <g1>Use system settings</g1> — use the system's proxy: Windows' or macOS' settings, or on Linux the <x2/>, <x3/> and <x4/> variables of your session.
82268b57f7ea4db3.text: <g1>使用系统设置</g1> — 使用系统的代理：Windows 或 macOS 的设置，或者 Linux 上您会话的 <x2/>、<x3/> 和 <x4/> 变量。

823467d84a23926f.source: The download list and settings are in <x1/> (<x2/>); on Linux in <x3/>, on a Mac in <x4/>. A portable copy keeps them in its <x5/> folder instead. Downloaded files go to your <g6>Downloads</g6> folder, sorted into a folder per category; you can change that in <g7>Options → Save to</g7>.
823467d84a23926f.text: 下载列表和设置保存在 <x1/> (<x2/>) 中；在 Linux 上保存在 <x3/> 中，在 Mac 上保存在 <x4/> 中。便携版则将其保存在 <x5/> 文件夹中。下载的文件会保存到您的 <g6>下载</g6> 文件夹，并按类别分类到子文件夹中；您可以在<g7>选项 → 保存到</g7> 中更改此设置。

824bc9d6c6ab7883.source: The tools don't show up at all

824f800df429a7d9.source: A browser fetches a file over one connection. MDM asks the server for several parts of the file at once, up to 32 connections (128 if you allow it), and keeps re-splitting: when a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the biggest part still left, so no slow connection holds up the end. It also remembers servers that refuse extra connections and stops asking them. See Connections and speed.
824f800df429a7d9.text: 浏览器通过一个连接获取文件。MDM 会同时向服务器请求文件的多个部分，最多 32 个连接（如果允许，可达 128 个），并持续重新拆分：当一个连接完成其部分后，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，这样就不会有慢速连接拖延整个下载。它还会记住拒绝额外连接的服务器，并停止向它们请求。请参阅连接和速度。

825031e6ace12073.source: Click a download link and <g1>Download File Info</g1> opens in MDM instead of the browser's own download bar. MDM gets the address together with the page it came from, your cookies for the site and the browser's User-Agent, so a download that needs you to be signed in still works. The browser's copy is cancelled and taken off its download list.
825031e6ace12073.text: 点击下载链接后，MDM 会打开<g1>下载文件信息</g1>窗口，而不是浏览器自带的下载栏。MDM 会获取下载地址、来源页面、您在该网站的 Cookie 以及浏览器的 User-Agent，因此需要登录才能下载的文件也能正常工作。浏览器本身的下载会被取消并从其下载列表中移除。

827d5df0769ca662.source: Yes. Copy a link to a file and MDM offers to download it at once (<g1>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g1>, on by default). You can also paste links into <g2>Add URL</g2>, drag them onto the drop target, add a whole batch, or use the command line. See <g3>Adding downloads</g3>.
827d5df0769ca662.text: 是的。复制文件链接后，MDM 会立即提供下载（<g1>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g1>，默认开启）。您也可以将链接粘贴到<g2>添加 URL</g2>中，将其拖放到目标区域，添加一整批，或使用命令行。请参阅<g3>添加下载</g3>。

82889cb817f4eb65.source: <g1>Take downloads from this browser</g1>: untick it to pause, and every download stays with the browser until you tick it again.
82889cb817f4eb65.text: <g1>从此浏览器接管下载</g1>：取消勾选可暂停接管，之后的下载都会由浏览器处理，直到您再次勾选。

82a5d8b104cd86f2.source: The same setting is in <g1>Options → Connection</g1>.
82a5d8b104cd86f2.text: 相同的设置位于<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>中。

82aaa69856a510cf.source: The extension works in <g1>Google Chrome</g1>, <g2>Microsoft Edge</g2>, <g3>Brave</g3>, <g4>Opera</g4> and <g5>Vivaldi</g5>, in <g6>Firefox</g6> 140 or later, and in <g7>Safari</g7> 17 or later on a Mac (see <g8>Safari</g8>).
82aaa69856a510cf.text: 此扩展程序适用于 <g1>Google Chrome</g1>、<g2>Microsoft Edge</g2>、<g3>Brave</g3>、<g4>Opera</g4> 和 <g5>Vivaldi</g5>，以及 <g6>Firefox</g6> 140 或更高版本，和 Mac 上的 <g7>Safari</g7> 17 或更高版本（请参阅 <g8>Safari</g8>）。

82c694679649336e.source: A limit per file, or for one download
82c694679649336e.text: 按文件或按下载任务限制速度

82d6ded95ec8b5ce.source: In <g1>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Settings...</g1>, tick <g2>Limit all downloads together to</g2> and type a speed in KBytes/sec. However many files are downloading, together they stay under it. It works on its own: there is nothing else to turn on. About two thirds of your connection's speed is a good start.
82d6ded95ec8b5ce.text: 在<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 设置...</g1>中，勾选<g2>将所有下载总计限制为</g2>，并输入一个以千字节/秒为单位的速度。无论有多少文件正在下载，它们的总速度都会保持在此限制之下。它会自动生效，无需额外开启。建议将速度设置为您网络连接速度的大约三分之二。

8322754bd95444e4.source: A link sent from the browser no longer fails with 403 on sites that refuse a browser's User-Agent on a connection that isn't a browser's: MDM asks once more with its own, as Add URL does (<g1>#372</g1>).
8322754bd95444e4.text: 从浏览器发送的链接不再因某些网站拒绝非浏览器连接上的浏览器 User-Agent 而导致 403 错误：MDM 会像“添加 URL”一样，再次使用自己的 User-Agent 进行请求（<g1>#372</g1>）。

83380c90a67e0771.source: The sign-in is kept in the system's keychain: Windows Credential Manager, the keyring on Linux, the macOS keychain. Without an unlocked one, it stays in MDM's own settings, and <g1>Options → Accounts</g1> says where it is. MDM sends a service only the links you download through it, with your token. The direct link is never shown or copied, since the services forbid sharing it, and the token is never written to MDM's log, crash reports or the command line's output. MDM asks each service well under its request limit.
83380c90a67e0771.text: 登录信息保存在系统的密钥链中：Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环、macOS 密钥链。如果没有解锁的密钥链，它会保存在 MDM 自己的设置中，<g1>选项 → 账户</g1>会显示其位置。MDM 只会向服务发送您通过它下载的链接以及您的令牌。直链绝不会显示或复制，因为服务禁止共享它，并且令牌绝不会写入 MDM 的日志、崩溃报告或命令行输出。MDM 向每个服务发出的请求远低于其请求限制。

834245161edd087c.source: A slow start no longer makes MDM give up on Direct3D and stay on OpenGL.
834245161edd087c.text: 启动缓慢不再导致 MDM 放弃 Direct3D 而停留在 OpenGL。

835acf9391f083d1.source: Was MDM installed with the setup, with <g1>Set up browser integration</g1> ticked? A portable copy can't take browser downloads. Run the setup again to add it.
835acf9391f083d1.text: MDM 是否通过安装程序安装，并勾选了<g1>设置浏览器集成</g1>？便携版无法接管浏览器下载。请重新运行安装程序以添加浏览器集成。

835d0e251835f1b5.source: <g1>Tasks</g1> — add downloads, torrents, magnet links, batch downloads and videos from a page; <g2>Torrent settings</g2>; <g3>Link grabber</g3>; <g4>RSS feeds</g4>; show the drop target; import and export the list; exit.
835d0e251835f1b5.text: <g1>任务</g1> — 添加下载、种子、磁力链接、批量下载和网页视频；<g2>种子设置</g2>；<g3>链接抓取器</g3>；<g4>RSS 源</g4>；显示拖放目标；导入和导出列表；退出。

83771adf9df51604.source: Windows wakes a computer only if its power plan allows wake timers. If it doesn't, the Scheduler says so, and <g1>Change</g1> opens the setting: <g2>Power Options → Change plan settings → Change advanced power settings → Sleep → Allow wake timers</g2>. Choose <g3>Enable</g3>: <g4>Important Wake Timers Only</g4> lets only Windows' own important timers wake the computer. On laptops the setting is often off on battery, so the computer is woken only while plugged in.

844d3712af7e5da9.source: <g1>Brave Origin connects, and the AppImage's helper is always there</g1> (<g2>#253</g2>): Brave Origin keeps its settings in a folder of its own (<x3/>), which MDM didn't know, so its extension said MDM wasn't installed. MDM now sets up Brave Origin, the Beta, Dev and Nightly versions of Brave, Chrome and Edge, and Vivaldi's snapshot; on macOS, Brave reads Chrome's folder, which MDM now writes for it. From the AppImage, MDM copies the helper program the browsers start out of the AppImage under a new name and swaps it in, so a browser still running the old copy no longer keeps the new one out, and puts it back at each start if it went missing. A copy or setup that fails is written to MDM's log, and <g4>Test browser integration</g4> says when the helper program is missing, when no browser was found, or why setting it up failed.
844d3712af7e5da9.text: <g1>Brave Origin 已连接，AppImage 的辅助程序始终存在</g1> (<g2>#253</g2>)：Brave Origin 将其设置保存在自己的文件夹中 (<x3/>)，MDM 之前不知道此文件夹，因此其扩展程序显示 MDM 未安装。MDM 现在会设置 Brave Origin、Brave 的 Beta、Dev 和 Nightly 版本、Chrome 和 Edge，以及 Vivaldi 的快照；在 macOS 上，Brave 读取 Chrome 的文件夹，MDM 现在会为其写入。对于 AppImage，MDM 会将浏览器启动的辅助程序从 AppImage 复制到新名称下并替换，这样正在运行旧副本的浏览器就不会阻止新副本，并且如果辅助程序丢失，每次启动时都会重新放置。复制或设置失败会写入 MDM 日志，<g4>测试浏览器集成</g4> 会说明辅助程序缺失、未找到浏览器或设置失败的原因。

875a0aa9fd4c9ada.source: <g1>A finished download no longer fails with "part file still in use" on a busy computer</g1> (<g2>#201</g2>): when the last bytes came in, the connections still running were cut off. One cut off while it read or wrote the part file (checking the bytes before a reconnect, for example) left that read or write to finish on its own, with the file still open, and renaming the finished file failed. The connections are now told to stop and waited for, when a download completes and when it is stopped or fails, so none of them outlives it. A stopped download's last writes are also in its saved progress now.
875a0aa9fd4c9ada.text: <g1>在繁忙的电脑上，已完成的下载不再因“部分文件仍在使用中”而失败</g1>（<g2>#201</g2>）：当最后字节传入时，仍在运行的连接被切断。一个在读取或写入部分文件时被切断的连接（例如，在重新连接之前检查字节）会使其读取或写入自行完成，文件仍处于打开状态，并且重命名已完成的文件失败。现在，当下载完成、停止或失败时，会通知连接停止并等待它们，因此没有连接会比下载本身更长寿。停止下载的最后写入现在也包含在其保存的进度中。

87c0ec1d01442f09.text: 流媒体的分块（片段）不会列出。受版权保护的流媒体（DRM：Widevine、PlayReady、FairPlay；大多数付费流媒体服务都使用这些技术）会标记为<g1>受保护</g1>，且不提供<g2>下载</g2>按钮：任何工具都不能绕过这种保护，MDM 也不会尝试。

87ff7e81ac4516d8.source: What keeps the remote control safe, in short:
87ff7e81ac4516d8.text: 简而言之，远程控制的安全保障：

880767a468b15c29.source: <g1>When Drive won't give a file.</g1> Drive limits how often a file can be downloaded: after many downloads in a day it answers "too many users have viewed or downloaded this file recently". MDM shows Drive's own words and writes nothing. Try again later (it can take up to a day), or sign in to Google in your browser and download from there, which often gets past the limit. MDM doesn't try to get around it. A file whose owner turned off downloading, or that your account can't open, gets <g2>no access</g2>.
880767a468b15c29.text: <g1>当云端硬盘无法提供文件时。</g1>云端硬盘限制了文件的下载频率：一天内多次下载后，它会回复“最近有太多用户查看或下载此文件”。MDM 会显示云端硬盘自己的提示，不作任何修改。请稍后再试（可能需要一天时间），或者在浏览器中登录 Google 并从那里下载，这通常可以绕过限制。MDM 不会尝试绕过此限制。如果文件的所有者禁用了下载，或者您的帐户无法打开该文件，则会显示<g2>无权访问</g2>。

880dcd6570293c2e.source: Downloading may be against some sites' terms. Checking that is up to you.

88254f518650bd32.source: Tick <g1>Only while I'm using the computer</g1> and the cap applies only while you use the mouse or keyboard. After a minute without input, MDM goes back to full speed.

888f93dc8f248ae4.source: <g1>The crash data file (<x2/>)</g1> is a snapshot of what MDM was running at that moment. It helps the developers most, but it can hold pieces of what MDM had in memory, such as download addresses, cookies and saved passwords. It is only attached when you tick <g3>Also attach the crash data</g3>.
888f93dc8f248ae4.text: <g1>崩溃数据文件（<x2/>）</g1>是 MDM 当时运行状态的快照。它对开发者最有帮助，但可能包含 MDM 内存中的部分内容，例如下载地址、Cookie 和已保存的密码。只有勾选<g3>同时附上崩溃数据</g3>后，才会附上此文件。

88b16f0adf785619.source: <g1>Pieces</g1> — a map of the torrent's pieces: there, partly there, or missing.
88b16f0adf785619.text: <g1>分块</g1> — 种子分块的映射：已存在、部分存在或缺失。

8964c9e8c41b70ca.text: 在 Linux 上，只有管理员才能设置电脑的唤醒闹钟，因此该选项在管理员允许之前是灰色的。要让<x1/>组中的用户设置它，管理员需运行一次：

89fa61b2290f1772.source: <g1>Download Now</g1> adds each video as its own download and starts the main queue, which runs as many at once as you set in the <g2>Scheduler</g2> (<g3>Download N files at the same time</g3>). <g4>Later</g4> adds them without starting. Adding more than 500 at once asks first.
89fa61b2290f1772.text: <g1>立即下载</g1>会将每个视频分别添加为一个下载任务，并启动主队列。队列会按照您在<g2>计划程序</g2>（<g3>同时下载 N 个文件</g3>）中设置的数量同时下载。<g4>稍后</g4>会添加视频，但不启动下载。一次添加超过 500 个视频时会先询问。

8a13ed32b3c23581.source: Still stuck? Use <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> and include the page address.
8a13ed32b3c23581.text: 仍无法解决？使用<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>，并附上页面地址。

8a28300cfedb3a20.source: Install MDM with the setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration</g1> ticked. In Firefox, then open <g2>the add-on's page on addons.mozilla.org</g2> and click <g3>Add to Firefox</g3>. In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, open <g4>its page in the Chrome Web Store</g4> and click <g5>Add to Chrome</g5> (Edge shows <g6>Get</g6>, and first asks to allow extensions from other stores). Can't use a store? Open the browser's extensions page, turn on Developer mode, choose <g7>Load unpacked</g7> and pick the <x8/> folder in MDM's folder. The <g9>tutorial</g9> walks through it.
8a28300cfedb3a20.text: 使用安装程序安装 MDM，并勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成</g1>。在 Firefox 中，打开<g2>addons.mozilla.org 上的附加组件页面</g2>，然后点击<g3>添加到 Firefox</g3>。在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中，打开<g4>Chrome 网上应用店中的页面</g4>，然后点击<g5>添加到 Chrome</g5>（Edge 显示<g6>获取</g6>，并首先要求允许来自其他商店的扩展）。无法使用商店？打开浏览器的扩展程序页面，开启开发者模式，选择<g7>加载已解压的扩展程序</g7>，然后选择 MDM 文件夹中的<x8/>文件夹。<g9>教程</g9>会详细介绍。

8a40a7060dae6e26.source: <g1><g2>Connections and speed</g2></g1> — the progress window, how MDM splits a file over several connections, resuming, and the Speed Limiter.
8a40a7060dae6e26.text: <g1><g2>连接和速度</g2></g1> — 介绍进度窗口、MDM 如何通过多个连接分段下载文件、如何恢复下载，以及“速度限制器”。

8a44bb004f34a088.source: Any other page address that turns out to be a web page, not a file, is offered to the video window too.
8a44bb004f34a088.text: 如果其他页面地址对应的是网页而非文件，MDM 也会将其交给视频窗口处理。

8a76b2e374eac60a.source: The shine glossy parts blend toward at their top: buttons, boxes, bars and title bars (Luna, Aero, Aqua)
8a76b2e374eac60a.text: 光泽部分顶部融合的光泽：按钮、方框、进度条和标题栏（Luna、Aero、Aqua）

8a7c81a31241f98b.source: Propose the change with GitHub's pencil button. Your name goes into the release notes.
8a7c81a31241f98b.text: 使用 GitHub 的铅笔按钮提交更改。您的名字将出现在发布说明中。

8aa8085a4b6b5ba8.source: Add the download as usual (<g1>Add URL</g1>, or from the browser).
8aa8085a4b6b5ba8.text: 像往常一样添加下载（<g1>添加 URL</g1>，或来自浏览器）。

8ae30b18a577af05.text: 替换“应用程序”中的应用。

8b150cd4da81f3c9.source: Run Mister Download Manager without a window on a home server, NAS, Docker or Unraid, and send it downloads from your phone or your browser.
8b150cd4da81f3c9.text: 在家庭服务器、NAS、Docker 或 Unraid 上无窗口运行 Mister Download Manager，并通过手机或浏览器向其发送下载任务。

8b1688d4bd8c9246.source: <g1>The automation API</g1>: other programs list the running app's downloads (as JSON) and pause, start, remove or delete them, over a local, token-protected channel. AI assistants use it through MDM's MCP server: see <g2>AI assistants</g2>.
8b1688d4bd8c9246.text: <g1>自动化 API</g1>：其他程序可通过本地的令牌保护通道，以 JSON 格式列出正在运行的应用程序中的下载任务，并暂停、开始、移除或删除任务。AI 助手通过 MDM 的 MCP 服务器使用此 API：参阅<g2>AI 助手</g2>。

8b2b9199172669fe.source: No. It is an independent project written from scratch, with no connection to Tonec Inc., and contains none of IDM's code or artwork.
8b2b9199172669fe.text: 没有。它是一个从零开始编写的独立项目，与 Tonec Inc. 没有任何关系，不包含 IDM 的任何代码或艺术作品。

8b2eb0f35c19889a.source: <g1>Plain HTTP downloads work on a system without CA certificates</g1> (<g2>#264</g2>): on a minimal install without the <x3/> package (the tar.gz, the AppImage or a source build), no download started, <x4/> ones included ("No CA certificates were loaded from the system"). Plain HTTP and FTP now work there, and each HTTPS or FTPS download fails at once, without retrying, saying that the computer has no certificates to check the server with and to install <x5/>.
8b2eb0f35c19889a.text: <g1>在没有 CA 证书的系统上，纯 HTTP 下载也能工作</g1>（<g2>#264</g2>）：在没有 <x3/> 包的最小安装（tar.gz、AppImage 或源代码构建）上，没有下载开始，包括 <x4/> 下载（“未从系统加载 CA 证书”）。现在，纯 HTTP 和 FTP 在那里也能工作，并且每个 HTTPS 或 FTPS 下载都会立即失败，不会重试，并说明电脑没有证书来检查服务器，需要安装 <x5/>。

8b478db93b62df04.text: 验证下载文件的校验和（MD5、SHA-256）

8b6b100cf7aba467.source: To change more than colours, make a theme file that inherits the scheme by its file name and adds what you like:
8b6b100cf7aba467.text: 要更改颜色以外的更多内容，请制作一个主题文件，通过其文件名继承该方案并添加您喜欢的内容：

8b6d6550dbca9ec8.source: <g1>Download video: the buttons fit their text in every language</g1> (<g2>#172</g2>): in German <g3>ffmpeg installieren</g3> showed as "ffmpeg installie...", and in Russian <g4>Helpers...</g4> and <g5>Install ffmpeg</g5> were cut too. Each button is now as wide as its translated text (English is unchanged), and the page's title stops before the Install button instead of running under it. In Arabic and the other right-to-left languages, a widened <g6>Hide tab</g6> in a download's window now grows into the room beside it instead of towards the window's edge.
8b6d6550dbca9ec8.text: <g1>下载视频：按钮在所有语言中都能适应其文本长度</g1> (<g2>#172</g2>)：在德语中，<g3>ffmpeg installieren</g3> 显示为“ffmpeg installie...”，在俄语中，<g4>帮助程序...</g4> 和<g5>安装 ffmpeg</g5> 也被截断。现在每个按钮的宽度都与其翻译文本的长度一致（英文保持不变），页面的标题会在“安装”按钮之前停止，而不是在其下方运行。在阿拉伯语和其他从右到左的语言中，下载窗口中加宽的<g6>隐藏选项卡</g6>现在会向其旁边的空间扩展，而不是向窗口边缘扩展。

8b8a49dba39702b6.source: <g1>Themes</g1><g2>Nine looks, light and dark, from Classic to Aqua, or your own in a text file.</g2>
8b8a49dba39702b6.text: <g1>主题</g1><g2>九种外观，包括浅色和深色模式，从“经典”到“Aqua”，或在文本文件中自定义。</g2>

8b93f9dffbe6efdb.source: If Direct3D, Vulkan or Metal can't start on your computer (no driver for it, some virtual machines), or its first window doesn't show within 10 seconds of its own (the time MDM spends loading your list and its icons doesn't count, however slow the computer is just after it starts), MDM draws with OpenGL, and <g1>View → Draw with</g1> says so and why. Choosing it again tries it again at the next start.
8b93f9dffbe6efdb.text: 如果您的电脑无法启动 Direct3D、Vulkan 或 Metal（缺少驱动程序，或在某些虚拟机中），或者 MDM 启动后 10 秒内（不计入 MDM 加载列表和图标的时间，即使电脑启动后运行缓慢）其首个窗口没有显示，MDM 将使用 OpenGL 绘制，并且<g1>视图 → 绘制方式</g1>会显示此信息及原因。再次选择它会在下次启动时再次尝试。

8b95ee287644fd4f.source: Mister Download Manager's link grabber collects a page's links, sorts them into packages, checks which are online and extracts the archives they bring.
8b95ee287644fd4f.text: Mister Download Manager 的链接抓取器可以收集页面上的链接，将其分类打包，检查哪些在线，并提取它们带来的压缩包。

8ba3e471bdf1018f.source: <g1>Manual proxy/socks configuration</g1> — type the proxy's address, <g2>Port</g2>, and a <g3>UserName</g3> and <g4>Password</g4> if it needs them, then tick the protocols it is for (<g5>http</g5>, <g6>https</g6>). For a SOCKS proxy, write the address as <x7/>.
8ba3e471bdf1018f.text: <g1>手动代理/SOCKS 配置</g1> — 输入代理地址和<g2>端口</g2>；如果需要，还要输入<g3>用户名</g3>和<g4>密码</g4>，然后勾选代理支持的协议（<g5>http</g5>、<g6>https</g6>）。使用 SOCKS 代理时，地址格式为 <x7/>。

8bdd68bc00815e03.source: <g1>Custom DNS support:</g1> choose who looks up addresses: Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, NextDNS or your own, over HTTPS, TLS or plain.
8bdd68bc00815e03.text: <g1>自定义 DNS 支持：</g1> 选择由谁来解析地址：Cloudflare、Google、Quad9、AdGuard、NextDNS 或您自己的服务器，支持 HTTPS、TLS 或纯文本协议。

8bdde34517b27efd.source: Options on its Archives page: extracting archives when they are downloaded, and Link grabber's look-ups
8bdde34517b27efd.text: “选项”的“存档”页面：下载后解压存档，以及“链接抓取器”的查找。

8bdfaff0af16d86a.source: MDM lists the qualities: pick one.
8bdfaff0af16d86a.text: MDM 列出视频画质：选择一个。

8be8920a58642fa0.source: The progress window: one file over eight connections, each one's share of the file drawn as it fills
8be8920a58642fa0.text: 进度窗口：一个文件通过八个连接下载，每个连接下载的文件部分会随着下载进度而填充

8bf1347e6970e3e9.source: MDM works with screen readers such as Narrator and NVDA, which hear what each control is and its state. Everything can be done from the keyboard, with the keys most Windows programs use.
8bf1347e6970e3e9.text: MDM 支持 Narrator 和 NVDA 等屏幕阅读器，它们能识别每个控件及其状态。所有操作都可通过键盘完成，使用大多数 Windows 程序通用的按键。

8bfc1eb922329fc0.source: The browser warns that the connection's certificate isn't trusted. That is expected: MDM made its own certificate, on your computer, and no public authority knows it. To be sure the page is your MDM's, open the warning's details: the certificate's <g1>SHA-256 fingerprint</g1> is the one <g2>Options → Remote</g2> shows. Then continue to the page (<g3>Advanced → Proceed</g3> in Chrome, <g4>Show details → visit this website</g4> in Safari).
8bfc1eb922329fc0.text: 浏览器会警告连接的证书不受信任。这是预期行为：MDM 在您的电脑上生成了自己的证书，任何公共机构都不知道它。为确保页面是您的 MDM 的，请打开警告详情：证书的<g1>SHA-256 指纹</g1>与<g2>选项 → 远程</g2>中显示的指纹一致。然后继续访问页面（Chrome 中为<g3>高级 → 继续</g3>，Safari 中为<g4>显示详情 → 访问此网站</g4>）。

8c45e85312faa4e6.source: The full terms are in the <g1>Terms of use</g1>.
8c45e85312faa4e6.text: 完整条款请参见<g1>使用条款</g1>。

8c6583c8229f13c3.source: Downloads and torrents in one app, stable on Android
8c6583c8229f13c3.text: 在一个应用程序中处理下载和种子，在 Android 上运行稳定

8c699effe606d133.source: Files MDM downloads from the browser are marked as coming from the internet, as the browser marks its own: Windows checks a program with SmartScreen before it runs and Office opens a document in Protected View.
8c699effe606d133.text: MDM 从浏览器下载的文件会被标记为来自互联网，就像浏览器标记自己的文件一样：Windows 会在程序运行前使用 SmartScreen 检查它，Office 会在受保护视图中打开文档。

8c7321b31cd98d97.source: <g1>Toolbar.</g1> <g2>Add URL</g2>, <g3>Add Torrent</g3>, <g4>Resume</g4>, <g5>Stop</g5>, <g6>Stop All</g6>, <g7>Delete</g7>, <g8>Delete Completed</g8>, <g9>Options</g9>, <g10>Scheduler</g10>, <g11>Start Queue</g11>, <g12>Stop Queue</g12>. The small arrow next to <g13>Add Torrent</g13>, <g14>Start Queue</g14> and <g15>Stop Queue</g15> opens more choices.
8c7321b31cd98d97.text: <g1>工具栏。</g1><g2>添加 URL</g2>、<g3>添加 Torrent</g3>、<g4>恢复</g4>、<g5>停止</g5>、<g6>停止所有</g6>、<g7>删除</g7>、<g8>删除已完成</g8>、<g9>选项</g9>、<g10>计划程序</g10>、<g11>启动队列</g11>、<g12>停止队列</g12>。点击<g13>添加 Torrent</g13>、<g14>启动队列</g14>和<g15>停止队列</g15>旁边的小箭头可打开更多选项。

8c7d715c80bde878.source: <g1>Downloads from forms</g1> (a button that posts and gets a file back) are posted again by MDM, with the form's data, instead of being lost. A form that sends a file (multipart) stays with the browser.
8c7d715c80bde878.text: <g1>来自表单的下载</g1>（一个提交并返回文件的按钮）会由 MDM 再次提交，并附带表单数据，而不是丢失。发送文件（multipart）的表单会留在浏览器中处理。

8c81524f0b11e734.source: Can it download a video's subtitles?

8cb163cde329bcf4.source: <g1>Mister Download Manager</g1> appears in the list. Leave it turned on. Pin its button to the toolbar to see at a glance whether the browser reaches MDM.
8cb163cde329bcf4.text: <g1>Mister Download Manager</g1> 会出现在列表中。保持其开启状态。将其按钮固定到工具栏，即可一目了然地查看浏览器是否已连接到 MDM。

8ccfea341db37ac1.source: The automation API's list also gives the queues, the categories and the free space; it starts and stops a queue by name, and an added address can choose its category and queue.
8ccfea341db37ac1.text: 自动化 API 列表还提供队列、类别和可用空间；它按名称启动和停止队列，并且添加的地址可以选择其类别和队列。

8cf32ee91cd5fba9.source: A second browser download arriving while Download File Info was open replaced the first, which was lost (the browser had already given it up). They now wait their turn, and those still waiting when MDM quits are kept in the main queue (Download Later).
8cf32ee91cd5fba9.text: 当“下载文件信息”窗口打开时，第二个浏览器下载任务到达会替换第一个，导致第一个任务丢失（浏览器已经放弃了它）。现在它们会按顺序等待，并且当 MDM 退出时仍在等待的任务会保留在主队列中（稍后下载）。

8cf829352e4003d3.source: Turn it on in <g1>Options → Remote</g1>, then click <g2>Pair a device...</g2>. Scan the QR code with the phone's camera, or type the address and the 8-digit code. A code works once, for ten minutes.
8cf829352e4003d3.text: 在<g1>选项 → 远程</g1>中打开它，然后点击<g2>配对设备...</g2>。用手机摄像头扫描二维码，或输入地址和 8 位代码。一个代码只能使用一次，有效期为十分钟。

8d23f684c34c0bbe.source: <g1>Linux</g1> on x86-64 with a desktop session, X11 or Wayland (today's files experimental).
8d23f684c34c0bbe.text: x86-64 架构的 <g1>Linux</g1>，带有桌面会话，X11 或 Wayland（当前文件为实验性）。

8d5482092a09013b.source: Some pages play a video without a link to it, and some players hide it from the download button too. The toolbar button lists what the page has loaded, so you can still save it:
8d5482092a09013b.text: 有些页面播放的视频没有链接，有些播放器也会隐藏视频，不让下载按钮检测到。工具栏按钮会列出页面已加载的内容，因此您仍然可以保存这些内容：

8d833607c2d3b591.source: Sites change often, and a newer yt-dlp usually fixes a video that stopped working. MDM doesn't update yt-dlp on its own yet; <g1>the help</g1> shows how to get the newest one.
8d833607c2d3b591.text: 网站经常变化，更新的 yt-dlp 通常能修复停止工作的视频。MDM 尚未自动更新 yt-dlp；<g1>帮助</g1>中说明了如何获取最新版本。

8d8e052bd62085d8.source: <g1>Statistics.</g1> Medians with interquartile ranges, bootstrap 95% intervals (10,000 resamples) for each median and for the ratio of medians, and a two-sided Mann–Whitney U test.
8d8e052bd62085d8.text: <g1>统计。</g1> 中位数及四分位距，每个中位数和中位数比率的自举 95% 置信区间（10,000 次重采样），以及双侧 Mann–Whitney U 检验。

8da81bf6e443e93a.source: The host serves only MDM's own extension. Its IDs are in one place, <x1/> (<x2/>): the unpacked copy's (<x3/>, from the manifest's public key), the Chrome Web Store's (<x4/>, signed with the store's own key: <x5/> leaves the manifest's key out of the store's copy), the Firefox add-on's (<x6/>) and its addons.mozilla.org page; the Edge and Opera stores' are placeholders, never served, until the extension is listed there. The host writes each browser's manifest with those IDs, and the app offers the store's copy (Add to Chrome, Add to Firefox) before the unpacked one.
8da81bf6e443e93a.text: 主机仅服务于 MDM 自己的扩展程序。其 ID 位于一处，<x1/> (<x2/>)：未打包副本的 ID（<x3/>，来自清单的公钥），Chrome 网上应用店的 ID（<x4/>，用商店自己的密钥签名：<x5/> 将清单的密钥排除在商店副本之外），Firefox 附加组件的 ID（<x6/>）及其 addons.mozilla.org 页面；Edge 和 Opera 商店的 ID 是占位符，在扩展程序在那里上架之前不会提供。主机使用这些 ID 写入每个浏览器的清单，应用程序在未打包副本之前提供商店副本（“添加到 Chrome”、“添加到 Firefox”）。

8dbeeeabcf1f6918.source: <g1>86 interface languages</g1>, every language Windows 11 offers, chosen by flag on the first start or in <g2>View → Language...</g2>; right to left for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur; fonts for every script from the system itself. The installer speaks the same languages, and the browser extension speaks your browser's (50 languages).
8dbeeeabcf1f6918.text: <g1>86 种界面语言</g1>，Windows 11 提供的所有语言，首次启动时通过旗帜选择或在<g2>视图 → 语言...</g2>中选择；阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语从右到左显示；所有脚本的字体均来自系统本身。安装程序支持相同的语言，浏览器扩展程序支持您的浏览器语言（50 种语言）。

8dbf6ff24d2ed734.source: Can't use a store? It comes with the app, in its <x1/> folder, and <g2>as its own download</g2> for Chromium browsers (<x3/>: unzip, then <g4>Load unpacked</g4> on the browser's extensions page with Developer mode on). The <g5>step-by-step guide</g5> shows each browser.
8dbf6ff24d2ed734.text: 无法使用商店？它随应用程序一起提供，位于其 <x1/> 文件夹中，<g2>也可作为单独的下载</g2>用于 Chromium 浏览器（<x3/>：解压后，在浏览器扩展页面上开启开发者模式，然后点击<g4>加载已解压的扩展程序</g4>）。<g5>分步指南</g5>会展示每个浏览器的操作步骤。

8dc29fd0c1aa70c1.source: <g1>Over several connections</g1>: as many as <g2>Options → Connection</g2> gives a file. The progress window's connections table shows each one, and the segment map shows the video and then its sound.
8dc29fd0c1aa70c1.text: <g1>通过多个连接</g1>：与<g2>选项 → 连接</g2>中为文件设置的连接数相同。进度窗口的连接表会显示每个连接，分段图会显示视频及其音频。

8dd172f00bd75694.source: On 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, MDM is the stable, recommended build. The <g1>download page</g1> offers three files:
8dd172f00bd75694.text: 在 64 位 Windows 10 和 11 上，MDM 是稳定且推荐的构建版本。<g1>下载页面</g1>提供三种文件：

8de593350090e7e8.source: If MDM never opens, see <g1>The setup or MDM won't start</g1>.
8de593350090e7e8.text: 如果 MDM 始终无法打开，请参阅<g1>安装程序或 MDM 无法启动</g1>。

8dfb095805a146c6.source: <g1>Also delete the file from disk</g1> — tick it to delete the files too. For an unfinished download, this deletes the part downloaded so far. Leave it unticked to take the downloads off the list and keep the files.
8dfb095805a146c6.text: <g1>同时从磁盘中删除文件</g1> — 勾选后也会删除文件。对于尚未完成的下载，会删除已下载的部分。不勾选则会将下载从列表中移除，但保留文件。

8e0392a5361b8cc7.source: <g1>Torrents</g1><g2>Magnet links and .torrent files beside your other downloads, queued and scheduled like any of them.</g2>
8e0392a5361b8cc7.text: <g1>种子</g1><g2>磁力链接和 .torrent 文件可与其他下载任务一起，像普通任务一样排队和计划。</g2>

8e12c185ccf34fa4.source: <g1>Controls that didn't react to the mouse</g1>: the ▾ of Address and Save As (Add URL, Download File Info), the drop-down lists, check boxes, radio buttons, the Categories pane's ×, the Scheduler's date button and calendar, scroll bars and the list's column headers now show when the pointer is over them and when they're pressed, as Windows' own controls do; an arrow stays pressed while its list is open.
8e12c185ccf34fa4.text: <g1>之前无法响应鼠标操作的控件</g1>：地址和另存为字段中的 ▾（“添加 URL”、“下载文件信息”）、下拉列表、复选框、单选按钮、“类别”窗格中的 ×、“计划程序”中的日期按钮和日历、滚动条以及列表的列标题，现在都会像 Windows 自带控件一样，在指针悬停和按下时显示相应状态；列表打开时，箭头会保持按下状态。

8e1f60791f272cfe.source: Use <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> in MDM: it opens the bug report form on GitHub with your version, system and language filled in. Or <g2>open the form</g2> yourself. Security problems go privately through the <g3>security page</g3>.
8e1f60791f272cfe.text: 在 MDM 中使用<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>：它会打开 GitHub 上的错误报告表，并已填写您的版本、系统和语言信息。或者您也可以<g2>自行打开该表单</g2>。安全问题请通过<g3>安全页面</g3>私下提交。

8e4c4a984da7391d.source: Check that the Speed Limiter is off: <g1>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Turn off</g1>. Also look at <g2>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Settings... → Limit all downloads together to</g2>, which applies even with the limiter off.
8e4c4a984da7391d.text: 检查速度限制器是否已关闭：<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 关闭</g1>。还要查看<g2>下载 → 速度限制器 → 设置... → 将所有下载总计限制为</g2>；即使关闭速度限制器，此设置仍然生效。

8ebacedce5c28ec5.source: Add URL sends these to the gallery window: - Wikimedia Commons categories; - Flickr photographers and albums; - DeviantArt and ArtStation galleries; - Imgur albums; - Pixiv artists and works; - Pinterest boards and pins; - Danbooru and Gelbooru searches; - Tumblr blogs; - Bluesky profiles.
8ebacedce5c28ec5.text: 添加 URL 会将以下内容发送到图库窗口：- 维基共享资源分类；- Flickr 摄影师和相册；- DeviantArt 和 ArtStation 图库；- Imgur 相册；- Pixiv 艺术家和作品；- Pinterest 画板和图钉；- Danbooru 和 Gelbooru 搜索；- Tumblr 博客；- Bluesky 个人资料。

8ed0452c66932511.source: <g1>The progress window, and the windows with a style theme's title bar, without a black band across their top</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>): on the same Windows 11 Insider build, the progress window showed a black band a title bar tall above its own title bar and a thin one down its left side, its contents moved down and cut off at the bottom; so could every dialog and the main window with Metro, Luna, Aero or Aqua. MDM draws these title bars itself, in windows that kept the system's title bar style, hidden. On Windows 11 they now have no title bar style at all: the progress window and the dialogs are plain windows, all theirs; the main window keeps the system's resizing edges, so it still resizes, snaps and maximizes as before, with a thin strip of its title bar's colour above it. Moving them by their title bar, their taskbar button, Alt+Tab and the window menu (Alt+Space, or a right-click on the title bar) work as before. Windows 10 keeps the frames it had.
8ed0452c66932511.text: <g1>进度窗口以及带有样式主题标题栏的窗口顶部不再有黑条</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）：在相同的 Windows 11 Insider 版本上，进度窗口在其自身标题栏上方显示一个标题栏高度的黑条，左侧有一条细线，其内容向下移动并在底部被截断；所有对话框以及带有 Metro、Luna、Aero 或 Aqua 主题的主窗口也可能出现这种情况。MDM 在保留系统标题栏样式的窗口中自行绘制这些标题栏，并将其隐藏。在 Windows 11 上，它们现在完全没有标题栏样式：进度窗口和对话框是普通的窗口，完全由 MDM 控制；主窗口保留了系统的调整大小边缘，因此它仍然可以像以前一样调整大小、吸附和最大化，其上方有一条细细的标题栏颜色带。通过标题栏、任务栏按钮、Alt+Tab 和窗口菜单（Alt+Space，或右键点击标题栏）移动它们的功能与以前相同。Windows 10 保持了原有的框架。

8f085588eab5dbf1.source: <g1>RSS feeds</g1><g2>Follow torrent feeds, and let rules add the new episodes you want, each one only once.</g2>
8f085588eab5dbf1.text: <g1>RSS 源</g1><g2>关注种子 RSS 源，设置规则自动添加您想要的新剧集，每集只添加一次。</g2>

8f11311d78b1263e.source: <g1>Media on this page says why it's empty</g1>: on a player that streams in pieces there's no file to list, and it says to use the button over the video instead of asking you to play it again.
8f11311d78b1263e.text: <g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>会说明其为空的原因：对于分段流式传输的播放器，没有文件可供列出，它会提示您使用视频上方的按钮，而不是要求您再次播放。

8f28e007e7328371.source: <g1>Theme files</g1>: every colour and size MDM's controls are drawn with (corner radii, borders, font sizes, the list's row height, the icons' ink) comes from the theme, by role; the classic look is that theme, unchanged pixel for pixel. A theme file (TOML or JSON in the data folder's <x2/> folder) can change any role, choose each control's style (<x3/>) and an icon set, and a theme can be a folder that brings its own icons. An icon set can mix PNG pictures with SVG drawings, and one-colour icons (<x4/>, <x5/>, drawn in the theme's text colour) with coloured ones, and hold pictures at 32 and 48 pixels, used on a screen scaled to 150 % and more: the style themes' pictures stay sharp there.
8f28e007e7328371.text: <g1>主题文件</g1>：MDM 控件的所有颜色和尺寸（圆角半径、边框、字体大小、列表行高、图标墨迹）均按角色来自主题；经典外观即是该主题，像素级保持不变。主题文件（数据文件夹 <x2/> 文件夹中的 TOML 或 JSON 格式）可以更改任何角色，选择每个控件的样式（<x3/>）和图标集，主题也可以是一个包含自有图标的文件夹。图标集可以混合 PNG 图片和 SVG 绘图，以及单色图标（<x4/>、<x5/>，以主题的文本颜色绘制）和彩色图标，并包含 32 和 48 像素的图片，用于 150% 或更高缩放比例的屏幕：风格主题的图片在此保持清晰。

8f425dccc6a74df8.source: macOS: <g1>Download video</g1> no longer stops with a Python error and a "Python.framework is damaged" alert on a copy of MDM downloaded by a browser (<g2>#330</g2>, <g3>#339</g3>). MDM now installs yt-dlp's folder build, which it unpacks once and checks against yt-dlp's signed list, instead of the single-program build that unpacks Python afresh at every start. The video window then offers to install it in place of a copy that came with an earlier version.
8f425dccc6a74df8.text: macOS：通过浏览器下载的 MDM 副本，<g1>下载视频</g1>不再因 Python 错误和“Python.framework 已损坏”警报而停止（<g2>#330</g2>、<g3>#339</g3>）。MDM 现在安装 yt-dlp 的文件夹构建版本，该版本只需解压一次并根据 yt-dlp 的签名列表进行检查，而不是每次启动时都重新解压 Python 的单一程序构建版本。视频窗口随后会提供安装它以替换早期版本附带的副本。

8f5bc00256713559.source: Nothing: the window says so, and your system's updates bring the new version.
8f5bc00256713559.text: 无：窗口会显示，并且您的系统更新会带来新版本。

8f5c1305e03b1090.source: A server that allows two connections. MDM learns it and keeps to two; IDM opened 480.
8f5c1305e03b1090.text: 一个允许两个连接的服务器。MDM 学习并保持两个连接；IDM 打开了 480 个。

8f7481f4372a14d6.source: MDM checks the account and shows its name and whether it is premium. <g1>OK</g1> keeps it.
8f7481f4372a14d6.text: MDM 会检查帐户，并显示帐户名称及是否为高级帐户。点击<g1>确定</g1>即可保存。

8f81187a957c46df.source: <g1><g2>Download overnight</g2></g1> — queue files and let the Scheduler start them at night.
8f81187a957c46df.text: <g1><g2>通宵下载</g2></g1> — 将文件加入队列，让计划程序在夜间启动下载。

8f9b78589fda95ad.source: A finished torrent that isn't being shared lets go of its files, so they can be moved or deleted while MDM runs.
8f9b78589fda95ad.text: 已完成但未共享的种子会释放其文件，以便在 MDM 运行时可以移动或删除这些文件。

8fc16e02df7c0938.source: <g1>A log</g1>, kept in MDM's data folder (<x2/>), so a report can show what led to a problem.
8fc16e02df7c0938.text: <g1>日志</g1>保存在 MDM 的数据文件夹中（<x2/>），报告可据此显示问题发生前的情况。

8fd5190974156ab1.source: <g1>Reading the dump.</g1> The monitor reads the dump with Mozilla's <x2/>. It uses the release's Breakpad symbols when they are found. A build from source can also read the native debug info beside it (its <x3/>, DWARF) when built with <x4/>; the shipped app goes without that reader, several MB. The report's <g5>Signature</g5> (for example <x6/>) stays the same across reports of one problem, and the window searches existing issues for it.
8fd5190974156ab1.text: <g1>读取转储文件。</g1> 监视器使用 Mozilla 的 <x2/> 读取转储文件。如果找到发布版本的 Breakpad 符号，就会使用这些符号。使用 <x4/> 构建的源码版本也可以读取旁边的原生调试信息（其 <x3/>，DWARF）；随附的应用不包含该读取器，因为它会占用几 MB。报告的<g5>签名</g5>（例如 <x6/>）在同一问题的多份报告中保持不变，窗口会据此搜索现有问题。

8fe7cc9878663c27.source: To watch a video while it downloads, tick <g1>Download in order</g1> (see <g2>Download in order</g2>).
8fe7cc9878663c27.text: 要边下载边观看视频，请勾选<g1>按顺序下载</g1>（参见<g2>按顺序下载</g2>）。

9001b1c9cd0241bb.source: Mister Download Manager (MDM) is a free download manager for Windows and Linux (and, still experimental, macOS). It is laid out the way Internet Download Manager users expect: a toolbar, categories on the left, one list of downloads and a browser extension that hands downloads to it.
9001b1c9cd0241bb.text: Mister Download Manager (MDM) 是一款适用于 Windows 和 Linux（macOS 版本仍在实验中）的免费下载管理器。它的布局与 Internet Download Manager 用户所熟悉的界面一致：一个工具栏、左侧的类别、一个下载列表以及一个将下载任务交给它的浏览器扩展。

9043acfd376ea96d.source: Corner radius of egui's own widgets
9043acfd376ea96d.text: egui 自身小部件的圆角半径

909c099c48c2a801.source: MDM tells Windows it draws for each monitor's own scale, so Windows never stretches its windows into blur, and it draws Windows' fonts grid-fitted to whole pixels. If the text still looks blurred, tell us your screen's resolution and Windows' display scale when you <g1>report it</g1>.
909c099c48c2a801.text: MDM 告诉 Windows 它会根据每个显示器的缩放比例进行绘制，因此 Windows 不会将其窗口拉伸导致模糊，并且它会以网格对齐到完整像素的方式绘制 Windows 字体。如果文字仍然模糊，请在<g1>报告问题</g1>时告知我们您的屏幕分辨率和 Windows 的显示缩放比例。

90b3e4ba23d3ab6b.source: The <x1/> copy has no installer, but you can register the helper yourself. Open a command prompt in MDM's folder and run:
90b3e4ba23d3ab6b.text: 此 <x1/> 版本没有安装程序，但您可以自行注册辅助程序。在 MDM 文件夹中打开命令提示符并运行：

90c53d032e28403b.source: The checked accent under the pointer

90e1029ca6c017f8.source: Right-click it for <g1>Add new download</g1>, <g2>Add batch download</g2>, <g3>Downloads in progress</g3>, <g4>Speed Limiter</g4>, <g5>Scheduler</g5>, the main download queue, <g6>Options</g6> and <g7>Exit</g7>.
90e1029ca6c017f8.text: 右键单击它可选择<g1>添加新下载</g1>、<g2>添加批量下载</g2>、<g3>正在进行的下载</g3>、<g4>速度限制器</g4>、<g5>计划程序</g5>、主下载队列、<g6>选项</g6>和<g7>退出</g7>。

90f5fe16b9f31f12.source: Batch download numbered files and lists of links
90f5fe16b9f31f12.text: 批量下载编号文件和链接列表

90f994f09c15f5fa.source: With <x1/>, every command prints JSON, one object per line: a progress line every half second while a file downloads, then the path, size and time when it's done. Sizes are in bytes, speeds in bytes per second, and a failure prints an error object, so a script or an AI agent reads the result without parsing text. The <g2>formats</g2> are listed command by command.
90f994f09c15f5fa.text: 使用 <x1/>，每个命令都会打印 JSON，每行一个对象：文件下载时每半秒打印一行进度，然后是完成时的路径、大小和时间。大小以字节为单位，速度以字节每秒为单位，失败时打印错误对象，因此脚本或 AI 代理无需解析文本即可读取结果。<g2>格式</g2>按命令列出。

9114c433b50cbdeb.source: More connections help only where a server sends each one at a limited speed. Most servers allow a few connections per address, and MDM notices when one says no: it stops asking that server for more and lists what it learned under <g1>Exceptions</g1> in <g2>Options → Connection</g2>. You can set a number for a server yourself there too.
9114c433b50cbdeb.text: 当服务器限制每个连接的速度时，增加连接数才会有帮助。大多数服务器允许每个地址有几个连接，MDM 会在服务器拒绝时注意到：它会停止向该服务器请求更多连接，并在<g2>选项 → 连接</g2>下的<g1>例外</g1>中列出它学到的信息。您也可以在那里为服务器自行设置连接数。

911baa1a13bfe282.source: The queues are on the left, with <g1>Download limits</g1> below them. The right side shows the selected queue on two tabs, <g2>Schedule</g2> and <g3>Files in the queue</g3>.
911baa1a13bfe282.text: 队列位于左侧，<g1>下载限制</g1>位于其下方。右侧通过两个选项卡显示所选队列的内容：<g2>计划</g2>和<g3>队列中的文件</g3>。

91211638d5845d9d.source: Moving from Internet Download Manager? Export your list there and import it in MDM. Every download comes over with its address, referrer and cookies, into a window laid out the way you know.
91211638d5845d9d.text: 要从 Internet Download Manager 切换过来吗？在 IDM 中导出您的列表，然后导入到 MDM。每个下载任务都会带着地址、来源和 Cookie，导入到您熟悉的界面中。

9121e1b489370681.source: <g1>Speed Limiter</g1> — a limit for this download only. See below.
9121e1b489370681.text: <g1>速度限制器</g1> — 仅用于此下载的限制。请参见下文。

91413c8d067f6992.source: <g1>All Downloads</g1> — everything, with a node per category below it.
91413c8d067f6992.text: <g1>所有下载</g1> — 显示所有下载，下方按类别列出各个节点。

91799f6f221cf37b.source: Inside a container, the address MDM finds is the container's own: give it the one you open, the <g1>server's</g1> address with the port you published, as <x2/>, and the log and the QR code show that one. Then pair as <g3>Control MDM from your phone</g3> says. For another code, at any time:
91799f6f221cf37b.text: 在容器内部，MDM 找到的地址是容器自身的地址：请提供您打开的地址，即带有您发布的端口的<g1>服务器</g1>地址，如<x2/>所示，日志和二维码将显示该地址。然后按照<g3>从手机控制 MDM</g3>所述进行配对。如需获取另一个代码，随时可以：

95d723ad5c56209c.text: MDM 的支持是根据每个服务的公开文档构建的，尚未通过真实的付费账户确认。如果您的账户出现问题，请在 GitHub 上提交问题，切勿在其中粘贴您的令牌或密钥。

95d9ea7a266a569b.source: The download page: pick your system's file
95d9ea7a266a569b.text: 下载页面：选择适合您系统的文件

95e0579f795bdd56.source: <g1>Description or part of the description</g1> — your notes.
95e0579f795bdd56.text: <g1>描述或描述的一部分</g1> — 您的备注。

95ff4e3f1e52b773.source: portable.zip — runs from a folder or USB stick
95ff4e3f1e52b773.text: portable.zip — 可从文件夹或 U 盘运行

9610ce30533afc6e.source: <g1>Your own devices, for the remote control.</g1> Off until you turn it on in <g2>Options → Remote</g2>: then MDM answers, over HTTPS on your local network, only the phones and computers you paired with its code.
9610ce30533afc6e.text: <g1>您的设备，用于远程控制。</g1> 在<g2>选项 → 远程</g2>中开启前，此功能默认关闭：开启后，MDM 仅通过本地网络上的 HTTPS 协议响应您已用其代码配对的手机和电脑。

961eaa849deedf28.source: Download File Info for a ZIP file: its address, the Compressed category, the folder it goes to, its size, and the Download Later, Start Download and Cancel buttons
961eaa849deedf28.text: ZIP文件的下载文件信息：其地址、压缩文件类别、保存文件夹、大小，以及稍后下载、开始下载和取消按钮

962a389b4aee01a7.source: Does it support FTP? — Mister Download Manager
962a389b4aee01a7.text: 支持 FTP 吗？— Mister Download Manager

96301334bc1bfc65.source: To run the whole app without a window, on a home server or a NAS, see <g1>Run MDM on a server</g1> (<x2/>); to control it from a phone, <g3>Control MDM from your phone</g3>.
96301334bc1bfc65.text: 要在家庭服务器或 NAS 上无窗口运行整个应用程序，请参阅<g1>在服务器上运行 MDM</g1> (<x2/>)；要通过手机控制它，请参阅<g3>通过手机控制 MDM</g3>。

96305159e842a657.source: Every colour and size a control is drawn with comes from the active theme (#45). A theme is a light and a dark palette, metrics, control styles and an icon style (<x1/>):
96305159e842a657.text: 控件绘制的每种颜色和大小都来自活动主题 (#45)。一个主题包含一个亮色和暗色调色板、度量、控件样式和图标样式 (<x1/>)：

963552ab075ccbdb.source: MDM offers yt-dlp and ffmpeg on its first start, with Yes, download them (recommended) and Not now
963552ab075ccbdb.text: MDM 在首次启动时提供 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，并带有“是，下载它们（推荐）”和“暂不”选项

9641498adf0c3309.source: <g1>A Base16 scheme</g1>, the <x2/> file the <g3>Base16 and Base24 schemes</g3> come in: both the classic layout (<x4/> and <x5/> to <x6/> at the top) and the newer one (<x7/> and a <x8/> block). A Base24 scheme reads as its first 16 colours.
9641498adf0c3309.text: <g1>Base16 方案</g1>，即 <x2/> 文件，<g3>Base16 和 Base24 方案</g3> 均采用此格式：包括经典布局（顶部 <x4/> 和 <x5/> 到 <x6/>）和新布局（<x7/> 和 <x8/> 块）。Base24 方案读取其前 16 种颜色。

964baafe2e54e20e.source: For a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later: <g1>Apple menu → About This Mac</g1> shows a <g2>Chip</g2>). Open it and drag Mister Download Manager to Applications. macOS asks before its first start, because the app isn't notarized by Apple: right-click it and choose <g3>Open</g3> (on macOS 15 and later: <g4>System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway</g4>).
964baafe2e54e20e.text: 适用于配备 Apple 芯片（M1 或更高版本：<g1>苹果菜单 → 关于本机</g1> 显示 <g2>芯片</g2>）的 Mac。打开它，将 Mister Download Manager 拖到“应用程序”文件夹。macOS 在首次启动前会询问，因为此应用未经 Apple 公证：右键点击它并选择<g3>打开</g3>（在 macOS 15 及更高版本上：<g4>系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开</g4>）。

964f931287002369.source: Every release and what it changed, newest first. Follow along with the <g1>news feed</g1> or watch the project on GitHub.
964f931287002369.text: 每次发布及其变更，最新版本在前。请关注<g1>新闻源</g1>或在 GitHub 上关注项目。

9666abc08fa96656.source: Is Mister Download Manager related to IDM?
9666abc08fa96656.text: Mister Download Manager 与 IDM 有关联吗？

9675f888cdb836b1.text: 选择第一个/最后一个下载

96762962430d58e1.source: The tabs stay once the torrent has finished, for as long as it is shared.
96762962430d58e1.text: 只要 torrent 仍在共享，其选项卡就会在下载完成后保留。

9682bbc6499d98d3.source: <g1>All files and install steps</g1><g2>Every release on GitHub</g2>
9682bbc6499d98d3.text: <g1>所有文件和安装步骤</g1><g2>GitHub 上的所有发布</g2>

968549d62c413703.source: <g1>Stop</g1> ends MDM's downloads of the pictures, and gallery-dl with everything it started. The pictures saved so far stay.
968549d62c413703.text: <g1>停止</g1>会终止 MDM 对图片的下载，以及 gallery-dl 启动的所有进程。已保存的图片会保留。

96abca8820d90816.source: Download scheduler and queues — Mister Download Manager
96abca8820d90816.text: 下载计划程序和队列 — Mister Download Manager

96b088ea6d0f9419.source: AllDebrid sometimes needs a while to prepare a link. MDM waits for it, up to 10 minutes, and the list says so.
96b088ea6d0f9419.text: AllDebrid 有时需要一段时间才能准备好链接。MDM 最多会等待 10 分钟，列表会显示等待状态。

96cec022ce66b5c4.source: Unzip the file to a folder you can write to (not straight into <x1/>).
96cec022ce66b5c4.text: 将文件解压到您有写入权限的文件夹中（不要直接解压到 <x1/>）。

96e4167073e87a3c.source: <g1>In the stores</g1>: the Firefox add-on is on addons.mozilla.org, <g2>Mister Download Manager</g2>, installed with one click and kept up to date by Firefox (and by Zen and LibreWolf); the Chromium one is in the Chrome Web Store, <g3>Mister Download Manager</g3>, for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, installed with one click and kept up to date. Chrome offers it by itself once MDM is installed, and the website, the help and the README offer <g4>Add to Firefox</g4> and <g5>Add to Chrome</g5> first. The store's copy needs this release of MDM: the helper of MDM 0.2.x serves only the copy in MDM's own folder, and the browser refuses the store's (<g6>#208</g6>). The store's copy shows no Download video button on YouTube, whose downloads the store's policy forbids; <g7>Tasks → Download video from a page</g7> still takes any page.
96e4167073e87a3c.text: <g1>在商店中</g1>：Firefox 附加组件位于 addons.mozilla.org，<g2>Mister Download Manager</g2>，一键安装并由 Firefox（以及 Zen 和 LibreWolf）保持更新；Chromium 附加组件位于 Chrome 网上应用店，<g3>Mister Download Manager</g3>，适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi，一键安装并保持更新。MDM 安装后，Chrome 会自行提供，网站、帮助和 README 首先提供<g4>添加到 Firefox</g4>和<g5>添加到 Chrome</g5>。商店版本需要此 MDM 版本：MDM 0.2.x 的助手仅服务于 MDM 自身文件夹中的版本，浏览器会拒绝商店版本（<g6>#208</g6>）。商店版本在 YouTube 上不显示“下载视频”按钮，因为商店政策禁止下载 YouTube 视频；<g7>任务 → 从页面下载视频</g7>仍然可以处理任何页面。

970641facab3170c.source: <g1>Move/Rename</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+M</g2>) moves or renames the file of a finished download, or of one that hasn't started yet. With several downloads selected it asks for a folder and moves them all there, each under its own name.
970641facab3170c.text: <g1>移动/重命名</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+M</g2>) 用于移动或重命名已完成下载的文件，或尚未开始下载的文件。如果选中了多个下载任务，它会要求选择一个文件夹，然后将所有文件移动到该文件夹，每个文件保留其原有名称。

970b4b0f622b3cc5.source: <g1>Start download on Mister Download Manager startup</g1> — start the queue whenever MDM starts.
970b4b0f622b3cc5.text: <g1>在 Mister Download Manager 启动时开始下载</g1> — 每次启动 MDM 时都启动此队列。

971fbad8e10de039.source: Choose the language. Windows' display language is already selected. The setup offers every language MDM has, and MDM starts in the one you pick.
971fbad8e10de039.text: 选择语言。Windows 的显示语言已选中。安装程序提供 MDM 拥有的所有语言，MDM 将以您选择的语言启动。

97408a3a460ac468.source: Untick what you don't want, then Download Now.
97408a3a460ac468.text: 取消勾选不想要的文件，然后点击“立即下载”。

9757a8b628979f6a.source: The list shows each quality with its size, best first, and the sound alone at the end. Check <g1>Save to</g1> and <g2>File name</g2>, then click <g3>Download Now</g3>, or <g4>Later</g4> to put it in the list for later. The video gets its own row and progress window, like any other download.
9757a8b628979f6a.text: 列表会显示各种画质及其大小，最佳画质排在最前面，纯音频排在最后。检查<g1>保存到</g1>和<g2>文件名</g2>，然后点击<g3>立即下载</g3>，或点击<g4>稍后</g4>将其添加到稍后下载列表。视频会像其他下载一样，拥有独立的行和进度窗口。

976e1bc04dee0c02.source: Both the address you clicked and the one its redirects led to are checked, so a site you excluded stays excluded even when it sends you to another server. Everything else stays with the browser. Changes in Options reach the browser within a minute; you don't need to restart it.
976e1bc04dee0c02.text: 系统会检查您点击的地址以及重定向后的地址，因此即使被排除的网站将您重定向到另一台服务器，该网站仍会被排除。其他所有下载仍由浏览器处理。选项中的更改会在一分钟内同步到浏览器，无需重启浏览器。

9772287c22790a58.source: Unzip it onto the stick, for example to <x1/>.
9772287c22790a58.text: 将其解压到 U 盘上，例如解压到<x1/>。

9776a28342c940e4.source: Bigger when you need it, faster to open, and closer to your system.
9776a28342c940e4.text: 需要时更大，打开更快，更贴近您的系统。

979e9bd41ea38bec.source: With <g1>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g1> ticked (it is, unless you turned it off), when you copy a link to a file type in <g2>Options → File types</g2> (ZIP, EXE, MP4, PDF and many more), <g3>Download File Info</g3> opens with it filled in, ready for <g4>Start Download</g4>. Links to other pages are left alone. With <g5>Options → Downloads → Show start download dialog</g5> off, the download starts at once instead. Only links copied while MDM runs are taken, never one that was already there.
979e9bd41ea38bec.text: 勾选<g1>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g1>（除非您已关闭，否则默认勾选），当您复制<g2>选项 → 文件类型</g2>中列出的文件类型（ZIP、EXE、MP4、PDF 等）的链接时，<g3>下载文件信息</g3>将打开并已填入该链接，可供<g4>开始下载</g4>。指向其他页面的链接将不作处理。如果<g5>选项 → 下载 → 显示开始下载对话框</g5>关闭，下载将立即开始。MDM 只会处理在 MDM 运行时复制的链接，不会处理之前已有的链接。

97da1bf72f9f642f.source: <g1>Maximum download speed for one file</g1> holds each download to the same speed. Set it first, since it starts at a very slow 10 KBytes/sec, then choose <g2>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Turn on</g2>. <g3>Turn off</g3> gives full speed back, and <g4>Always turn on Speed Limiter on Mister Download Manager startup</g4> keeps it on from the start.
97da1bf72f9f642f.text: <g1>单个文件的最大下载速度</g1>将每个下载任务限制在相同的速度。请先设置此项，因为它默认从非常慢的 10 千字节/秒开始，然后选择<g2>下载 → 速度限制器 → 开启</g2>。<g3>关闭</g3>将恢复全速，而<g4>始终在 Mister Download Manager 启动时开启速度限制器</g4>则会使其从一开始就保持开启状态。

97de26efb1e196ce.source: The <g1>Q</g1> column now shows a queue icon for each of them.
97de26efb1e196ce.text: <g1>Q</g1>列现在会为每个下载显示一个队列图标。

97dee52b896350d2.source: <g1>The AppImage on Linux:</g1> the AppImage's files are gone once it quits, so MDM keeps a copy of its helper program in its data folder (<x2/>) and points the browsers there. Start MDM once after moving or renaming the AppImage, or after an AppImage manager (Gear Lever, AppImageLauncher and the like) moved it, so the helper knows where to start it from.
97dee52b896350d2.text: <g1>Linux 上的 AppImage：</g1> AppImage 的文件在退出后会消失，因此 MDM 会在其数据文件夹 (<x2/>) 中保留其帮助程序的一个副本，并让浏览器指向那里。在移动或重命名 AppImage 后，或在 AppImage 管理器（如 Gear Lever、AppImageLauncher 等）移动它之后，请启动 MDM 一次，以便帮助程序知道从何处启动它。

97df160b348bfb2f.source: Select the downloads in the box

97eaa3c02021cbda.source: Import your download list from IDM — Mister Download Manager
97eaa3c02021cbda.text: 从 IDM 导入下载列表 — Mister Download Manager

981faeae41148137.source: Check the folder, then Start Download.
981faeae41148137.text: 检查文件夹，然后点击“开始下载”。

982812ef66b913d5.source: <g1>Status</g1> — what it is doing, the address to open on the phone, and the certificate's fingerprint.
982812ef66b913d5.text: <g1>状态</g1> — 当前正在做什么、手机上要打开的地址以及证书的指纹。

9844e8e8905cd325.source: <g1>A Safari extension, inside the Mac app:</g1> a click on a link to a file type MDM takes goes to MDM, and so do the right-click items, the button over videos and <g2>Media on this page</g2>, as in the other browsers. Safari gives extensions no access to its downloads, so a download a page starts by itself stays with Safari, and the browser's proxy is not shared. See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
9844e8e8905cd325.text: <g1>Mac 应用内嵌 Safari 扩展：</g1>点击 MDM 支持的文件类型链接会跳转到 MDM，右键菜单项、视频上方的按钮和<g2>此页面上的媒体</g2>也同样如此，与其他浏览器一致。Safari 不允许扩展访问其下载，因此页面自身启动的下载仍由 Safari 处理，且浏览器代理不共享。请参阅<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

9869286e1f319519.source: The same care goes into what MDM fetches for itself. The helpers it can install for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. MDM's own updates install only files listed in a checksum list signed with MDM's release key, which every release carries.
9869286e1f319519.text: MDM 对自身获取的文件也同样谨慎。它可为视频安装的辅助工具在运行前都会经过验证：yt-dlp 会对照其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会对照其发布的校验和进行验证。MDM 自身的更新只会安装列在校验和列表中的文件，该列表由 MDM 的发布密钥签名，每个版本都包含此密钥。

986d7c04b3768a5c.text: <g1>Mister Download Manager 0.5.2</g1><g2>免费的 IDM 替代品</g2>

98740eb10c0bdfdd.source: The crash data file (<x1/>) helps the developers most, but it can hold pieces of what MDM had in memory, such as addresses, cookies and saved passwords. It is attached only when you tick <g2>Also attach the crash data</g2>.
98740eb10c0bdfdd.text: 崩溃数据文件 (<x1/>) 对开发者帮助最大，但它可能包含 MDM 内存中的部分内容，例如地址、Cookie 和保存的密码。仅当您勾选<g2>同时附加崩溃数据</g2>时才会附加它。

9884d340beffa35b.source: <g1>Texts that were always in English</g1> are translated in every language: the empty list's message, buttons of the crash report window, and why OK or Verify is greyed in some windows.
9884d340beffa35b.text: <g1>原本始终显示为英文的文本</g1>现已翻译成所有语言，包括空列表提示、崩溃报告窗口中的按钮，以及某些窗口中“确定”或“验证”按钮变灰的原因。

988a7a63eb86d092.source: A scheme changes colours only, on the classic look: every window, button and menu stays where it was. A dark scheme makes MDM dark and a light one light, whatever <g1>View → Always dark</g1> says. The scheme's colours go where they mean the same:
988a7a63eb86d092.text: 方案只改变经典外观的颜色：所有窗口、按钮和菜单都保持原位。深色方案使 MDM 变暗，浅色方案使 MDM 变亮，无论 <g1>视图 → 始终为深色</g1> 的设置如何。方案的颜色会应用到其含义相同的位置：

98926abaa4b33890.source: Your phone opens a small page that MDM itself serves on your home network. Paste a link, a magnet link or a torrent file, and watch it download on the computer. Nothing to install on the phone, and no outside service.
98926abaa4b33890.text: 您的手机会打开一个由 MDM 在您的家庭网络上提供的小页面。粘贴链接、磁力链接或种子文件，然后观看它在电脑上下载。手机上无需安装任何东西，也无需外部服务。

989d0a3e3e184d6f.source: On the phone, on the same Wi-Fi: scan the QR code with the camera (or type the address).
989d0a3e3e184d6f.text: 在手机上，连接同一 Wi-Fi：用相机扫描二维码（或输入地址）。

989f471f8d0c0cca.source: The website's <g1>Themes page</g1> has a prompt you can give an AI assistant, with the format, every key and the rules, to write a theme for you from a description.
989f471f8d0c0cca.text: 网站的<g1>主题页面</g1>提供了一个您可以提供给 AI 助手的提示，其中包含格式、所有键和规则，以便根据描述为您编写主题。

98ba5822f64ea0d2.source: Mac OS X's feel: gel buttons round at the ends, a blue focus ring and a blue gel progress bar.
98ba5822f64ea0d2.text: Mac OS X 的感觉：两端圆润的凝胶按钮、蓝色焦点环和蓝色凝胶进度条。

98c2bdc7d9ac8445.source: <g1>Show queue selection panel on pressing "Download Later" button</g1> — ask which queue; off puts it in the <g2>Main download queue</g2>.
98c2bdc7d9ac8445.text: <g1>按下“稍后下载”按钮时显示队列选择面板</g1> — 询问要使用哪个队列；关闭此选项后，下载会放入<g2>主下载队列</g2>。

98cabd18b288ca1d.source: Yes, built in: open a .torrent file or paste a magnet link, tick the files you want in the folder tree, and the torrent downloads in the same list as everything else, with its peers, trackers and pieces one tab away. See Torrents.
98cabd18b288ca1d.text: 是，内置支持：打开 .torrent 文件或粘贴磁力链接，在文件夹树中勾选所需文件，种子下载会与其他下载显示在同一列表中，其对等节点、跟踪器和分块信息只需切换一个选项卡即可查看。请参阅“种子”页面。

98e94f4629f01678.source: See why a download stayed in the browser, and which setting to change.
98e94f4629f01678.text: 查看下载停留在浏览器的原因，以及需要更改的设置。

98ee44f0be07d8d6.text: 选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 网卡

98f4c63ffc4e2e0d.source: Removing the last feed in the RSS feeds window no longer crashes the app (<g1>#321</g1>).
98f4c63ffc4e2e0d.text: 在 RSS 源窗口中删除最后一个源不再导致应用程序崩溃（<g1>#321</g1>）。

98fb5e5b449dc77b.source: Each column title has a faint funnel. Click it to filter the list by that column:
98fb5e5b449dc77b.text: 每个列标题旁都有一个浅色的漏斗图标。点击图标可按该列筛选列表：

98fcb27645bb56dd.source: <g1>Without the setup</g1> (a zip copy): on the first start, MDM shows every language with its flag and its own name. Pick yours.
98fcb27645bb56dd.text: <g1>不使用安装程序</g1>（zip 压缩包）：首次启动时，MDM 会显示所有语言的国旗和语言名称。选择所需语言。

9c229c6b356c1396.source: <g1>The host connection limit test tells a reconnect from a connection too many</g1> (<g2>#224</g2>). A server sees that a client dropped an answer only when it next writes to it, so on a busy computer a connection that reconnects can be refused once while the server still counts its old answer. The lab server now logs, with each refusal, how far the answers holding the client's slots had been sent; the test fails only for a refusal none of them explains.
9c229c6b356c1396.text: <g1>主机连接限制测试区分重新连接和过多连接</g1>（<g2>#224</g2>）。服务器只有在下次写入客户端时才会发现客户端丢弃了响应，因此在繁忙的计算机上，重新连接的连接可能会被拒绝一次，而服务器仍在计算其旧响应。实验室服务器现在会记录每次拒绝时，持有客户端槽的响应已发送的进度；测试仅在没有任何解释的拒绝时失败。
