9e4744c9b576debc.source: Go to a web page and click a download link, for example a ZIP or an EXE: MDM opens <g1>Download File Info</g1>. Click <g2>Start Download</g2>.
9e4744c9b576debc.text: 访问网页并点击下载链接，例如 ZIP 或 EXE 文件：MDM 会打开<g1>下载文件信息</g1>。点击<g2>开始下载</g2>。

9e583f3f6cc8d5af.source: <g1>Update now finds the Linux and macOS files by either name</g1>: a release's AppImage, .deb, .rpm, .tar.gz and .dmg were named <x2/>; MDM now looks for the name without it first and still takes the older one, so Update now keeps working whichever a release uses.
9e583f3f6cc8d5af.text: <g1>“立即更新”现在可以通过任一名称找到 Linux 和 macOS 文件</g1>：发布的 AppImage、.deb、.rpm、.tar.gz 和 .dmg 文件都命名为 <x2/>；MDM 现在会首先查找没有它的名称，并且仍然接受旧名称，因此无论发布使用哪个名称，“立即更新”都能继续工作。

9e6e301009e5975d.text: Xfce 上的 MDM 主窗口

9e723581d21aba3f.source: <g1>Another browser built on Chromium</g1> (Helium, Thorium, ungoogled-chromium...): choose <g2>Chromium</g2> and that browser's profile folder (its <x3/> folder, or <x4/>...; under <x5/> on Linux, <x6/> on Windows). yt-dlp reads the folder, but a browser that keeps its key under its own name in the keyring, or locks its cookies as Chrome does, can't be read this way: use its extension's button.
9e723581d21aba3f.text: <g1>其他基于 Chromium 的浏览器</g1>（Helium、Thorium、ungoogled-chromium...）：选择<g2>Chromium</g2>和该浏览器的配置文件文件夹（其<x3/>文件夹，或<x4/>...；在 Linux 上位于<x5/>下，在 Windows 上位于<x6/>下）。yt-dlp 会读取该文件夹，但如果浏览器将其密钥以自己的名称保存在密钥环中，或像 Chrome 一样锁定其 Cookie，则无法通过此方式读取：请使用其扩展程序的按钮。

9ea4c71fa0f481c4.source: MDM follows your system: when Windows (or your desktop's light/dark preference on Linux and macOS) is set to dark mode, so is MDM. To keep MDM light whatever the system does, turn off <g1>View → Dark Mode support</g1>. To keep it dark whatever the system does, for example on a desktop that reports no preference, turn on <g2>View → Always dark</g2>.
9ea4c71fa0f481c4.text: MDM 会跟随系统设置：当 Windows（或 Linux 和 macOS 上桌面环境的浅色/深色偏好设置）设为深色模式时，MDM 也会使用深色模式。要让 MDM 不受系统设置影响，始终保持浅色，请关闭<g1>视图 → 深色模式支持</g1>。要让 MDM 不受系统设置影响，始终保持深色（例如，桌面环境未报告偏好设置时），请开启<g2>视图 → 始终为深色</g2>。

9eace8e71a572e6e.source: Is the file's type in <g1>Options → File types</g1>? Only listed types are taken automatically. <g2>Download with Mister Download Manager</g2> on the right-click menu takes any link.
9eace8e71a572e6e.text: 文件类型是否列在<g1>选项 → 文件类型</g1>中？只有列表中的文件类型才会被自动接管。右键菜单中的<g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载</g2>可以下载任何链接。

9ebe47af30bc7593.source: Click your language above: it opens its file on GitHub, one text per row.
9ebe47af30bc7593.text: 点击上面的语言：它会在 GitHub 上打开其文件，每行一个文本。

9ee01014043d0097.source: Yes. It's open source under the GNU GPL, version 3. No trial, no paid edition, no registration key, no nag screen, no ads. <g1>More</g1>
9ee01014043d0097.text: 是的。它是 GNU GPL v3 许可下的开源软件。没有试用期，没有付费版，没有注册码，没有弹窗，没有广告。<g1>更多</g1>

9ee8f15bb6e8423c.source: Select part of a page and right-click it for <g1>Download selected links with Mister Download Manager</g1>, or right-click the page for <g2>Download all links with Mister Download Manager</g2>: the links open in <g3><g4>Link grabber</g4></g3>, sorted into packages, where you tick the ones you want.
9ee8f15bb6e8423c.text: 选中页面的一部分，然后右键点击并选择<g1>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载选定链接</g1>；或者右键点击页面并选择<g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载所有链接</g2>：这些链接会在<g3><g4>链接抓取器</g4></g3>中打开，并按包分类，您可以勾选想要的链接。

9efdcb6a62e4c3f8.source: File Properties with the download's address
9efdcb6a62e4c3f8.text: 显示下载地址的“文件属性”

9f049ef9f553fd9d.source: MDM splits a file into parts and downloads them side by side, then keeps every connection busy until the last byte. If the line drops or the computer restarts, the download carries on from where it was.
9f049ef9f553fd9d.text: MDM 将文件分成多个部分并同时下载，然后保持每个连接忙碌，直到下载完最后一个字节。如果网络中断或计算机重启，下载会从中断处继续。

9f1b18ba278b131b.source: <g1>The app's own command line</g1>, the same switches as IDM's: hand a download to the running app from a script, a batch file or another program.
9f1b18ba278b131b.text: <g1>应用程序自带的命令行</g1>，使用与 IDM 相同的开关：通过脚本、批处理文件或其他程序，将下载任务交给正在运行的应用程序。

9f205a2e0f05f0f5.source: MDM is made by Ahmed Nefzaoui, an independent developer, and is open to contributions from anyone on GitHub. Bug reports, translations and code are all welcome.
9f205a2e0f05f0f5.text: MDM 由独立开发者 Ahmed Nefzaoui 制作，并欢迎 GitHub 上的任何人贡献。错误报告、翻译和代码都受到欢迎。

9f53b85b50e77a6c.source: Link grabber listing imported links in packages, with their names, sizes and whether they are online
9f53b85b50e77a6c.text: 链接抓取器以包的形式列出导入的链接，显示其名称、大小以及是否在线

9f60d98a8a676f14.source: Run MDM without a window on a home server or a NAS, and send it downloads from your phone or your browser. The files land in the server's own folders, such as a network share.
9f60d98a8a676f14.text: 在家庭服务器或 NAS 上无窗口运行 MDM，并通过手机或浏览器向其发送下载任务。文件将直接保存到服务器的文件夹中，例如网络共享。

9f6e2df52a0ee2a1.source: PDFs, music and videos the browser would open itself, and downloads from forms, go to MDM too. Hold <g1>Alt</g1> while clicking to let the browser have one.
9f6e2df52a0ee2a1.text: 浏览器会自行打开的 PDF、音乐和视频，以及来自表单的下载，也会发送到 MDM。在点击时按住<g1>Alt</g1>键，可让浏览器自行处理。

9f782f136a8bb467.source: The built-in categories can now be renamed, given other file types, or deleted.
9f782f136a8bb467.text: 内置类别现在可以重命名、指定其他文件类型或删除。

9f93bf61864af099.source: Plainly: everyone sharing the same torrent sees your IP address. That is how BitTorrent works, and no setting changes it. To hide it, use a VPN for the whole computer. <g1>Torrents and your security</g1> says what others can see.
9f93bf61864af099.text: 简单来说：所有共享同一种子的人都能看到您的 IP 地址。BitTorrent 的工作方式就是如此，任何设置都无法改变。要隐藏它，请为整台计算机使用 VPN。<g1>种子和您的安全</g1>说明了其他人可以看到什么。

9fdf9558274838d9.source: Yes, built in: open a <x1/> file or paste a magnet link, tick the files you want in the folder tree, and the torrent downloads in the same list as everything else, with its peers, trackers and pieces one tab away. See <g2>Torrents</g2>.
9fdf9558274838d9.text: 可以，内置支持：打开<x1/>文件或粘贴磁力链接，在文件夹树中勾选所需文件，种子就会在与其他下载相同的列表中下载，其对等点、跟踪器和分片信息都在一个选项卡中。请参阅<g2>种子</g2>。

9fe363ab929197a2.source: Videos protected with DRM (most paid streaming services) can't be downloaded.
9fe363ab929197a2.text: 受 DRM 保护的视频（大多数付费流媒体服务）无法下载。

a005349660165dea.source: <g1>Palette roles.</g1> <x2/> declares each role with a stable key (<x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>…), a description and the classic look's light and dark values, written out (the classic look isn't derived). The shared painters (<x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>) read them through <x10/> and <x11/> and decide each control's states from them; no painting code holds a colour of its own.
a005349660165dea.text: <g1>调色板角色。</g1> <x2/> 声明每个角色都有一个稳定的键（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>…）、一个描述以及经典外观的亮色和暗色值，明确写出（经典外观并非派生）。共享的绘图器（<x6/>、<x7/>、<x8/>、<x9/>）通过 <x10/> 和 <x11/> 读取它们，并根据它们决定每个控件的状态；没有绘图代码拥有自己的颜色。

a00be807376be1c7.source: On Windows, MDM must be installed with the setup, with <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> ticked. It is ticked by default. If you're not sure, run the setup again. A portable copy can't do this. On Linux and macOS, start MDM once: it sets browser integration up itself.
a00be807376be1c7.text: 在 Windows 上，MDM 必须通过安装程序安装，并勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Firefox）</g1>。此选项默认勾选。如果您不确定，请再次运行安装程序。便携版无法执行此操作。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，启动 MDM 一次即可：它会自动设置浏览器集成。

a015c3ccc9319dfa.source: MDM contains no adware, spyware, bundled offers or tracking. Its whole source code is public, so anyone can check what it does, and every release is built…
a015c3ccc9319dfa.text: MDM 不含广告软件、间谍软件、捆绑软件或跟踪功能。它的全部源代码都是公开的，任何人都可以检查其功能；每个版本都由 GitHub 的服务器根据这份代码构建，构建过程也可以检查。

a02c94e070503928.source: Browsers built on them work too: Chromium and Helium take the extension as Chrome does, Brave Origin as Brave does, Zen and LibreWolf as Firefox does. On Windows, Zen has a bug of its own (see <g1>The browser and MDM aren't connected</g1>).
a02c94e070503928.text: 基于这些浏览器构建的其他浏览器也同样适用：Chromium 和 Helium 像 Chrome 一样安装扩展，Brave Origin 像 Brave 一样，Zen 和 LibreWolf 像 Firefox 一样。在 Windows 上，Zen 自身存在一个错误（请参阅<g1>浏览器与 MDM 未连接</g1>）。

a02d16007411c0b8.source: <g1>Sign-ins in the system's keychain</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>): debrid accounts, Sites Logins' passwords and the proxy's password are kept in Windows Credential Manager, in the system keyring on Linux (Secret Service: GNOME Keyring, KeePassXC and others) and in the macOS keychain, and the settings keep only a reference. Those already saved move there on the next start. A locked keyring is never unlocked and no keyring is ever asked for a password: without one, they stay in MDM's settings as before, sealed for your Windows account on Windows (the proxy's password now too, like Sites Logins' passwords). <g3>Options → Accounts</g3> says where they are. A portable copy keeps them in its own folder, and uninstalling with <g4>remove the download list and settings</g4> removes them from Credential Manager too.
a02d16007411c0b8.text: <g1>系统钥匙串中的登录信息</g1>（<g2>#44</g2>）：debrid 账户、“站点登录”的密码和代理密码保存在 Windows 凭据管理器中，Linux 上的系统钥匙串（Secret Service：GNOME Keyring、KeePassXC 等）和 macOS 钥匙串中，设置中只保留引用。已保存的密码会在下次启动时移到那里。锁定的钥匙串永远不会解锁，也永远不会要求钥匙串输入密码：如果没有密码，它们会像以前一样保留在 MDM 的设置中，在 Windows 上为您的 Windows 账户密封（代理密码现在也一样，就像“站点登录”的密码一样）。<g3>选项 → 账户</g3>会显示它们的位置。便携式副本将其保存在自己的文件夹中，并且使用<g4>删除下载列表和设置</g4>卸载时也会将其从凭据管理器中删除。

a04886db62535b92.source: A translation longer than the English ends in <g1>...</g1> where it doesn't fit; point at it to read it whole.
a04886db62535b92.text: 翻译比英文长、无法完整显示时，会以<g1>...</g1>结尾；将指针移到上面即可查看全文。

a055c6e11c6c0a0e.source: Freeze reports now say whether MDM was stuck in a loop, waiting on something, or the computer was too busy to run it.
a055c6e11c6c0a0e.text: 冻结报告现在会说明 MDM 是陷入循环、等待某事，还是计算机太忙无法运行。

a05a0538e9ea2498.source: <g1>File Properties</g1> shows a download's type, status, size and folder, its address, your description, the page it came from (<g2>Referer</g2>), where its server is (<g3>country and round trip</g3>, as its last run saw them) and a login for the site. <g4>Last try</g4> and <g5>Result</g5> tell you how its last attempt went.
a05a0538e9ea2498.text: <g1>文件属性</g1>显示下载的类型、状态、大小和文件夹、下载地址、描述、来源页面（<g2>引用页</g2>）、服务器所在位置（<g3>国家和往返时间</g3>，根据上次运行时的信息），以及网站登录信息。<g4>上次尝试</g4>和<g5>结果</g5>会显示上次尝试的情况。

a0699e809eb6239e.source: MDM runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11, and on 64-bit Linux: see On Linux. Builds for macOS are new and still experimental: see On a Mac.
a0699e809eb6239e.text: MDM 运行在 64 位 Windows 10 和 Windows 11，以及 64 位 Linux 上：请参阅“在 Linux 上”。macOS 版本是新推出的，仍处于实验阶段：请参阅“在 Mac 上”。

a079f6f8e2772761.source: <g1>RSS support:</g1> follow feeds and add new torrents automatically, by your own rules.
a079f6f8e2772761.text: <g1>RSS 支持：</g1> 关注订阅源，并根据您自己的规则自动添加新种子。

a07f2dcbe8384d26.source: Every feature of Mister Download Manager: acceleration and resume, the browser extension, video, torrents, the scheduler, the link grabber, themes and more.
a07f2dcbe8384d26.text: Mister Download Manager 的所有功能：加速和恢复、浏览器扩展、视频、种子、计划任务、链接抓取器、主题等。

a09cf46e49e64bbb.source: A sweep through every window for the small things that make a program feel finished: how each control looks and answers the mouse and the keyboard, dark mode everywhere, screen readers, and a long list of fixes found by reviewing all of it (issue #7 and more).
a09cf46e49e64bbb.text: 全面检查了所有窗口，修复那些影响程序完善度的小问题：控件外观及其对鼠标和键盘操作的响应、各处的深色模式、屏幕阅读器支持，以及全面检查后发现的大量问题（问题 #7 等）。

a0b72e0ca30f6343.text: <g1>已交付</g1><g2>1 GiB 在 1.01 秒内</g2>

a0bcc795abe2ba9c.source: Smaller Mac downloads, lighter Linux updates
a0bcc795abe2ba9c.text: 更小的 Mac 下载，更轻的 Linux 更新

a0c11538b9c2d798.source: <g1>Download [N] files at the same time</g1> — how many of the queue's downloads run together. The rest wait their turn.
a0c11538b9c2d798.text: <g1>同时下载 [N] 个文件</g1> — 队列中同时运行的下载数量。其余的会等待轮到它们。

a0c229fa0387954f.source: Choose <g1>Tasks → Add batch download</g1> and write the address with one asterisk where the files differ: <x2/>. Under <g3>Replace asterisk to</g3>, choose <g4>Numbers</g4> or <g5>Letters</g5>, then <g6>From</g6> and <g7>To</g7>. For numbers, <g8>Wildcard size</g8> sets the number of digits: with 3, the files are <x9/>, <x10/> and so on.
a0c229fa0387954f.text: 选择<g1>任务 → 添加批量下载</g1>，并在文件不同之处写入一个星号：<x2/>。在<g3>将星号替换为</g3>下，选择<g4>数字</g4>或<g5>字母</g5>，然后选择<g6>从</g6>和<g7>到</g7>。对于数字，<g8>通配符大小</g8>设置位数：如果设置为 3，文件将是<x9/>、<x10/>等等。

a0cef8bf72170dd2.source: What each one says it offers, on its own website or in its code's README. A dash means it isn't among the features it lists, not that it can't be done.
a0cef8bf72170dd2.text: 每个下载管理器在其官网或代码的 README 中声称提供的功能。破折号表示其未列出该功能，不代表无法实现。

a0f175fb9b78e22a.source: A whole numbered series from one address.
a0f175fb9b78e22a.text: 从一个地址下载整个编号系列。

a0f44b2041902a09.source: gallery-dl checks the address on your computer, without going online. When the line reads <g1>gallery-dl can download this gallery's files</g1>, you're ready.
a0f44b2041902a09.text: gallery-dl 会在您的电脑上检查地址，无需联网。当显示“<g1>gallery-dl 可以下载此图库的文件</g1>”时，就可以开始下载了。

a11eb17a68d5036a.text: <g1>Linux AppImage</g1><g2>任何发行版 · 实验性</g2>

a11ff1df96b6c18c.source: <g1><g2>Command line and automation</g2></g1> — IDM's command-line switches, the <x3/> tool, and the automation API other programs can use.
a11ff1df96b6c18c.text: <g1><g2>命令行和自动化</g2></g1> — IDM 的命令行开关、<x3/> 工具以及其他程序可以使用的自动化 API。

a12e87e4f58e6e09.source: <g1>Dailymotion's embedded player</g1> (<g2>#359</g2>): its address is looked up as the video's own page, so the download button works on sites that embed one.
a12e87e4f58e6e09.text: <g1>Dailymotion 的嵌入式播放器</g1>（<g2>#359</g2>）：其地址现在被视为视频本身的页面，因此下载按钮可以在嵌入该播放器的网站上使用。

a138862f6607942e.source: addresses (implicit TLS) don't start while an adapter is chosen; <x1/> with TLS is fine. Connections to this computer itself aren't bound, so a proxy running on this computer decides where your downloads go from there. On macOS, a VPN that reconnects may come back as a new interface (<x2/> instead of <x3/>): pick it again.
a138862f6607942e.text: 如果选择了适配器，则地址（隐式 TLS）不会开始下载；<x1/> 使用 TLS 则可以。连接到此计算机本身的流量不受此限制，因此在此计算机上运行的代理会决定您的下载去向。在 macOS 上，重新连接的 VPN 可能会以新接口的形式出现（<x2/> 而不是 <x3/>）：请重新选择它。

a16824942383eb7f.source: A theme is one small text file, in <g1>TOML</g1> (or JSON). It names only what it changes; everything else comes from the theme it builds on. You don't need to build MDM or know how to program.
a16824942383eb7f.text: 主题是一个小的 <g1>TOML</g1>（或 JSON）文本文件。它只命名它所更改的内容；其他所有内容都来自它所基于的主题。您无需构建 MDM 或了解如何编程。

a186c2ecb83c1705.source: Keep some speed for everything else
a186c2ecb83c1705.text: 为其他任务保留一些速度

a18e9003d93b63fb.source: <g1>Installed with the setup:</g1> MDM starts in the language you chose in the setup.
a18e9003d93b63fb.text: <g1>通过安装程序安装：</g1> MDM 以您在安装程序中选择的语言启动。

a194f040aea0fdf9.source: Some buttons are greyed. They belong to features that aren't built yet.
a194f040aea0fdf9.text: 有些按钮是灰色的。它们属于尚未构建的功能。

a1a366218784daae.source: Hold <g1>Alt</g1> while clicking a link to let the browser download it instead of MDM. In Firefox, Alt+click saves a link only when its <x2/> setting is on (in <x3/>); otherwise right-click the link and choose <g4>Save Link As...</g4>, which the browser keeps. <g5>Options → General → Keys...</g5> says so, and holds <g6>Also take files the browser would open</g6>.
a1a366218784daae.text: 在点击链接时按住 <g1>Alt</g1> 键，让浏览器而不是 MDM 下载它。在 Firefox 中，只有当其 <x2/> 设置开启时（在 <x3/> 中），Alt+点击才能保存链接；否则右键点击链接并选择 <g4>链接另存为...</g4>，浏览器会保留该链接。<g5>选项 → 常规 → 按键...</g5> 中有说明，并包含 <g6>也接管浏览器会打开的文件</g6>。

a1b29b6dc03c2789.source: If MDM says it's up to date, there's nothing for you to do. The extension updates by itself through its store and can get ahead of the app for a while. Everything keeps working, and the message goes away with the next version of MDM.
a1b29b6dc03c2789.text: 如果 MDM 提示已是最新版本，则无需进行任何操作。扩展程序会通过其商店自行更新，有时会比应用程序版本更新得快。所有功能仍可正常使用，此消息将在 MDM 的下一个版本中消失。

a2907e04d7c8512f.text: 为什么 MDM 没有接管我的下载？ — Mister Download Manager

a294b81a4c5134b9.source: Install MDM with the setup from <g1>the download page</g1>, and keep <g2>Set up browser integration</g2> ticked.
a294b81a4c5134b9.text: 使用<g1>下载页面</g1>中的安装程序安装 MDM，并确保勾选<g2>设置浏览器集成</g2>。

a29c315dcb4443e0.source: <g1>A finished torrent's progress window lost its tabs while it was still shared</g1>: Files, Peers, Trackers, Pieces and General (with the share ratio) said "Shown while the torrent is downloading." They now stay for as long as the torrent is shared.
a29c315dcb4443e0.text: <g1>已完成的洪流在共享时，其进度窗口会丢失选项卡</g1>：文件、对等方、跟踪器、分块和常规（包含共享率）选项卡会显示“洪流下载时显示。”。现在这些选项卡在洪流共享期间会一直显示。

a2bc0741291e5a76.source: A freeze report will say whether MDM's window ran all along (a loop), waited (on a lock, the disk or the network), or hardly ran at all. That last kind usually means a computer too busy to run MDM, most likely not a bug in MDM, and those reports share one signature so they find one issue instead of many. macOS doesn't measure this yet. The window's title will be in MDM's language too, and the report will keep its own lines in every language, left to right in Arabic and Persian.
a2bc0741291e5a76.text: 冻结报告会说明 MDM 窗口是始终运行（循环）、等待（锁定、磁盘或网络）还是几乎没有运行。最后一种情况通常意味着计算机过于繁忙而无法运行 MDM，很可能不是 MDM 中的错误，这些报告共享一个签名，因此它们会找到一个问题而不是多个问题。macOS 尚未测量此项。窗口标题也将采用 MDM 的语言，报告将保留其在每种语言中的行，在阿拉伯语和波斯语中从左到右显示。

a2d96f4a163d77b8.source: For the best qualities and MP3, MDM needs <g1>ffmpeg</g1>, which joins the picture and the sound, and makes the MP3. On Windows MDM offers to install it (about 80 MB): click <g2>Install ffmpeg</g2> if you want them. On Linux and macOS MDM uses the system's ffmpeg. Without it, you get the qualities that come with their sound.
a2d96f4a163d77b8.text: 为了获得最佳质量和 MP3，MDM 需要 <g1>ffmpeg</g1>，它负责将图像和声音合并，并制作 MP3。在 Windows 上，MDM 会提供安装它（约 80 MB）：如果您需要，请点击<g2>安装 ffmpeg</g2>。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，MDM 使用系统的 ffmpeg。如果没有它，您将只能获得自带声音的质量。

a2ecbbee3658b831.text: 480 个连接对比 2 个连接。

a332d36c2ada2664.source: User names and passwords for sites that ask for them. <g1>New</g1> adds a row: the site (with a path if the login is only for part of it), the user name and the password. <g2>Edit</g2> and <g3>Remove</g3> change or delete the selected row. MDM uses the login for every download from that site. A login typed in <g4>Add URL</g4> (<g5>Use authorization</g5>) takes priority for that one download.
a332d36c2ada2664.text: 需要用户名和密码的站点的登录信息。<g1>新建</g1>会添加一行，填写站点（如果登录信息仅适用于站点的部分路径，则填写路径）、用户名和密码。<g2>编辑</g2>和<g3>删除</g3>可修改或删除选中的行。MDM 会将此登录信息用于从该站点进行的所有下载。在<g4>添加 URL</g4>（<g5>使用授权</g5>）中输入的登录信息仅对该次下载优先使用。

a356f214a2ec96a0.source: In Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur the whole window is mirrored, the way Windows does it for these languages. File names, addresses and folder paths keep their own direction inside translated sentences, so they stay readable. MDM uses the system's own fonts for every script.
a356f214a2ec96a0.text: 在阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语中，整个窗口会像 Windows 对这些语言的处理方式一样进行镜像显示。文件名、地址和文件夹路径在翻译后的句子中会保持其自身方向，以确保可读性。MDM 为每种文字都使用系统自带的字体。

a3633bf4f8cf650e.source: Remove the selected item of a list (a login, an exception, a queue: asks first)
a3633bf4f8cf650e.text: 删除列表中选中的项目（登录信息、例外项或队列；删除前会询问）

a38402946943e3ca.source: <g1>Report a bug</g1><g2>Something broken or odd? Tell us what you saw.</g2>
a38402946943e3ca.text: <g1>报告错误</g1><g2>遇到故障或异常？告诉我们您遇到了什么。</g2>

a3df8367f292fb9b.source: Video pages and image galleries: yt-dlp, gallery-dl and the ffmpeg yt-dlp starts can't be held to an adapter themselves, so while one is chosen MDM gives them a proxy of its own on this computer (<x1/>, with a password only they get). MDM opens their connections through the adapter, as it opens its own, and looks the names up with the DNS you chose. When the adapter disconnects, their connections close and the downloads stop with the others. Video formats that can't go through a proxy (RTMP, RTSP, MMS, FTP) are refused rather than sent around it.
a3df8367f292fb9b.text: 视频页面和图片库：yt-dlp、gallery-dl 以及 yt-dlp 启动的 ffmpeg 本身无法绑定到适配器，因此选择适配器后，MDM 会在此计算机上为它们提供自己的代理（<x1/>，只有它们知道密码）。MDM 会像处理自己的连接一样，通过该适配器为它们建立连接，并使用您选择的 DNS 查询域名。适配器断开连接时，它们的连接会关闭，下载也会和其他下载一起停止。无法通过代理传输的视频格式（RTMP、RTSP、MMS、FTP）会被拒绝，而不会绕过代理发送。

a3f154dfacda2d5a.source: <g1>Name</g1>: the package's name, kept with its downloads.
a3f154dfacda2d5a.text: <g1>名称</g1>：分组名称，会与其中的下载一起保存。

a4106dfebeee68bc.source: <g1>The last languages</g1> (after #247): Options → Proxy's title takes two lines where one leaves Get System too little room (Bulgarian, Armenian, Tamil), and where it ran over the page's icon or past the window's left edge (Greek, Finnish, Catalan, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Malayalam, Serbian, Afrikaans). In Greek and Malayalam, the Scheduler's "Turn off computer when done" and its choices have shorter machine translations, so the drop-down fits beside the caption; in Belarusian, Welsh, French, Russian, Tamil and Ukrainian, the longer ones the translation review brought (such as Russian's Hibernate) are back to their earlier, shorter wording.
a4106dfebeee68bc.text: <g1>最后的语言调整</g1>（继 #247 之后）：在某些语言（保加利亚语、亚美尼亚语、泰米尔语）中，“选项”→“代理”的标题需要两行，否则“从系统获取”的空间不足；在另一些语言（希腊语、芬兰语、加泰罗尼亚语、爱沙尼亚语、拉脱维亚语、立陶宛语、马拉雅拉姆语、塞尔维亚语、南非荷兰语）中，标题会超出页面图标或窗口左边缘。在希腊语和马拉雅拉姆语中，“计划程序”的“完成后关闭计算机”及其选项的机器翻译较短，因此下拉菜单可以与标题并排显示；在白俄罗斯语、威尔士语、法语、俄语、泰米尔语和乌克兰语中，翻译审阅后较长的措辞（如俄语的“休眠”）已恢复到之前较短的措辞。

a410e1f12c6dc5bd.source: Options, General: Use advanced browser integration and the list of browsers MDM takes downloads from
a410e1f12c6dc5bd.text: 选项，常规：使用高级浏览器集成和 MDM 从中获取下载的浏览器列表

a419d7027655348e.text: 在 MDM 运行时运行<x1/>。

a43367ad93483b7d.source: MDM reads the torrent and shows its files as a folder tree. A <x1/> file is read at once. A magnet link first has to get the file list from other peers, usually within seconds. While it waits, <g2>Add torrent</g2> shows how many peers it found, from the trackers, the DHT or your local network, and how many answered. After 30 seconds without an answer, it says what may be in the way: a link with no trackers while the DHT is off, or a firewall, a VPN or a network that blocks BitTorrent.
a43367ad93483b7d.text: MDM 读取种子文件，并将其文件显示为文件夹树。一个 <x1/> 文件会立即读取。磁力链接需要先从其他对等点获取文件列表，通常在几秒钟内完成。在等待期间，<g2>添加种子</g2> 会显示它从跟踪器、DHT 或本地网络中找到的对等点数量，以及有多少对等点做出了响应。如果在 30 秒内没有响应，它会说明可能存在的问题：一个没有跟踪器且 DHT 已关闭的链接，或者防火墙、VPN 或阻止 BitTorrent 的网络。

a43f559b321cf278.source: A torrent names the trackers MDM asks for peers. MDM doesn't contact a tracker on your own computer or your local network (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/> and the like), so a torrent can't make MDM send requests into the network it sits in. <g4>Add trackers...</g4> follows the same rule: it refuses such an address and tells you why, rather than keeping one that would never be asked.
a43f559b321cf278.text: 种子会列出 MDM 用来请求对等方的跟踪器。MDM 不会联系您自己的计算机或本地网络上的跟踪器（<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/> 等），因此种子无法让 MDM 向其所在的网络发送请求。<g4>添加跟踪器...</g4>也遵循同样的规则：遇到这类地址时会拒绝添加并说明原因，而不是保留一个永远不会被联系的地址。

a44c5fa75c2945d8.source: The layout is familiar on purpose: the toolbar, the categories, the download list, the progress window with every connection, queues and the scheduler. The differences: MDM is free and open source, downloads BitTorrent and magnet links in the same list, finished faster in our benchmark, speaks 86 languages and has builds for Linux and macOS. IDM is the more mature product, refined over many years. See the full comparison.
a44c5fa75c2945d8.text: 布局刻意保持熟悉：工具栏、类别、下载列表、显示每个连接的进度窗口、队列和计划任务。不同之处在于：MDM 是免费开源的，可以在同一列表中下载 BitTorrent 和磁力链接，在我们的基准测试中完成速度更快，支持 86 种语言，并提供 Linux 和 macOS 版本。IDM 是更成熟的产品，经过多年完善。查看完整比较。

a44d436e19996493.source: It downloads like any other file.
a44d436e19996493.text: 它像其他文件一样下载。

a44e8ef88f2d252b.source: Write your own theme as a TOML or JSON file, or import a Base16 scheme or your pywal colours.
a44e8ef88f2d252b.text: 您可以将自己的主题编写为 TOML 或 JSON 文件，或导入 Base16 方案或您的 pywal 颜色。

a4593e6b1208fff5.source: <g1>Send on GitHub</g1> opens GitHub's crash report form in your browser, already filled in, with the folder that holds the report. You check it and submit it. That needs a GitHub account. <g2>Nothing is sent by itself</g2>: there is no background upload and no reporting service, only your browser and GitHub.
a4593e6b1208fff5.text: <g1>在 GitHub 上发送</g1>会在您的浏览器中打开 GitHub 的崩溃报告表单，其中已填写好内容，并附带报告所在的文件夹。您检查后提交即可。这需要一个 GitHub 帐户。<g2>没有任何内容会自动发送</g2>：没有后台上传，也没有报告服务，只有您的浏览器和 GitHub。

a45f25e5b3e6d530.source: Download a torrent, or only some of its files. If some of its files are already in the folder, it stops and names them; <x1/> uses them instead (what matches is kept, the rest downloaded).
a45f25e5b3e6d530.text: 下载种子，或只下载其中部分文件。如果文件夹中已存在其中部分文件，操作会停止并列出这些文件；<x1/> 会使用这些文件（保留匹配的部分，下载其余部分）。

a462139057cb83c0.source: If it says <g1>Google Drive won't give this file now</g1>, Drive's download limit for that file was reached. See <g2>Google Drive links</g2>.
a462139057cb83c0.text: 如果显示<g1>Google 云端硬盘暂时无法提供此文件</g1>，则该文件已达到 Google 云端硬盘的下载限制。另请参阅<g2>Google 云端硬盘链接</g2>。

a46f8686e56a7328.source: Which browsers does it work with? — Mister Download Manager
a46f8686e56a7328.text: Mister Download Manager 支持哪些浏览器？

a4a44a5a7d528e25.source: MDM opens where you left it: the window's place and size, the Categories pane, its open branches and the category or queue you were looking at.
a4a44a5a7d528e25.text: MDM 会在上次关闭时的位置和大小打开窗口，并恢复类别窗格、展开的分支，以及您当时查看的类别或队列。

a4b01563b82565da.source: <g1>Sharper text on Windows</g1> (<g2>#262</g2>): Segoe UI and Tahoma are grid-fitted across as well as up and down, and each letter starts on a whole pixel, as Windows draws its own grey text: upright strokes were two grey pixels wide at 100 % and 125 %, which read as blurred.
a4b01563b82565da.text: <g1>Windows 上的文本更清晰</g1>（<g2>#262</g2>）：Segoe UI 和 Tahoma 字体在水平和垂直方向上都进行了网格对齐，每个字母都从一个完整的像素开始，就像 Windows 绘制其自己的灰色文本一样：在 100% 和 125% 缩放下，竖直笔画是两个灰色像素宽，看起来模糊不清。

a4b04f29f56fdc42.source: <g1>Add category</g1> — make your own, for example <g2>Books</g2> for <x3/>. Give it a name, the file types (separated by spaces, <x4/> allowed) and a folder.
a4b04f29f56fdc42.text: <g1>添加类别</g1> — 创建自定义类别，例如为<x3/>创建<g2>图书</g2>类别。设置类别名称、文件类型（用空格分隔，可使用<x4/>）和文件夹。

a4b1f9a84345ac5d.source: <g1>yt-dlp</g1> (about 23 MB) looks the page up and finds where the video and its sound come from; MDM downloads them (<g2>How a video comes down</g2>). The first time, click <g3>Install yt-dlp</g3>. MDM checks the download against the signature yt-dlp's developers publish before it uses it.
a4b1f9a84345ac5d.text: <g1>yt-dlp</g1>（约 23 MB）负责查找页面并找到视频及其音频的来源；MDM 则负责下载它们（<g2>视频下载方式</g2>）。首次使用时，请点击<g3>安装 yt-dlp</g3>。MDM 会在使用前对照 yt-dlp 开发者发布的签名来检查下载文件。

a4d3460eeaa0a1e4.text: Linux：Flatpak 和 Snap 浏览器

a4d974a7cf63b1e0.source: Speed Limiter settings: Maximum download speed for one file, Always turn on Speed Limiter on startup, and Limit all downloads together to, with Only while I'm using the computer
a4d974a7cf63b1e0.text: 速度限制器设置：单个文件的最大下载速度、始终在启动时开启速度限制器，以及将所有下载总计限制为（包含仅在我使用计算机时）

a4ec7f409ec80484.source: The download list and settings are saved atomically to the data folder (<x1/>): <x2/> on Windows, <x3/> on Linux, <x4/> on macOS, a <x5/> folder beside a portable copy, or <x6/> (<x7/>). The browser host reads the same file for the capture rules, so a change in Options applies to the next captured download.
a4ec7f409ec80484.text: 下载列表和设置以原子方式保存到数据文件夹 (<x1/>)：Windows 上的 <x2/>，Linux 上的 <x3/>，macOS 上的 <x4/>，便携式副本旁边的 <x5/> 文件夹，或 <x6/> (<x7/>)。浏览器主机读取相同的文件以获取捕获规则，因此“选项”中的更改适用于下一个捕获的下载。

a50025a18eca7051.source: MDM's interface comes in 86 languages: every display language Windows 11 offers, from Afrikaans to Vietnamese, including both Chinese scripts, Spanish for Spain and Mexico, French for France and Canada, Portuguese for Portugal and Brazil, and Serbian in Cyrillic and Latin.
a50025a18eca7051.text: MDM 界面支持 86 种语言：Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，从南非荷兰语到越南语，包括简体中文和繁体中文、西班牙语（西班牙和墨西哥）、法语（法国和加拿大）、葡萄牙语（葡萄牙和巴西），以及使用西里尔字母和拉丁字母的塞尔维亚语。

a50c3c69c4e98ed6.source: Put downloads in a queue and let the Scheduler start them when nobody needs the connection. When the queue is done, MDM can quit or turn the computer off.
a50c3c69c4e98ed6.text: 将下载任务放入队列，让计划程序在网络空闲时启动它们。队列完成后，MDM 可以退出或关闭计算机。

a51b37558abe6a60.source: The app talks to <g1>the servers you download from</g1>, to <g2>GitHub</g2> to check for updates when it starts (you can turn that off), and to GitHub again for <g3>yt-dlp and ffmpeg</g3> if you download videos.
a51b37558abe6a60.text: 此应用会与<g1>您下载文件的服务器</g1>通信；启动时会与<g2>GitHub</g2>通信以检查更新（您可以关闭此功能）；如果您下载视频，还会再次与GitHub通信以获取<g3>yt-dlp和ffmpeg</g3>。

a53baf5e058e53a2.source: Add downloads with <g1>Add URL</g1>, the clipboard (<g2>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g2>) or the drop target (<g3>Tasks → Show drop target</g3>).
a53baf5e058e53a2.text: 使用<g1>添加 URL</g1>、剪贴板（<g2>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g2>）或拖放目标（<g3>任务 → 显示拖放目标</g3>）添加下载。

a54ad83afe939ad1.source: yt-dlp looks the page up and picks the quality's video and sound. MDM's own downloader then brings each of them in, one after the other, the way it downloads any file:
a54ad83afe939ad1.text: yt-dlp 查找页面并选择所需质量的视频和音频。MDM 自带的下载器会像下载任何文件一样，一个接一个地下载它们：

The image is small, about 175 MB: Debian's slim base, MDM's two programs and the certificates downloads are checked against. It needs no desktop libraries: MDM loads those only to open a window, which a server never does.
a69373ac180f98a4.text: 首次构建时间较长（在小型服务器上可能长达一小时：整个程序作为一个整体进行优化）。镜像很小，大约 175 MB：包含 Debian 的精简基础、MDM 的两个程序以及用于检查下载的证书。它不需要桌面库：MDM 仅在打开窗口时才加载这些库，而服务器从不打开窗口。

a7431b39fec4f131.source: How it holds: Windows binds the adapter's own address. Windows then sends those packets only through that adapter (its strong host model). Linux binds the device itself (Linux 5.7 or newer), and macOS binds the interface. An address of a kind the adapter doesn't have (IPv6 on an IPv4-only VPN) is refused, not sent around it.
a7431b39fec4f131.text: 它如何保持：Windows 绑定适配器自己的地址。然后 Windows 只通过该适配器发送这些数据包（其强主机模型）。Linux 绑定设备本身（Linux 5.7 或更高版本），macOS 绑定接口。适配器不具备的地址类型（例如仅支持 IPv4 的 VPN 上的 IPv6）将被拒绝，而不会绕过它发送。

a9db3c477db73349.source: <g1>Memory</g1> (on the Processes tab) is what MDM holds for itself alone, its <g2>private working set</g2>. With the window open and nothing downloading, that is about 70 MB.
a9db3c477db73349.text: <g1>内存</g1>（在“进程”选项卡中）是 MDM 独立占用的内存，即其<g2>专用工作集</g2>。在窗口打开且没有下载任务时，大约是 70 MB。

a9efaabb8e76e3a1.source: Move between the <g1>Categories</g1> pane and the download list
a9efaabb8e76e3a1.text: 在<g1>类别</g1>窗格和下载列表之间移动

a9f6a1bd795629db.source: A link to one video inside a playlist or a mix downloads just that video, not the whole list.
a9f6a1bd795629db.text: 播放列表或混合内容中的单个视频链接只下载该视频，而不是整个列表。

aa002a06c5896773.source: When there is one, <g1>Update now</g1> downloads it, checks it, puts it in place and restarts MDM; your list, settings and downloads stay as they are:
aa002a06c5896773.text: 当有新版本时，<g1>立即更新</g1>会下载、检查、安装并重新启动 MDM；你的列表、设置和下载保持不变：

aa048c896c213dbd.source: Firefox and Waterfox: MDM now takes the download before the browser's file dialog, so the browser doesn't download it too.
aa048c896c213dbd.text: Firefox 和 Waterfox：MDM 现在会在浏览器文件对话框之前接管下载，避免浏览器重复下载。

aa13a9113eceef9e.source: Use your own copies of yt-dlp and ffmpeg instead of MDM's.
aa13a9113eceef9e.text: 使用您自己的 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg 副本，而不是 MDM 内置的。

aa1ab6951c7de9ce.source: <g1>Windows: a slow start no longer turns Direct3D off</g1> (part of <g2>#280</g2>): MDM gives Direct3D 10 seconds to show its first frame, and goes back to OpenGL when it doesn't. Those 10 seconds counted MDM's own loading too (the list, the fonts, the icons), which can take that long by itself on a busy computer just after it starts, so Direct3D was taken for failing and OpenGL drew from then on. Only Direct3D's own time counts now. Crash and freeze reports say what drew, on which graphics card and driver (OpenGL's too), and why, near their top, where a report cut to fit still has it.
aa1ab6951c7de9ce.text: <g1>Windows：慢速启动不再关闭 Direct3D</g1>（<g2>#280</g2> 的一部分）：MDM 会给 Direct3D 10 秒时间来显示其第一帧，如果未显示则返回 OpenGL。这 10 秒也计算了 MDM 自身的加载时间（列表、字体、图标），这在刚启动的繁忙计算机上可能需要很长时间，因此 Direct3D 被认为是失败的，此后便使用 OpenGL 绘制。现在只计算 Direct3D 自身的时间。崩溃和冻结报告会在顶部附近说明绘制方式、使用的显卡和驱动程序（也包括 OpenGL 的），以及原因，即使报告被截断以适应空间，这些信息也仍然存在。

aa29963bc67d10b2.source: Mister Download Manager extracts ZIP, TAR, GZ and XZ archives itself, and 7z and RAR with 7-Zip, as soon as they finish downloading.
aa29963bc67d10b2.text: Mister Download Manager 自身可提取 ZIP、TAR、GZ 和 XZ 压缩包，并借助 7-Zip 提取 7z 和 RAR 压缩包，下载完成后立即进行。

aa306d14a55f34a4.source: <g1>Linux: menus appear at once, as menus, on compositors that animate windows</g1> (Hyprland, picom with fading, <g2>#277</g2>). Before the fix above, Hyprland gave MDM's menus a window's border and slid each one down from the top of the screen. And moving from title to title along the menu bar closed one menu window and opened another, so such a compositor faded each menu out and the next one in at every switch. The menu bar's menus now share one window that moves from title to title, as a submenu's window already did from item to item, and each menu window says which menu it is (a drop-down menu, a right-click menu, a drop-down list), as GTK's and Qt's do.
aa306d14a55f34a4.text: <g1>Linux：在动画窗口的合成器上，菜单会立即以菜单形式出现</g1>（Hyprland，带淡入淡出的 picom，<g2>#277</g2>）。在上述修复之前，Hyprland 会给 MDM 的菜单一个窗口边框，并将其从屏幕顶部滑下。并且沿着菜单栏从一个标题移动到另一个标题会关闭一个菜单窗口并打开另一个，因此这样的合成器会在每次切换时淡出每个菜单并淡入下一个。现在菜单栏的菜单共享一个从标题移动到标题的窗口，就像子菜单的窗口已经从项目移动到项目一样，并且每个菜单窗口都说明它是哪个菜单（下拉菜单、右键菜单、下拉列表），就像 GTK 和 Qt 的菜单一样。

aa3308d063f6822b.source: Acts on downloads by id: <x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/> (file kept) or <x4/> (file deleted too). Answers <x5/>; a running download must be paused before it is removed or deleted. Only while the API is on.
aa3308d063f6822b.text: 根据 ID 操作下载：<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>（保留文件）或 <x4/>（也删除文件）。返回 <x5/>；移除或删除正在进行的下载前，必须先暂停。仅在 API 开启时可用。

aa33e21a9939345a.source: <g1>Linux: Vulkan, and macOS: Metal, in View → Draw with</g1> (<g2>#206</g2>). Linux can draw its windows with Vulkan (on Wayland and X11), and macOS with Metal, the way Windows draws with Direct3D. OpenGL stays the default there until reports from real graphics cards are in: try it and tell us how it went. The same safety net as on Windows: when Vulkan or Metal can't start (no driver for it), its first frame doesn't come within 10 seconds, or a start with it ends before its first frame, MDM draws with OpenGL until it is chosen again, and the menu says why. A graphics card reset while MDM runs starts MDM again.
aa33e21a9939345a.text: <g1>Linux：Vulkan，macOS：Metal，在视图 → 绘制方式中</g1>（<g2>#206</g2>）。Linux 可以在 Wayland 和 X11 上使用 Vulkan 绘制窗口，macOS 可以使用 Metal，就像 Windows 使用 Direct3D 绘制一样。OpenGL 仍是默认设置，直到收到真实显卡的报告：请尝试并告诉我们效果如何。与 Windows 相同的安全网：当 Vulkan 或 Metal 无法启动（没有驱动）、其第一帧在 10 秒内未出现，或使用它启动但在第一帧出现前结束时，MDM 会使用 OpenGL 绘制，直到再次选择它，菜单会说明原因。MDM 运行时显卡重置会重新启动 MDM。

aa4c0c6b476d4f22.source: Browser integration is set up by MDM itself at each start (the browsers installed then are found); add the extension as in <g1>Browser integration</g1>. Firefox installed as a Snap (Ubuntu's) reaches MDM once you allow it; other Snap and Flatpak browsers can't (see <g2>Flatpak and Snap browsers</g2>). The tray icon, Dark Mode support and Launch on startup work on GNOME (Ubuntu's), KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon.
aa4c0c6b476d4f22.text: 浏览器集成由 MDM 每次启动时自行设置（会找到当时安装的浏览器）；按照<g1>浏览器集成</g1>中的说明添加扩展。作为 Snap（Ubuntu 的）安装的 Firefox 在您允许后即可连接 MDM；其他 Snap 和 Flatpak 浏览器无法连接（请参阅<g2>Flatpak 和 Snap 浏览器</g2>）。托盘图标、深色模式支持和开机启动功能在 GNOME（Ubuntu 的）、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 上均可使用。

aa4e2c439b4fc32d.source: <g1>Codeberg, for gallery-dl.</g1> If you download an image gallery, MDM installs gallery-dl from its official releases on Codeberg and checks its author's signature; gallery-dl then talks to the site you asked for.
aa4e2c439b4fc32d.text: <g1>Codeberg，用于gallery-dl。</g1>如果您下载图片库，MDM会从Codeberg的官方发布中安装gallery-dl并检查其作者签名；然后gallery-dl会与您请求的网站通信。

aa5663869aa3510d.source: MDM doesn't need to be running first: the browser starts it. If MDM can't be reached at all, the download stays with the browser, so nothing is lost.
aa5663869aa3510d.text: MDM 无需预先运行：浏览器会启动它。如果 MDM 完全无法访问，下载将保留在浏览器中，因此不会丢失任何内容。

aa66812539354310.source: <g1>Better translations in every language.</g1> Every machine-translated text of the program and of the website was read again against the English, with a style guide for each language (how it writes commands, questions and labels) and the terms native reviewers settled, and fixed where it was wrong or unnatural. Texts a person reviewed (all of Italian and Arabic) were left as they are. New texts are translated the same way from now on.
aa66812539354310.text: <g1>所有语言的翻译都更完善。</g1> 程序和网站的每段机器翻译文本都已根据英文原文重新审阅，并遵循各语言的风格指南（如何撰写命令、问题和标签）以及本地审阅者确定的术语，对错误或不自然的表达进行了修正。人工审阅过的文本（所有意大利语和阿拉伯语文本）保持不变。今后，新文本也将以同样的方式进行翻译。

aa841f364038c810.source: Each column title has a faint funnel. Click it to keep only some rows:
aa841f364038c810.text: 每个列标题旁都有一个浅色漏斗图标。点击图标可只显示符合条件的行：

aa96ab75fe37ecf8.source: <g1>A window's contents the first time they read it</g1> (<g2>#131</g2>): a window read for the first time (Link grabber, Options, About...) showed only its title bar until it was drawn again. It now answers with what it shows at once, as soon as a screen reader is running.
aa96ab75fe37ecf8.text: <g1>窗口内容首次读取时即可显示</g1> (<g2>#131</g2>)：首次读取的窗口（链接抓取器、选项、关于...）只显示其标题栏，直到再次绘制。现在，只要屏幕阅读器运行，它就会立即响应并显示其内容。

aa9ee64ba69f2d26.source: A download that stopped halfway doesn't have to start over. MDM keeps what it has and continues from there.
aa9ee64ba69f2d26.text: 中途停止的下载不必重新开始。MDM 会保留已下载的部分，并从那里继续。

aab5074afda2571f.source: On Linux, with Firefox or Chromium installed as a Snap, see <g1>Flatpak and Snap browsers</g1>.
aab5074afda2571f.text: 在 Linux 上，如果 Firefox 或 Chromium 是通过 Snap 安装的，请参阅<g1>Flatpak 和 Snap 浏览器</g1>。

aac0379eae040d8f.source: The browser doesn't send downloads to MDM
aac0379eae040d8f.text: 浏览器不将下载发送到 MDM

aaee3e530d5ed0f7.source: A queue runs four downloads at once by default. Set another number on its <g1>Files in the queue</g1> tab, or 1 to fetch them one by one. A download that fails moves to the end and is tried again 30 seconds later. Besides the <g2>Main download queue</g2>, you can make as many queues as you like.
aaee3e530d5ed0f7.text: 默认情况下，一个队列同时运行四个下载任务。您可以在其<g1>队列中的文件</g1>选项卡上设置其他数字，或设置为 1 以逐个获取。下载失败的任务会移到队尾，并在 30 秒后再次尝试。除了<g2>主下载队列</g2>，您可以创建任意数量的队列。

ab07128daa051fbf.source: The glow inside a button under the pointer, where the style draws one (Luna; transparent: none)
ab07128daa051fbf.text: 指针下按钮内部的光晕，如果样式有绘制（Luna；透明：无）

ab1368844dd3a2f6.source: a file that is already there is kept, and the new one is numbered: <x1/>.
ab1368844dd3a2f6.text: 已存在的文件会保留，新文件会添加编号：<x1/>。

ab27f8afb9ce9f2a.source: Also check the extension's toolbar button: with <g1>Take downloads from this browser</g1> off, everything stays with the browser.
ab27f8afb9ce9f2a.text: 还要检查扩展程序的工具栏按钮：如果关闭了<g1>从此浏览器接管下载</g1>，所有下载都会由浏览器处理。

ab35ea0188ea0106.text: 在 MDM 的数据文件夹中：

ab45139a1c9aca69.source: Bring your IDM list, keep your habits, and download faster. Free and open source, for good.
ab45139a1c9aca69.text: 带上您的 IDM 列表，保持您的习惯，下载更快。永久免费开源。

ab4d50bebeaf2572.source: How do I download a video from YouTube or another site?
ab4d50bebeaf2572.text: 如何从 YouTube 或其他网站下载视频？

ab65426a5cb2f7e3.source: IDM itself is closed source. Mister Download Manager is open source (GPL-3.0) and laid out the way IDM users expect, but it's a separate program written from scratch. Anyone can read its code on <g1>GitHub</g1>.
ab65426a5cb2f7e3.text: IDM 本身是闭源的。Mister Download Manager 是开源的 (GPL-3.0)，布局符合 IDM 用户的期望，但它是一个从头开始编写的独立程序。任何人都可以到 <g1>GitHub</g1> 阅读其代码。

aba40d7bfbc246e5.source: <g1>Download in order</g1> (<g2>#39</g2>): to watch a video while it downloads, tick <g3>Download in order</g3> in <g4>Add torrent</g4>, or choose <g5>Torrent → Download in order</g5> in the list's right-click menu, even while it runs. A file's start comes first, and with <g6>First and last pieces first</g6> (on by default) its end comes early too, which most video files need before they play. Slower peers take pieces a little further on, so the start isn't waiting for them. Other torrents now download the rarest pieces first, as BitTorrent programs usually do: on MDM's test swarms they finished just as fast, and they finished where a scarce piece's only holder left. Torrents already in the list carry on, with nothing checked again. MDM also honours a peer's request to cancel a piece it no longer needs, so its upload isn't spent on data nobody wants.
aba40d7bfbc246e5.text: <g1>按顺序下载</g1> (<g2>#39</g2>)：要在视频下载时观看，请在<g3>添加种子</g3>中勾选<g4>按顺序下载</g4>，或者在列表的右键菜单中选择<g5>种子 → 按顺序下载</g5>，即使下载正在进行中也可以。文件开头部分会优先下载，并且勾选<g6>先下载首尾分块</g6>（默认开启）后，文件末尾部分也会提前下载，这是大多数视频文件播放前所必需的。速度较慢的对等点会下载稍远的分块，这样开头部分就不会等待它们。现在，其他种子会优先下载最稀有的分块，就像 BitTorrent 程序通常做的那样：在 MDM 的测试群中，它们完成速度一样快，并且在稀有分块的唯一持有者离开时也能完成。列表中已有的种子会继续下载，无需重新检查。MDM 还会响应对等点取消不再需要的分块的请求，这样上传就不会浪费在没人需要的数据上。

abc8c4d74c44fb09.source: A fix for 0.2.2, which froze on every system as soon as Add URL opened, and crash reports, so the next problem like it is caught and fixed sooner.
abc8c4d74c44fb09.text: 修复了 0.2.2 版的问题：打开“添加 URL”后，所有系统都会立即冻结；此外还改进了崩溃报告，以便更快地捕获和修复类似问题。

abe7ed5d6eb405a8.source: <g1>MDM didn't answer</g1> (red): MDM isn't installed or didn't start. <g2>Get MDM</g2> opens its download page; <g3>Retry</g3> tries again.
abe7ed5d6eb405a8.text: <g1>MDM 未响应</g1>（红色）：MDM 未安装或未启动。<g2>获取 MDM</g2>会打开其下载页面；<g3>重试</g3>会再次尝试。

ac1acb5254f1187e.source: What video a page holds (YouTube, Vimeo, ...), and the qualities to choose from.
ac1acb5254f1187e.text: 查看网页中包含的视频（YouTube、Vimeo 等）以及可选画质。

ac1ba7ef6480ed92.source: , <x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/> and <x5/> exit with code 1 when the app answers with an error (the API is off, an unknown action), as they do when the app isn't running.
ac1ba7ef6480ed92.text: 当应用响应错误（API 已关闭，未知操作）时，<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/> 和 <x5/> 会以代码 1 退出，就像应用未运行时一样。

ac4b27cd07db9df5.text: 显示所有选项。如果命令失败（应用未运行，应用返回错误，下载中断），则以代码 1 退出。例如：

ac53d931c9be8331.source: The token changes at every start; only programs that can read your data folder (yours) can use it. 2. Connect to that port and send one line of JSON: the token and the command's fields, e.g. <x1/>. 3. MDM answers with one line: <x2/> for a command, or a JSON object for a question.
ac53d931c9be8331.text: 令牌每次启动时都会更改；只有能读取您的数据文件夹的程序（也就是您自己的程序）才能使用它。2. 连接到该端口，并发送一行 JSON，其中包含令牌和命令字段，例如 <x1/>。3. MDM 会回复一行内容：执行命令时返回 <x2/>，查询时返回 JSON 对象。

ac828ac836f8fc57.source: <g1>Listen on</g1>: <g2>Every local network address</g2> (the default) listens on each private address of the computer (<x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, and IPv6's <x6/>), one by one, and follows them when you join another network. <g7>This computer only</g7> listens on <x8/>. Or pick one address of one adapter.
ac828ac836f8fc57.text: <g1>监听</g1>：<g2>每个本地网络地址</g2>（默认）会逐一监听电脑的每个私有地址（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>和 IPv6 的<x6/>），并在您加入另一个网络时跟随它们。<g7>仅此电脑</g7>监听<x8/>。或者选择一个适配器的一个地址。

ac85d17c17b64879.source: The download manager you already know. Rebuilt to be faster.
ac85d17c17b64879.text: 您熟悉的下载管理器，重新打造，速度更快。

ac91e88a570edede.source: The same window has the network switches (incoming connections, the port, UPnP, the DHT, a SOCKS5 proxy) and the blocklist: see <g1>Torrents and your security</g1>.
ac91e88a570edede.text: 同一窗口中还有网络开关（传入连接、端口、UPnP、DHT、SOCKS5 代理）和阻止列表：请参阅<g1>种子与您的安全</g1>。

acac626778255068.source: <g1>Audio-only support:</g1> download just a video's sound, as MP3, Opus or FLAC.
acac626778255068.text: <g1>纯音频支持：</g1> 仅下载视频的音频，格式为 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC。

acb8437ecc383f9f.source: Opens the checked package in your system's package installer, which asks for your password.
acb8437ecc383f9f.text: 在系统的软件包安装程序中打开已检查的软件包；安装程序会要求输入密码。

accd90bb9771b608.source: Crash reports: a freeze that was over before its snapshot was taken says so, instead of calling it a deadlock in code that was only waiting for events (<g1>#355</g1>).
accd90bb9771b608.text: 崩溃报告：在快照生成之前已结束的卡顿会如实报告，而不是将其称为仅等待事件的代码中的死锁（<g1>#355</g1>）。

acd70b3db02ac756.text: 下载 1 GiB 文件的速度快 5.4 倍，小文件快 106 倍，使用 2 个连接而非 480 个。每次测试的原始数据和方法。

acda1dd9909e3d30.text: 在长列表中查找下载 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

The published ones are taken on GitHub's Windows runner (<x6/>).

adc99f39f820cbb6.source: A debrid service, such as Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize or TorBox, is a paid account that downloads files from file hosts on its own servers. It hands back a plain direct link, without the host's waits, speed caps and captchas. With your account in MDM, a link from a host your service supports is unlocked through the service, then downloaded by MDM like any file: all its connections, pause and resume.
adc99f39f820cbb6.text: Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize 或 TorBox 等网盘离线下载服务是一种付费账户，它将文件从文件托管服务下载到自己的服务器上。它会返回一个直接链接，没有文件托管服务的等待、速度限制和验证码。在 MDM 中设置您的账户后，您的服务支持的文件托管服务链接将通过该服务解锁，然后由 MDM 像下载任何文件一样下载：包括所有连接、暂停和恢复功能。

ade160a1aa789777.source: MDM downloads what you point it at, the way a web browser does, only faster and with more control. It's made for everyday downloads: software and updates, documents, your own files from cloud storage, videos and music you're allowed to save, Linux images and other torrents shared by their makers, and anything else you have the right to download.
ade160a1aa789777.text: MDM 像网页浏览器一样下载您指定的内容，只是速度更快、控制更灵活。它适用于日常下载：软件和更新、文档、您自己的云存储文件、您有权保存的视频和音乐、Linux 镜像以及制作者分享的其他种子文件，还有您有权下载的任何其他内容。

af4bad51d4f2c31b.source: <g1>HLS and DASH videos from the browser, as their stream</g1> (<g2>#155</g2>): a video played as a stream (most sites' long videos) failed with yt-dlp's "Unsupported URL" when the extension sent the page instead of the stream. <g3>Download with Mister Download Manager</g3> in the right-click menu on such a video now sends the stream its player loaded, as the button over videos and <g4>Media on this page</g4> do. In Firefox it did nothing at all. The cookies sent are those of the stream's own server, not the page's.

af517cc60e2f1001.source: A site may refuse subtitles when it's asked too often: YouTube does, most of all for its translated captions. The video is saved all the same. MDM asks for the subtitles once more after 20 seconds, and if they still don't come, the <g1>Download complete</g1> window and the download's log say which ones are missing and why. Try them again later. When subtitles meant to go inside the video only come on that second try, they're saved beside it instead.
af517cc60e2f1001.text: 请求过于频繁时，网站可能会拒绝提供字幕，YouTube 尤其如此，翻译字幕更是如此。视频仍会正常保存。MDM 会在 20 秒后再次请求字幕。如果仍未获取到，<g1>下载完成</g1>窗口和下载日志会说明缺少哪些字幕以及原因。可以稍后再试。如果原本应嵌入视频的字幕直到第二次尝试才获取到，就会改为保存在视频文件旁边。

b1cfb9dac9c38d80.source: Then yt-dlp does what it does after a download: it joins the video and its sound with ffmpeg into one MP4, saves or embeds the subtitles, and converts the sound for an MP3, Opus or FLAC choice.
b1cfb9dac9c38d80.text: 然后 yt-dlp 会在下载完成后执行其操作：它会使用 ffmpeg 将视频和音频合并为一个 MP4 文件，保存或嵌入字幕，并为 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC 选项转换音频。

b1d90b3e9d2a1cd5.source: runs unit tests and end-to-end downloads against <x1/> with injected faults (slow, dropped and refused connections, servers without ranges, changing files). <x2/> runs the published speed comparison; its raw data is in <x3/>.
b1d90b3e9d2a1cd5.text: 针对注入故障（慢速、丢弃和拒绝连接、无范围服务器、文件更改）的 <x1/> 运行单元测试和端到端下载。<x2/> 运行已发布的速度比较；其原始数据在 <x3/> 中。

b1ea4cd6806043cd.source: <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> — Minimize hides the main window, and a download's progress window, in the notification area; downloads go on. On by default. Where the tray has no icon, the main window minimizes to the taskbar instead. The close setting above is separate; when it is on, closing hides there too (or minimizes to the taskbar if there is no icon at all). Greyed where no tray shows MDM's icon (some Linux desktops); in a Wayland session the main window stays minimized in the dock, since Wayland can't hide a window.
b1ea4cd6806043cd.text: <g1>最小化到通知区域</g1> — 最小化会将主窗口和下载进度窗口隐藏到通知区域；下载会继续进行。默认开启。在托盘没有图标的地方，主窗口会最小化到任务栏。上面的关闭设置是独立的；当它开启时，关闭也会隐藏到通知区域（如果完全没有图标，则最小化到任务栏）。在没有托M盘显示 MDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面）会变灰；在 Wayland 会话中，主窗口会保持最小化在 Dock 中，因为 Wayland 无法隐藏窗口。

b1f35176aca676c5.source: While the queue runs, the computer doesn't go to sleep. When the queue is done, the computer's own sleep settings apply again: a computer nobody is using goes back to sleep by itself. <g1>Turn off computer when done → Sleep</g1> sends it back to sleep at once.
b1f35176aca676c5.text: 队列运行时，电脑不会进入睡眠状态。队列完成后，电脑自身的睡眠设置将再次生效：无人使用的电脑会自行进入睡眠状态。<g1>完成后关闭计算机 → 睡眠</g1>会立即让电脑进入睡眠状态。

b208caa24e13c211.source: <g1>Shift+Up / Shift+Down</g1> makes the selection longer or shorter.
b208caa24e13c211.text: 按 <g1>Shift+Up / Shift+Down</g1> 可扩大或缩小选择范围。

b2181eccf65e86be.source: This <g1>website</g1> counts visits with <g2>Statcounter</g2>, which sets a cookie and sees your IP address; it runs only on the website, never in the app.
b2181eccf65e86be.text: 本<g1>网站</g1>使用<g2>Statcounter</g2>统计访问量，它会设置一个 cookie 并查看您的 IP 地址；它只在网站上运行，绝不会在应用中运行。

b23e4d23398b2d6f.text: 感谢这些杰出人士的贡献：每一位在 GitHub 上提交拉取请求、提出问题或参与讨论的朋友。衷心感谢你们每一个人。

The command line's and the MCP server's help name the website's guide. Problem reports, releases and the source stay on GitHub.

b26bf4af67d50f02.source: If you want Internet Download Manager's layout without its price, Mister Download Manager: it is free and open source, laid out like IDM, imports your IDM list, and also downloads torrents and videos. Free Download Manager, AB Download Manager, Motrix, Neat Download Manager, Prism, JDownloader 2, Xtreme Download Manager and Gopeed are free too, each with its own strengths.
b26bf4af67d50f02.text: 如果您想要 Internet Download Manager 的布局但又不想付费，Mister Download Manager 是一个不错的选择：它免费且开源，界面布局与 IDM 相似，可导入您的 IDM 列表，还能下载种子和视频。Free Download Manager、AB Download Manager、Motrix、Neat Download Manager、Prism、JDownloader 2、Xtreme Download Manager 和 Gopeed 也都是免费的，各有其独特优势。

b26fdfb3218b9d13.source: Many more: the checksum dialog, the progress window's completion options and speed limit, the torrent and video windows (Stop a look-up, stale video choices), Batch's letter ranges, addresses without http://, duplicate links arriving together, imports that doubled downloads, menu titles that shared access letters in French and other languages, and more.
b26fdfb3218b9d13.text: 还有许多其他修复：校验和对话框、进度窗口中的完成选项和速度限制、种子和视频窗口（停止查找、过时的视频选项）、批处理中的字母范围、不含 http:// 的地址、同时到达的重复链接、导入时重复添加下载任务、法语和其他语言中菜单标题的访问键重复等。

After <g4>Don't allow</g4>, the extension says the connection failed and the desktop doesn't ask again; to be asked again, run this in a terminal, then use the extension again:
b2775daa5cb453f0.text: <g1>Snap 版 Firefox</g1>（Ubuntu 自带的 Firefox）通过桌面环境连接 MDM，桌面环境会读取您主文件夹中的浏览器文件以及 .deb 或 .rpm 为所有用户安装的文件。扩展程序首次调用 MDM 时，桌面环境会询问“<g2>允许 Firefox 启动 WebExtension 后端吗？</g2>”以连接 Mister Download Manager：请选择<g3>允许</g3>。选择<g4>不允许</g4>后，扩展程序会提示连接失败，并且桌面环境不会再次询问；要再次被询问，请在终端中运行以下命令，然后再次使用扩展程序：

b316129fd0c0323b.source: <g1>Menus open where they belong</g1>: in a Wayland session they opened in the middle of the screen (<g2>#50</g2>), as Wayland lets no program place its windows, and MDM's menus and drop-down lists are windows it places; MDM now runs through XWayland when it is there (<x3/> keeps Wayland). Under tiling compositors such as sway (<g4>#267</g4>), through XWayland, the menu bar's menus, their submenus, the right-click menus and the drop-down lists still opened in the middle of the screen, as the compositor placed them like windows. They are now menu windows no window manager places, as X11 menus are, so they open where MDM puts them, on every window manager.
b316129fd0c0323b.text: <g1>菜单在其应有的位置打开</g1>：在 Wayland 会话中，它们会在屏幕中央打开 (<g2>#50</g2>)，因为 Wayland 不允许程序放置其窗口，而 MDM 的菜单和下拉列表是它放置的窗口；MDM 现在在存在 XWayland 时通过 XWayland 运行 (<x3/> 保持 Wayland)。在平铺合成器（如 sway (<g4>#267</g4>)）下，通过 XWayland，菜单栏的菜单、其子菜单、右键菜单和下拉列表仍然在屏幕中央打开，因为合成器将它们视为窗口。现在它们是窗口管理器不放置的菜单窗口，就像 X11 菜单一样，因此它们会在 MDM 放置它们的位置打开，在所有窗口管理器上都是如此。

Rows marked <g5>(auto)</g5> are limits MDM learned by itself from servers that refused more connections. They can't be edited and fade away by themselves.

b43709818a581c9e.source: Mister Download Manager keeps the layout IDM users know, brings your IDM list over, and costs nothing: free and open source, with no trial, no ads and no sign-up. Below it, nine other free download managers people use instead of IDM, compared honestly.
b43709818a581c9e.text: Mister Download Manager 保留了 IDM 用户熟悉的界面，可导入您的 IDM 下载列表，而且完全免费：它是一款免费的开源软件，没有试用期、没有广告，也无需注册。下面将诚实地对比其他九款人们用来替代 IDM 的免费下载管理器。

b43a1402be6398da.source: Install MDM with its setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration</g1> ticked. Then add the extension: Firefox 140 or later takes it from addons.mozilla.org, and Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi from the Chrome Web Store. The browser keeps it updated.
b43a1402be6398da.text: 安装 MDM 时，请勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成</g1>。然后添加扩展程序：Firefox 140 或更高版本从 addons.mozilla.org 获取，Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 从 Chrome 网上应用店获取。浏览器会保持其更新。

b43d099ebe687e60.source: Dependencies point inward: <x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/> and <x5/> use <x6/> and <x7/>; the engine knows nothing of the UI. The app sees the engine only through its events (progress, segment table snapshots, finished, failed).
b43d099ebe687e60.text: 依赖项指向内部：<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/> 和 <x5/> 使用 <x6/> 和 <x7/>；引擎对 UI 一无所知。应用仅通过其事件（进度、分段表快照、完成、失败）查看引擎。

b447f1f754eac87e.source: Text in a script outside the interface language (a video title in Bangla, a playlist in Japanese) now shows its letters, instead of boxes: the font for that script is loaded the first time it is needed (<g1>#405</g1>).
b447f1f754eac87e.text: 界面语言之外的脚本中的文本（孟加拉语的视频标题，日语的播放列表）现在会显示其字母，而不是方框：该脚本的字体会在首次需要时加载（<g1>#405</g1>）。

b447fbc7b60ab7d5.source: On Linux, Vulkan needs your graphics card's Vulkan driver: Mesa's (<x1/> on Ubuntu and Debian, <x2/> or <x3/> on Arch) for AMD and Intel, NVIDIA's own driver for NVIDIA.
b447fbc7b60ab7d5.text: 在 Linux 上，Vulkan 需要显卡的 Vulkan 驱动程序：AMD 和 Intel 显卡需要 Mesa 驱动（Ubuntu 和 Debian 上使用<x1/>，Arch 上使用<x2/>或<x3/>）；NVIDIA 显卡需要使用 NVIDIA 自带的驱动程序。

b45cf41d19dc2fdc.source: The AppImage can also be updated by AppImage tools (AppImageLauncher, Gear Lever, AppImageUpdate): it carries the address of its updates, and each release has its <x1/> file, so those tools download only the parts that changed. This starts with the AppImage of the version after 0.2.4.
b45cf41d19dc2fdc.text: 也可以使用 AppImage 工具（AppImageLauncher、Gear Lever、AppImageUpdate）更新 AppImage：其中包含更新地址，每个版本都有自己的 <x1/> 文件，因此这些工具只会下载发生变化的部分。此功能从 0.2.4 之后版本的 AppImage 开始提供。

b46a6cff0a89e843.source: <g1>Stopping a download under a low speed limit took seconds</g1>: each connection first waited for its turn under the limit. Stop now ends those waits at once.
b46a6cff0a89e843.text: <g1>在低速限制下停止下载需要几秒钟</g1>：每个连接首先在限制下等待轮到自己。现在，停止操作会立即结束这些等待。

b46f093f1aea3d25.source: <g1>Download video offering only the sound, with no reason given</g1> (<g2>#351</g2>): when a page's better videos need ffmpeg and it isn't installed, the window now says so.
b46f093f1aea3d25.text: <g1>下载视频仅提供音频，未给出原因</g1>（<g2>#351</g2>）：当页面上更好的视频需要 ffmpeg 且未安装时，窗口现在会显示此信息。

b4c6b4d600e8fca1.source: The code that draws the windows is optimised for size (the engine stays optimised for speed), and the programs are optimised as a whole.
b4c6b4d600e8fca1.text: 绘制窗口的代码已针对大小进行优化（引擎仍针对速度进行优化），并且程序作为一个整体进行了优化。

b4ca8797bf90ea72.source: <g1>MDM's own downloads use its own downloader</g1>: yt-dlp, ffmpeg, MDM's updates and a crash report's symbols now come down with several connections, resume after a cut connection and go through your proxy settings. Each file is still checked against its publisher's signed checksums before use.
b4ca8797bf90ea72.text: <g1>MDM 自身的下载使用自己的下载器</g1>：现在，yt-dlp、ffmpeg、MDM 更新和崩溃报告符号文件都会通过多个连接下载，网络中断后可以续传，并会使用代理设置。每个文件在使用前仍会根据发布者的签名校验和进行验证。

b4d5d25243e1d43b.source: No. MDM has no accounts, no analytics and no telemetry. It connects to the servers you download from and, each time it starts and once a day while it runs…
b4d5d25243e1d43b.text: 不。MDM 没有账户、分析或遥测功能。它连接到您下载文件的服务器，并且每次启动时以及运行时每天一次…

b4e383c17ad547ef.source: Learns the limit from the server's answer, keeps to it, and remembers it for next time. Finished in 12.6 s.
b4e383c17ad547ef.text: 从服务器的响应中学习限制，并遵守该限制，下次还会记住。在 12.6 秒内完成。

b4f2b685df7bbb1d.source: A selected row in a list without the focus
b4f2b685df7bbb1d.text: 列表中未获得焦点的选定行

b4fe270a9dd2f23b.source: Save and close the running app (the installer uses it before an upgrade).
b4fe270a9dd2f23b.text: 保存并关闭正在运行的应用程序（安装程序会在升级前使用此开关）。

b52a39cec850241e.source: File types: what the browser hands over, and the sites left alone.
b52a39cec850241e.text: 文件类型：浏览器移交的文件类型，以及不受 MDM 处理的网站。

b53503e9d42a4135.source: Options → General → Edit...: turn the button off, or list sites it never shows on.
b53503e9d42a4135.text: 选项 → 常规 → 编辑...：关闭按钮，或列出它从不显示的网站。

b5377276e996b945.source: The button over a video. Drag it where you like; it stays there.
b5377276e996b945.text: 视频上方的按钮。可将它拖到任意位置，之后会停留在那里。

b58e6af3659b2c7f.source: <g1>The crash report window in other languages</g1> (<g2>#204</g2>): in any language but English, the report in its box ran together on a few long lines, as its line breaks were taken for a translation's and flowed again. The report now keeps its own lines in every language, and in Arabic and Persian it reads left to right, from the box's left edge, as the English data it is (the window around it stays right to left). The release notes in <g3>Check for updates</g3> keep their lines the same way. <g4>End and restart MDM</g4> showed cut in German, French, Russian and Arabic: the buttons are now as wide as their text, the others giving back room they don't need.
b58e6af3659b2c7f.text: <g1>崩溃报告窗口支持其他语言</g1> (<g2>#204</g2>)：除英语外，其他语言的报告框中，报告内容会挤在几行长句中，因为其换行符被误认为是翻译的一部分并重新排版。现在，报告在所有语言中都能保持其原有行数，并且在阿拉伯语和波斯语中，报告内容（作为英文数据）会从报告框左侧开始从左到右显示（报告框本身仍保持从右到左）。<g3>检查更新</g3> 中的发布说明也以同样方式保持行数。<g4>结束并重启 MDM</g4> 在德语、法语、俄语和阿拉伯语中显示不完整：现在按钮宽度会根据文本调整，其他按钮则会释放不必要的空间。

b595be014bba99b9.source: Read this page in your language?
b595be014bba99b9.text: 要用您的语言阅读此页面吗？

b5ce8e1194ffd521.source: If the address is a video's page (YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok and others), the video window opens instead. See <g1>Video downloads</g1>. A magnet link opens <g2>Add torrent</g2>; see <g3>Torrents</g3>.
b5ce8e1194ffd521.text: 如果地址是视频页面（YouTube、Vimeo、TikTok 等），会打开视频窗口。请参阅<g1>视频下载</g1>。磁力链接会打开<g2>添加种子</g2>窗口。请参阅<g3>种子</g3>。

b6149d04af86226a.source: The next / previous tab (also <g1>Ctrl+Page Down</g1> / <g2>Page Up</g2>)
b6149d04af86226a.text: 切换到下一个/上一个选项卡（也可使用 <g1>Ctrl+Page Down</g1> / <g2>Page Up</g2>）

b64013cae5c2317a.source: Every link on a page. Only the ones you tick.
b64013cae5c2317a.text: 页面上的所有链接。只下载您勾选的。

b6590db023b237f0.source: As links arrive, MDM asks each server about its file, a few at a time. Each link then shows its real name and size, and whether it is <g1>Online</g1>, <g2>Offline (404)</g2>, <g3>Needs a login</g3> or <g4>Busy, try later</g4>. Offline links come unticked, so you don't queue what isn't there. Links to web pages are hidden by default.
b6590db023b237f0.text: 链接到达时，MDM 会一次性向每个服务器询问其文件信息。每个链接随后会显示其真实名称和大小，以及它是<g1>在线</g1>、<g2>离线 (404)</g2>、<g3>需要登录</g3>还是<g4>繁忙，请稍后重试</g4>。离线链接默认不勾选，这样您就不会将不存在的内容加入队列。指向网页的链接默认隐藏。

b68461ac7025e237.source: then signs out and in again. The setting stays after a restart. The computer has one wake alarm: if another program has set it, MDM leaves it alone and says so.
b68461ac7025e237.text: 然后注销并重新登录。重启后设置仍然有效。电脑只有一个唤醒闹钟：如果其他程序已设置，MDM 会保留它并提示。

b68b9d62355a1a70.source: Download File Info no longer stays open but out of sight, with every later download waiting behind it (<g1>#440</g1>). The next one after answering <g2>Create folder</g2> came up as an invisible window, and on Windows one hidden with a minimized main window is now shown again, as is the duplicate question
b68b9d62355a1a70.text: “下载文件信息”不再保持打开但不可见，导致后续所有下载在其后等待（<g1>#440</g1>）。回答<g2>创建文件夹</g2>后的下一个下载任务会显示为一个不可见的窗口，现在在 Windows 上，与最小化的主窗口一起隐藏的窗口会再次显示，重复的询问也是如此。

b6a64bab432ffff1.source: The same, for a Mac with an Intel processor (About This Mac shows a <g1>Processor</g1>).
b6a64bab432ffff1.text: 同样，适用于配备 Intel 处理器（关于本机显示 <g1>处理器</g1>）的 Mac。

b6c6533af9e6a7eb.text: 仅使用您自己的账户。共享账户或其链接会违反服务条款，并可能导致账户被暂停。

b6fd95d785a07bfc.text: 前一个/后一个菜单；在子菜单中，<g1>向左</g1>关闭子菜单

b73adcfb797ce9e9.text: <g1>选项 → 区域</g1>：日期和时间按您所在区域的格式显示，或按您自己的方式（日、月或年优先，12 小时制或 24 小时制，一周的第一天）；列表和计划程序会随之调整。

b774439cca0b2a3c.text: 项目符号、勾选标记和子菜单箭头

b79173d2d22ed62f.source: <g1>Three more controls</g1> (after #212): in Russian and a few other languages, Download File Info's <g2>Preview</g2>, Options → Proxy's <g3>Get System</g3> and the Scheduler's drop-down after <g4>Turn off computer when done</g4> still ended in "...". Download File Info grows by what Preview's label needs (Russian, Ukrainian, Telugu, Belarusian and a few more), the Proxy page's title moves left to give Get System its room, and the Scheduler's drop-down widens towards its caption.
b79173d2d22ed62f.text: <g1>新增三个控件</g1>（继 #212 之后）：在俄语和其他几种语言中，“下载文件信息”的<g2>预览</g2>、“选项”→“代理”的<g3>从系统获取</g3>以及“计划程序”中<g4>完成后关闭计算机</g4>后的下拉菜单仍然以“...”结尾。“下载文件信息”会根据“预览”标签所需的空间（俄语、乌克兰语、泰卢固语、白俄罗斯语等）进行扩展，“代理”页面的标题会向左移动，为“从系统获取”腾出空间，“计划程序”的下拉菜单会向其标题方向加宽。

b793f20aa217a8fa.source: If MDM or this website ever needs to use a new service, this page will say so first, and the change will be listed in <g1>What's new</g1>. Past versions of this page are in the project's history on GitHub.
b793f20aa217a8fa.text: 如果 MDM 或本网站需要使用新服务，我们会先在本页面说明，并在<g1>新增内容</g1>中列出变更。本页面的历史版本可在 GitHub 上的项目历史记录中查看。

b7c0190ca4719975.source: The assistant can't change MDM's options, see your browser, or turn the automation API on by itself.
b7c0190ca4719975.text: 助手无法更改 MDM 的选项、查看您的浏览器，也无法自行开启自动化 API。

b7cf37766b3a4159.source: On <g1>Q</g1>, tick <g2>In a queue</g2> or <g3>Not in a queue</g3>.
b7cf37766b3a4159.text: 在 <g1>队列</g1> 上，勾选 <g2>在队列中</g2> 或 <g3>不在队列中</g3>。

b7e47ad1f6a91134.source: The app comes in 86 languages, every one Windows 11 offers. It follows your computer's language, and you can switch any time in View → Language.
b7e47ad1f6a91134.text: 本应用支持 86 种语言，涵盖 Windows 11 提供的所有语言。它会跟随您电脑的语言设置，您也可以随时在“视图”→“语言”中切换。

b817df03d902cf1a.source: <g1>A tour of the features</g1> on the website instead of a wall of screenshots.
b817df03d902cf1a.text: 网站上新增了<g1>功能导览</g1>，不再使用一整页的屏幕截图。

b84114a1d735eb2d.source: <g1><g2>Run MDM on a server</g2></g1> — MDM without a window on a home server or NAS (Docker, Unraid), downloading into its folders; send it downloads from your phone or browser.
b84114a1d735eb2d.text: <g1><g2>在服务器上运行 MDM</g2></g1> — 在家用服务器或 NAS（Docker、Unraid）上无窗口运行 MDM，下载到其文件夹中；从手机或浏览器向其发送下载任务。

b841e874966572b8.source: <g1>Two columns for torrents in the download list</g1> (<g2>#357</g2>): <g3>Peers</g3> (those a torrent has connected while it runs, seeders and leechers alike) and <g4>Share ratio</g4> (what it has sent against what it took), after <g5>Transfer rate</g5>. A layout saved before them gets them there.
b841e874966572b8.text: <g1>下载列表中新增两个种子列</g1>（<g2>#357</g2>）：<g3>对等方</g3>（种子运行时连接的做种者和吸血者）和<g4>共享率</g4>（已发送与已接收数据之比），位于<g5>传输速率</g5>之后。在此之前保存的布局将包含它们。

b8544619a7ae8ec9.source: YouTube fixes for the Download video button, and the button in Chrome, Edge and Brave.
b8544619a7ae8ec9.text: YouTube 下载视频按钮以及 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 浏览器中的按钮修复。

b86face263e9f2af.source: We'd rather you knew. IDM has a site grabber that follows a whole website's pages (MDM's link grabber takes the links of one page), and many years of polish and compatibility fixes. MDM is new; if something you rely on is missing, <g1>ask for it</g1>.
b86face263e9f2af.text: 我们宁愿您了解。IDM 有一个网站抓取器，可以跟踪整个网站的页面（MDM 的链接抓取器只抓取一个页面的链接），并且经过多年的完善和兼容性修复。MDM 是新程序；如果您依赖的某些功能缺失，<g1>请提出请求</g1>。

b88a67e39c494a61.source: The server runs on the app's Tokio runtime, one listener per local network address. Each request is checked (<x1/>, <x2/>, token), turned into an <x3/> marked <x4/> (a field no request line can set) and handed to the app through the same channel as the command line's; the app answers it on its next frame, as it answers the automation API. Its page is built in (<x5/>) and its texts come from the app's catalogs (<x6/>).
b88a67e39c494a61.text: 服务器在应用的 Tokio 运行时上运行，每个本地网络地址一个监听器。每个请求都经过检查（<x1/>、<x2/>、令牌），转换为标记为 <x3/> 的 <x4/>（请求行无法设置的字段），并通过与命令行相同的通道传递给应用；应用在下一帧响应它，就像响应自动化 API 一样。其页面内置于 <x5/> 中，其文本来自应用的目录 (<x6/>)。

b88bda5a82ad2252.source: Each command's outcome goes into the torrent's event log; hover its <g1>Status</g1> cell in the list to read it.
b88bda5a82ad2252.text: 每条命令的执行结果都会记录在种子的事件日志中；将鼠标悬停在列表中的<g1>状态</g1>单元格上即可查看。

b8b97aa49bef24ec.source: three end-to-end tests depended on timing: a refused connection coming back, the learned connection limit, and a dead address (a server without ranges was fixed earlier). Each now waits for the state it checks. The lab server can hold a connection slot for a test (<x1/>), and <x2/> now also means every slot is free (#136);
b8b97aa49bef24ec.text: 三个端到端测试依赖于时间：被拒绝的连接返回、学习到的连接限制和死地址（没有范围的服务器已在早些时候修复）。现在每个测试都会等待其检查的状态。实验室服务器可以为测试保留一个连接槽（<x1/>），并且 <x2/> 现在也意味着每个槽都已空闲（#136）；

b8d4d5dda0dce541.source: <g1>Add torrent</g1> shows the torrent's files as a folder tree. Untick what you don't need; <g2>Selected</g2> shows how many files and how much data are left. Torrents have their own category and folder, <x3/> by default.
b8d4d5dda0dce541.text: <g1>添加种子</g1>会以文件夹树的形式显示种子的文件。取消勾选您不需要的文件；<g2>已选择</g2>会显示还剩下多少文件和数据。种子有自己的类别和文件夹，<x3/> 默认。

b8e5b1ee06c56715.text: 下载列表和计划程序中的日期和时间格式。

b8eb9228a25e0978.source: MDM takes IDM's command-line switches, so scripts written for IDM can hand it their downloads. A separate tool downloads in a terminal, and a local API lets other programs see and control the running app.
b8eb9228a25e0978.text: MDM 支持 IDM 的命令行参数，因此为 IDM 编写的脚本可以将其下载任务交给 MDM。一个独立的工具可以在终端中下载，本地 API 允许其他程序查看和控制正在运行的应用程序。

b8face0bc8562340.source: Is the extension loaded and turned on? Look for <g1>Mister Download Manager</g1> on the browser's extensions page. In Firefox, install it from addons.mozilla.org: a temporary add-on is gone after a restart. See <g2>Browser integration</g2>.
b8face0bc8562340.text: 扩展程序是否已加载并启用？在浏览器的扩展程序页面中查找<g1>Mister Download Manager</g1>。在 Firefox 中，请从 addons.mozilla.org 安装扩展程序；临时附加组件会在重启后消失。另请参阅<g2>浏览器集成</g2>。

b91d64d24c968b5b.text: <g1>登录后视频支持：</g1> 使用您的浏览器 Cookie 下载需要登录才能观看的视频。

b9213ed6a8b3c240.text: 您的计算机不会连接到种子的对等方。

bb66b5a231ef607c.source: <g1>The time</g1> is measured from the download's own connections, as each one opens: MDM sends nothing extra to the server. It is an estimate (the time to open a connection, divided by its round trips: one for http, two for https), so it says <g2>about</g2>. The quickest connection counts.
bb66b5a231ef607c.text: <g1>时间</g1>是从下载自身的连接中测量的，每个连接打开时都会测量：MDM 不会向服务器发送任何额外数据。这是一个估算值（打开连接所需的时间，除以其往返次数：HTTP 为一次，HTTPS 为两次），因此显示<g2>约</g2>。最快的连接会被计算在内。

bb7529bf5491688a.source: A debrid service, such as Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize or TorBox, is a paid account that downloads files from file hosts on its own servers. It hands…
bb7529bf5491688a.text: Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize 或 TorBox 等网盘离线下载服务是一种付费账户，它将文件从文件托管服务下载到自己的服务器上。它会返回一个直接链接，没有文件托管服务的等待、速度限制和验证码。在 MDM 中设置您的账户后，您的服务支持的文件托管服务链接将通过该服务解锁，然后由 MDM 像下载任何文件一样下载：包括所有连接、暂停和恢复功能。

bbeb2269d1830f72.source: <g1>A menu shut with Escape opens again at the first click on its title</g1>: a menu opened from the menu bar and shut with Escape, the pointer still on its title, was left marked open. On Linux the next click on that title only "shut" it, and a second click was needed; on Windows Escape seemed to do nothing (the menu came back at once). Escape, or MDM losing the focus, now shuts the menu whatever the pointer rests on; a press on a title still shuts its own menu or opens another.
bbeb2269d1830f72.text: <g1>用 Esc 关闭的菜单在第一次点击其标题时会再次打开</g1>：从菜单栏打开并用 Esc 关闭的菜单，如果指针仍在其标题上，则会被标记为打开状态。在 Linux 上，下次点击该标题只会“关闭”它，需要第二次点击才能打开；在 Windows 上，Esc 似乎什么也没做（菜单立即返回）。现在，Esc 或 MDM 失去焦点都会关闭菜单，无论指针停留在何处；点击标题仍然会关闭其自身的菜单或打开另一个菜单。

bc4dcd5d0ee98446.source: nine more tests checked a time, a speed or a byte count that a starved CPU or a busy CI runner can't keep. Each now checks the state itself, or times from the event it is about: a slow request's own duration, a stop measured from Stop against a wait of minutes, the first bytes before a pause, a speed limit against a download the server paces at the same time (and every byte paid for once), parts asked again instead of a deadline, links that expire after a number of requests instead of milliseconds, range attempts a server without ranges answers slowly enough not to fill the sockets, and the bytes a sparse file takes on the drive. The slow-connection test now fails without shedding (it passed without it before). The lab server can hand out such links (<x1/>) and pace answers to range requests on their own (<x2/>) (#201).
bc4dcd5d0ee98446.text: 另外九项测试检查了在 CPU 资源不足或 CI 运行器繁忙时无法保持的时间、速度或字节计数。现在，每项测试都检查状态本身，或从相关事件开始计时：慢速请求自身的持续时间，从“停止”开始测量停止时间而不是等待几分钟，暂停前的第一个字节，针对服务器同时限制下载速度的下载任务的速度限制（并且每个字节只支付一次），重新请求部分而不是截止日期，在请求次数而不是毫秒数后过期的链接，服务器在没有范围请求时响应缓慢以至于不会填满套接字的范围尝试，以及稀疏文件在驱动器上占用的字节数。慢速连接测试现在在不丢弃数据的情况下会失败（之前在不丢弃数据的情况下会通过）。实验室服务器可以提供此类链接（<x1/>）并单独调整范围请求的响应速度（<x2/>）（#201）。

Torrents have their own <g7>Torrents</g7> category. Each category has its own folder, by default inside your Downloads folder (<x8/>, <x9/> and so on; General uses <x10/> itself).
bc713e862e9b84d3.text: 每个下载都会根据文件类型归入一个类别：<g1>常规</g1>、<g2>压缩文件</g2>、<g3>文档</g3>、<g4>音乐</g4>、<g5>程序</g5>或<g6>视频</g6>。种子文件有自己的<g7>种子</g7>类别。每个类别都有自己的文件夹，默认位于“下载”文件夹中（<x8/>、<x9/>等；常规类别直接使用<x10/>）。

bc83548866edf95a.text: 对于数字，将<g1>通配符大小</g1>设置为位数。如果设置为 3，文件将是<x2/>、<x3/>等等。

bc9abb4c3d1c81e8.text: MDM 每个列表最多列出 20,000 个视频。

bcf14ec27beee1ce.source: Unzip the portable copy anywhere, a USB stick included. The download list, the settings, the video helpers and torrent data stay in a <x1/> folder next to the program, and nothing is written to the registry. Two things need the installer instead: starting with Windows, and taking downloads from the browser, since both go through the registry. <g2>Carry MDM on a USB stick</g2> shows the set-up.
bcf14ec27beee1ce.text: 将便携版解压到任何位置，包括 U 盘。下载列表、设置、视频助手和 torrent 数据都保存在程序旁边的 <x1/> 文件夹中，并且不会写入注册表。有两项功能需要安装程序：随 Windows 启动，以及从浏览器获取下载，因为这两项都通过注册表。<g2>在 U 盘上携带 MDM</g2> 展示了设置方法。

bd0124357425c778.source: Yes. In IDM, export your list with <g1>Tasks → Export → To IDM export file</g1>. In MDM, choose <g2>Tasks → Import → From IDM export file</g2> and pick that <x3/> file: every download comes over with its address, referrer and cookies. A plain text file of links works too. See <g4>Adding downloads</g4>.
bd0124357425c778.text: 可以。在 IDM 中，选择<g1>任务 → 导出 → 导出到 IDM 文件</g1>来导出列表。在 MDM 中，选择<g2>任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 导出文件</g2>，然后选择该<x3/>文件：所有下载任务都会保留其地址、来源页和 Cookie。纯文本格式的链接文件也可以。请参阅<g4>添加下载</g4>。

bd0d153b08edc05e.text: MDM 在手机上的页面：带有类别和何时选项的地址框，带有开始按钮的队列，以及显示进度的下载任务

bd3527667ef96098.text: Mac 应用程序自带 Safari 扩展程序：无需下载。需要 Safari 17 或更高版本以及 macOS 14 或更高版本。

bd405bf51bf8471b.source: The translations (85 languages besides English) are packed, 12 MB of text in under 1 MB without the translators' notes, and unpacked once at start.
bd405bf51bf8471b.text: 翻译（除英语外 85 种语言）已打包，12 MB 的文本在不到 1 MB 的空间中（不含译者注释），并在启动时一次性解包。

bd5e4bf0c407b27b.source: <g1>Torrents through your debrid account</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>): with <g3>Send torrents and magnet links to the first account instead of to peers</g3> ticked (<g4>Options → Accounts</g4>), a magnet link or a <x5/> file goes to the account. Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Premiumize download the torrent on their servers, and the list shows how far they are (<g6>45% at Real-Debrid</g6>). MDM then downloads its files over HTTP, with all its connections and resume, and removes the torrent from the account's list. Your computer never connects to the torrent's peers. Experimental, as the accounts are.
bd5e4bf0c407b27b.text: <g1>通过您的网盘账户下载种子</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>)：勾选<g3>将种子和磁力链接发送到第一个账户而不是对等点</g3>（<g4>选项 → 账户</g4>）后，磁力链接或 <x5/> 文件会发送到该账户。Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 和 Premiumize 会在其服务器上下载种子，列表会显示下载进度（<g6>Real-Debrid 上 45%</g6>）。MDM 随后通过 HTTP 下载其文件，支持所有连接和断点续传，并从账户列表中移除该种子。您的计算机永远不会连接到种子的对等点。此功能为实验性，与账户功能一样。

bd7a6a6a0b2e95e2.source: A minimal Linux system (often with the AppImage, the tar.gz or a build from source) may have no CA certificates, which MDM needs to check a secure server. Plain <x1/> and <x2/> downloads still work; each <x3/> or <x4/> one stops at once saying the computer has no certificates to check the server with. Install the <x5/> package (<x6/>, <x7/>), then resume the download. The .deb and .rpm bring it.
bd7a6a6a0b2e95e2.text: 最小化的 Linux 系统（通常使用 AppImage、tar.gz 或从源代码构建）可能没有 CA 证书，MDM 需要这些证书来检查安全服务器。普通的<x1/>和<x2/>下载仍然有效；每个<x3/>或<x4/>下载会立即停止，并提示电脑没有证书来检查服务器。安装<x5/>软件包（<x6/>、<x7/>），然后恢复下载。.deb 和 .rpm 包自带此功能。

bd8e50643c3c4ebf.source: Going the other way is just as easy: <g1>Tasks → Export → To text file</g1> saves one address per line, and <g2>To IDM export file</g2> writes an <x3/> file.

bddff41f922f3579.source: <g1>Number of retries for each file if downloading failed</g1> — how often a failed download is tried again before the queue gives up on it. Without it, MDM keeps trying.

be8957380c28726f.source: On a Linux system without CA certificates (a minimal install without the <x1/> package), torrents still work: peers, the DHT and <x2/> trackers. An <x3/> tracker can't be checked there, so MDM skips it; install that package to use those too.
be8957380c28726f.text: 在没有 CA 证书的 Linux 系统上（未安装 <x1/> 软件包的最小化安装），种子仍然可以工作：对等节点、DHT 和 <x2/> 跟踪器。无法在此类系统上检查 <x3/> 跟踪器，因此 MDM 会跳过它；安装该软件包即可使用这些功能。

bebf1a7c82ae2be4.source: A torrent in order isn't faster to finish, and it helps the swarm less: use it for what you want to watch now.
bebf1a7c82ae2be4.text: 按顺序下载不会让种子更快完成，对群的贡献也较小：仅在需要立即观看内容时使用此功能。

befc877eb2e581be.source: <g1>Torrent settings: the network is yours to choose</g1> (<g2>#40</g2>): accept incoming connections or not, map the port with UPnP or not, a fixed port, the DHT, finding peers on the local network, a SOCKS5 proxy from Proxy / Socks (which turns off what would go around it), an IP blocklist (P2P or eMule format, fetched again every 7 days), and stopping the torrent engine when no torrent runs. A new help page, <g3>Torrents and your security</g3>, says what others can see and what each switch does.
befc877eb2e581be.text: <g1>种子设置：网络由您选择</g1>（<g2>#40</g2>）：可以选择是否接受传入连接，是否使用 UPnP 映射端口，固定端口，DHT，在本地网络上查找对等点，来自“代理/SOCKS”的 SOCKS5 代理（这会关闭绕过代理的连接），IP 黑名单（P2P 或 eMule 格式，每 7 天重新获取一次），以及在没有种子运行时停止种子引擎。新的帮助页面 <g3>种子与您的安全</g3> 解释了其他人可以看到什么以及每个开关的作用。

bf65e2eb8f9aed86.source: <g1>Move it</g1>: drag it by its dots along the video's edge; while you drag, the edge and the spots it snaps to (the corners and the middle) show. It stays there on that site.

bf6c448169dc52d7.source: <g1>A magnet link could wait minutes for its file list</g1> (<g2>#92</g2>): in 0.2.4 on Windows, the DHT (how MDM finds peers without trackers) could stop for the rest of the session once a computer it asked was gone, so a magnet its trackers didn't serve never got its file list. The updated torrent library keeps going, and a test keeps it that way. <g3>Add torrent</g3> now shows the wait: the peers found, from the trackers, the DHT or the local network, and how many answered. After 30 seconds without an answer, it says what may be in the way.
bf6c448169dc52d7.text: <g1>磁力链接可能需要数分钟才能获取其文件列表</g1>（<g2>#92</g2>）：在 Windows 上的 0.2.4 版本中，DHT（MDM 在没有追踪器的情况下查找对等点的方式）一旦其请求的计算机消失，可能会在会话的其余时间停止，因此其追踪器未提供服务的磁力链接永远无法获取其文件列表。更新后的 torrent 库会继续运行，并且一项测试会保持这种状态。<g3>添加种子</g3>现在会显示等待情况：找到的对等点（来自追踪器、DHT 或本地网络），以及有多少个响应。在 30 秒内没有响应后，它会说明可能存在的问题。

bfb5be5f11fb070f.source: Your browsers hand it their downloads, and proven open-source tools do the specialist work. <g1>Set up the extension</g1>.
bfb5be5f11fb070f.text: 浏览器会将下载任务交给 MDM，专业工作则由成熟的开源工具完成。<g1>设置扩展</g1>。

bfccf2cc495dc164.source: One egui window painted to fixed pixel coordinates, plus one immediate viewport per dialog. <x1/> holds the state (downloads, queues, settings, the list's selection) and turns menu, toolbar, key and IPC commands into actions. Each dialog is its own module and returns an <x2/> (open, closed, done with a value). Windows-only calls are confined to <x3/> and their Linux and macOS counterparts to <x4/> (starting with the session, the browsers' host, sounds, show in folder, the crash handler); every other file is safe, portable Rust. Fonts come from the system: Windows' Fonts folder, macOS's system fonts, fontconfig on Linux (<x5/>). On Windows, Latin, Greek and Cyrillic text is drawn by DirectWrite (<x6/>, through egui's glyph rasterizer hook): View → Text → Smooth in its natural mode, anti-aliased at the size asked for and placed at quarter pixels with the font's own advances; Classic (the default) in GDI-classic mode, so each letter's hinted shape and whole-pixel width come together. Other scripts are shaped and drawn by egui.
bfccf2cc495dc164.text: 一个 egui 窗口绘制到固定的像素坐标，每个对话框一个即时视口。<x1/> 负责维护状态（下载、队列、设置、列表选择），并将菜单、工具栏、按键和 IPC 命令转换为操作。每个对话框都是独立的模块，并返回一个 <x2/>（打开、关闭、完成并带有一个值）。仅限 Windows 的调用被限制在 <x3/> 中，而其 Linux 和 macOS 对应部分则在 <x4/> 中（从会话开始、浏览器主机、声音、在文件夹中显示、崩溃处理程序）；其他所有文件都是安全、可移植的 Rust 代码。字体来自系统：Windows 的 Fonts 文件夹、macOS 的系统字体、Linux 上的 fontconfig (<x5/>)。在 Windows 上，拉丁语、希腊语和西里尔语文本由 DirectWrite 绘制 (<x6/>，通过 egui 的字形光栅化器钩子)：在自然模式下，视图 → 文本 → 平滑，按请求的大小进行抗锯齿处理，并以四分之一像素放置，使用字体自身的字距；经典（默认）模式下，使用 GDI 经典模式，因此每个字母的提示形状和整像素宽度结合在一起。其他脚本由 egui 进行塑形和绘制。

c1201126721896ce.source: With <g1>Use proxy/socks from a browser's request</g1> (on by default), a download MDM takes from the browser goes through the proxy the browser used for it: a VPN or proxy extension's, the browser's own manual proxy, or its auto-config script. Content limited to the VPN's country keeps working. In Firefox, switch on <g2>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g2> in the extension's popup. Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi can't hand the proxy over yet: set the same proxy in MDM there. A proxy that needs the VPN extension's own login can't be shared, and the download says so rather than going without it.
c1201126721896ce.text: 启用<g1>使用浏览器请求中的代理/SOCKS</g1>（默认开启）后，MDM 从浏览器接管的下载将通过浏览器为其使用的代理进行：可以是 VPN 或代理扩展的代理、浏览器自己的手动代理，或其自动配置脚本。这样，受 VPN 国家/地区限制的内容也能正常工作。在 Firefox 中，请在扩展程序的弹出窗口中开启<g2>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g2>。Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 尚无法移交代理：请在 MDM 中设置相同的代理。需要 VPN 扩展自身登录凭据的代理无法共享，下载会显示相关信息，而不是在没有代理的情况下进行。

c123aa98640ee0cd.source: <g1>Downloads still go to the computer's Downloads folder</g1> unless you change it. To keep them with MDM, set each category's folder in <g2>Options → Save to</g2>. <g3>Carry MDM on a USB stick</g3> shows how.

It installs only files listed in a checksum list signed by MDM's release key, which every release now carries (<x2/>). The first update this way will be from 0.2.1 to the next version.
c16bf35f546c4e5c.text: 在“帮助”→“检查更新”中选择<g1>立即更新</g1>：MDM 会在 Windows（安装版、便携版和普通 zip）、macOS 和 Linux（AppImage、.tar.gz；.deb 或 .rpm 会在系统安装程序中打开）上下载新版本、验证并安装，然后重新启动。它只会安装 MDM 发布密钥签名的校验和列表中列出的文件；现在每个版本都附带该列表（<x2/>）。首次使用此方式更新时，会从 0.2.1 更新到下一个版本。
