c2cf4051e18e66fc.source: <g1>A video download could fail in MDM while yt-dlp went on and finished it</g1> (<g2>#79</g2>). A line yt-dlp printed in the system's code page rather than UTF-8 (a title in Turkish or Russian on some Windows) ended MDM's reading there, and the finished file was then "not said". yt-dlp now always writes UTF-8, every line is read to the end, and the saved file is also found by its name. Whenever MDM gives a video download up, it ends yt-dlp and everything yt-dlp started, so nothing goes on downloading unseen.
c2cf4051e18e66fc.text: <g1>视频下载可能在 MDM 中失败，而 yt-dlp 继续并完成了下载</g1>（<g2>#79</g2>）。yt-dlp 以系统代码页而不是 UTF-8 打印的一行（在某些 Windows 上以土耳其语或俄语显示的标题）结束了 MDM 的读取，然后完成的文件被“未告知”。yt-dlp 现在总是写入 UTF-8，每一行都被读取到最后，并且保存的文件也可以通过其名称找到。每当 MDM 放弃视频下载时，它都会结束 yt-dlp 和 yt-dlp 启动的所有内容，因此不会有任何内容在后台继续下载。

c2e8e85fbcb5f098.source: It has <g1>no remote code, no analytics and no ads</g1>, and sends nothing to us or anyone else.
c2e8e85fbcb5f098.text: 它<g1>没有远程代码、没有分析和没有广告</g1>，并且不向我们或任何其他人发送任何内容。

c2ef218c38582097.source: It uses <g1>8 connections</g1> by default. You can set 1 to 32 in <g2>Options → Connection → Default max. conn. number</g2>, or up to 128 after ticking <g3>Allow more than 32 connections</g3> there. More connections help only when the server sends each one at a limited speed and allows that many from one address; most servers allow far fewer.
c2ef218c38582097.text: MDM 默认使用 <g1>8 个连接</g1>。您可以在<g2>选项 → 连接 → 默认最大连接数</g2>中设置 1 到 32 个连接，或者勾选<g3>允许超过 32 个连接</g3>后最多设置 128 个。只有当服务器以有限的速度发送每个连接并允许来自一个地址的多个连接时，更多的连接才会有帮助；大多数服务器允许的连接数要少得多。

c30f4658e7e28160.source: Start the video first: the list fills as the page loads things, and it's emptied when the tab goes to another page. With <g1>Prefix media file names with the page title</g1> on, a file from the list is named after the page, then its own name (<x2/>). Click <g3>Download</g3> beside one: a stream opens MDM's <g4>Download video from a page</g4> window, which reads its qualities (yt-dlp does the work); a file goes to MDM's list like any other download. Your cookies for its server, the page as the referrer and your browser's User-Agent go with it, as they do for a link you click.
c30f4658e7e28160.text: 请先播放视频：列表会随着页面加载内容而填充，并在标签页转到其他页面时清空。启用<g1>在媒体文件名前加上页面标题</g1>后，列表中的文件将以页面名称命名，然后是其自身名称（<x2/>）。点击其中一个旁边的<g3>下载</g3>：流媒体会打开 MDM 的<g4>从页面下载视频</g4>窗口，该窗口会读取其质量（yt-dlp 完成此工作）；文件会像其他下载一样添加到 MDM 的列表。您为此服务器的 Cookie、页面作为引用者以及您的浏览器用户代理都会随之发送，就像您点击链接时一样。

c31622b1a542c888.text: 适用于 Intel Mac 的 <g1>.dmg</g1>

c337f01f6c9f7565.source: Lists your downloads, newest first: file, address, folder, status, size, how much is done, speed. It can list only one status (Queued, Downloading, Stopped, Complete, Error) or only names and addresses that contain some text.

c39475c811938808.source: After deleting, the next download in the list is selected, so you can press <g1>Delete</g1> again.

c413bff1e7aee244.source: <g1>Galleries work with the gallery-dl a Linux distribution ships</g1> (<g2>#236</g2>): with Ubuntu 24.04's gallery-dl 1.26.9 chosen in Helpers, every gallery failed at once ("unrecognized arguments: --no-input"): MDM passed options that only newer releases know. MDM now reads the chosen gallery-dl's version and passes only what that release accepts, from 1.20 (Ubuntu 22.04) to today's; checked against every release from 1.17 to 1.32. An older one (Debian 11's 1.17) is refused when chosen, saying it is too old and which version MDM needs, and one chosen before is passed over for MDM's own copy, which Helpers says. gallery-dl 1.30.0, whose version starts with an empty line, is no longer taken for another program.
c413bff1e7aee244.text: <g1>图库可与 Linux 发行版自带的 gallery-dl 配合使用</g1>（<g2>#236</g2>）：在“帮助程序”中选择 Ubuntu 24.04 的 gallery-dl 1.26.9 后，所有图库都立即失败（“无法识别的参数：--no-input”）：MDM 传递了只有较新版本才知道的选项。MDM 现在读取所选 gallery-dl 的版本，并仅传递该版本接受的选项，从 1.20（Ubuntu 22.04）到最新版本；已针对从 1.17 到 1.32 的所有版本进行检查。如果选择旧版本（Debian 11 的 1.17），则会拒绝，并提示它太旧以及 MDM 需要哪个版本，并且之前选择的版本会被 MDM 自己的副本取代，这在“帮助程序”中有所说明。版本以空行开头的 gallery-dl 1.30.0 不再被误认为是其他程序。

c41cf3697bdcc8d7.source: The extension asks the host which file types to take, checks each download against them, and cancels the browser's download only after the app has accepted it; otherwise the browser keeps it, and the extension says why.

c488af9290492a52.source: Closing the main window doesn't quit MDM. It hides in the notification area, and downloads, queues and schedules carry on. To make closing quit (a portable copy's folder can then be deleted), untick <g1>Options → General → Keep running when closing the window</g1>. If there is no icon for MDM at all — not in the notification area, nor behind the ^ hidden icons — the window minimizes to the taskbar instead, so downloads continue and there is a way back. An icon behind ^ can be clicked to bring the window back, and starting MDM again always does.
c488af9290492a52.text: 关闭主窗口不会退出 MDM。它会隐藏在通知区域，下载、队列和计划会继续运行。要使关闭窗口即退出（之后便可删除便携版副本的文件夹），请取消勾选<g1>选项 → 常规 → 关闭窗口时保持运行</g1>。如果通知区域或“^ 隐藏图标”后面都没有 MDM 图标，则窗口会最小化到任务栏，这样下载仍会继续，并且可以找回窗口。点击“^”后面的图标可以恢复窗口，再次启动 MDM 也能恢复。

c493485e5f202b58.source: Before you click <g1>OK</g1>, the window shows the <g2>First file</g2>, <g3>Second file</g3> and <g4>Last file</g4>, so a typo shows up before anything downloads. If the server needs a login, tick <g5>Use authorization</g5>. Copied one address with a number in it, such as <x6/>? <g7>Tasks → Add batch download from clipboard</g7> (Ctrl+B) puts the asterisk where the number was and waits for the last one in <g8>To</g8>. Copied a whole list of links, or a forum post with links in it? The same command lists every one of them in Link grabber, ticked and ready to start.
c493485e5f202b58.text: 在您点击<g1>确定</g1>之前，窗口会显示<g2>第一个文件</g2>、<g3>第二个文件</g3>和<g4>最后一个文件</g4>，因此任何输入错误都会在下载开始前显示出来。如果服务器需要登录，请勾选<g5>使用授权</g5>。复制了一个包含数字的地址，例如<x6/>？<g7>任务 → 从剪贴板批量添加下载</g7>（Ctrl+B）会将星号放在数字所在的位置，并等待<g8>到</g8>中的最后一个。复制了整个链接列表，或者包含链接的论坛帖子？相同的命令会在链接抓取器中列出所有链接，并已勾选，随时可以开始。

c608b90547be8d53.source: Wait for the list. It shows each quality with its size, best first, then the sound alone: - A video's line says its resolution, its codec, its frame rate and whether it is HDR: <x1/>. A resolution that comes in several (AV1, VP9 and H.264, HDR and SDR) has a line for each: AV1 makes the smallest file, H.264 plays on the most devices, and an HDR video looks washed out on a screen without HDR. <x2/> is said only beside an HDR line of the same resolution. - The size is that of exactly what downloads, the video and its sound. A size with <x3/> before it (<x4/>) is only an estimate: the site didn't say the size, so it comes from the stream's bitrate and length. - <g5>Audio only, original</g5>: the site's own file, not converted, once for each type the site has it in (WebM with Opus inside, M4A), the best first. The best sound there is, in the smallest file. - <g6>Audio only MP3</g6> at its best variable bitrate (VBR) and at 320, 256, 192 and 128 kbps, for players that only take MP3. - <g7>Audio only OPUS</g7>: an <x8/> file. When the site's sound is Opus already (YouTube's usually is), it's only moved into that file, not converted, so nothing is lost. - <g9>Audio only FLAC</g9>: a lossless <x10/> file, for a library or a program that wants FLAC. It can't add quality: the site's sound is already compressed with losses, and FLAC keeps it exactly as it came, in a file several times bigger. The window says so when you choose it.
c608b90547be8d53.text: 等待列表加载。列表中会显示每种画质及其大小，最佳画质排在最前面，然后是纯音频选项： - 视频行显示其分辨率、编解码器、帧率以及是否为 HDR：<x1/>。如果某个分辨率有多种（AV1、VP9 和 H.264，HDR 和 SDR），则每种都会有一行：AV1 生成的文件最小，H.264 可以在大多数设备上播放，而 HDR 视频在不支持 HDR 的屏幕上会显得色彩暗淡。<x2/> 仅在相同分辨率的 HDR 行旁边显示。 - 大小是实际下载内容（视频和音频）的大小。前面带有 <x3/> 的大小（<x4/>）只是一个估算值：网站没有提供大小，因此它是根据流的比特率和长度计算得出的。 - <g5>仅音频，原始</g5>：网站提供的原始文件，未经转换，每种类型（包含 Opus 的 WebM、M4A）各一个，最佳的排在最前面。这是音质最佳且文件最小的音频。 - <g6>仅音频 MP3</g6>：提供最佳可变比特率 (VBR) 以及 320、256、192 和 128 kbps 的选项，适用于仅支持 MP3 的播放器。 - <g7>仅音频 OPUS</g7>：一个 <x8/> 文件。如果网站的音频已经是 Opus 格式（YouTube 通常是），则只会将其移入该文件，不进行转换，因此不会有任何损失。 - <g9>仅音频 FLAC</g9>：一个无损 <x10/> 文件，适用于需要 FLAC 的音乐库或程序。它无法提升音质：网站的音频已经经过有损压缩，FLAC 只是将其原封不动地保存下来，文件大小会增加数倍。当您选择此选项时，窗口会显示相关说明。

c616fb0beefab805.source: <g1>No site-specific shortcuts around rules.</g1> MDM treats sites the same way. It has no features made for getting around a particular site's terms, paywall or limits.

c996f36adbc992f8.text: <g1>过长的文件名会超出进度窗口</g1> (<g2>#62</g2>)：在<g3>完成后选项</g3>选项卡上，“保存到:”的较长翻译（土耳其语、德语等）会与路径重叠，并且路径会超出窗口边缘。现在标签会根据其语言所需的空间进行调整，路径会在中间缩短，以保持文件名可见，并在鼠标悬停时显示完整路径；包括从右到左的语言。

c9adce03030690a2.source: <g1>Seeding and upload limits, and a share ratio that lasts</g1> (<g2>#39</g2>): under "Keep sharing torrents after they finish", Torrent settings can stop sharing a finished torrent at a share ratio, or after it has been shared for some minutes; both off by default. A torrent stopped so says it in its event log and isn't shared again at the next start. Torrent settings can limit what all torrents together send, and a torrent's progress window can limit its own, kept with it. Its General tab now counts what it sent and how long it shared over all its runs, so the share ratio no longer starts again at 0 after a pause or a restart.
c9adce03030690a2.text: <g1>做种和上传限制，以及持久的分享率</g1>（<g2>#39</g2>）：在“下载完成后继续共享种子”下方，“种子设置”可以根据分享率或做种时长（以分钟计）停止共享已完成的种子；两者默认关闭。因此停止的种子会在其事件日志中显示，并且下次启动时不会再次共享。 “种子设置”可以限制所有种子一起发送的数据量，并且种子的进度窗口可以限制其自身的上传量，此设置会随种子保存。其“常规”选项卡现在会统计所有运行期间的发送量和共享时长，因此分享率在暂停或重启后不再从 0 开始。

cb8376955028cc1c.source: <g1>Linux: uninstalling the .deb or .rpm leaves no browser files behind</g1> (<g2>#266</g2>): MDM wrote the files that tell each browser where its helper is in every user's home folder, and <x3/> or <x4/> left them there, naming a program that was gone. The packages now install them for everyone, in each browser's own folder (Chrome and Brave, Chromium and Vivaldi, Edge, Firefox, the Snap Firefox included), and remove them with the package; MDM writes none in the home folder for those browsers, and takes away the ones an earlier version wrote. The AppImage and the tar.gz, and Opera, Helium, Thorium and Firefox's forks (which read them only in the home folder), still get them there.
cb8376955028cc1c.text: <g1>Linux：卸载 .deb 或 .rpm 后不会留下浏览器文件</g1>（<g2>#266</g2>）：MDM 会在每个用户的主文件夹中写入文件，告诉每个浏览器其助手的位置，而 <x3/> 或 <x4/> 会将它们留在那里，指向一个已不存在的程序。现在软件包会为所有人将它们安装到每个浏览器自己的文件夹中（Chrome 和 Brave、Chromium 和 Vivaldi、Edge、Firefox，包括 Snap Firefox），并在卸载软件包时将其删除；MDM 不会在主文件夹中为这些浏览器写入任何文件，并删除早期版本写入的文件。AppImage 和 tar.gz，以及 Opera、Helium、Thorium 和 Firefox 的分支（它们只在主文件夹中读取这些文件），仍然会在那里获取它们。

cbc1f1134f6a8b39.source: If you want <g1>Internet Download Manager (IDM)</g1>'s layout without its price, the free alternative is <g2>Mister Download Manager (MDM)</g2>: a free, open-source download manager for Windows 10 and 11, with macOS and Linux builds to try. It looks and works like IDM, imports your IDM download list, downloaded a 1 GiB file 5.4 times faster than IDM 6.42 in <g3>our published benchmark</g3>, and downloads torrents, magnet links and videos too.
cbc1f1134f6a8b39.text: 如果您想要 <g1>Internet Download Manager (IDM)</g1> 的界面但又不想付费，那么免费的替代品就是 <g2>Mister Download Manager (MDM)</g2>：这是一款适用于 Windows 10 和 11 的免费开源下载管理器，并提供 macOS 和 Linux 的实验版本。它外观和功能都与 IDM 相似，可以导入您的 IDM 下载列表，在<g3>我们发布的基准测试</g3>中，下载 1 GiB 文件比 IDM 6.42 快 5.4 倍，并且还支持下载种子、磁力链接和视频。

cbcab1b56789a1b0.source: This is the only part of MDM that waits for connections from outside. Downloads, MDM's DNS choice (Options → Connection → DNS), its updates and its helpers only connect out, so they never need a firewall exception; the browser extension and the automation API reach MDM on this computer only (127.0.0.1).
cbcab1b56789a1b0.text: 这是 MDM 唯一会等待外部连接的部分。下载、MDM 的 DNS 选择（选项 → 连接 → DNS）、更新和辅助程序都只发起外连，因此不需要防火墙例外；浏览器扩展和自动化 API 只会在这台计算机上连接 MDM（127.0.0.1）。

cc738cbd5fc52de1.source: (<x1/>, #157) runs the same <x2/> without eframe: a loop calls its <x3/> (what <x4/> runs at every frame) on a bare <x5/>, woken by the command channel, and never its <x6/>; commands are added as the remote control adds them (no window). The <x7/> and <x8/> (Compose, Unraid's template) run it on a server (<g9>server.md</g9>).
cc738cbd5fc52de1.text: (<x1/>, #157) 运行相同的 <x2/> 而不使用 eframe：一个循环在裸 <x5/> 上调用其 <x3/>（<x4/> 在每一帧运行的内容），由命令通道唤醒，从不调用其 <x6/>；命令由远程控制添加（无窗口）。<x7/> 和 <x8/>（Compose、Unraid 的模板）在服务器上运行它（<g9>server.md</g9>）。

cca215a39bfa83ba.source: <g1>Less memory in the notification area</g1> (<g2>#72</g2>): closed to the tray, or minimized there (on by default), MDM gives the memory it isn't using back to Windows. Task Manager's <g3>Memory</g3> drops from about 50 MB to under 10 MB (with 500 downloads in the list, from 58 to about 14 MB). It gives it back again 2 minutes after hiding, when the clock's ticks and a one-time allocation have brought some back, then every 10 minutes while MDM stays there. After the language list (which needs a font for every script) closes, those fonts are let go: about 70 MB less than before. On Linux the heap's free memory goes back to the system the same way. <g4>MDM uses a lot of memory</g4> explains Task Manager's figures.
cca215a39bfa83ba.text: <g1>通知区域内存占用更少</g1>（<g2>#72</g2>）：关闭到托盘或最小化到托盘（默认开启）时，MDM 会将未使用的内存返还给 Windows。任务管理器的<g3>内存</g3>从约 50 MB 降至 10 MB 以下（列表中有 500 个下载时，从 58 MB 降至约 14 MB）。在隐藏 2 分钟后，当计时器滴答声和一次性分配带回一些内存后，它会再次返还内存，然后 MDM 保持在那里时每 10 分钟返还一次。语言列表（需要每种脚本的字体）关闭后，这些字体会被释放：比以前减少约 70 MB。在 Linux 上，堆的空闲内存以相同的方式返还给系统。<g4>MDM 使用大量内存</g4>解释了任务管理器的数字。

cd673e3701cb16c6.source: <g1>Allow more than 32 connections</g1> — raises the most to 128, for the number above and for the exceptions. Most servers allow far fewer from one address; MDM notices and asks those for fewer. Turned off again, any higher number comes back to 32.

ce2ed7cec4b218a8.source: Linux won't be experimental any more: every change is now checked on a Linux desktop as well as on Windows. GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon were checked window by window: the tray icon and its menu, <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1>, Dark Mode support following the desktop, and the browsers handing downloads over (Ubuntu's Snap Firefox, Google Chrome and Brave). A Wayland session runs MDM through XWayland, so menus open under their titles, on tiling compositors such as sway too. The <x2/> and <x3/> were installed in clean Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora 45 systems and bring everything MDM needs; from the AppImage or the <x4/>, a missing library is named at start with the command that installs it. <g5>Update now</g5> asks the package manager which package MDM is.

d4637ad7d72759fd.source: <g1>A video's sound as MP3, Opus or FLAC</g1> (<g2>#32</g2>, <g3>#70</g3>): <g4>Download video</g4> lists <g5>Audio only MP3</g5> at its best variable bitrate (VBR) and at 320, 256, 192 and 128 kbps, after the sound in the site's own format, now named <g6>Audio only, original</g6>. ffmpeg converts it (on Windows MDM offers to install it, as for the best video qualities; on Linux and macOS it uses the system's), and the browser's <g7>Download video</g7> button offers the same. Under the MP3 ones, <g8>Audio only OPUS</g8> (YouTube's Opus is only moved into an <x9/> file, not converted) and <g10>Audio only FLAC</g10> (lossless, with an honest note in the window: it can't add quality the site's lossy sound doesn't have, the file is only bigger). The command line takes <x11/> (<x12/> for VBR), <x13/> and <x14/>.
d4637ad7d72759fd.text: <g1>将视频音轨转换为 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC</g1> (<g2>#32</g2>, <g3>#70</g3>)：<g4>下载视频</g4>列出了<g5>仅音频 MP3</g5>的最佳可变比特率 (VBR) 以及 320、256、192 和 128 kbps 选项，排在网站自有格式的音轨之后，后者现在命名为<g6>仅音频，原始</g6>。ffmpeg 会进行转换（在 Windows 上，MDM 会像安装最佳视频质量所需组件一样，提供安装 ffmpeg 的选项；在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它使用系统自带的 ffmpeg），浏览器中的<g7>下载视频</g7>按钮也提供相同选项。在 MP3 选项下方，有<g8>仅音频 OPUS</g8>（YouTube 的 Opus 仅移入 <x9/> 文件，不进行转换）和<g10>仅音频 FLAC</g10>（无损，窗口中会诚实地注明：它无法增加网站有损音轨不具备的质量，文件只会更大）。命令行接受 <x11/>（<x12/> 用于 VBR）、<x13/> 和 <x14/>。

d46403a8c3425456.source: The app understands the same switches as IDM: <x1/> for the address, <x2/> for the folder, <x3/> for the file name, <x4/> to queue it without starting, <x5/> to skip the <g6>Download File Info</g6> window, and <x7/> to start the main download queue. A batch file or another program that drives IDM this way can drive MDM by changing the program's name.
d46403a8c3425456.text: 此应用程序支持与 IDM 相同的命令行参数：<x1/> 用于地址，<x2/> 用于文件夹，<x3/> 用于文件名，<x4/> 用于将其加入队列而不开始，<x5/> 用于跳过<g6>下载文件信息</g6>窗口，以及 <x7/> 用于启动主下载队列。以这种方式驱动 IDM 的批处理文件或其他程序可以通过更改程序名称来驱动 MDM。

d4746b859b60aae1.source: <g1>Linux builds and window shots in minutes, on WSL2</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): <x3/> sets up <x4/>, an Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 distribution of its own, which builds any branch or pull request for Linux at the computer's full speed (<x5/>: about 5 minutes from scratch, under a minute after a change, against 15 to 60 in the VirtualBox machine), shoots MDM's windows in any language and mode on a virtual screen that never shows on Windows (<x6/>: about a second a window, against 40), compares OpenGL and Vulkan pixel by pixel (<x7/>), and hands a build to a VirtualBox machine for what needs a real desktop (<x8/>).
d4746b859b60aae1.text: <g1>在 WSL2 上，Linux 构建和窗口截图只需几分钟</g1>（<g2>#164</g2> 的一部分）：<x3/> 设置了 <x4/>，一个独立的 Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 发行版，它以计算机的全部速度构建适用于 Linux 的任何分支或拉取请求（<x5/>：从头开始约 5 分钟，更改后不到一分钟，而 VirtualBox 机器需要 15 到 60 分钟），在 Windows 上从不显示的虚拟屏幕上以任何语言和模式拍摄 MDM 的窗口（<x6/>：每个窗口约一秒，而之前需要 40 秒），逐像素比较 OpenGL 和 Vulkan（<x7/>），并将构建文件交给 VirtualBox 机器以处理需要真实桌面的任务（<x8/>）。

d5820405986dce29.source: <g1>The servers you download from.</g1> To download a file, MDM connects to the server that holds it and sends what any browser would: the request, and the cookies, referrer and browser identification the extension passed along, so downloads that need you to be signed in keep working. Every new download's name is now shortened to fit its folder (keeping the extension), and when nobody named the file (no name from the browser, no answer to the look-up, not edited), it gets the name the server gives, as in a browser: <x2/> rather than the address's token.

d7651d3580e5b3f8.source: What MDM keeps in your home folder stays, as with any package: your list and settings (<x1/>), the AppImage's and the tar.gz's browser files, and those of the browsers that read them only there (Opera, Helium, Thorium, and Firefox's forks: Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp, Waterfox). A package can't remove those: it never touches home folders. Without MDM they lead nowhere, so the extension says it can't reach MDM. To remove them as well, run this as each user who used MDM, <g2>before</g2> uninstalling:
d7651d3580e5b3f8.text: MDM 在您的主文件夹中保留的内容会像任何软件包一样保留：您的列表和设置（<x1/>）、AppImage 和 tar.gz 的浏览器文件，以及那些只从此处读取它们的浏览器（Opera、Helium、Thorium 和 Firefox 的分支：Zen、LibreWolf、Floorp、Waterfox）。软件包无法移除这些文件：它从不触及主文件夹。没有 MDM，它们将无处可去，因此扩展会显示无法连接 MDM。要一并移除它们，请在卸载<g2>之前</g2>，以每个使用过 MDM 的用户身份运行以下命令：

They're saved beside the video as an <x2/> file, or put inside it with <g3>Put them into the video</g3>. See <g4>Subtitles</g4>.

d79ad01ff4322b0a.source: <g1>Automatically start downloading the following file types</g1> — the file types the browser hands over (and the clipboard picks up). Separate them by spaces; <x2/> matches any characters, as in <x3/>. <g4>Default</g4> puts the original list back. The list starts with the usual archives, programs and installers (Windows, macOS and Linux ones: DMG, PKG, DEB, RPM, APPIMAGE, MSIX), music and videos, PDF and Office files, AI models and datasets (GGUF, SAFETENSORS, CKPT, PT, ONNX, PARQUET), 3D and CAD files (GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, BLEND, STEP), design and camera RAW files, ebooks, disk images and split archives. Pages, scripts, plain text and web images are left out on purpose, so saving a picture or a page stays with the browser; add any type you need, or put a single <x5/> in the box to take every file that has an extension. A list you never changed gains the types a new version adds; one you edited stays as it is.
d79ad01ff4322b0a.text: <g1>自动下载以下文件类型</g1> — 浏览器移交（和剪贴板获取）的文件类型。用空格分隔；<x2/> 匹配任何字符，如 <x3/>。点击<g4>默认</g4>会恢复原始列表。列表最初包含常见的压缩包、程序和安装程序（Windows、macOS 和 Linux：DMG、PKG、DEB、RPM、APPIMAGE、MSIX）、音乐和视频、PDF 和 Office 文件、AI 模型和数据集（GGUF、SAFETENSORS、CKPT、PT、ONNX、PARQUET）、3D 和 CAD 文件（GLB、FBX、OBJ、STL、BLEND、STEP）、设计和相机 RAW 文件、电子书、磁盘映像和分卷压缩包。页面、脚本、纯文本和网页图片被有意排除，因此保存图片或页面仍由浏览器处理；添加您需要的任何类型，或在框中输入单个 <x5/> 以获取所有带扩展名的文件。您从未更改过的列表会添加新版本增加的类型；您编辑过的列表则保持不变。

d7a59305d1341d4e.source: The app and the extension hold no personal data about you, so there is nothing for us to show, correct or delete there. The website's visit statistics are held by Statcounter; to have records of your visits removed, open an issue with the date and time of your visit, or ask Statcounter directly. Data that you send to GitHub (an issue, for example) is handled by GitHub and can be edited or deleted there.
d7a59305d1341d4e.text: 应用和扩展程序不保存您的任何个人数据，因此我们无从查看、更正或删除这些数据。网站的访问统计数据由 Statcounter 保存；如需删除您的访问记录，请提交问题并注明访问日期和时间，或直接联系 Statcounter。您发送给 GitHub 的数据（例如提交的问题）由 GitHub 处理，您可以在 GitHub 上编辑或删除。

d7afcd66a0c1606a.text: 复制文件地址（在浏览器中：右键点击链接 → <g1>复制链接</g1>）。

d7b53117265cba23.source: Type a feed's address into <g1>Feed address</g1> and click <g2>Add feed</g2>. MDM fetches it at once, then every 30 minutes; change that under <g3>Check feeds every ... minutes</g3>, 5 at the least.
d7b53117265cba23.text: 在<g1>源地址</g1>中输入源地址，然后点击<g2>添加源</g2>。MDM 会立即获取源，之后每 30 分钟获取一次；可在<g3>每隔...分钟检查源</g3>中更改间隔，最短为 5 分钟。

d7cea04e06c4311d.source: To bring the window back, choose it in <g1>Downloads in progress</g1>, or double-click the download in the list.
d7cea04e06c4311d.text: 要恢复窗口，请在<g1>正在进行的下载</g1>中选择它，或双击列表中的下载项。

d7dccabcd92050ba.source: <g1>Your debrid accounts.</g1> A link or torrent you send through a Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize account in <g2>Options → Accounts</g2> goes to that service, which then serves the file. Its sign-in stays on your computer, with the passwords above.
d7dccabcd92050ba.text: <g1>您的网盘账户。</g1>您通过<g2>选项 → 账户</g2>中的Real-Debrid、AllDebrid或Premiumize账户发送的链接或种子会发送到该服务，然后由该服务提供文件。您的登录信息会与上述密码一起保存在您的计算机上。

d7e47d8cb056d141.source: <g1>Download in order</g1>, to watch a video while it downloads, with each file's first and last pieces early. Other torrents fetch the rarest pieces first.
d7e47d8cb056d141.text: <g1>按顺序下载</g1>，以便在视频下载时观看，每个文件的开头和结尾分块会优先下载。其他种子则优先获取最稀有的分块。

d81050aa0a832cee.source: Next time, only what is new

d82bc40d598cdc1d.source: Downloads: which windows show, and what a duplicate link does.
d82bc40d598cdc1d.text: 下载：显示哪些窗口，以及重复链接的作用。

d835a1659f05d750.source: <g1>Streams</g1>: HLS (<x2/>) and DASH (<x3/>), the way most sites play long videos. Each stream is listed once, however many qualities its player switched between, with its qualities (<x4/>) and its length when the extension can read them. A stream whose address doesn't end in <x5/> or <x6/>, served as plain text, is found too: when you open the list (or press the download button over its player) and the player plays a stream, the extension reads the first few kilobytes of what that player fetched to recognise it. Nothing is read until you ask.
d835a1659f05d750.text: <g1>流媒体</g1>：HLS (<x2/>) 和 DASH (<x3/>)，这是大多数网站播放长视频的方式。无论播放器切换过多少种画质，每个流媒体只列出一次，并显示其画质 (<x4/>)，以及扩展程序能够读取的时长。如果流媒体地址不以 <x5/> 或 <x6/> 结尾，且以纯文本形式提供，也能检测到：打开列表（或在播放器上方点击下载按钮）时，如果播放器正在播放流媒体，扩展程序会读取播放器获取的前几千字节来识别流媒体。在您请求之前，不会读取任何内容。

d880c385e71b0520.source: The gallery gets one row in the list. Its size grows as the pictures arrive, and its log says how many were saved. Each picture is marked as downloaded from the internet, as any download is.
d880c385e71b0520.text: 图库会在列表中占一行。随着图片下载，显示的大小会增加；日志会显示已保存的图片数量。和其他下载一样，每张图片都会标记为从互联网下载。

d891713dc4499493.source: <g1>Enter did two things</g1>: with Cancel or a check box focused, Enter also pressed OK.
d891713dc4499493.text: <g1>Enter 键会执行两项操作</g1>：当“取消”按钮或复选框获得焦点时，按 Enter 也会触发“确定”。

d8ea8e46a4b278bd.source: Each product's own website, linked above, and for the open-source ones their code on GitHub: <g1>AB Download Manager</g1>, <g2>Motrix</g2>, <g3>Prism</g3>, <g4>Xtreme Download Manager</g4>, <g5>Gopeed</g5>; licences and latest releases as GitHub shows them, 4 November 2026
d8ea8e46a4b278bd.text: 每个产品的官网（链接如上），以及开源产品的 GitHub 代码：<g1>AB Download Manager</g1>、<g2>Motrix</g2>、<g3>Prism</g3>、<g4>Xtreme Download Manager</g4>、<g5>Gopeed</g5>；许可证和最新版本以 GitHub 显示为准，2026 年 11 月 4 日

d92f326852722dd3.source: Does it work on Mac and Linux?
d92f326852722dd3.text: 它能在 Mac 和 Linux 上运行吗？

d94b3dd782154f61.source: Set up the extension once, and every download link you click in Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Helium goes to MDM.
d94b3dd782154f61.text: 只需设置一次扩展，您在 Firefox、Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 或 Helium 中点击的每个下载链接都将发送到 MDM。

d94f1c99aee6b6e7.source: <g1>Credentials stay with their site.</g1> Logins and cookies are sent only to the host they belong to, even across redirects.
d94f1c99aee6b6e7.text: <g1>凭据仅用于对应的网站。</g1>登录信息和 Cookie 只会发送到所属主机，即使经过重定向也是如此。

d9686c3ea1ff4f0a.source: Install the extension from its page in the Chrome Web Store, <g1>Mister Download Manager</g1>: click <g2>Add to Chrome</g2>. In Edge the button is <g3>Get</g3>: Edge first asks to <g4>Allow extensions from other stores</g4> (click <g5>Allow</g5>), then <g6>Add extension</g6>. The browser keeps it updated. MDM's <g7>Add Mister Download Manager to your browser</g7> window opens that page in each browser for you, and Chrome may offer it by itself at its next start once MDM is installed.
d9686c3ea1ff4f0a.text: 从 Chrome 网上应用店的 <g1>Mister Download Manager</g1> 页面安装扩展：点击<g2>添加到 Chrome</g2>。在 Edge 中，按钮显示为<g3>获取</g3>：Edge 会先询问是否<g4>允许来自其他商店的扩展</g4>（点击<g5>允许</g5>），然后再询问是否<g6>添加扩展</g6>。浏览器会自动更新此扩展。MDM 的<g7>将 Mister Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g7>窗口会为您在每个浏览器中打开该页面。安装 MDM 后，Chrome 也可能会在下次启动时自动提供此扩展。

d9702d61beba459f.source: Listing and acting on downloads needs MDM's automation API, which is off until you turn it on. With MDM running, run this once (it stays on):
d9702d61beba459f.text: 列出和操作下载需要使用 MDM 的自动化 API。开启之前，该 API 处于关闭状态。MDM 运行时，运行此命令一次即可（之后会保持开启）：

d9862086c382da0c.source: Wake the computer to run a queue

d9b76e3e6afd2fa9.source: <g1><g2>Download a video from a page</g2></g1> — pick a quality and save a video.
d9b76e3e6afd2fa9.text: <g1><g2>从页面下载视频</g2></g1> — 选择质量并保存视频。

d9dcf7778d51f367.source: <g1>Through a proxy</g1>, MDM only sees the proxy, so it says <g2>through a proxy</g2> (with the proxy's country when it knows it) instead of guessing the server's. A VPN that works at the system level can't be seen: the country is then the server's, but the time includes the VPN's detour.
d9dcf7778d51f367.text: <g1>通过代理</g1>，MDM 只能看到代理，因此会显示<g2>通过代理</g2>（如果知道代理的国家，则会显示代理的国家），而不是猜测服务器的位置。系统级别的 VPN 无法被看到：此时国家是服务器的国家，但时间包括了 VPN 的绕行。

d9dde89e1b709127.source: Add URL: the copied address is already there. Click OK.
d9dde89e1b709127.text: 添加 URL：复制的地址已在其中。点击“确定”。

da12a252ee14babe.source: To stop in the morning whatever is left, tick <g1>Stop download at</g1> and set a time, for example 7:00:00 AM.
da12a252ee14babe.text: 要在早上停止所有剩余的下载，请勾选<g1>在以下时间停止下载</g1>并设置一个时间，例如早上 7:00:00。

da1944611f1b4a60.source: <g1>Off by default</g1>, and nothing listens while it is off.
da1944611f1b4a60.text: <g1>默认关闭</g1>，关闭时没有任何监听。

da24d37fd1911825.source: <g1>The .deb and .rpm bring what MDM's window needs</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): on a system without libxkbcommon-x11 (a minimal install, a container), MDM installed from them stopped at start under X11 and XWayland, and without the CA certificates (Debian's minimal install) no download started. They now require both, and EGL for Wayland windows. They also require the glibc the programs were built against, read from the programs themselves, instead of a fixed version: a package built on a newer system no longer installs on an older one where it can't start.
da24d37fd1911825.text: <g1>.deb 和 .rpm 包会带来 MDM 窗口所需的一切</g1>（<g2>#164</g2>的一部分）：在没有 libxkbcommon-x11 的系统（最小安装、容器）上，从这些包安装的 MDM 在 X11 和 XWayland 下启动时会停止，并且如果没有 CA 证书（Debian 的最小安装），则无法开始下载。它们现在需要两者，以及 Wayland 窗口的 EGL。它们还需要程序构建时所依赖的 glibc，从程序本身读取，而不是固定版本：在较新系统上构建的包不再安装在无法启动的旧系统上。

da2e1f2b68c87f18.source: Let the home server do the downloading.

da5804cb7ae48112.source: Some servers report a new date for the same file every time. Tick <g1>Options → Downloads → Ignore file modification time changes when resuming a download</g1>.
da5804cb7ae48112.text: 有些服务器每次都会为同一个文件报告新的日期。勾选<g1>选项 → 下载 → 恢复下载时忽略文件修改时间更改</g1>。

da6586417d8dd463.source: Done: Open the file, or Open folder.
da6586417d8dd463.text: 完成：打开文件，或打开文件夹。

da6e8c125b6f0d96.source: If the site replaced the file with a new version, the parts MDM has don't fit any more. Right-click the download and choose <g1>Redownload</g1> to start again from the beginning. A finished file is only replaced when the new download completes.
da6e8c125b6f0d96.text: 如果网站用新版本替换了文件，MDM 已下载的部分就不再匹配。右键点击下载并选择<g1>重新下载</g1>以从头开始。只有当新下载完成时，已完成的文件才会被替换。

da6edd8a7cee18e1.source: where it listens: every local network address unless given
da6edd8a7cee18e1.text: 监听地址：除非指定，否则为所有本地网络地址

da81e23f7451bda1.source: Terms of use — Mister Download Manager
da81e23f7451bda1.text: 使用条款 — Mister Download Manager

da9c23c3457966df.source: The <g1>user guide</g1> covers every window, with step-by-step tutorials. Something broken? <g2>Open an issue on GitHub</g2>, or use Help → Report a problem in the app.
da9c23c3457966df.text: <g1>用户指南</g1>涵盖了每个窗口，并提供分步教程。遇到问题？<g2>在 GitHub 上提交问题</g2>，或在应用中使用“帮助”→“报告问题”。

dabaf2be6d185ffc.source: Questions about these terms: open an <g1>issue on GitHub</g1>.
dabaf2be6d185ffc.text: 有关这些条款的问题：请在<g1>GitHub 上提交问题</g1>。

daf0900c44e24071.source: Removes downloads from the list and keeps their files, or deletes the files too when asked. A running download must be paused first.
daf0900c44e24071.text: 从列表中删除下载并保留其文件，或者在要求时也删除文件。正在运行的下载必须先暂停。

dafeec6d3a75fb44.source: In MDM, click <g1>Add URL</g1> on the toolbar (or press <g2>Ctrl+N</g2>). The address is already filled in.
dafeec6d3a75fb44.text: 在 MDM 中，点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 URL</g1>（或按<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>）。地址已自动填写。

db2ddcfc7e327586.source: Remote Control and Headless Mode Support
db2ddcfc7e327586.text: 远程控制和无界面模式支持

db4c3e21ec3c44a4.source: <g1>Working set</g1> (Details tab, add the column) adds memory shared with other programs. MDM draws its windows with the graphics card, so the graphics driver's memory counts here too, about 120 MB in all.
db4c3e21ec3c44a4.text: <g1>工作集</g1>（“详细信息”选项卡，添加该列）会加上与其他程序共享的内存。MDM 使用显卡绘制窗口，因此显卡驱动程序的内存也计算在内，总共大约 120 MB。

db518ca5cd5e57ca.source: Yes. MDM accepts IDM's familiar command-line switches, comes with misterdownloadmanager-cli for downloads from a terminal, and has a local, token-protected automation API that can list, pause, start and remove downloads. The API is off until you turn it on. See Command line and automation.
db518ca5cd5e57ca.text: 是。MDM 接受 IDM 熟悉的命令行开关，附带 misterdownloadmanager-cli 用于从终端下载，并具有一个本地的、受令牌保护的自动化 API，可以列出、暂停、开始和删除下载。此 API 默认关闭，直到您将其打开。请参阅命令行和自动化。

db5e343720753d5c.source: A split button's divider at rest: its shadow
db5e343720753d5c.text: 分割按钮静止时的分隔线：其阴影

db74b9137912e0a2.source: A proxy that asks for a login the VPN extension gives itself can't be shared: no other program has that login. The download then stops and says so, rather than going without the proxy. Use the VPN's own app, or choose its adapter under <g1>Network adapter</g1>.
db74b9137912e0a2.text: 如果代理需要 VPN 扩展自行提供的登录信息，就无法共享：其他程序无法获取这些登录信息。此时下载会停止并说明原因，而不会绕过代理继续下载。请使用 VPN 自带的应用，或在<g1>网络适配器</g1>中选择 VPN 的适配器。

db773b614d9bb463.source: The windows are drawn with OpenGL (eframe's glow) or with the system's own graphics API through eframe's wgpu, with that one backend only: Direct3D 12 on Windows (the default there), Vulkan on Linux, Metal on macOS (choices there; OpenGL stays their default until real graphics cards have tried them, #206). View → Draw with picks one, from the next start. One code path does it on every system (<x1/>): when the chosen one can't start, the other one is tried, so the windows always open. A watched start with the system's API leaves a marker until its first frame is drawn: a start that ends before it (a crash inside the driver), one whose first frame doesn't come within 10 seconds (MDM then starts again with OpenGL), or a graphics card lost twice in 10 minutes is remembered with its reason, which the menu shows.
db773b614d9bb463.text: 窗口使用 OpenGL（eframe 的 glow）或通过 eframe 的 wgpu 使用系统自己的图形 API 绘制，仅使用该后端：Windows 上的 Direct3D 12（默认），Linux 上的 Vulkan，macOS 上的 Metal（这些是选项；OpenGL 仍是它们的默认，直到真正的显卡尝试过它们，#206）。“视图”→“绘制方式”选择一个，从下次启动开始生效。一个代码路径在每个系统上都这样做 (<x1/>)：当选择的无法启动时，会尝试另一个，因此窗口总是能打开。使用系统 API 的受监控启动会在绘制第一帧之前留下标记：如果启动在此之前结束（驱动程序内部崩溃），或者第一帧在 10 秒内未出现（MDM 随后会使用 OpenGL 重新启动），或者显卡在 10 分钟内丢失两次，则会记住其原因，并在菜单中显示。

dba089f6ed3c76a8.source: Black and white, a bright accent, every edge drawn, text at 7:1 or more.
dba089f6ed3c76a8.text: 黑白分明，明亮的强调色，每条边缘都清晰可见，文本对比度达到 7:1 或更高。

dbab4b9a74908e08.source: Your system's accent colour and contrast setting, followed as you change them, on Windows, Linux and macOS.
dbab4b9a74908e08.text: 在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上，MDM 会跟随您更改系统强调色和对比度设置。

dbd0785b71ca5554.source: The Mister Download Manager extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox: downloads you click go to MDM with their cookies.
dbd0785b71ca5554.text: 适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Firefox 的 Mister Download Manager 扩展：您点击的下载将连同其 Cookie 一起发送到 MDM。

dbd790f226f0403e.source: Capped by data, not by speed
dbd790f226f0403e.text: 按数据量而非速度限制

dbdba7e84dfb92b6.source: A portable copy's server finds the portable copy's MDM by itself, from its own folder.
dbdba7e84dfb92b6.text: 便携版服务器会从其自身文件夹中自动找到便携版 MDM。

dbfaeb9bc058b8a9.source: The browser started MDM's helper, but it stopped before answering. Security software is the usual cause.
dbfaeb9bc058b8a9.text: 浏览器启动了 MDM 的辅助程序，但辅助程序在响应之前就停止了。常见原因是安全软件。

dc1a2189e80bed74.source: <g1>Downloads in progress</g1> lists the running downloads. Choose one to see its progress window.
dc1a2189e80bed74.text: <g1>正在进行的下载</g1>列出正在运行的下载。选择一个可查看其进度窗口。

dc31d8975851fca3.source: Windows: no more crash when a screen is unplugged, turned off or rearranged while MDM runs (<g1>#335</g1>).
dc31d8975851fca3.text: Windows：在 MDM 运行时，当屏幕被拔下、关闭或重新排列时，不再发生崩溃（<g1>#335</g1>）。

dc75431952fc8673.source: Today's files marked <x1/> are for macOS 11 and later, on Apple Silicon or Intel, and for Linux on x86-64: an AppImage for most distributions, a <x2/> for Ubuntu, Debian, Mint and Pop!_OS, an <x3/> for Fedora, openSUSE and RHEL, and a <x4/> of the plain programs. Please <g5>tell us how it went</g5>, good or bad.
dc75431952fc8673.text: 目前标有 <x1/> 的文件适用于 macOS 11 及更高版本（Apple Silicon 或 Intel 芯片），以及 x86-64 架构的 Linux：包括适用于大多数发行版的 AppImage、适用于 Ubuntu、Debian、Mint 和 Pop!_OS 的 <x2/>、适用于 Fedora、openSUSE 和 RHEL 的 <x3/>，以及普通程序的 <x4/>。请<g5>告诉我们您的使用体验</g5>，无论好坏。

dc868ceecfac36d1.source: Open <g1>Downloads → Options</g1> and the <g2>Save to</g2> tab.
dc868ceecfac36d1.text: 打开<g1>下载 → 选项</g1>，然后选择<g2>保存到</g2>选项卡。

dc8e69124b2726ab.source: <g1>The extension's toolbar button</g1> says whether the browser reaches MDM. When it doesn't, a red <g2>!</g2> and <g3>How to fix it</g3> lead to the new help page, <g4>The browser and MDM aren't connected</g4>, at the section for the reason. Its popup also pauses taking downloads, leaves the current site to the browser for good, and opens MDM or its Options.
dc8e69124b2726ab.text: <g1>扩展的工具栏按钮</g1>会显示浏览器是否连接到 MDM。如果未连接，红色<g2>!</g2>和<g3>如何修复</g3>会引导至新的帮助页面<g4>浏览器与 MDM 未连接</g4>，并跳转到相应原因的章节。其弹出窗口还可以暂停接管下载、永久将当前站点留给浏览器处理，以及打开 MDM 或其“选项”。

dcabc8a97e80dd97.source: Downloads → Speed Limiter → Settings...: one speed for all of MDM.
dcabc8a97e80dd97.text: 下载 → 速度限制器 → 速度限制器设置...：MDM 的所有下载共享一个速度。

dce175995531cf3a.source: <g1>Don't start downloading automatically from the following sites</g1> — sites whose downloads stay in the browser, separated by spaces. <x2/> covers every part of a site. <g3>Default</g3> puts the original list back.
dce175995531cf3a.text: <g1>不自动从以下网站下载</g1> — 下载保留在浏览器中的网站，用空格分隔。<x2/>涵盖网站的每个部分。<g3>默认</g3>会恢复原始列表。

dce1d04a23573e65.source: <g1>Where a download's server is says "this computer" or "the local network"</g1>, each with its own icon in the flag's place, instead of "this computer or the local network" with nothing; the dot between the place and the time is round, where the font's thin "·" read as an apostrophe.
dce1d04a23573e65.text: <g1>下载服务器位置显示“此计算机”或“本地网络”</g1>，每个都有自己的图标代替旗帜，而不是“此计算机或本地网络”且无图标；位置和时间之间的点是圆形的，而字体细长的“·”之前被误读为撇号。

dce3ae8513f15cf7.source: An import opens <g1>Link grabber</g1>, which sorts the links into packages: the volumes of one archive together, the links of one page together, the rest in <g2>Various files</g2>. Each link is looked up for its real name, its size and whether the server still has it, and the ones that are gone come unticked. A link already in your list goes under <g3>Already in the list</g3>, unticked.

de91aa24c4e3719d.source: gallery-dl lists the gallery's pictures: where each one comes from and the name it gets in the folder. The log says how many each saved.

Menus and the drop target are now plain pop-up windows, as Windows' own menus are, with nothing above their contents to take for a title bar; every window of MDM without a title bar is made one the same way.
dee8c65c52bd5601.text: <g1>菜单和拖放目标顶部不再有黑条</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）：在 Windows 11 Insider 版本 (22635) 上，每个菜单和子菜单顶部都显示一个标题栏高度的黑条，左侧有一条细线，其项目向下移动了相同的高度，最后几个项目被截断；拖放目标（任务 → 显示拖放目标）也一样，其图标向下移动。这些窗口都具有标题栏样式，被 MDM 隐藏了，并且在该版本上，某些东西将窗口的图片放置在标题栏结束的位置。现在，菜单和拖放目标是普通的弹出窗口，就像 Windows 自己的菜单一样，其内容上方没有任何东西可以作为标题栏；MDM 中所有没有标题栏的窗口都以相同的方式创建。

A locked keyring is never unlocked for MDM: without one, they stay in MDM's settings, sealed for your Windows account on Windows. <g1>Options → Accounts</g1> says where they are. A <g2>portable copy</g2> keeps them in its own folder.
e1369e1deca0e4ec.text: 密码（这些密码、代理密码和网盘账户密码）保存在系统的钥匙串中：Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环（Secret Service：GNOME Keyring、KeePassXC 及其他）或 macOS 钥匙串；MDM 的设置仅保留一个引用。锁定的密钥环绝不会为 MDM 解锁：如果没有密钥环，它们将保留在 MDM 的设置中，并在 Windows 上为您的 Windows 账户加密。<g1>选项 → 账户</g1>会说明它们的位置。<g2>便携版</g2>会将它们保存在自己的文件夹中。

e28c225087570ff5.text: 系统的 DNS 以自己的方式查找名称，Windows 可能会通过每个网卡进行查询。为了也将名称保留在 VPN 内部，请在<g1>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g1>中选择一个 DNS：MDM 然后会通过该网卡进行查询。请参阅<g2>DNS 和代理</g2>。

e2e30d683ce66b3d.text: <g1>Windows 上的 Zen：</g1>Zen 1.21.15b 及更高版本存在一个自身的错误，会导致使用辅助程序的附加组件无法连接到辅助程序（<g2>zen-browser/desktop#15432</g2>）。在 Zen 修复此问题之前，可以使用 Zen 1.21.14b。

e2f5e55e73258c80.source: <g1>Connections.</g1> Passive mode is used by default. <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks → Use FTP in PASV mode</g2> switches it off for servers that only take active connections. FTP connects to the server directly, not through the HTTP proxy.
e2f5e55e73258c80.text: <g1>连接。</g1>默认使用被动模式。对于只接受主动连接的服务器，可通过<g2>选项 → 代理/Socks → 在 PASV 模式下使用 FTP</g2>关闭被动模式。FTP 会直接连接服务器，不会通过 HTTP 代理。

e300155917e63d97.source: <g1>Choose the DNS</g1> (<g2>#36</g2>): <g3>Options → Connection → DNS</g3> picks who turns names into addresses for downloads, FTP, MDM's own downloads and the update check. The system's (the default), Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, NextDNS (with your configuration ID) or your own, asked over HTTPS (the default), TLS, or plain over TCP. <g4>Test</g4> shows how long it takes to answer. When it can't be reached, the download stops with a message naming it, unless you allow falling back to the system's DNS; your hosts file and local names stay with the system's. The command line's <x5/> takes <x6/>. Torrent trackers still use the system's DNS, and so do video pages and galleries unless a network adapter is chosen.
e300155917e63d97.text: <g1>选择 DNS</g1>（<g2>#36</g2>）：<g3>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g3> 选择谁将名称转换为下载、FTP、MDM 自己的下载和更新检查的地址。系统默认、Cloudflare、Google、Quad9、AdGuard、NextDNS（带您的配置 ID）或您自己的，通过 HTTPS（默认）、TLS 或纯 TCP 查询。<g4>测试</g4> 显示响应所需的时间。当无法访问时，下载会停止并显示命名它的消息，除非您允许回退到系统的 DNS；您的 hosts 文件和本地名称仍使用系统的 DNS。<x5/> 命令行接受 <x6/>。种子跟踪器仍使用系统的 DNS，视频页面和图库也是如此，除非选择了网络适配器。

e34726ffae8c3bba.text: 更新日志 — Mister Download Manager 版本历史

e355f6dfc0ceea1d.text: 如何报告错误或提出功能请求？— Mister Download Manager

e3696cca91bc9263.source: A browser fetches a file over one connection. MDM asks the server for several parts of the file at once, up to 32 connections (128 if you allow it), and keeps re-splitting: when a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the biggest part still left, so no slow connection holds up the end. It also remembers servers that refuse extra connections and stops asking them. See <g1>Connections and speed</g1>.
e3696cca91bc9263.text: 浏览器通过一个连接获取文件。MDM 会同时向服务器请求文件的多个部分，最多 32 个连接（如果允许，可达 128 个），并持续重新分配：当一个连接完成其部分时，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，这样就不会有慢速连接拖延整个下载。它还会记住拒绝额外连接的服务器，并停止向它们请求。请参阅<g1>连接和速度</g1>。

e3862f2f1e024923.source: <g1>Your IP address.</g1> Everyone sharing the same torrent sees it, as do its trackers and the DHT (the network peers use to find each other). That's how BitTorrent works, and no setting in MDM changes it. To hide your address, use a VPN on your whole computer.
e3862f2f1e024923.text: <g1>您的 IP 地址。</g1>所有共享同一种子的人，以及该种子的跟踪器和 DHT（对等方用来相互查找的网络），都能看到您的 IP 地址。这就是 BitTorrent 的工作方式，MDM 中的任何设置都无法改变这一点。要隐藏您的地址，请在整台计算机上使用 VPN。

e38fe6db3f869fe3.source: <g1>Use FTP in PASV mode</g1> — on by default: for FTP downloads MDM opens the data connections itself (passive mode), which works through routers and firewalls. Turn it off only for a server that needs active mode (the server connects back to you). FTP never goes through the proxy above, so its <g2>ftp</g2> box stays greyed. See <g3>FTP and FTPS</g3>.
e38fe6db3f869fe3.text: <g1>在 PASV 模式下使用 FTP</g1> — 默认开启：进行 FTP 下载时，MDM 会自行建立数据连接（被动模式），这种方式可在路由器和防火墙环境下使用。只有服务器需要主动模式（由服务器连接到您）时才关闭此选项。FTP 不会通过上述代理，因此其<g2>ftp</g2>复选框会显示为灰色。请参阅<g3>FTP 和 FTPS</g3>。

e393d2a019bf4cc9.source: <g1>Download selected links</g1> and <g2>Download all links</g2> read the links of the page (or of your selection) when you choose them, and pass them to MDM with the page's address and its site's cookies.
e393d2a019bf4cc9.text: 当您选择<g1>下载选定链接</g1>和<g2>下载所有链接</g2>时，它们会读取页面（或您选择的）链接，并将其与页面地址及其网站 cookie 一起传递给 MDM。

e3bf39c2a21c6fe0.source: Linux: dark mode follows the desktop, and a slow keyring or sleep service no longer freezes the window.
e3bf39c2a21c6fe0.text: Linux：深色模式现在会跟随桌面设置，并且密钥环或休眠服务缓慢不再导致窗口冻结。

e3ce2a886e89c710.source: Restart the browser after setting it up.
e3ce2a886e89c710.text: 设置完成后重启浏览器。

e3ce5d60681227f0.source: <g1>GitHub, for video helpers.</g1> If you use <g2>Download video from a page</g2>, MDM downloads yt-dlp (and ffmpeg, if you want merged qualities) from their official GitHub releases, checks them, and once per session asks GitHub whether yt-dlp has a newer release. yt-dlp then talks to the video site you asked for, as your browser would.
e3ce5d60681227f0.text: <g1>GitHub，用于视频辅助工具。</g1>如果您使用<g2>从页面下载视频</g2>，MDM 会从 yt-dlp（如果您需要合并质量，还会下载 ffmpeg）的官方 GitHub 版本下载它们，检查它们，并且每个会话一次向 GitHub 询问 yt-dlp 是否有更新的版本。然后 yt-dlp 会像您的浏览器一样与您请求的视频网站通信。

e3da3e83e9ba3cf7.source: A bar of the whole file, showing where each connection started and how far it has got (<g1>Start positions and download progress by connections</g1>).
e3da3e83e9ba3cf7.text: 显示整个文件的进度条，显示每个连接的起始位置和已完成的进度（<g1>连接的起始位置和下载进度</g1>）。

e430a7f95d146b8c.source: It is the same MDM as on a desktop: its list, categories, queues, Scheduler, speed limits and torrents. You control it with the <g1>remote control's page</g1> (from any phone or computer on your network), the browser extension pointed at it, or its command line.
e430a7f95d146b8c.text: 它与桌面版 MDM 相同：包括列表、分类、队列、计划程序、速度限制和种子。您可以通过<g1>远程控制页面</g1>（从网络上的任何手机或电脑）、指向它的浏览器扩展程序或其命令行来控制它。

e44930d18622541d.source: Choose the next category (<g1>Compressed</g1>, <g2>Documents</g2>, <g3>Music</g3>, <g4>Programs</g4>, <g5>Video</g5>, <g6>Torrents</g6>) and do the same, for example <x7/>.

e646f73c14c73fff.source: <g1>Resuming.</g1> MDM keeps the file's size and modification time. If either has changed when you resume, it says the file changed on the server instead of mixing two versions (<g2>Options → Downloads → Ignore file modification time changes</g2> skips the time check). The password is not written to the resume file next to the download: MDM gives it again when it resumes.
e646f73c14c73fff.text: <g1>恢复下载。</g1>MDM 会记录文件大小和修改时间。如果恢复下载时其中任何一项已变化，MDM 会提示服务器上的文件已更改，而不会混合两个版本（启用<g2>选项 → 下载 → 忽略文件修改时间更改</g2>可跳过时间检查）。密码不会写入下载文件旁边的恢复文件；恢复下载时，MDM 会再次提供密码。

e655ba486d16b2e5.source: When the browser can't hand a download to MDM, it keeps the download itself, so nothing is lost. The extension's toolbar button then shows a red <g1>!</g1>. Click it to see what's wrong, then <g2>How to fix it</g2> brings you to the matching section below.
e655ba486d16b2e5.text: 浏览器无法将下载任务交给 MDM 时，会自行处理下载，因此不会丢失任何内容。此时，扩展程序的工具栏按钮会显示红色的 <g1>!</g1>。点击它可查看问题所在，然后点击<g2>如何修复</g2>跳转到下方相应的部分。

e676e5ae98f9e413.source: MDM then downloads its files from the service over HTTP, as any download, into the <g1>Torrents</g1> folder. A torrent of several files gets a folder of its own there.
e676e5ae98f9e413.text: 然后，MDM 会通过 HTTP 从服务下载种子文件，并将其保存到<g1>种子</g1>文件夹中。包含多个文件的种子会在该文件夹中单独存放在一个子文件夹内。

e680897e60d1dca2.source: To bring the built-in categories back as they came, with their names, file types and folders, use <g1>Options → Save to → Restore the built-in categories</g1>. Your own categories, General and Torrents stay as they are.
e680897e60d1dca2.text: 要将内置类别恢复为初始状态，包括名称、文件类型和文件夹，请使用<g1>选项 → 保存到 → 恢复内置类别</g1>。自定义类别、常规和种子类别保持不变。

e680b303dc899de3.source: A second copy of MDM watches the first. When MDM crashes, the report window says <g1>Mister Download Manager closed unexpectedly</g1>. When its window hasn't answered for 8 seconds, it says <g2>Mister Download Manager stopped responding</g2>, and <g3>End and restart MDM</g3> closes the frozen copy and starts a fresh one. If MDM comes back by itself, the window says so.
e680b303dc899de3.text: MDM 的第二个副本会监视第一个副本。当 MDM 崩溃时，报告窗口会显示<g1>Mister Download Manager 意外关闭</g1>。当其窗口在 8 秒内没有响应时，它会显示<g2>Mister Download Manager 已停止响应</g2>，并且<g3>结束并重启 MDM</g3>会关闭冻结的副本并启动一个新的。如果 MDM 自行恢复，窗口会显示此信息。

A file names only what it changes; the rest comes from the theme it <x5/> (a built-in's id or another file, the classic look by default), down a chain in which a cycle is refused. Unknown keys are warnings, not errors. The built-in style themes are such files too, carried in the program (<x6/>).
e707093847217661.text: <g1>主题文件。</g1> <x2/> 从数据文件夹的 <x3/> 读取 TOML 或 JSON（一个文件，或 <x4/> 旁边带有图标）。一个文件只命名它所更改的内容；其余部分来自它 <x5/> 的主题（内置主题的 ID 或另一个文件，默认是经典外观），沿着一个拒绝循环的链。未知键是警告，而不是错误。内置样式主题也是此类文件，包含在程序中（<x6/>）。

e74158e5348133d6.source: <g1>Your own yt-dlp and ffmpeg</g1> (<g2>#51</g2>): <g3>Download video from a page → Helpers...</g3> shows where each comes from, and <g4>Use another program...</g4> takes a copy you already have instead of MDM's own (checked once, then used by the window and the command line alike; MDM leaves its updates to you). <g5>Use MDM's own copy</g5> goes back.

e9de3deb5fe58030.source: <g1>Video subtitles</g1> (<g2>#68</g2>): Download video from a page lists the video's subtitle languages, the uploader's first, then the site's automatic captions (in the language spoken, English and yours). They're saved beside the video as <x3/>, or put into the video with ffmpeg (MP4, MKV), and the choice is offered again for the next video. Subtitles a site refuses (YouTube limits how often they may be fetched) never cost the video: MDM asks once more after a pause, then says which are missing. On the command line: <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>; <x7/> lists them. A finished video and its subtitles are now marked as downloaded from the internet, as other downloads are.
e9de3deb5fe58030.text: <g1>视频字幕</g1>（<g2>#68</g2>）：“从页面下载视频”功能会列出视频的字幕语言，首先是上传者提供的语言，然后是网站自动生成的字幕（视频中的口语语言、英语和您的语言）。字幕会以 <x3/> 格式保存在视频文件旁边，或者通过 ffmpeg 嵌入到视频中（MP4、MKV），并且下次下载视频时会再次提供选择。如果网站拒绝提供字幕（YouTube 限制了获取字幕的频率），视频下载不会受影响：MDM 会在暂停后再次尝试，然后显示哪些字幕缺失。命令行选项：<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/>；<x7/> 用于列出字幕。已完成的视频及其字幕现在会像其他下载一样，标记为已从互联网下载。

ea282dea9c9a7014.source: If it says <g1>this site lets only browsers through</g1>, the site's bot check (Cloudflare's, for one) turned MDM away. MDM has already asked once more connecting the way your browser does, with your browser's cookies for that site, and the site still wants its check answered in a browser. Open the site in your browser (passing its check there can be enough: click the link again), or hold <g2>Alt</g2> as you click the link to leave that download to the browser. See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
ea282dea9c9a7014.text: 如果提示<g1>此网站只允许浏览器访问</g1>，则说明网站的机器人检测（例如 Cloudflare 的检测）拒绝了 MDM。MDM 已经尝试以您浏览器的方式再次连接，并使用了您浏览器在该网站的 Cookie，但网站仍然要求在浏览器中完成检测。请在浏览器中打开该网站（通过检测可能就足够了：再次点击链接），或者在点击链接时按住 <g2>Alt</g2> 键，将该下载任务交给浏览器处理。详见<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

eb0420560f61474c.source: <g1>No silent overwrite</g1>: when some of a torrent's files are already in the folder, MDM asks before writing into them (<g2>No</g2> is the default). The command line's <x3/> stops and names them, unless given <x4/>.

eb0fb6cd2d124649.source: <g1>A file-type icon before every file name or folder</g1> (<g2>#122</g2>): the download list, Download File Info, Properties, Download complete (its open folder), Add torrent (the torrent and its tree), a torrent's Files tab, the progress window's Save To, the Scheduler's files, Batch download's preview, and Download video's qualities and a playlist's videos (the file each one gives). Each is your system's own icon for that type, the one its file manager shows: Windows Explorer's, macOS Finder's, or your Linux desktop's icon theme (KDE's, GNOME's or GTK's choice, then the themes it builds on). It is sharp at every display scale (125, 150, 200 %), taken at the size the screen needs. Each type is looked up once, in the background, so a long list never waits for it. Where the system has no icon for a type (a Linux desktop without an icon theme), MDM draws one of its own, from the Tango icons (public domain).
eb0fb6cd2d124649.text: <g1>每个文件名或文件夹前显示文件类型图标</g1>（<g2>#122</g2>）：下载列表、“下载文件信息”、“属性”、“下载完成”（其打开文件夹）、“添加种子”（种子及其树状结构）、种子文件的“文件”选项卡、进度窗口的“保存到”、“计划程序”的文件、批量下载的预览，以及“下载视频”的质量和播放列表视频（每个视频生成的文件）。每个图标都是您系统为该类型文件提供的图标，即文件管理器显示的图标：Windows 资源管理器、macOS Finder，或您的 Linux 桌面图标主题（KDE、GNOME 或 GTK 的选择，然后是其所基于的主题）。在任何显示缩放比例（125%、150%、200%）下都保持清晰，按屏幕所需尺寸获取。每种类型只查找一次，在后台进行，因此长列表不会因此等待。如果系统没有某种类型的图标（例如没有图标主题的 Linux 桌面），MDM 会从 Tango 图标（公共领域）中自行绘制一个。

eb1e3724d60ad6dd.source: <g1>User-Agent for manually added downloads</g1> — how MDM names itself to servers for downloads you add yourself. With <g2>Automatic</g2> ticked (the default), MDM introduces itself as your default browser: the User-Agent that browser sends, at the version you have installed (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox or Safari). The box shows it, and pointing at it names the browser. When MDM doesn't recognise your default browser, it sends a current Chrome's. Untick <g3>Automatic</g3> to type your own; tick it again to go back. Downloads from the browser use that browser's own User-Agent. If a site turns a browser's User-Agent away, MDM asks once more with its own.
eb1e3724d60ad6dd.text: <g1>手动添加下载的用户代理</g1> — MDM 在您手动添加下载时向服务器表明身份的方式。勾选“<g2>自动</g2>”（默认）后，MDM 会将自己标识为您的默认浏览器：发送该浏览器当前安装版本（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi、Firefox 或 Safari）的用户代理。框中会显示该信息，鼠标指向时会显示浏览器名称。如果 MDM 无法识别您的默认浏览器，它会发送当前 Chrome 的用户代理。取消勾选“<g3>自动</g3>”可自行输入；再次勾选可恢复。通过浏览器发起的下载会使用该浏览器自己的用户代理。如果某个网站拒绝了浏览器的用户代理，MDM 会再次尝试使用自己的用户代理。

ebb00adeab17b68e.source: <g1>Links that work only once</g1> (or hosts that allow one download at a time) failed with "403 Forbidden" after Download File Info had looked them up (<g2>#28</g2>): the window's look and the download each asked the server. The download now continues from the answer the window got, and asks again only if that connection has closed meanwhile.
ebb00adeab17b68e.text: <g1>一次性链接</g1>（或一次只允许一个下载的主机）在“下载文件信息”查询后失败，显示“403 Forbidden”（<g2>#28</g2>）：窗口查询和下载操作都向服务器发出了请求。现在，下载会从窗口获得的响应继续，并且仅当该连接在此期间关闭时才再次请求。

ebb02e1568d6f55f.source: Speed Limiter settings: the maximum speed for all downloads
ebb02e1568d6f55f.text: 速度限制器设置：所有下载的最大速度

ebd4dfa7b5dfc4d3.source: All of this needs a notification area that shows MDM's icon. Windows and macOS have one, and so do most Linux desktops (KDE, GNOME with its AppIndicator extension, waybar's tray). On a desktop without one, MDM starts minimized instead, closing the window quits MDM, and <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> is greyed. In a Wayland session the main window stays minimized in the dock, because Wayland can't hide a window.
ebd4dfa7b5dfc4d3.text: 所有这些功能都需要一个显示 MDM 图标的通知区域。Windows 和 macOS 都有，大多数 Linux 桌面（KDE、带有 AppIndicator 扩展的 GNOME、waybar 的托盘）也都有。在没有通知区域的桌面上，MDM 会改为最小化启动，关闭窗口会退出 MDM，并且<g1>最小化到通知区域</g1>会显示为灰色。在 Wayland 会话中，主窗口会保持最小化在 Dock 中，因为 Wayland 无法隐藏窗口。

ebe70dff5e0f1598.source: MDM downloads videos from their web pages: YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, TikTok, X, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, SoundCloud and well over a thousand other sites. <g1>yt-dlp</g1>, an open-source program whose community keeps it working as sites change, finds the video on the page; MDM's own downloader then brings it in, the way it downloads any file.
ebe70dff5e0f1598.text: MDM 可以从 YouTube、Vimeo、Dailymotion、Twitch、TikTok、X、Instagram、Facebook、Reddit、SoundCloud 以及其他一千多个网站下载视频。开源程序 <g1>yt-dlp</g1> 的社区会持续更新，以适应网站的变化，它负责在网页上找到视频；然后 MDM 自带的下载器会像下载任何文件一样将其下载。

ec5948db00d533b3.source: The address the browser was given is kept along with where its redirects led, so an expired signed link (a GitHub release, a cloud drive) is renewed when resumed, and a site excluded in Options is left alone even when it redirects to another.
ec5948db00d533b3.text: 浏览器提供的地址会与重定向后的地址一起保存，因此过期的签名链接（GitHub 发布、云盘）在恢复时会续期，并且在选项中排除的网站即使重定向到其他网站也会被忽略。

ec76a04b2f141c3a.source: <g1>Windows' language</g1>, at the top, follows Windows' display language. When Windows uses a language MDM doesn't have, MDM shows English.
ec76a04b2f141c3a.text: 顶部的<g1>Windows 语言</g1>会跟随 Windows 的显示语言。如果 Windows 使用的语言不在 MDM 中，MDM 会显示英文。

ec83076f0311f20e.source: A theme is one small text file in <g1>TOML</g1> (or JSON, <x2/>; or a <g3>colour scheme</g3>, <x4/>). It names only what it changes; everything else comes from the theme it <x5/>:
ec83076f0311f20e.text: 主题是一个小的 <g1>TOML</g1> 文本文件（或 JSON，<x2/>；或<g3>配色方案</g3>，<x4/>）。它只命名它所更改的内容；所有其他内容都来自它所 <x5/> 的主题：

ec8dbbc2dc38cd32.source: A torrent stopped by one of these says so in its event log, and isn't shared again when MDM starts. Raise or turn off the limit to share it again. - <g1>Limit uploading for all torrents to</g1> — off by default. Caps what all your torrents together send to other peers, while they download and while they share. A torrent's own upload limit, in its progress window, applies on top of it. - <g2>Open magnet links and .torrent files with Mister Download Manager</g2> — Windows then opens magnet links in your browser and <x3/> files in Explorer with MDM. This is for your Windows account only; a program you chose in Windows' <g4>Open with</g4> stays first. The setup can turn it on for you.
ec8dbbc2dc38cd32.text: 因上述任一原因停止共享的种子会在事件日志中注明，且 MDM 下次启动时不会再次共享。提高或关闭限制即可再次共享。 - <g1>将所有 torrent 的上传限制为</g1> — 默认关闭。限制所有 torrent 在下载和共享期间向其他节点上传的总速度。种子进度窗口中设置的单个种子上传限速也会生效。 - <g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 打开磁力链接和 .torrent 文件</g2> — 设置后，Windows 会使用 MDM 在浏览器中打开磁力链接，并在资源管理器中打开 <x3/> 文件。此设置仅适用于您的 Windows 账户；您在 Windows 的<g4>打开方式</g4>中选择的程序仍优先使用。安装程序可以为您启用此功能。

ec9a97a0002e01aa.source: <g1>Subtitle support:</g1> download a video's subtitles, saved beside it or put into it.
ec9a97a0002e01aa.text: <g1>字幕支持：</g1> 下载视频字幕，可保存到视频旁边或嵌入视频中。

ed015fb2e04742ce.source: <g1>Encrypted</g1>: HTTPS, with a certificate made on your computer and kept; its fingerprint is in Options, to compare with the one the phone's browser shows.

ed0419b45b0e746b.source: Pick a feed on the left to see its articles. An article with a torrent shows a torrent icon and its size when the feed gives it. Double-click one, or select it and click <g1>Download...</g1>, to open <g2>Add torrent</g2> with it, as for any magnet link or <x3/> address.
ed0419b45b0e746b.text: 选择左侧的源以查看其中的文章。如果文章包含种子，且源提供了种子大小，文章旁会显示种子图标和大小。双击文章，或选中后点击<g1>下载...</g1>，即可用该种子打开<g2>添加种子</g2>窗口，操作方式与磁力链接或<x3/>地址相同。

ed421ed944fa90a0.source: <g1>With the setup:</g1> the setup asks for its language first, with Windows' display language selected. MDM starts in the language you choose there.
ed421ed944fa90a0.text: <g1>通过安装程序：</g1>安装程序会先询问要使用的语言，并默认选择 Windows 的显示语言。MDM 会以您在此处选择的语言启动。

ed5b7e8737429bd7.source: The server's certificate is checked against Windows' (or the system's) trusted certificates, as for <x1/>. A Linux system without them (a minimal install without the <x2/> package) still downloads over plain HTTP and FTP; each secure download then fails at once, saying to install that package.
ed5b7e8737429bd7.text: 服务器证书会根据 Windows（或系统）的受信任证书进行检查，与 <x1/> 的方式相同。没有这些证书的 Linux 系统（未安装 <x2/> 软件包的最小化安装）仍会通过纯 HTTP 和 FTP 下载；每个安全下载都会立即失败，并提示安装该软件包。

ed7e98ef180222ef.source: <g1>Must contain</g1>: words the title must contain, all of them, in any order. <x2/> separates alternatives (<x3/>), and <x4/> and <x5/> are wildcards. Case doesn't matter.
ed7e98ef180222ef.text: <g1>必须包含</g1>：标题必须包含的词语，且所有词语都要出现，顺序不限。<x2/>用于分隔备选项（<x3/>），<x4/>和<x5/>是通配符。不区分大小写。

ed892871d41a817e.source: Bind downloads to a VPN adapter, with a kill switch — Mister Download Manager
ed892871d41a817e.text: 将下载绑定到 VPN 网卡，并带断流开关 — Mister Download Manager

ed910aded9955f8e.source: A download from the browser keeps the browser's name, size and type: Download File Info no longer asks the server again, so a link's own name (<x1/>), a Unicode name and a download behind a sign-in show right away, and correctly. When it must ask (an address typed in), it asks with the cookies, referrer and User-Agent the download will use.
ed910aded9955f8e.text: 从浏览器下载的文件会保留浏览器的名称、大小和类型：下载文件信息不再向服务器再次请求，因此链接本身的名称（<x1/>）、Unicode 名称和需要登录才能下载的文件会立即正确显示。当必须请求时（例如手动输入的地址），它会使用下载将使用的 cookie、referrer 和 User-Agent 进行请求。

edc9abcb08e77b81.source: <g1><g2>Image galleries</g2></g1> — download a gallery's pictures (Wikimedia Commons, Flickr, DeviantArt and many more) with gallery-dl.
edc9abcb08e77b81.text: <g1><g2>图片库</g2></g1> — 使用 gallery-dl 下载图片库中的图片（Wikimedia Commons、Flickr、DeviantArt 等）。

ee039e1bd1c5bf4b.source: Downloads from a private window are kept out of the saved list.
ee039e1bd1c5bf4b.text: 从隐私窗口下载的文件不会保存在已保存列表中。
