ee1b23b4b3e85124.text: 如何安装浏览器扩展程序？

ee291d81382d51c0.source: With the server set up, you can ask your assistant things like "What is MDM downloading right now, and how long is left?", "Download this ISO to my ISOs folder tonight, don't start it yet", or "Remove the finished downloads from the list but keep the files". The assistant turns that into requests to MDM and tells you what happened.
ee291d81382d51c0.text: 设置好服务器后，您可以向助手提问，例如“MDM 现在正在下载什么，还剩多长时间？”，“今晚将此 ISO 下载到我的 ISO 文件夹，但暂时不要开始”，或者“从列表中删除已完成的下载，但保留文件”。助手会将这些问题转换为对 MDM 的请求，并告诉您结果。

ee657a313da06c4d.source: If you want Internet Download Manager's layout without its price, Mister Download Manager: free and open source, laid out like IDM, and it imports your IDM list. If you need something else first, such as an Android app or a particular feature, the comparison above shows what each of the others is good at.
ee657a313da06c4d.text: 如果您想要 Internet Download Manager 的布局但不想付费，请选择 Mister Download Manager：免费开源，布局与 IDM 相似，并且可以导入您的 IDM 列表。如果您首先需要其他功能，例如安卓应用或特定功能，上面的比较显示了其他每个产品的优点。

ee658e61097dcf6b.source: A computer that is asleep doesn't run anything until it wakes, unless the queue has <g1>Wake the computer to run this queue</g1> ticked (on Windows it needs <g2>Allow wake timers</g2> in the power plan; the Scheduler says when it's off). See <g3>Wake the computer to run a queue</g3>.
ee658e61097dcf6b.text: 电脑在休眠状态下不会运行任何程序，除非队列勾选了<g1>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g1>（在 Windows 上，电源计划中需要<g2>允许唤醒定时器</g2>；计划程序会显示其何时关闭）。请参阅<g3>唤醒电脑以运行队列</g3>。

ee6f42906303457a.source: <g1><g2>Browser integration</g2></g1> — the extension for Firefox (from addons.mozilla.org), Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Helium (from the Chrome Web Store), which downloads it takes, and what happens when MDM isn't running.
ee6f42906303457a.text: <g1><g2>浏览器集成</g2></g1> — 适用于 Firefox（来自 addons.mozilla.org）、Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Helium（来自 Chrome 网上应用店）的扩展程序，它会接管哪些下载，以及 MDM 未运行时会发生什么。

ee6f7b9e469f83a7.source: <g1>Download limits</g1> keeps a capped internet plan in check: no more than a set number of megabytes every few hours. When the limit is reached, downloads wait, and they carry on by themselves when the period is over.
ee6f7b9e469f83a7.text: <g1>下载限制</g1>可以控制有流量限制的互联网套餐：每隔几小时下载的兆字节数不超过设定值。达到限制后，下载会暂停，并在期限结束后自行继续。

ee842e23c6f5db1a.source: <g1>What happened:</g1> the error and the place in MDM's code where it happened.
ee842e23c6f5db1a.text: <g1>发生了什么：</g1>错误，以及错误在 MDM 代码中发生的位置。

ee9034f4bfe810cf.source: <g1>Recheck files</g1> — reads every piece of the torrent's files and checks it, for example after you moved files in or a disk had errors. A running torrent goes on afterwards and fetches what is missing. A stopped one stays stopped. Its event log says how much was found: a finished torrent with a damaged piece becomes stopped, and resuming it fetches the piece again.
ee9034f4bfe810cf.text: <g1>重新检查文件</g1> — 读取种子文件的每个部分并进行检查，例如在您移动文件或磁盘出现错误之后。运行中的种子会继续运行并获取缺失的部分。已停止的种子保持停止状态。其事件日志会显示找到多少内容：已完成的种子如果损坏了一个部分，则会变为停止状态，恢复它会再次获取该部分。

eea0683af36fb9e8.source: Something not working? We'd like to know.

eead62195911a621.source: <g1>Windows</g1>: in <g2>Windows Credential Manager</g2> (Control Panel → Credential Manager → Windows Credentials), as entries named <x3/>, for your Windows account. They roam with your profile, as MDM's settings folder does.
eead62195911a621.text: <g1>Windows</g1>：在<g2>Windows 凭据管理器</g2>（控制面板 → 凭据管理器 → Windows 凭据）中，作为名为<x3/>的条目，用于您的 Windows 账户。它们会随您的配置文件漫游，就像 MDM 的设置文件夹一样。

eee3dbbafbb8e53c.source: - <g1>Chromium as a Snap</g1> (Ubuntu's Chromium) starts MDM's helper inside its sandbox, where it can't reach MDM, so MDM doesn't list it in <g2>Add Mister Download Manager to your browser</g2>. Use Firefox, or Google Chrome from its own <x3/>. - <g4>Flatpak browsers</g4> (such as Zen's <x5/>) can't start MDM's helper, so MDM doesn't list them either. Install the browser from your distribution's packages (or the browser maker's own <x6/>, <x7/>, tarball or AppImage) to use browser integration.
eee3dbbafbb8e53c.text: - <g1>Snap 版 Chromium</g1>（Ubuntu 自带的 Chromium）会在沙盒中启动 MDM 助手，但助手无法在沙盒中访问 MDM，因此 MDM 不会在<g2>将 Mister Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>中列出 Chromium。请使用 Firefox，或从 Google Chrome 自己的<x3/>安装。 - <g4>Flatpak 浏览器</g4>（例如 Zen 的<x5/>）无法启动 MDM 助手，因此 MDM 也不会列出这些浏览器。要使用浏览器集成，请从发行版的软件包中安装浏览器，或从浏览器开发者自己的<x6/>、<x7/>、tarball 或 AppImage 安装。

eef7cd8b9e89ab48.source: <g1>The app icon on macOS</g1>: the Dock showed a small, blurry icon while MDM ran; it keeps the app's own now. Elsewhere windows take their icon from a large size (sharp at any scaling).
eef7cd8b9e89ab48.text: <g1>macOS 上的应用图标</g1>：MDM 运行时，Dock 上显示一个小而模糊的图标；现在它会保留应用本身的图标。在其他地方，窗口图标取自大尺寸（在任何缩放比例下都清晰）。

ef078e7bf8101d03.source: 1 the file types MDM takes, 2 the sites it leaves to the browser.
ef078e7bf8101d03.text: 1 MDM 捕获的文件类型，2 MDM 留给浏览器处理的站点。

ef0fe27d24f63c0a.source: <g1>Timing.</g1> End to end: from issuing the command to the finished file under its final name, polled every millisecond on a monotonic clock. MDM renames its finished file into place; IDM creates the final file early and fills it, so for IDM the moment it reaches full size counts. Transfer: the server's first request to its last byte, read on the same clock through a calibration request before each run.
ef0fe27d24f63c0a.text: <g1>计时。</g1> 端到端：从发出命令到文件以最终名称完成，在单调时钟上每毫秒轮询一次。MDM 将完成的文件重命名到位；IDM 提前创建最终文件并填充它，因此对于 IDM，达到完整大小的时刻即为完成。传输：服务器的第一个请求到最后一个字节，在每次运行前通过校准请求在同一时钟上读取。

ef1f6cf42ae2684d.source: <g1>Customize MDM Download panels in browsers → Edit...</g1> — the download button over videos on web pages: turn it off, or list the sites it never shows on (separate them by spaces; <x2/> covers its subdomains). See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
ef1f6cf42ae2684d.text: <g1>自定义浏览器中的 MDM 下载面板 → 编辑...</g1> — 网页视频上方的下载按钮：关闭它，或列出它从不显示的网站（用空格分隔；<x2/>涵盖其子域名）。请参阅<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

ef2822f419ae24aa.source: Run MDM with no window on a server, NAS, Docker or Unraid with <x1/>, and send it downloads from your browser.
ef2822f419ae24aa.text: 在服务器、NAS、Docker 或 Unraid 上，使用 <x1/> 运行无窗口的 MDM，并从浏览器向其发送下载任务。

ef3160e078d4d318.source: MDM opens 8 connections by default, and you can set anything from 1 to 32 in <g1>Options → Connection</g1>. When a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the largest part still left, so the work is shared out again and again until the file is done. A connection that falls far behind the others is dropped and opened again.
ef3160e078d4d318.text: MDM 默认开启 8 个连接，您可以在<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>中设置 1 到 32 个。当一个连接完成其部分后，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，因此工作会不断重新分配，直到文件下载完成。如果一个连接远远落后于其他连接，它将被断开并重新连接。

ef47e1ebbb6f563f.source: Mister Download Manager ("MDM") is free, open-source software made by Ahmed Nefzaoui and contributors. Because its whole source code is public at <g1>github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager</g1>, you don't have to take this page's word for it: every network connection described here can be checked in the code.
ef47e1ebbb6f563f.text: Mister Download Manager（“MDM”）是由 Ahmed Nefzaoui 和贡献者开发的免费开源软件。由于其全部源代码在<g1>github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager</g1>上公开，您无需相信本页面的说法：此处描述的每个网络连接都可以在代码中进行检查。

ef4a27773ff3aeb9.source: The download progress window: a file over eight connections, each one's share drawn as it fills.
ef4a27773ff3aeb9.text: 下载进度窗口：一个文件通过 8 个连接下载，图中显示每个连接已完成的部分。

ef570eed3976e4be.text: 主题 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

ef5c9c83c0fe82a9.source: MDM listens for the browser before its window is up, and the browser's helper waits 20 seconds for a slow first start instead of 5.
ef5c9c83c0fe82a9.text: MDM 在其窗口启动前监听浏览器，并且浏览器辅助程序会等待 20 秒以应对首次启动缓慢的情况，而不是 5 秒。

ef6e5d90b67f8e4e.source: <g1>"Hide tab" was cut in longer languages</g1> (German "Registerkarte au..."): the button grows to fit its label where there is room, through a shared helper other buttons can use.
ef6e5d90b67f8e4e.text: <g1>“隐藏选项卡”在较长的语言中被截断</g1>（德语“Registerkarte au...”）：按钮会根据标签的长度自动扩展，只要有空间，通过一个共享的辅助功能，其他按钮也可以使用此功能。

ef8cedcbdccdaf85.source: The code is filled in when you scanned the QR code; otherwise type it. Give the phone a name, and tap <g1>Pair</g1>. The window on the computer says so, and closes with <g2>Done</g2>.
ef8cedcbdccdaf85.text: 扫描二维码后，代码会自动填写；否则请手动输入。为手机命名，然后点击<g1>配对</g1>。电脑上的窗口会显示配对成功，并以<g2>完成</g2>关闭。

ef9a4d7edbc1d621.source: <g1>Video pages and image galleries</g1> go through it too, on Windows, Linux and macOS: video downloads (yt-dlp and the ffmpeg it starts) and galleries (gallery-dl) go through a proxy MDM runs on this computer, which opens their connections through the adapter as MDM opens its own, with the DNS you chose, IPv4 and IPv6. The same kill switch: when the adapter disconnects, their connections close at once and the downloads stop, then start again when it is back. Formats over RTMP, RTSP, MMS or FTP, which can't go through it, are refused. The command line's <x2/> and <x3/> take <x4/>.
ef9a4d7edbc1d621.text: <g1>视频页面和图片图库</g1>在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上也通过它进行：视频下载（yt-dlp 及其启动的 ffmpeg）和图库（gallery-dl）通过 MDM 在此计算机上运行的代理进行，该代理通过适配器打开其连接，就像 MDM 打开自己的连接一样，使用您选择的 DNS、IPv4 和 IPv6。相同的断网开关：当适配器断开连接时，它们的连接会立即关闭，下载停止，然后在适配器恢复时重新开始。无法通过它进行的 RTMP、RTSP、MMS 或 FTP 格式将被拒绝。<x2/> 和 <x3/> 命令行接受 <x4/>。

efaf00494efe309f.source: The other downloads keep their speed.

efb69276e4a6fa08.source: A fix for 0.2.3, whose toolbar buttons did nothing (only their drop-down arrows worked), and for dark mode, which drew everything a little bigger and in other places than day mode.
efb69276e4a6fa08.text: 修复了 0.2.3 版的问题：工具栏按钮点击后没有反应（只有下拉箭头有效）。还修复了深色模式下元素尺寸稍大、位置与浅色模式不同的问题。

efeefb4eb3f42f1d.source: <g1>Video downloads' progress</g1> went back and forth (a stream in fragments re-estimates its size, and picture and sound arrive one after the other); it only moves forward now, from the size the video window showed.
efeefb4eb3f42f1d.text: <g1>视频下载的进度</g1>曾来回跳动（分段流会重新估算其大小，并且图像和声音会先后到达）；现在它只会向前移动，从视频窗口显示的大小开始。

eff6c00ab7dd9c1d.source: The thumb or an arrow under the pointer

effc1ee925dfd7a5.source: If MDM can't be reached at all (it was uninstalled, or the helper isn't registered), the download stays with the browser, so nothing is lost, and the toolbar button shows a red <g1>!</g1>. See <g2>The browser and MDM aren't connected</g2>, or run <g3>Options → General → Test browser integration...</g3>.
effc1ee925dfd7a5.text: 如果完全无法连接到 MDM（它已被卸载，或助手未注册），下载将由浏览器处理，因此不会丢失任何内容，并且工具栏按钮会显示红色的 <g1>!</g1>。请参阅 <g2>浏览器和 MDM 未连接</g2>，或运行 <g3>选项 → 常规 → 测试浏览器集成...</g3>。

f0122065c2796282.source: Yes. MDM comes with an MCP server, misterdownloadmanager-mcp: add it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or another assistant that supports MCP, and you can ask it in your own words to list, add, pause, resume or remove downloads. It works with the MDM on your computer only, and needs the automation API on. See AI assistants.
f0122065c2796282.text: 可以。MDM 自带 MCP 服务器，misterdownloadmanager-mcp：将其添加到 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 或其他支持 MCP 的助手中，即可用自己的话要求它列出、添加、暂停、恢复或删除下载。它只能连接您电脑上的 MDM，并且需要启用自动化 API。请参阅 AI 助手。

f0158ad929a46bdf.source: <g1>System keychain support:</g1> passwords and account sign-ins are now kept in your system's keychain, not in MDM's settings.
f0158ad929a46bdf.text: <g1>支持系统钥匙串：</g1> 密码和账户登录信息现在保存在您系统的钥匙串中，而不是 MDM 的设置里。

f019d7a91e057d16.source: A download saved under a numbered name because another file already had its name (<x1/>) now shows that name in the list and opens its own file, instead of keeping the old name and opening the other file (<g2>#442</g2>). Two downloads waiting under one name no longer collide when they start: the later one takes the next free name, instead of failing with "already being downloaded" or continuing the other one's data.
f019d7a91e057d16.text: 由于其他文件已占用其名称而以编号名称保存的下载文件（<x1/>）现在会在列表中显示该名称并打开其自身文件，而不是保留旧名称并打开其他文件（<g2>#442</g2>）。两个以同一名称等待的下载任务在开始时不再冲突：后一个任务会占用下一个可用名称，而不是因“已在下载”而失败或继续另一个任务的数据。

f01b0d771d8f75e6.source: <g1>View → Theme → Add a theme file…</g1> does it for you: pick a file anywhere, and MDM copies it into the themes folder and uses it at once. A file that isn't a theme stays out, and MDM says why.
f01b0d771d8f75e6.text: <g1>视图 → 主题 → 添加主题文件…</g1> 即可完成操作：选择任意文件，MDM 会将其复制到主题文件夹并立即应用。如果文件不是主题文件，MDM 会将其排除并说明原因。

f01bb992070dab45.source: Image galleries — Mister Download Manager help
f01bb992070dab45.text: 图片图库 — Mister Download Manager 帮助

f0332c2aa7cd2077.source: <g1>A download's progress file could be written again just after it stopped</g1> (<g2>#106</g2>), and <g3>a download could fail as it finished, with "part file still in use"</g3> (<g4>#116</g4>). MDM saves a download's progress every few seconds, in a file beside it. A download paused or finished during one of those saves could stop before the save was done; that save then wrote an old progress file a moment later, or, when the last bytes arrived during it, still held the file. A download now stops only once its save is done.
f0332c2aa7cd2077.text: <g1>下载的进度文件可能会在停止后立即再次写入</g1>（<g2>#106</g2>），并且<g3>下载可能会在完成时失败，并显示“部分文件仍在使用中”</g3>（<g4>#116</g4>）。MDM 每隔几秒钟将下载进度保存到其旁边的一个文件中。在其中一次保存期间暂停或完成的下载可能会在保存完成之前停止；然后该保存会在片刻之后写入旧的进度文件，或者，当最后字节在此期间到达时，仍然持有该文件。现在，下载只有在保存完成后才会停止。

f0367ba56d9b43fa.source: Mister Download Manager — free download manager and IDM alternative
f0367ba56d9b43fa.text: Mister Download Manager — 免费下载管理器和 IDM 替代品

f037bd6ae0bfb52b.source: <g1>Keyboard everywhere</g1>: arrow keys in radio groups and tab strips, Ctrl+Tab between tabs, type a name to jump to it in any list or drop-down, Up/Down through Add URL's and Save As' history, Home/End in menus, Tab between the Categories tree and the list (the tree answers the arrows), F2 to rename, held arrows repeat, the date picker's calendar works from the keyboard and has Today.
f037bd6ae0bfb52b.text: <g1>随处都可使用键盘操作</g1>：在单选组和选项卡栏中使用箭头键，在选项卡之间使用 Ctrl+Tab，在任何列表或下拉菜单中键入名称即可跳转到对应项，在“添加 URL”和“另存为”的历史记录中使用向上/向下键，在菜单中使用 Home/End，在“类别”树和列表之间使用 Tab（树会响应箭头键），使用 F2 重命名，按住箭头键可连续操作；日期选择器的日历可用键盘操作，并有“今天”按钮。

f03aff69718cb1f3.source: <g1>The AppImage updates through AppImage tools too</g1> (<g2>#24</g2>): it carries the address of its updates, and each release has its <x3/>, so AppImageLauncher, Gear Lever and AppImageUpdate download only the parts that changed. <g4>Update now</g4> works as before.
f03aff69718cb1f3.text: <g1>AppImage 也能通过 AppImage 工具更新</g1>（<g2>#24</g2>）：它带有更新地址，每个版本都有其 <x3/>，因此 AppImageLauncher、Gear Lever 和 AppImageUpdate 只下载更改的部分。<g4>立即更新</g4>功能与之前一样。

f03c509d0238da7b.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: a folder for the rule's torrents, and <g2>Add them without starting them</g2> if you'd rather start them yourself.
f03c509d0238da7b.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：规则种子的文件夹，如果您更愿意自己启动它们，则选择<g2>添加但不启动</g2>。

f047e40e7188535a.source: Narrow it down with categories and sorting
f047e40e7188535a.text: 使用类别和排序缩小范围

f07b8550d655f4bb.source: The crash report window after MDM stopped responding
f07b8550d655f4bb.text: MDM 停止响应后的崩溃报告窗口

f088cdaf6f222203.source: <g1>Use proxy/socks from a browser's request…</g1> — on by default. A download MDM takes from the browser goes through the proxy the browser used for it. That's the one a VPN or proxy extension set, the browser's own manual proxy, or its proxy auto-config script. Without it, the download would leave from your own address, and content limited to the VPN's country, or to its address, would fail. The browser extension reads that proxy and hands it to MDM with each download, once you switch on <g2>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g2> in the extension's toolbar popup (Firefox asks you once; Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi ask nothing more: see <g3>A VPN or proxy extension</g3>).
f088cdaf6f222203.text: <g1>使用浏览器请求中的代理/SOCKS…</g1> — 默认开启。MDM 从浏览器接管的下载会通过浏览器用于该下载的代理。这包括 VPN 或代理扩展设置的代理、浏览器自己的手动代理，或其代理自动配置脚本。如果没有此设置，下载将从您自己的地址发出，并且受限于 VPN 国家或其地址的内容将无法下载。一旦您在扩展程序的工具栏弹窗中开启<g2>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g2>（Firefox 会询问一次；Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 不会再询问：请参阅<g3>VPN 或代理扩展</g3>），浏览器扩展就会读取该代理并将其随每次下载传递给 MDM。

f09a7e7e0cc71c2e.source: In the system's keychain, as are Sites Logins' passwords and the proxy's. MDM's settings keep only a reference to it. <g1>Options → Accounts</g1> says where they are on your computer.
f09a7e7e0cc71c2e.text: 与“站点登录”密码和代理密码一样，都保存在系统密钥链中。MDM 的设置仅保留对其的引用。<g1>选项 → 账户</g1> 会显示它们在您计算机上的位置。

f09d8a183f62958e.source: The computer has to be asleep, not shut down. On Windows the power plan must allow wake timers: the Scheduler says when it doesn't, and <g1>Change</g1> opens the setting. On Linux an administrator allows it once. On macOS only an administrator can schedule a wake, so the option is greyed there. MDM never asks for an administrator's password.
f09d8a183f62958e.text: 计算机必须处于睡眠状态，而不是关机。在 Windows 上，电源计划必须允许唤醒计时器：计划程序会在不允许时提示，点击<g1>更改</g1>可以打开设置。在 Linux 上，管理员需要一次性允许。在 macOS 上，只有管理员才能安排唤醒，因此该选项会变灰。MDM 从不要求管理员密码。

f0a48a4100d89aef.source: Copied several links at once, a list or a whole forum post? Choose <g1>Tasks → Add batch download from clipboard</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+B</g2>, also in the tray icon's menu). MDM reads the clipboard then, and only then, and finds every download link in the text: <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/> and magnet links, one per line or among other words, in Markdown (<x6/>) or between <x7/> and <x8/>. Each one is listed once in <g9>Link grabber</g9>, ticked and sorted into packages: pick a folder for each package, then <g10>Start</g10> or <g11>Add to queue</g11>. Downloads added together end with one <g12>Downloads complete</g12> summary. Magnet links are added as torrents with all their files once their files are known. A copied address with a number in its name, such as <x13/>, opens <g14>Batch download</g14> instead (below). If the clipboard holds no text, or no link, MDM says so.
f0a48a4100d89aef.text: 一次复制了多个链接、一个列表或整个论坛帖子？选择<g1>任务 → 从剪贴板批量添加下载</g1>（<g2>Ctrl+B</g2>，也可在托盘图标菜单中找到）。MDM 会读取剪贴板，并且只在此时读取，然后从文本中找到所有下载链接：<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/> 和磁力链接，每行一个或混杂在其他文字中，可以是 Markdown 格式（<x6/>）或在 <x7/> 和 <x8/> 之间。每个链接都会在<g9>链接抓取器</g9>中列出一次，被勾选并分类到不同的包中：为每个包选择一个文件夹，然后点击<g10>开始</g10>或<g11>添加到队列</g11>。同时添加的下载任务会以一个<g12>下载已完成</g12>摘要结束。磁力链接在文件信息已知后，会作为包含所有文件的种子任务添加。如果复制的地址名称中包含数字，例如<x13/>，则会打开<g14>批量下载</g14>（见下文）。如果剪贴板中没有文本或没有链接，MDM 会提示。

f0d4d5fcac6fda0c.source: <g1>Protected video · can't be saved</g1> (grey, with a lock): a copy-protected video (DRM), which no tool may save.
f0d4d5fcac6fda0c.text: <g1>受保护视频 · 无法保存</g1>（灰色，带锁）：受版权保护的视频 (DRM)，任何工具都无法保存。

f0e933d37db8b9a1.source: <g1>Cursor</g1>: the same <x2/> entry as Claude Desktop's, in <x3/> (or add it in Cursor's MCP settings).
f0e933d37db8b9a1.text: <g1>Cursor</g1>：与 Claude Desktop 相同的<x2/>条目，在<x3/>中（或在 Cursor 的 MCP 设置中添加）。

f10113695e758efd.source: A playlist's or channel's videos, one line each as they're listed: its place, length, title and address.
f10113695e758efd.text: 列出播放列表或频道中的视频，每行一个，按列表顺序显示其位置、时长、标题和网址。

f1049590a0018070.source: <g1>Started with the computer, MDM waits in the notification area</g1> (<g2>#226</g2>): with <g3>Options → General → Launch Mister Download Manager on startup</g3>, MDM no longer opens its window in front at every sign-in. It starts hidden, its icon in the notification area, with its downloads, queues, Scheduler and browser hand-overs running; its icon, or starting MDM again, shows the window as before. The same on Linux and macOS; where no notification area shows MDM's icon (some Linux desktops), it starts minimized, and the option's tooltip says so (it waits for one up to 30 seconds after its icon is made, its window hidden: a desktop's can come up after MDM at sign-in). The startup entry now passes <x4/> (new on the <g5>command line</g5>); an entry written by an earlier version or its installer is written again at the next start, and the installer writes the new one.
f1049590a0018070.text: <g1>随电脑启动，MDM 在通知区域等待</g1>（<g2>#226</g2>）：通过<g3>选项 → 常规 → 启动时运行 Mister Download Manager</g3>，MDM 不再在每次登录时都将窗口置于前台。它会隐藏启动，图标显示在通知区域，同时其下载、队列、计划程序和浏览器交接功能都在运行；点击其图标或再次启动 MDM，窗口会像以前一样显示。在 Linux 和 macOS 上也是如此；如果通知区域不显示 MDM 的图标（某些 Linux 桌面），它会最小化启动，并且该选项的工具提示会说明这一点（它会在图标创建后等待最多 30 秒，窗口隐藏：桌面可能在登录时 MDM 之后出现）。启动项现在传递 <x4/>（<g5>命令行</g5>上的新功能）；由早期版本或其安装程序写入的启动项会在下次启动时重新写入，安装程序会写入新的启动项。

f1198b0bddc112e0.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: the folder its files go to. When a package holds several kinds of files, the box says <g2>Each file's category folder</g2>: each file goes to its category's folder (<g3>Options → Save to</g3>), as Import always did.
f1198b0bddc112e0.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：文件的保存文件夹。如果一个分组包含多种文件，设置框会显示<g2>每个文件的类别文件夹</g2>：每个文件都会保存到对应类别的文件夹（<g3>选项 → 保存到</g3>），与导入时的处理方式相同。

f1277bd229063e91.source: More than 80 fixes. The main ones:
f1277bd229063e91.text: 超过 80 项修复。主要包括：

f135b1b9671dc439.source: Make everything larger / smaller, in every window (<g1>View → Interface size</g1>, 100 % to 200 %)
f135b1b9671dc439.text: 放大 / 缩小所有窗口中的界面元素（<g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>，100% 到 200%）

f1452f6e417cd255.source: <g1>Playlists and channels</g1> (<g2>#69</g2>): Download video from a page lists a playlist's or a channel's videos, with their lengths, all ticked, with Select all and Select none. One quality applies to all of them (the best, up to a height, the original sound, MP3, Opus or FLAC). Each video gets its own download, in a folder named after the list, and Download Now starts the main queue, which runs as many at once as its settings say. A playlist is listed as its videos come in; the listing can be stopped and taken up again (List the rest), and one the site breaks off says after how many videos and why. A channel is listed 50 videos at a time, with Load more. Lists of thousands stay quick, and adding more than 500 downloads asks first. On the command line: <x3/> and <x4/>.
f1452f6e417cd255.text: <g1>播放列表和频道</g1>（<g2>#69</g2>）：“从页面下载视频”功能现在会列出播放列表或频道中的所有视频，显示其时长，并默认全部选中，提供“全选”和“不选”选项。所有视频应用相同的质量设置（最佳、最高高度、原始音轨、MP3、Opus 或 FLAC）。每个视频都会在以列表命名的文件夹中单独下载，“立即下载”会启动主队列，根据设置同时运行多个下载任务。播放列表会随着视频的加载而列出；列表过程可以暂停和恢复（“列出其余部分”），如果网站中断列表，会显示中断的视频数量和原因。频道视频每次列出 50 个，并提供“加载更多”选项。数千个视频的列表也能保持快速响应，添加超过 500 个下载任务时会先进行确认。命令行选项：<x3/> 和 <x4/>。

f15b13cd13f82fd3.source: <g1>Luna, Aero and Aqua</g1>, after Windows XP, Windows 7 and Mac OS X (Leopard), each with a light and a dark side and icons drawn for MDM in its era's manner. <g2>Luna</g2>: buttons shaded from white with a dark blue edge and an orange glow under the pointer, green ticks, square text boxes, progress in green blocks and a deep blue title bar with the title in bold and square buttons (Close red). <g3>Aero</g3>: glossy buttons in two halves that turn light blue under the pointer, quiet check boxes, a glossy green progress bar and a glassy title bar, the title on a soft glow, its buttons hung from the top (Close wider and red). <g4>Aqua</g4>: gel buttons round at the ends (the default one blue), glossy check boxes, a blue focus ring, a blue gel progress bar and a grey title bar with the title centred and small round graphite buttons whose glyphs show under the pointer. Every glyph and shade is MDM's own drawing; none of Microsoft's or Apple's pictures or fonts are used.
f15b13cd13f82fd3.text: <g1>Luna、Aero 和 Aqua</g1>：分别仿照 Windows XP、Windows 7 和 Mac OS X (Leopard) 界面风格，每种风格都有浅色和深色模式，图标按其时代风格为 MDM 绘制。<g2>Luna</g2>：按钮从白色渐变，深蓝色边缘，指针悬停时有橙色光晕，绿色勾选，方形文本框，绿色块状进度条，深蓝色标题栏，标题粗体，方形按钮（“关闭”按钮为红色）。<g3>Aero</g3>：光泽按钮分为两半，指针悬停时变为浅蓝色，简洁的复选框，光泽绿色进度条，玻璃质感标题栏，标题带有柔和光晕，按钮悬挂在顶部（“关闭”按钮更宽，为红色）。<g4>Aqua</g4>：两端圆润的凝胶按钮（默认按钮为蓝色），光泽复选框，蓝色焦点环，蓝色凝胶进度条，灰色标题栏，标题居中，小型圆形石墨按钮，其字形在指针悬停时显示。所有字形和阴影均为 MDM 自行绘制；未使用任何 Microsoft 或 Apple 的图片或字体。

f19042c8ea331c71.source: Start MDM. The download is in the list under <g1>Unfinished</g1>.
f19042c8ea331c71.text: 启动 MDM。该下载在<g1>未完成</g1>下的列表中。

f1b78c765ed86557.source: FTP downloads work like web downloads: several connections at once, pause and resume, and the same progress window.
f1b78c765ed86557.text: FTP 下载与网页下载类似：可以同时建立多个连接、暂停和恢复下载，并使用相同的进度窗口。

f1d95acee0814a9f.source: There, MDM connects itself to your browsers at each start, has its tray icon, follows the system's light or dark look and uses the system's fonts and ffmpeg. The Mac app isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS asks before its first start: right-click it and choose <g1>Open</g1> (on macOS 15 and later, <g2>System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway</g2>). A <x3/> or <x4/> update opens in the system's installer. A few parts work only on Windows, and the help says so where it matters.
f1d95acee0814a9f.text: 在此，MDM 每次启动时都会自动连接到您的浏览器，拥有托盘图标，遵循系统的浅色或深色外观，并使用系统的字体和 ffmpeg。Mac 应用程序尚未获得 Apple 认证，因此 macOS 在首次启动前会询问：右键点击它并选择<g1>打开</g1>（在 macOS 15 及更高版本上，选择<g2>系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开</g2>）。<x3/> 或 <x4/> 更新会在系统的安装程序中打开。少数功能仅在 Windows 上可用，帮助文档会在相关位置说明。

f1ee92efff9ac821.source: <g1>Menus on macOS and Linux</g1>: clicking a menu item did nothing (the click moved the focus to the menu's own window, which closed it first). The list's right-click menu and the toolbar's drop-downs had the same fault.
f1ee92efff9ac821.text: <g1>macOS 和 Linux 上的菜单</g1>：单击菜单项没有反应（单击会将焦点移到菜单自己的窗口，而该窗口会先关闭）。列表的右键菜单和工具栏的下拉菜单也有同样的问题。

f1ffe13bf5cbb2c3.source: View → Interface size (<x1/>, #262) is egui's zoom factor over the display's own scale: every window is laid out in points, so it opens that much larger; one larger than the screen scrolls.
f1ffe13bf5cbb2c3.text: “视图”→“界面大小”(<x1/>, #262) 是 egui 在显示器自身缩放比例之上的缩放因子：每个窗口都以点为单位布局，因此它会按比例放大；如果大于屏幕，则会滚动。

f2039bc45d79ae2e.source: Every list's and table's column headers
f2039bc45d79ae2e.text: 所有列表和表格的列标题

f232ea1acad0ee9e.source: If the video won't download, see <g1>Video downloads</g1>.
f232ea1acad0ee9e.text: 如果视频无法下载，请参阅<g1>视频下载</g1>。

f25612dbbaabbb5b.source: Videos protected with DRM (most paid streaming services) can't be downloaded, and MDM doesn't try. The browser extension's <g1>Media on this page</g1> shows such a stream as <g2>Protected</g2> and doesn't send it.
f25612dbbaabbb5b.text: 受 DRM 保护的视频（大多数付费流媒体服务的视频）无法下载，MDM 也不会尝试下载。浏览器扩展程序的<g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>会将这类视频流标记为<g2>受保护</g2>，并且不会发送。

f258c0caca2dcac9.source: Paste a video's page. Pick the quality.
f258c0caca2dcac9.text: 粘贴视频页面链接，选择画质。

f262d1421b480e2f.source: Firefox (from addons.mozilla.org), Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi (from the Chrome Web Store), through the MDM browser extension…
f262d1421b480e2f.text: Firefox（来自 addons.mozilla.org）、Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi（来自 Chrome 网上应用店）可通过 MDM 浏览器扩展程序使用……

f26764c71f561cf8.source: In <g1>Address</g1>, write the address with one asterisk where the number or letter changes: <x2/>.
f26764c71f561cf8.text: 在<g1>地址</g1>中，在数字或字母变化的位置写入一个星号：<x2/>。

f28372a54bdb034d.source: Options → Remote: the address, the certificate's fingerprint and the paired devices.
f28372a54bdb034d.text: 选项 → 远程：地址、证书指纹和已配对设备。

f2a4d41d6eb9fde0.source: <g1>MDM's recent log:</g1> for example "command AddUrl" or "window opened: add-url".
f2a4d41d6eb9fde0.text: <g1>MDM 的最新日志：</g1>例如“命令 AddUrl”或“窗口已打开：add-url”。

f2b45bae019642ac.source: Use the path from step 2 (in JSON, every <x1/> is written <x2/>). Other assistants take the same thing: a command to start, no arguments.
f2b45bae019642ac.text: 使用第 2 步中的路径（在 JSON 中，每个<x1/>都写成<x2/>）。其他助手也使用相同的方式：一个启动命令，没有参数。

f2d4f3ae1b5602bb.source: From GitHub's public record, <x1/>: people with pull requests first, then those who opened issues, then those who commented, each once. The maintainer and automated accounts aren't counted.
f2d4f3ae1b5602bb.text: 根据 GitHub 的公开记录，<x1/>：首先是提交拉取请求的人，其次是提出问题的人，然后是发表评论的人，每人只计算一次。维护者和自动化账户不计入在内。

f2fd829426a9d905.source: Click <g1>Add URL</g1> on the toolbar, choose <g2>Tasks → Add new download</g2>, or press <g3>Ctrl+N</g3>.
f2fd829426a9d905.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 URL</g1>，选择<g2>任务 → 添加新下载</g2>，或按<g3>Ctrl+N</g3>。

f30a1100eede128a.source: <g1>General</g1> — the info hash, pieces, peers, how much was sent, the share ratio, how long it has been shared and the folder. What was sent and the time shared add up over all of the torrent's runs: they don't start again at 0 after a pause or a restart of MDM.
f30a1100eede128a.text: <g1>常规</g1> — 信息哈希、分块、对等点、已发送量、分享率、已分享时长以及文件夹。已发送量和已分享时长是该 torrent 所有运行的总和：在暂停或重启 MDM 后，它们不会从 0 重新开始计算。

f30bf87e61f773d3.source: <g1>Download counts</g1> in the Categories tree, <g2>an empty list that says why</g2> (with Clear filters or Add new download), <g3>a right-click menu on the list's blank space</g3>, a double-click on a column border to fit it, and <g4>Reset columns</g4>.
f30bf87e61f773d3.text: “类别”树中的<g1>下载计数</g1>，<g2>一个说明原因的空列表</g2>（带有“清除筛选器”或“添加新下载”），<g3>列表空白处的右键菜单</g3>，双击列边框以适应内容，以及<g4>重置列</g4>。

f313ce0fb2d7fe17.source: <g1>Peers</g1> — the computers you are downloading from, with how much you received from and sent to each.
f313ce0fb2d7fe17.text: <g1>对等方</g1> — 您正在从中下载的计算机，以及您从每个计算机接收和发送的数据量。

f344e5dfcec067d9.source: The downloads go to a queue. As with Download Later, MDM asks which queue unless you turn off <g1>Options → Downloads → Show queue selection panel on closing batch download dialogs</g1>.
f344e5dfcec067d9.text: 下载会进入队列。与“稍后下载”一样，MDM 会询问要将下载放入哪个队列，除非您关闭<g1>选项 → 下载 → 关闭批量下载对话框时显示队列选择面板</g1>。

f3901fedc4a7dd52.source: <g1>Browser extension</g1><g2>Downloads you click in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Firefox go straight to MDM, sign-in included.</g2>
f3901fedc4a7dd52.text: <g1>浏览器扩展</g1><g2>在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 或 Firefox 中点击的下载会直接发送到 MDM，包括登录信息。</g2>

f39ce0c1bd08bf1c.source: The separate 28 MB command-line program: now a 0.2 MB launcher, every command works as before.
f39ce0c1bd08bf1c.text: 独立的 28 MB 命令行程序：现在是一个 0.2 MB 的启动器，所有命令功能不变。

f3a0324b1e23c534.source: <g1>Which file types:</g1> <g2>Options → File types → Automatically start downloading the following file types</g2>. Add or remove types, separated by spaces.
f3a0324b1e23c534.text: <g1>选择文件类型：</g1><g2>选项 → 文件类型 → 自动开始下载以下文件类型</g2>。添加或删除文件类型，各类型之间用空格分隔。

f3a16665a583e72f.source: The list shows the order they will run in. Use the arrow buttons under it to move a download up or down.
f3a16665a583e72f.text: 列表显示了它们将运行的顺序。使用下面的箭头按钮可以向上或向下移动下载。

f3d42829279ef4a5.source: A VPN or proxy extension is a proxy for the browser only. Switch on <g1>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g1> in the extension's toolbar popup (it's off as installed), and MDM downloads what it takes from the browser through the same proxy (with <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks → Use proxy/socks from a browser's request</g2>, on by default; see <g3>Options</g3>). Switched off, the extension reads nothing of the browser's proxy.
f3d42829279ef4a5.text: VPN 或代理扩展仅是浏览器的代理。在扩展的工具栏弹出窗口中打开“<g1>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g1>”（默认安装时为关闭），MDM 就会通过相同的代理下载它从浏览器接管的任务（默认情况下，<g2>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 使用浏览器请求中的代理/SOCKS</g2>已开启；详见<g3>选项</g3>）。如果关闭此选项，扩展将不会读取浏览器的任何代理信息。

f3d90a3cd84b7d3f.source: Crash and freeze reports: the monitor process, out-of-process minidumps, symbolicated stacks, the report's text and the release logs (<g1>crash-reports.md</g1>)
f3d90a3cd84b7d3f.text: 崩溃和冻结报告：监视进程、进程外 minidumps、符号化堆栈、报告文本和发布日志（<g1>crash-reports.md</g1>）

f3db0a80eb6e5aa4.source: <g1>Apply</g1> saves your changes. <g2>Close</g2> closes the window.
f3db0a80eb6e5aa4.text: <g1>应用</g1>保存您的更改。<g2>关闭</g2>关闭窗口。

f3e13f17fac83792.source: Download videos from YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok and over a thousand other sites with Mister Download Manager and yt-dlp, in the quality you choose.
f3e13f17fac83792.text: 使用 Mister Download Manager 和 yt-dlp，从 YouTube、Vimeo、TikTok 和一千多个其他网站下载您选择画质的视频。

f3e7f32ca716840a.source: <g1>MDM says why the browser kept a download</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>): every download left to the browser by Options is a line in MDM's log naming the setting that decided (its type isn't in <g3>File types</g3>, its site or address is excluded, it's under the minimum size, the browser is unticked, browser integration is off, or the extension may not read the site), and the extension's button shows the last one, with the file's name. A download from a private window is logged without its name or site.
f3e7f32ca716840a.text: <g1>MDM 会说明浏览器保留下载的原因</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）：“选项”中留给浏览器的每个下载都是 MDM 日志中的一行，其中会说明决定此操作的设置（其类型不在<g3>文件类型</g3>中、其站点或地址被排除、它小于最小大小、浏览器未勾选、浏览器集成已关闭，或扩展可能无法读取该站点），并且扩展按钮会显示最后一个原因以及文件名。来自隐私窗口的下载不会记录其名称或站点。

f3eb4961e73b466d.source: Tick <g1>Remember Speed Limiter settings for this file on download stop/resume</g1> to keep this limit for the file: it applies again when you resume it later, even after restarting MDM.
f3eb4961e73b466d.text: 勾选<g1>记住此文件的限速器设置</g1>，以便在停止或恢复下载时保留此文件的限速设置。之后恢复下载时，即使重启过 MDM，此限制也会再次生效。

f430e9ac7d47c2cd.source: Yes: every release has builds for Linux and macOS. Today's are marked experimental; from version 0.5.0, Linux isn't, after checks on four desktops, and macOS stays experimental. Windows 10 and 11 are the main platform. <g1>More</g1>
f430e9ac7d47c2cd.text: 是的：每个版本都有 Linux 和 macOS 的构建。目前这些版本标记为实验性；从 0.5.0 版本开始，Linux 在经过四种桌面环境的测试后不再是实验性版本，而 macOS 仍保持实验性。Windows 10 和 11 是主要平台。<g1>更多</g1>

f43b6e23ff05315a.source: Switches can start with <x1/> or <x2/>, in any case. If MDM is running, the command goes to it; if not, MDM starts and carries it out. For example:
f43b6e23ff05315a.text: 开关可以以 <x1/> 或 <x2/> 开头，且不区分大小写。如果 MDM 正在运行，命令会发送给它；否则，MDM 会启动并执行命令。例如：

f47d19d2ae313a6b.source: <g1>MDM as an IDM alternative</g1><g2>Spot something wrong? Tell us</g2>
f47d19d2ae313a6b.text: <g1>MDM 作为 IDM 的替代品</g1><g2>发现错误？告诉我们</g2>

f481370a8fc74096.source: <g1>The Linux files are named without <x2/></g1>: the AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz are <x3/>, and the .deb's and .rpm's descriptions no longer call them an experimental build. Update now, the AppImage tools and the website find them by either name. The macOS .dmg files keep <x4/>.
f481370a8fc74096.text: <g1>Linux 文件命名不带 <x2/></g1>：AppImage、.deb、.rpm 和 .tar.gz 文件名为 <x3/>，.deb 和 .rpm 的描述不再称其为实验性版本。立即更新、AppImage 工具和网站可以通过任一名称找到它们。macOS 的 .dmg 文件保留 <x4/>。

f4c91787ed2b3160.source: Seven downloads, each run at least seven times by IDM 6.42 and Mister Download Manager from the same test server: MDM was 5.4× faster on 1 GiB and 106× on small files. Charts, raw data and the method.
f4c91787ed2b3160.text: IDM 6.42 和 Mister Download Manager 分别从同一测试服务器下载 7 个文件，每个文件至少测试 7 次：MDM 下载 1 GiB 文件的速度快 5.4 倍，小文件快 106 倍。图表、原始数据和测试方法。

f4cb21e3d3b5a953.text: <g1>交付选项</g1><g2>版本 0.5.2 · 所有人免费</g2>

f523b03f18ef6ae9.source: Both apps on the same PC, downloading from the same test server, in alternating runs. The server's own log says when each request arrived and when the last byte left, so nothing relies on either app's word.
f523b03f18ef6ae9.text: 两款应用在同一台电脑上，交替运行，从同一测试服务器下载。服务器日志记录了每个请求的到达时间以及最后一个字节的离开时间，因此结果不依赖于任何一款应用的数据。

f54ce429a109d5fe.source: <g1>Metro</g1>, after Windows 8's flat look: square corners, flat buttons, boxes that take an accent border when focused, check boxes with a tick, a bordered progress bar, scroll bars with their arrows always shown, one-colour icons (Microsoft's Fluent UI System Icons, MIT) and a title bar in the theme's colour with the title centred.
f54ce429a109d5fe.text: <g1>现代</g1>，仿照 Windows 8 的扁平化外观：方角、扁平按钮、获得焦点时带有强调色边框的方框、带勾选标记的复选框、带边框的进度条、始终显示箭头的滚动条、单色图标（Microsoft 的 Fluent UI System Icons，MIT 许可）以及主题色标题栏，标题居中显示。

f554a7b471d1c8c4.source: To check that your copy is the real one:
f554a7b471d1c8c4.text: 要检查您的副本是否为正版：

f55e431df0898bf7.source: Corner radius of a popup in a window (a calendar, a filter box)
f55e431df0898bf7.text: 窗口中弹出框的圆角半径（日历、筛选框）

f55f43905143b2ec.text: 任务 → 添加批量下载

f566a29ba545e840.source: A page whose video the window can't find: play the video in your browser, then use the extension's <g1>Media on this page</g1> to send the stream the page loaded.
f566a29ba545e840.text: 如果窗口找不到页面中的视频：在浏览器中播放视频，然后使用扩展程序的<g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>发送页面加载的视频流。

f575c52354f70221.source: Free forever, no ads, no trial
f575c52354f70221.text: 永久免费，无广告，无试用

f599b55f9382804e.source: Such a part pressed or open
f599b55f9382804e.text: 此类部分被按下或打开时

f5ccbc8600909247.source: Only your devices, only at home
f5ccbc8600909247.text: 仅限您的设备，仅限家中

f5d0db4c9a23ece3.source: <g1><g2>Adding downloads</g2></g1> — Add URL, the clipboard, the drop target, batch downloads and lists of links, and Start Download versus Download Later.
f5d0db4c9a23ece3.text: <g1><g2>添加下载</g2></g1> — 介绍“添加 URL”、剪贴板、拖放目标、批量下载和链接列表，以及“开始下载”与“稍后下载”的区别。

f5d1e8a8bc6e8e59.source: Compare it with the same file's line in that release's <x1/>.
f5d1e8a8bc6e8e59.text: 将其与该版本 <x1/> 中对应文件的行进行比较。

f5e911e1675285c5.source: Add the extension to each browser you use, as below: Firefox from its add-ons store, the others from the Chrome Web Store. Until a browser's extension has reached MDM, MDM's <g1>Add Mister Download Manager to your browser</g1> window opens at each start: it lists the browsers it found, and <g2>Add the extension</g2> opens the store's page in that browser. <g3>Install it by hand</g3> opens the steps for loading it without the store; <g4>Don't ask again</g4> stops the window.
f5e911e1675285c5.text: 按照以下说明，将扩展程序添加到您使用的每个浏览器：Firefox 从其附加组件商店获取，其他浏览器从 Chrome 网上应用店获取。在浏览器的扩展程序连接到 MDM 之前，MDM 的<g1>将 Mister Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g1>窗口会在每次启动时打开：它会列出找到的浏览器，<g2>添加扩展</g2>会在该浏览器中打开商店页面。<g3>手动安装</g3>会打开不通过商店加载扩展程序的步骤；<g4>不再询问</g4>会关闭此窗口。

f6036d014e6073ae.source: <g1>Media on this page</g1> lists the video streams and the video and sound files a page has loaded, so a video with no link can still be saved. Copy-protected streams are listed as <g2>Protected</g2> and never sent.
f6036d014e6073ae.text: <g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>会列出页面已加载的视频流以及视频和音频文件，因此没有链接的视频仍然可以保存。受版权保护的流会显示为<g2>受保护</g2>，并且永远不会发送。

f617526761a05ad4.source: <g1>Show start download dialog</g1> — show <g2>Download File Info</g2> for each new download. With it off, downloads start at once, or only join the queue if you tick <g3>Do not start downloading, only add files to the queue</g3>.
f617526761a05ad4.text: <g1>显示开始下载对话框</g1> — 为每个新下载显示<g2>下载文件信息</g2>。如果关闭此选项，下载会立即开始，或者如果您勾选<g3>不开始下载，只将文件添加到队列</g3>，则只会加入队列。

f61a127a852f0426.source: Schedule: starting and stopping on time

f61cdf89eb50599c.source: The zips hold the same programs as the setup: the app, <x1/> (downloads from the command line; see <g2>Command line and automation</g2>) and the <x3/> folder.
f61cdf89eb50599c.text: zip 文件包含与安装程序相同的程序：应用程序、<x1/>（用于从命令行下载；请参阅<g2>命令行和自动化</g2>）以及 <x3/> 文件夹。

f6a660460c7cc189.source: Downloads from the browser keep the name, size and type the browser saw, so downloads behind a sign-in show correctly right away.
f6a660460c7cc189.text: 从浏览器下载的文件会保留浏览器看到的名称、大小和类型，因此需要登录才能下载的文件会立即正确显示。

f6f109ae827d390b.source: Control your downloads from your phone

f72bb1d455524e12.source: KDE Plasma's look: rounded corners, controls that take the accent's edge, KDE's icons.
f72bb1d455524e12.text: KDE Plasma 的外观：圆角、带有强调色边缘的控件、KDE 的图标。

f763bb66cf2403ec.source: <g1>Numbers</g1> are typed in one kind of box everywhere: arrows step them, a value out of range is outlined in red and set right when you leave the box (some were changed silently before).
f763bb66cf2403ec.text: <g1>数字</g1>在所有地方都以一种类型的框输入：箭头可步进它们，超出范围的值会以红色轮廓显示并在您离开框时自动更正（有些以前是静默更改的）。

f77cbac3441da259.source: A name that would lead outside the folder is left out, and so is a link to somewhere else on the disk. An archive that would write far more than its size, or more than the disk has room for, stops before it fills it. Extracted files are marked as coming from the internet, as the archive is, so Windows still warns before running a program from them. The archive itself goes to the Recycle Bin (the Trash on macOS and Linux) only if you ask.
f77cbac3441da259.text: 如果文件名会导致文件解压到指定文件夹之外，或者链接到磁盘上的其他位置，则会跳过该文件。如果压缩包解压后文件大小远超其自身大小，或超出磁盘可用空间，解压会在填满磁盘前停止。解压后的文件会被标记为来自互联网，就像压缩包本身一样，因此 Windows 在运行其中的程序前仍会发出警告。压缩包本身只有在您要求时才会移至回收站（macOS 和 Linux 上是废纸篓）。

f79d1bba86369d73.source: Your debrid service accounts (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox; experimental): <g1>Add...</g1> signs in by code in the browser or with your API token or key; a link from a host the service supports is then downloaded through it. The list's order is the order accounts are asked. See <g2>Debrid service accounts</g2>.
f79d1bba86369d73.text: 您的网盘服务帐户（Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize、TorBox；实验性功能）：点击“<g1>添加...</g1>”可通过浏览器中的代码或您的 API 令牌或密钥登录；然后，该服务支持的主机链接将通过它下载。列表中的顺序是帐户被请求的顺序。请参阅“<g2>网盘服务帐户</g2>”。

f7a4f8dcbb4812c2.source: In Chrome, Edge and Brave you can limit an extension to some sites (right-click its toolbar button → <g1>This can read and change site data</g1>). On a site it may not read, the extension can't pass your sign-in on, so it leaves the download to the browser. Choose <g2>On all sites</g2> to let MDM take downloads everywhere.
f7a4f8dcbb4812c2.text: 在 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 中，您可以限制扩展程序只能访问部分网站（右键点击工具栏上的扩展程序按钮 → <g1>此扩展程序可以读取和更改网站数据</g1>）。在扩展程序无法读取的网站上，它无法传递您的登录信息，因此会让浏览器处理下载。选择<g2>在所有网站上</g2>，即可让 MDM 接管所有网站的下载。

f7b804b244f90c19.source: Does it keep uploading after a torrent finishes?
f7b804b244f90c19.text: 种子下载完成后会继续上传吗？

f7bddb8310ecc7ae.source: <g1>Network adapter</g1> — <g2>Any (the system chooses)</g2> is the default. Pick an adapter, usually your VPN's, and every connection MDM opens goes out through it, or not at all. That covers downloads, FTP, torrents, video pages and image galleries, the DNS you chose, MDM's own downloads and the update check. It works as a kill switch: when the adapter disconnects, or the VPN is switched off, nothing goes out through your normal connection. Running downloads stop with "… is not connected" and start again when the adapter is back. The line under the list shows the adapter's address, or that it isn't connected.
f7bddb8310ecc7ae.text: <g1>网络适配器</g1> — <g2>任何（系统选择）</g2>是默认设置。选择一个适配器，通常是 VPN 使用的适配器，MDM 打开的所有连接都会通过它发出，否则就不会发出。这包括下载、FTP、种子下载、视频页面和图片库、您选择的 DNS、MDM 自己的下载以及更新检查。它可用作终止开关：适配器断开连接或 VPN 关闭时，所有流量都不会通过您的常规连接发出。正在进行的下载会因“……未连接”而停止，并在适配器恢复连接后重新开始。列表下方会显示适配器的地址，或显示其未连接。

f7c87e5e760659a2.source: MDM itself still sends nothing anywhere: the server talks only to the MDM on this computer, over a token-protected local channel. But what the assistant reads, it passes on to its own AI service. When it lists your downloads, their file names, addresses and folders go to that service, under that service's privacy terms. Turn the API off with <x1/>, or remove the server from the assistant, when you don't want that.
f7c87e5e760659a2.text: MDM 本身不会向任何地方发送任何数据：服务器仅通过受令牌保护的本地通道与此计算机上的 MDM 通信。但助手读取的内容会传递给它自己的 AI 服务。当它列出您的下载任务时，其文件名、地址和文件夹会根据该服务的隐私条款发送到该服务。当您不希望发生这种情况时，请使用 <x1/> 关闭 API，或从助手中删除服务器。

f7eac3fbf66a0512.source: No. MDM has no accounts, no analytics and no telemetry. It connects to the servers you download from and, each time it starts and once a day while it runs, asks GitHub whether a newer version exists (you can turn that off in Help → Check for updates). The browser extension talks only to MDM on your own computer. The details are in the <g1>privacy policy</g1>.
f7eac3fbf66a0512.text: 不。MDM 没有账户、分析和遥测功能。它连接到您下载的服务器，并在每次启动时和运行时每天一次向 GitHub 查询是否有新版本（您可以在“帮助”→“检查更新”中关闭此功能）。浏览器扩展程序只与您自己电脑上的 MDM 通信。详细信息请参阅<g1>隐私政策</g1>。

f7f2e0ba07d3545b.source: An HTTP Range server with a request log and fault injection, and an FTP/FTPS server with its own faults, for tests and benchmarks
f7f2e0ba07d3545b.text: 一个带请求日志和故障注入的 HTTP Range 服务器，以及一个带自身故障的 FTP/FTPS 服务器，用于测试和基准测试

f7f35f6dda096e0a.source: Wait while MDM looks the page up. The list of qualities appears, best first, with <g1>Audio only</g1> at the end: the sound as the site has it, then, with ffmpeg (next step), as an MP3 at its best variable bitrate or at 320, 256, 192 or 128 kbps.
f7f35f6dda096e0a.text: 请等待 MDM 查找页面。质量列表将出现，最佳质量在前，<g1>仅音频</g1>在最后：网站提供的原始音频，然后，通过 ffmpeg（下一步），以最佳可变比特率或 320、256、192 或 128 kbps 的 MP3 格式。

f7f4e5c7a18c04f0.source: <g1>7z and RAR archives need 7-Zip</g1>, a free program (<g2>7-zip.org</g2>). MDM runs it when it is installed, for split and encrypted archives too. RAR's own extraction code can't be part of a free program like MDM, and 7-Zip extracts 7z best.
f7f4e5c7a18c04f0.text: <g1>7z 和 RAR 存档需要 7-Zip</g1>，这是一款免费程序（<g2>7-zip.org</g2>）。安装 7-Zip 后，MDM 会调用它，也支持提取分卷和加密存档。RAR 自带的提取代码不能纳入 MDM 这类免费程序，而提取 7z 存档时，7-Zip 的效果最好。

f7fe4899939d8961.source: What's left: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet; screen readers (Orca) don't read MDM's windows on Linux yet; and native Wayland windows can't place menus, so XWayland stays the default. macOS stays experimental: its builds are made and tested by GitHub Actions, not yet on a Mac of ours.
f7fe4899939d8961.text: 待完成事项：Flatpak Firefox 尚未检查；屏幕阅读器 (Orca) 尚未在 Linux 上读取 MDM 窗口；原生 Wayland 窗口无法放置菜单，因此 XWayland 仍是默认选项。macOS 仍处于实验阶段：其构建由 GitHub Actions 完成和测试，我们尚未在 Mac 上进行测试。

f8092cd791a22a18.source: <g1>Stop sharing after sharing for … minutes</g1> — or once it has been shared that long, over all its runs. Off by default.
f8092cd791a22a18.text: <g1>共享时间达到以下时长后停止共享</g1> — 或者累计共享达到指定时长后停止。默认关闭。

f82dc8051d1faab0.source: names besides its addresses the page may be opened by
f82dc8051d1faab0.text: 除了其地址之外，页面可能通过其打开的名称

f8343b2a353d45b1.source: The same list is in MDM under Help → Keyboard shortcuts, and the menus show each command's keys beside it. On a Mac, ⌘ (Command) takes the place of Ctrl: ⌘N…
f8343b2a353d45b1.text: MDM 的“帮助”→“键盘快捷方式”下也有相同的列表，菜单中每个命令旁边都显示其快捷键。在 Mac 上，⌘ (Command) 键取代 Ctrl 键：⌘N...

f83a5475dd229215.source: Slower peers take pieces a little further on, so the start isn't waiting for them.
f83a5475dd229215.text: 速度较慢的对等方会下载稍靠后的分块，因此文件开头部分无需等待它们。

f8498963e898546a.source: <g1>The crash report window's status line stays inside the window</g1> (<g2>#164</g2>): the line above the check box ("The symbols couldn't be fetched: …", an issue's title, a translation) ran past the window's right edge, or its left edge in Persian. It is now cut with "…" at the margin and shown whole under the pointer. Its title ("Mister Download Manager crash report") is now in MDM's language too; it was always in the system's. On Windows that also gives its title bar MDM's light or dark again in every language: outside English it kept Windows' own mode.
f8498963e898546a.text: <g1>崩溃报告窗口的状态行保持在窗口内</g1> (<g2>#164</g2>)：复选框上方的行（“无法获取符号：…”、问题标题、翻译）会超出窗口右边缘，在波斯语中则超出左边缘。现在，它会在边缘处用“…”截断，并在指针悬停时完整显示。其标题（“Mister Download Manager 崩溃报告”）现在也使用 MDM 的语言；之前它总是使用系统语言。在 Windows 上，这也能让其标题栏在所有语言中再次显示 MDM 的浅色或深色模式：在英语之外，它会保持 Windows 自己的模式。

f850e1ec720abccf.source: Press a focused button, tick a check box, tick the selected row of a list
f850e1ec720abccf.text: 按下聚焦的按钮，勾选复选框，勾选列表中选定的行

f862a7b7f253fe5c.source: when you right-click a finished archive and choose <g1>Extract</g1>.
f862a7b7f253fe5c.text: 右键点击已下载完成的存档并选择“<g1>提取</g1>”时。

f89a410af1a10630.source: The site isn't in <g1>Don't start downloading automatically from the following sites</g1>, nor the address in <g2>Don't start downloading automatically from the following addresses</g2>.
f89a410af1a10630.text: 该网站不在<g1>不从以下网站自动开始下载</g1>中，地址也不在<g2>不从以下地址自动开始下载</g2>中。

f89c54d71eb189a4.source: If the graphics card is reset while MDM runs (a driver update), MDM starts again by itself. Lost twice in 10 minutes, it goes back to OpenGL, and <g1>View → Draw with</g1> says why.
f89c54d71eb189a4.text: 如果 MDM 运行时显卡被重置（驱动程序更新），MDM 会自行重新启动。如果在 10 分钟内两次丢失，它会回退到 OpenGL，并且<g1>视图 → 绘制方式</g1>会说明原因。

f8b52274ed125d5f.source: Tick <g1>Wake the computer to run this queue</g1> and a sleeping computer is woken a minute before the start time, so the network is back when the queue begins. It stays awake while the queue runs; afterwards its own sleep settings apply again. The line under the option says when the next wake is, or why there can't be one.
f8b52274ed125d5f.text: 勾选<g1>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g1>，休眠的计算机会在开始时间前一分钟被唤醒，以便在队列开始时网络恢复。队列运行时它会保持唤醒状态；之后会再次应用其自身的睡眠设置。选项下方的文字会说明下次唤醒的时间，或为何无法唤醒。

f8c444517ab946e2.text: 从普通 zip 文件安装

f8c71a9fb2bd8bde.source: <g1>Automatically put in "…" category the following file types</g1> — the file types that go to this category.
f8c71a9fb2bd8bde.text: <g1>自动将以下文件类型放入“…”类别</g1> — 属于此类别的文件类型。

f8e0a9e7ee529ff0.source: Select <g1>Main download queue</g1> on the left. The <g2>Schedule</g2> tab opens.
f8e0a9e7ee529ff0.text: 在左侧选择<g1>主下载队列</g1>。<g2>计划</g2>选项卡将打开。

f911ac7ba0d3f6eb.source: <g1>Options → General → Test browser integration</g1> checks MDM's side in order (integration on, the installed copy, the browsers can find MDM, which browsers' extension connected) and offers <g2>Set it up</g2> when the browsers can't find MDM.
f911ac7ba0d3f6eb.text: <g1>选项 → 常规 → 测试浏览器集成</g1>会按顺序检查 MDM 端（集成是否开启、已安装的版本、浏览器是否能找到 MDM、哪些浏览器扩展已连接），并在浏览器无法找到 MDM 时提供<g2>设置</g2>。

f91bcb77e6270a23.source: The command line's <x1/> takes <x2/> and checks the finished file: the code in hex, on its own or named, as in <x3/>. One command downloads the file and checks it:
f91bcb77e6270a23.text: 命令行工具<x1/>接受<x2/>参数，并检查已完成的文件：校验和可以是十六进制代码，单独提供或指定名称，例如<x3/>。一个命令即可下载并检查文件：

f92491ebeade13b8.source: This release tightens what MDM accepts from torrents.
f92491ebeade13b8.text: 此版本收紧了 MDM 对 torrent 文件的接受标准。

f924e5f826a5fa06.source: <g1>YouTube: "Requested format is not available" after MDM moved a video to another server</g1> (<g2>#94</g2>). When the servers this computer can reach don't serve the chosen quality, MDM downloads the nearest quality below it (always a video, never the sound alone) and says so in the download's log. With no video left at all, it tries the page's own servers. A server yt-dlp couldn't resolve or reach is avoided on the next look-up. The log also names the qualities a move left out.
f924e5f826a5fa06.text: <g1>YouTube：“请求的格式不可用”，在 MDM 将视频移动到另一个服务器后</g1>（<g2>#94</g2>）。当此计算机可访问的服务器不提供所选质量时，MDM 会下载低于它的最接近质量（始终是视频，从不单独下载声音），并在下载日志中说明。如果完全没有视频，它会尝试页面的自有服务器。yt-dlp 无法解析或访问的服务器会在下次查询时避免。日志还会列出移动操作遗漏的质量。

f972a60cffbd9bed.source: In <g1>Default download directory for "General" category</g1>, click <g2>Browse</g2> and choose a folder on the stick, for example <x3/>.
f972a60cffbd9bed.text: 在<g1>“常规”类别的默认下载目录</g1>中，点击<g2>浏览</g2>并选择 U 盘上的一个文件夹，例如<x3/>。

f98b6bca57fb71fe.source: Set <g1>Maximum download speed for one file</g1> in KBytes/sec. It starts at 10, so set it before you turn the limiter on.
f98b6bca57fb71fe.text: 以千字节/秒为单位设置<g1>单个文件的最大下载速度</g1>。默认值为 10，因此请在开启速度限制器前设置。

f98daba34f677b79.source: Click the tray icon to bring the window back.
f98daba34f677b79.text: 点击托盘图标可恢复窗口。

f9954a428332a813.source: <g1>Network adapter:</g1> while one is chosen (<g2>Options → Proxy / Socks → <g3>Network adapter</g3></g2>), galleries go through it too, as video pages do: MDM gives gallery-dl a proxy of its own on this computer, opens every connection through the adapter and looks the names up with the DNS you chose. When the adapter disconnects, the gallery stops with the other downloads; nothing goes out through your normal connection.
f9954a428332a813.text: <g1>网络适配器：</g1> 如果选择了某个适配器（<g2>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → <g3>网络适配器</g3></g2>），图库也会像视频页面一样通过它下载：MDM 会在您的电脑上为 gallery-dl 提供一个自己的代理，所有连接都通过该适配器打开，并使用您选择的 DNS 进行名称查找。当适配器断开连接时，图库会与其他下载一起停止；不会通过您的常规连接传输任何数据。

f9ad81eb1765abbd.source: In the browser extension's menu, <g1>Send downloads to → Another Mister Download Manager (a server)</g1>: type the server's address, open it once in that browser to accept its certificate, then enter a pairing code (<x2/> above). Downloads the extension catches, and <g3>Download with Mister Download Manager</g3> on a link, then go to the server instead of this computer. The browser's cookies are not sent to the server: a download that needs you to be signed in to a site stays with this computer.
f9ad81eb1765abbd.text: 在浏览器扩展程序的菜单中，选择<g1>将下载发送到 → 另一个 Mister Download Manager（服务器）</g1>：输入服务器地址，在该浏览器中打开一次以接受其证书，然后输入配对码（如<x2/>所示）。扩展程序捕获的下载，以及链接上的<g3>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载</g3>，将发送到服务器而不是此电脑。浏览器的 Cookie 不会发送到服务器：需要您登录网站的下载仍将在此电脑上进行。

f9b1393934105e30.source: Yes. The portable download is a zip: unzip it anywhere, a USB stick included, and run it. Your downloads list and settings stay in its own <x1/> folder, so nothing is written to the computer. See <g2>Portable mode</g2>.
f9b1393934105e30.text: 是的。便携式下载是一个 zip 文件：将其解压到任何地方，包括 U 盘，然后运行即可。您的下载列表和设置会保留在其自己的<x1/>文件夹中，因此不会写入计算机。请参阅<g2>便携模式</g2>。

f9b69f7e0c72df10.text: 预期用途 — Mister Download Manager

f9c366e9c3fc0557.source: Check <g1>Options → Connection</g1>. A low <g2>Default max. conn. number</g2>, or an exception for the server, means fewer connections. Rows marked <g3>(auto)</g3> are servers that refused more connections; MDM can't do more there.
f9c366e9c3fc0557.text: 检查<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>。如果<g2>默认最大连接数</g2>较低，或为该服务器设置了例外，连接数就会较少。标记为<g3>(auto)</g3>的行表示服务器拒绝了更多连接；MDM 无法再增加连接数。

f9d1377f746da798.source: No features were removed, only an old label and some bulky files.
f9d1377f746da798.text: 没有移除任何功能，只移除了一个旧标签和一些臃肿的文件。

f9de9c27524eaf61.source: No. MDM doesn't break copy protection (DRM), by design. Videos that are protected stay protected. See also <g1>what MDM is made for</g1>.

fadf100dc83489b4.source: The <g1>Categories</g1> pane will read as a tree, each category with its count, open or shut, and the menu bar and every right-click menu as menus whose items can be run. Screen readers will reach every row of a list, not only those in view, with its place ("12 of 40"), and lists such as Download video's qualities and Add torrent's files will read with their names and ticks. A window will show its contents the first time a screen reader reads it, and a drop-down's choice can be set by its text. In dark mode, grey notes and error texts will have the 4.5:1 contrast WCAG asks for. <g2>View → Theme</g2> adds <g3>High contrast</g3>: black and white, a bright accent, every edge drawn, text at 7:1 or more (see <g4>themes</g4>). <g5>View → Interface size</g5> will make every window larger, from 100 % to 200 % on top of the system's display scale, with <g6>Ctrl +</g6>, <g7>Ctrl −</g7> and <g8>Ctrl 0</g8> in any MDM window, as in a browser; a window larger than the screen scrolls the rest.
fadf100dc83489b4.text: “<g1>类别</g1>”窗格将以树状结构读取，每个类别及其计数（打开或关闭）都会被读出；菜单栏和所有右键菜单都将作为可执行项目的菜单被读取。屏幕阅读器将读取列表的每一行，而不仅仅是可见的行，并显示其位置（“40 个中的第 12 个”）；“下载视频”的画质列表和“添加种子”的文件列表将连同其名称和勾选状态一起被读取。屏幕阅读器首次读取窗口时，将显示其内容；下拉菜单的选择可以通过其文本进行设置。在深色模式下，灰色注释和错误文本将满足 WCAG 要求的 4.5:1 对比度。<g2>视图 → 主题</g2>增加了<g3>高对比度</g3>：黑白配色、明亮的强调色、所有边缘都已绘制、文本对比度达到 7:1 或更高（参见<g4>主题</g4>）。<g5>视图 → 界面大小</g5>将使每个窗口更大，在系统显示缩放的基础上从 100% 放大到 200%，在任何 MDM 窗口中，都可以像在浏览器中一样使用<g6>Ctrl +</g6>、<g7>Ctrl −</g7>和<g8>Ctrl 0</g8>；窗口大于屏幕时，其余部分将滚动显示。

fb19ef868e245f12.source: <g1>Download File Info</g1> says which account a link goes through: <g2>Download through Real-Debrid (your account)</g2>, ticked. Untick it to download that one link directly, without the service. MDM looks the address up again the new way, so the name and size shown are the ones you will get. A download the browser had already started shows it unticked.
fb19ef868e245f12.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>会显示链接将使用哪个帐户下载：<g2>通过 Real-Debrid 下载（您的帐户）</g2>，默认已勾选。取消勾选即可绕过服务，直接下载该链接。MDM 会按新的方式重新查询地址，因此显示的名称和大小与实际下载的文件相符。对于浏览器已经开始的下载，该选项默认未勾选。

fb2ec8c40af11f70.source: MDM downloads BitTorrent files from magnet links and <x1/> files. Torrents appear in the same list as other downloads, marked <g2>Torrent</g2> in the <g3>Source</g3> column, and can be queued and scheduled like them.
fb2ec8c40af11f70.text: MDM 可以从磁力链接和 <x1/> 文件下载 BitTorrent 文件。种子会出现在与其他下载相同的列表中，在<g3>源</g3>列中标记为<g2>种子</g2>，并且可以像其他下载一样进行排队和计划。

fb3cc6240014e2b2.source: Install MDM with the setup and keep Set up browser integration ticked. In Firefox, then open the add-on's page on addons.mozilla.org and click Add to Firefox. In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, open its page in the Chrome Web Store and click Add to Chrome (Edge shows Get, and first asks to allow extensions from other stores). Can't use a store? Open the browser's extensions page, turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked and pick the extension\chromium folder in MDM's folder. The tutorial walks through it.
fb3cc6240014e2b2.text: 使用安装程序安装 MDM，并勾选“设置浏览器集成”。在 Firefox 中，打开 addons.mozilla.org 上的附加组件页面，然后点击“添加到 Firefox”。在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中，打开 Chrome 网上应用店中的扩展程序页面，然后点击“添加到 Chrome”（Edge 显示“获取”，并首先询问是否允许来自其他商店的扩展程序）。无法使用商店？打开浏览器的扩展程序页面，开启“开发者模式”，选择“加载已解压的扩展程序”，然后选择 MDM 文件夹中的 extension\chromium 文件夹。教程会详细介绍此过程。

fb3db059de68f3ae.source: <g1>Open the post to download it</g1> (amber): the video sits in a feed and can't be downloaded from there. <g2>Open post</g2> opens the post in a new tab, when the button knows it; use the button there.
fb3db059de68f3ae.text: <g1>打开帖子以下载</g1>（琥珀色）：视频位于信息流中，无法从此处下载。<g2>打开帖子</g2>会在新标签页中打开帖子（如果按钮知道的话）；请在那里使用该按钮。

fb3ecd729cffd5f6.source: Paste a link from a file host your service supports, in <g1>Add URL</g1>, from the browser's <g2>Download with Mister Download Manager</g2>, or in a batch download. MDM unlocks it through your account, then downloads it with all its connections, pause and resume. When the direct link expires, MDM asks the service for a new one.
fb3ecd729cffd5f6.text: 在<g1>添加 URL</g1>中、从浏览器的<g2>使用 Mister Download Manager 下载</g2>中，或在批量下载中，粘贴您的服务支持的文件主机链接。MDM 会通过您的账户解锁该链接，然后用所有连接、暂停和恢复功能下载它。当直链过期时，MDM 会向服务请求一个新的链接。

fb46e7fbf2c2ba8f.source: Hand MDM a pile of links or a Google Drive link and let it get on with it.
fb46e7fbf2c2ba8f.text: 将一堆链接或 Google Drive 链接交给 MDM，让它自行处理。

fb6dfabb22d14f78.source: MDM downloads torrents itself, with no second program to install. Pick the files you want, watch the peers and the pieces come in, and keep sharing if you like.
fb6dfabb22d14f78.text: MDM 自身即可下载种子，无需安装第二个程序。您可以选择所需文件，查看对等点和分块的接收情况，并根据需要继续共享。

fb7be2f77bb10a9c.text: MDM 必须正在运行（它可以驻留在通知区域）。电脑必须处于睡眠状态，而不是已关机。

fb833006931d511e.text: MDM 有我的语言版本吗？

fb8c39302dc9ca78.source: Video pages and image galleries need helpers that the image doesn't include. Nothing opens a window, so a download that would ask a question, such as a duplicate, takes the choice set in the settings, or isn't added. Don't publish the port on the internet: reach your home network through a VPN instead.
fb8c39302dc9ca78.text: 视频页面和图片库需要镜像中不包含的辅助程序。没有任何窗口会打开，因此需要提问的下载（例如重复文件）会根据设置中选择的选项进行处理，或者不被添加。请勿将端口发布到互联网：请通过 VPN 访问您的家庭网络。

fb93d324a1845a73.source: Copy this prompt into your AI assistant and describe the look you want at its end. It gives the assistant the format, the keys and the rules: readable text and a visible focus in both sides, and nothing copied from anyone else's artwork. Look at both sides yourself before you share the result.
fb93d324a1845a73.text: 将此提示复制到您的 AI 助手，并在末尾描述您想要的外观。它会为助手提供格式、键和规则：两面都应有可读的文本和可见的焦点，并且不复制任何其他人的作品。在分享结果之前，请您自己查看两面。

fb9449981aa5fe8f.source: MDM never writes into a file that's already there without asking.
fb9449981aa5fe8f.text: 未经询问，MDM 绝不会写入已存在的文件。

In English the list keeps IDM's own date text (<x6/>), on the system's 12- or 24-hour clock (<x7/>).
fbb8c948c7d5543c.text: 列表中（<g2>上次尝试日期</g2>、<g3>已添加</g3>）和计划程序中的<g1>日期和时间</g1>默认遵循系统区域设置（在 Windows 上为<g4>设置 → 时间和语言 → 语言和区域 → 区域格式</g4>；在 macOS 和 Linux 上为您的语言常用方式），或者您可以在<g5>选项 → 区域</g5>中自定义日期顺序、时钟和每周的第一天。在英文界面中，列表会保留 IDM 自己的日期文本（<x6/>），并使用系统的 12 小时制或 24 小时制（<x7/>）。

fbba8f18d2fae06e.text: 可输入时文本框的底线

fbc41fd4efa0fd9a.source: Download a video; <x1/> takes a quality's selector from <x2/> (<x3/> = the best single file; <x4/> = the sound alone as the site has it, not converted; <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/> or <x8/> = the sound as an MP3 at that bitrate, <x9/> at its best variable one; <x10/> = as Opus; <x11/> = as FLAC, lossless but no better than the site's sound; conversions need ffmpeg). <x12/>: MDM's own downloader brings each stream yt-dlp finds over this many connections (8 by default, 1 to 128), a stream in pieces (HLS, DASH) this many pieces at once. <x13/> saves subtitles beside it: language codes from <x14/> (<x15/>), or <x16/> for every one the uploader gave; <x17/> takes the site's automatic captions instead; <x18/> puts them into the video (needs ffmpeg, MP4 or MKV). <x19/> sends the downloads' connections, and yt-dlp's (and ffmpeg's), through one network adapter, as for <x20/>; when it isn't connected, nothing starts.
fbc41fd4efa0fd9a.text: 下载视频；<x1/> 从 <x2/> 获取画质选择器（<x3/> = 最佳单一文件；<x4/> = 网站提供的纯音频，不转换；<x5/>、<x6/>、<x7/> 或 <x8/> = 该比特率的 MP3 音频，<x9/> 为最佳可变比特率；<x10/> = Opus 格式；<x11/> = FLAC 格式，无损但音质不优于网站源；转换需要 ffmpeg）。<x12/>：MDM 自己的下载器通过这么多连接（默认 8 个，1 到 128 个）下载 yt-dlp 找到的每个流，HLS、DASH 等分段流则同时下载这么多片段。<x13/> 将字幕保存到旁边：语言代码来自 <x14/>（<x15/>），或 <x16/> 表示上传者提供的所有字幕；<x17/> 改为获取网站的自动字幕；<x18/> 将字幕嵌入视频中（需要 ffmpeg，MP4 或 MKV 格式）。<x19/> 通过一个网络适配器发送下载连接以及 yt-dlp（和 ffmpeg）的连接，如 <x20/>；如果未连接，则不开始任何操作。

fbc5c79e5fad811f.text: <g1>VS Code</g1>：在<x2/>中，或在命令面板中选择<g3>MCP: 添加服务器</g3>：

fc0380f46b815fa6.source: <g1>A stream sent in many small pieces</g1> (HLS, DASH, as most sites other than YouTube send theirs) comes down that many pieces at once, each kept on disk as it arrives, then joined in order into one file, as yt-dlp joins them. Pieces encrypted with AES-128 are decrypted with the key the stream's playlist names. When their addresses expire, MDM asks yt-dlp for the stream's new list and carries on with the pieces still missing.
fc0380f46b815fa6.text: <g1>以许多小分块发送的流</g1>（HLS、DASH，大多数网站（YouTube 除外）都采用这种方式）会同时下载许多分块，每个分块在到达时都保存在磁盘上，然后按顺序合并成一个文件，就像 yt-dlp 合并它们一样。用 AES-128 加密的分块会用流播放列表指定的密钥解密。当它们的地址过期时，MDM 会向 yt-dlp 请求流的新列表，并继续下载仍缺失的分块。

fc6142664ebe25bc.text: 其他免费选项：Free Download Manager、AB Download Manager、Motrix、Neat Download Manager、Prism、JDownloader 2、Xtreme Download Manager、Gopeed 和 DOWNitUP。<g1>查看它们如何对比</g1>。

fc67345a4f529039.source: Choose whether to install for you only or for everyone on the computer. For you only needs no administrator rights and goes to <x1/>. For everyone goes to <x2/>.
fc67345a4f529039.text: 选择是仅为您安装还是为计算机上的所有人安装。仅为您安装不需要管理员权限，并会安装到 <x1/>。为所有人安装会安装到 <x2/>。

fc6db4c952b51150.source: Everything can be done from the keyboard, and MDM works with screen readers (such as Narrator and NVDA on Windows): its windows, dialogs and menus tell them what each control is and its state, and the download list reads each download's name, status and size. The <g1>Categories</g1> pane reads as a tree (each category with its count, open or shut, selected or not), and the menu bar and every right-click menu as menus whose items can be run from there. On Linux, screen readers (Orca) don't read MDM's windows yet; the keyboard works there as everywhere.
fc6db4c952b51150.text: MDM 支持屏幕阅读器（如 Windows 上的“讲述人”和 NVDA），所有操作均可通过键盘完成：其窗口、对话框和菜单会告知屏幕阅读器每个控件的名称和状态，下载列表会朗读每个下载任务的名称、状态和大小。<g1>类别</g1>窗格会以树状结构朗读（每个类别及其数量、展开或折叠、选中或未选中），菜单栏和所有右键菜单也会作为菜单朗读，其项目可直接运行。在 Linux 上，屏幕阅读器（Orca）尚无法朗读 MDM 的窗口；但键盘操作与其他地方一样有效。

fc9568529f8e5d11.source: MDM offers the same choice again for the next video when it has that language.
fc9568529f8e5d11.text: 下一个视频有相同语言的字幕时，MDM 会再次提供相同的选择。

fcac3d319058fc98.source: Options on its File types page: the file types the browser hands to MDM and the sites it leaves alone
fcac3d319058fc98.text: “选项”的“文件类型”页面：浏览器移交给 MDM 的文件类型以及不受 MDM 处理的网站。

fcb81f195c182b37.source: Categories in Mister Download Manager: each file type in its own folder, Finished and Unfinished at a glance, and categories of your own.
fcb81f195c182b37.text: Mister Download Manager 中的类别：按文件类型分类，已完成和未完成一目了然，以及您自己的自定义类别。

fcd7edd5083864fc.source: The main window in the Luna theme

fd2f8ecc1dec89a7.source: Does it keep uploading after a torrent finishes? — Mister Download Manager
fd2f8ecc1dec89a7.text: 种子下载完成后会继续上传吗？— Mister Download Manager

fd36b355f1d75039.source: In Safari open <g1>Settings → Extensions</g1> and tick <g2>Mister Download Manager</g2>. Click <g3>Always Allow on Every Website</g3>: the extension needs to read the site to pass your sign-in on.
fd36b355f1d75039.text: 在 Safari 中打开<g1>设置 → 扩展</g1>，然后勾选<g2>Mister Download Manager</g2>。点击<g3>始终允许在每个网站上</g3>：扩展程序需要读取网站才能传递您的登录信息。

fd40efe02c1179f3.source: The examples use Windows' paths; on macOS and Linux the programs have the same names without <x1/>.
fd40efe02c1179f3.text: 示例使用 Windows 路径；在 macOS 和 Linux 上，程序名称相同，不带 <x1/>。

fd63eb3e402437d2.source: <g1>First and last pieces first</g1> — with <g2>Download in order</g2>, each file's first and last pieces come before the rest. It's on by default.
fd63eb3e402437d2.text: <g1>先下载首尾分块</g1> — 启用<g2>按顺序下载</g2>时，每个文件的首尾分块会优先于其他分块下载。此功能默认开启。

fd66ec497d4a47d6.source: <g1>Ghost windows while a menu is open</g1> (issue #4): faded copies of the main window titled "egui window" opened and closed with every redraw of an open menu, and the toolbar's hover flickered under them. On a Mac in full screen they opened a space of their own and froze MDM (issue #5). They came with 0.2.0's menu keyboard support, which asked about a submenu's window that wasn't open, and that made one.
fd66ec497d4a47d6.text: <g1>菜单打开时出现的幽灵窗口</g1>（问题 #4）：每次打开的菜单重绘时，标题为“egui window”的主窗口褪色副本都会打开又关闭，工具栏的悬停效果也在这些副本下方闪烁。在 Mac 全屏模式下，这些窗口会占用自己的空间并导致 MDM 卡死（问题 #5）。这些窗口是在 0.2.0 添加菜单键盘支持时出现的：该功能会查询一个未打开的子菜单窗口，结果导致窗口被创建。

fd7c2bd567899d89.source: Buttons fit their text in every language.
fd7c2bd567899d89.text: 按钮文本在所有语言中都能正确显示。

fd8d00a1a895c664.source: RSS feeds: the boxes on the <g1>Download rules</g1> tab (<g2>Episodes</g2>, <g3>Must contain</g3> and the others) keep the keyboard while you type, instead of losing it after each key (<g4>#353</g4>).
fd8d00a1a895c664.text: RSS 源：在<g1>下载规则</g1>选项卡上的文本框（<g2>剧集</g2>、<g3>必须包含</g3>及其他）中输入时，键盘焦点会保持不变，而不是在每次按键后丢失（<g4>#353</g4>）。

fd9104eaf35b319b.source: Run in the notification area: start hidden, hide progress windows — Mister Download Manager
fd9104eaf35b319b.text: 在通知区域运行：隐藏启动，隐藏进度窗口 — Mister Download Manager

fd9436eee4e48316.source: To set a time, click a part of it (hours, minutes, seconds) and use the arrows, the mouse wheel, <g1>Up</g1> / <g2>Down</g2> or the number keys. <g3>Left</g3> and <g4>Right</g4> move between the parts.
fd9436eee4e48316.text: 要设置时间，请点击时间的一部分（小时、分钟、秒），然后使用箭头、鼠标滚轮、<g1>向上</g1>/<g2>向下</g2>键或数字键。<g3>向左</g3>和<g4>向右</g4>键可在各部分之间移动。

fda2cfaa8ff38501.source: Changed your mind? <g1>Options → Save to → Restore the built-in categories</g1> brings them back as they came, and leaves your own categories alone. <g2>General</g2> and <g3>Torrents</g3> still change only their folder.
fda2cfaa8ff38501.text: 改变主意了？<g1>选项 → 保存到 → 恢复内置类别</g1>可将它们恢复到初始状态，同时保留您自己的类别。<g2>常规</g2>和<g3>种子</g3>仍然只能更改其文件夹。

fda43ee86c59eb8d.source: Some servers drop the connection when the speed is very low. Avoid a tight limit for servers that can't resume (<g1>Resume capability: No</g1>).
fda43ee86c59eb8d.text: 速度过低时，某些服务器会断开连接。对于无法恢复下载的服务器（<g1>恢复功能：否</g1>），请避免设置过低的限速。

fdac126a9d867074.source: <g1>Nothing to relearn.</g1> The toolbar, categories, download list, progress window, queues, Scheduler and Options sit where you expect them. Even the command-line switches are the same: <x2/>.
fdac126a9d867074.text: <g1>无需重新学习。</g1> 工具栏、类别、下载列表、进度窗口、队列、计划程序和选项都在您期望的位置。甚至命令行开关也相同：<x2/>。

fdb42bc6bffd138a.source: <g1>How it asks:</g1> gallery-dl and MDM's downloader ask sites as MDM; MDM brings 4 pictures at a time, and gallery-dl, for what's left to it, one a second at most. Wikimedia's servers refuse tools that ask much faster or without a name. gallery-dl uses no configuration file of yours.
fdb42bc6bffd138a.text: <g1>请求方式：</g1> gallery-dl 和 MDM 的下载器会以 MDM 的身份向网站发出请求；MDM 每次下载 4 张图片，而 gallery-dl 对于剩余部分，最多每秒下载一张。维基媒体的服务器会拒绝请求过快或未具名的工具。gallery-dl 不会使用您的任何配置文件。

fdcffa742865c035.text: <g1>其他所有链接</g1>都会归入<g2>各种文件</g2>。

fde4e6f4f17a1676.source: When a browser can't use its store (a computer managed by an organization, or a build of your own), add the extension by hand:
fde4e6f4f17a1676.text: 如果浏览器无法使用其应用商店（例如计算机由组织管理，或您使用的是自行构建的版本），请手动添加扩展：

fe1e9bfa950043a0.source: File Properties: change the address or the folder of a download.
fe1e9bfa950043a0.text: 文件属性：更改下载的地址或文件夹。

fe3606d7fc5eae65.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>Every connection, live</g3> <g4>Each connection drawn as it fills, with the speed and the time left. Crash-safe resume picks up where it stopped.</g4>
fe3606d7fc5eae65.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>实时显示每个连接</g3> <g4>实时显示每个连接的进度、速度和剩余时间。崩溃后可从中断处继续下载。</g4>

fe37ffc179d02087.source: <g1>docker/unraid.xml</g1> is a template: copy it to <x2/> on the flash drive, then <g3>Docker → Add Container</g3> and pick <g4>misterdownloadmanager</g4>. It maps <x5/> to <x6/>, <x7/> to a share, the port 8463, and runs as <x8/> (99:100), as Unraid's shares expect. The image must be built first (above), on the server or pushed to a registry you use. If the container's log says a folder belongs to another user, give it to <x9/> once: <x10/>.
fe37ffc179d02087.text: <g1>docker/unraid.xml</g1> 是一个模板：将其复制到闪存驱动器上的 <x2/>，然后选择 <g3>Docker → 添加容器</g3> 并选择 <g4>misterdownloadmanager</g4>。它将 <x5/> 映射到 <x6/>，将 <x7/> 映射到一个共享，端口为 8463，并以 <x8/> (99:100) 身份运行，正如 Unraid 的共享所期望的那样。镜像必须先在服务器上构建（如上所述），或者推送到您使用的注册表。如果容器日志显示某个文件夹属于其他用户，请将其一次性授予 <x9/>：<x10/>。

fe5f5f847ef5514f.source: <g1>Browser integration needs the installer.</g1> The browser finds MDM's helper through the registry, so a portable copy can't take downloads from the browser. Use <g2>Add URL</g2>, the clipboard or the drop target instead (see <g3>Adding downloads</g3>).
fe5f5f847ef5514f.text: <g1>浏览器集成需要安装程序。</g1>浏览器通过注册表查找 MDM 的辅助程序，因此便携版无法从浏览器接收下载。请改用<g2>添加 URL</g2>、剪贴板或拖放区域（请参阅<g3>添加下载</g3>）。

fe7544246e6d98cc.source: <g1><g2>The download list</g2></g1> — columns, filters, the categories tree, selecting many downloads, finding one, and deleting downloads with or without their files.
fe7544246e6d98cc.text: <g1><g2>下载列表</g2></g1> — 列、筛选器、类别树、选择多个下载、查找下载，以及删除下载时是否同时删除文件。

fe7ec4edd3453985.source: On the computer: <g1>Options → Remote → Pair a device...</g1> It shows a QR code, the address and an 8-digit code.
fe7ec4edd3453985.text: 在电脑上：<g1>选项 → 远程 → 配对设备...</g1> 它会显示一个二维码、地址和一个 8 位代码。

fe80ed54707e2242.source: Untick the addresses you don't want (<g1>Check all</g1> and <g2>Uncheck all</g2> help), then click <g3>Add to queue</g3>.
fe80ed54707e2242.text: 取消勾选不需要的地址（可使用<g1>全选</g1>和<g2>取消全选</g2>），然后点击<g3>添加到队列</g3>。

fe9f6d5e666fd9b0.text: 隐私政策 — Mister Download Manager

fea945c5c18cacc1.source: Why is MDM faster than a browser?

feaa1885a7fdd962.source: Connection: how many connections, through which network adapter.
feaa1885a7fdd962.text: 连接：通过哪个网络适配器进行多少个连接。

feb05dfc7e7f0899.source: <g1>The first window opens seconds sooner, and no longer freezes on a busy computer</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): MDM asked fontconfig for its fonts one at a time (one program for each of some thirty scripts, more each time the language list opened) while the window waited, 2 s on an idle computer and long enough on a busy one for a freeze report on the very first start. It now asks once, all together, while the rest of MDM starts.
feb05dfc7e7f0899.text: <g1>第一个窗口打开速度加快数秒，并且在繁忙的计算机上不再冻结</g1>（<g2>#164</g2> 的一部分）：MDM 之前会一次一个地向 fontconfig 请求字体（大约三十个脚本中的每个脚本一个程序，每次打开语言列表时更多），而窗口则等待，在空闲计算机上等待 2 秒，在繁忙计算机上等待足够长的时间以至于在首次启动时出现冻结报告。现在它会一次性请求所有字体，而 MDM 的其余部分则同时启动。

fec6d809554b4fd9.source: IDM vs MDM, timed to the millisecond.
fec6d809554b4fd9.text: IDM 对比 MDM，精确到毫秒。

fec76950a77c380f.source: IDM's layout and your IDM list, with torrents, video and 86 languages built in
fec76950a77c380f.text: 采用 IDM 的界面，可导入 IDM 下载列表，并内置种子下载、视频下载和 86 种语言

ff14f69242c927bf.source: Videos protected with DRM, as most paid streaming services use, can't be downloaded, and MDM doesn't try. Downloading may be against some sites' terms: checking that is up to you.
ff14f69242c927bf.text: 大多数付费流媒体服务使用的 DRM 保护视频无法下载，MDM 也不会尝试。下载可能违反某些网站的服务条款：您需要自行检查。

ff20db8e8bec6162.source: On the first start MDM asks for the language; see <g1>Languages</g1>.
ff20db8e8bec6162.text: 首次启动时，MDM 会询问要使用的语言；请参阅<g1>语言</g1>。

ff26f3ab22a86c09.source: installs or updates gallery-dl, verified in the same way.
ff26f3ab22a86c09.text: 安装或更新 gallery-dl，并以相同方式进行验证。

ff71942d9ac7e304.source: <g1>Your AI assistant, only if you connect one.</g1> MDM's MCP server (<x2/>) talks only to the MDM on your computer. But if you add it to an AI assistant (Claude, Cursor, VS Code…) and turn on the automation API, the assistant can read your download list, and what it reads (file names, addresses, folders) goes to that assistant's AI service, under its privacy terms. Nothing of this happens unless you set it up; see <g3>AI assistants</g3>.
ff71942d9ac7e304.text: <g1>您的 AI 助手，仅当您连接了一个时。</g1> MDM 的 MCP 服务器（<x2/>）只与您电脑上的 MDM 通信。但是，如果您将其添加到 AI 助手（Claude、Cursor、VS Code 等）并打开自动化 API，助手可以读取您的下载列表，它读取的内容（文件名、地址、文件夹）会根据该助手的隐私条款发送到其 AI 服务。除非您进行设置，否则不会发生这种情况；请参阅<g3>AI 助手</g3>。

ff7459be5ff75e63.source: <g1>Chrome, Edge and Brave on Windows</g1> lock their cookies to themselves (Chrome 127 and later, "app-bound encryption"), and yt-dlp can't read them while the browser is open either. The window says so; choose Firefox, or use the button over the video, which works with any browser.
ff7459be5ff75e63.text: <g1>Windows 上的 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave</g1>将其 Cookie 锁定给自己（Chrome 127 及更高版本，“应用绑定加密”），并且在浏览器打开时 yt-dlp 也无法读取它们。窗口会显示此信息；请选择 Firefox，或使用视频上方的按钮，该按钮适用于任何浏览器。

ff91da638125787d.source: The download list with its columns: Source, File Name, Q, Size, Status, Time left, Transfer rate and more
ff91da638125787d.text: 下载列表及其列：源、文件名、队列、大小、状态、剩余时间、传输速率等

ffa0b11d5591b771.source: Can it download a video's subtitles? — Mister Download Manager
ffa0b11d5591b771.text: 可以下载视频字幕吗？— Mister Download Manager

ffbc009bfa4aa85a.source: Drag a link from your browser onto it. MDM adds it as if you had used <g1>Add URL</g1>.
ffbc009bfa4aa85a.text: 将浏览器中的链接拖到该方框上。MDM 会像您使用了<g1>添加 URL</g1>一样添加它。

ffc1ab734eab657f.source: 7z and RAR archives need 7-Zip, a free program. MDM uses it when it is installed, for split and encrypted archives too. <g1>Options → Archives</g1> says whether it was found; when it wasn't, the <g2>7-Zip needed</g2> window says so, with a <g3>Get 7-Zip</g3> button. RAR's own extraction code can't be part of a free program like MDM, which is why it asks 7-Zip.
ffc1ab734eab657f.text: 7z 和 RAR 压缩包需要 7-Zip，这是一个免费程序。MDM 在安装 7-Zip 后会使用它，也支持分卷和加密压缩包。<g1>选项 → 压缩包</g1>会显示是否已找到 7-Zip；如果未找到，<g2>需要 7-Zip</g2>窗口会提示，并提供<g3>获取 7-Zip</g3>按钮。RAR 自身的解压代码不能作为 MDM 这种免费程序的一部分，因此需要 7-Zip。

ffde1525f0903fb6.source: General: how MDM starts, and what it takes from the clipboard and the browsers.
ffde1525f0903fb6.text: 常规：MDM 如何启动，以及它从剪贴板和浏览器中获取什么。

ffe6d971c9f20725.source: Step by step in the help

ffeedec50b9a371f.source: For a download already in the list, <g1>File Properties</g1> has the same choice beside the login: <g2>Through Real-Debrid</g2>. It can be changed while the download isn't running. The next start goes the new way, and continues from what is already downloaded when the file is the same.
ffeedec50b9a371f.text: 对于列表中已有的下载，<g1>文件属性</g1> 中登录信息旁边也有相同的选项：<g2>通过 Real-Debrid</g2>。下载未运行时可以更改此选项。下次启动时将改用新方式，并在文件相同时从已下载的部分继续。

fff8606bdd4112ed.source: On Linux this needs a tray, which most desktops have (KDE Plasma, Xfce, Cinnamon, Ubuntu's GNOME or GNOME with the AppIndicator extension, waybar's tray). On a desktop without one (some tiling window managers), closing the window quits MDM, since there would be nowhere to bring it back from.
fff8606bdd4112ed.text: 在 Linux 上，这需要一个托盘，大多数桌面环境都具备（KDE Plasma、Xfce、Cinnamon、Ubuntu 的 GNOME 或带有 AppIndicator 扩展的 GNOME、waybar 的托盘）。在没有托盘的桌面环境（某些平铺式窗口管理器）中，关闭窗口会退出 MDM，因为无法将其恢复。

fffd298a8c5fc91a.source: your download addresses or file names;
